sum: This study investigates the lithospheric thermal state of the Barents Sea region by integrating Curie point depth (CPD) estimates with S-wave velocity structures of the upper mantle. By analyzing magnetic anomalies and seismic velocity variations, the authors map the thermal boundary conditions and lithospheric thickness. The joint analysis of CPD and S-wave velocities provides new constraints on the deep thermal structure, highlighting regional variations in heat flow and lithospheric strength. This work offers critical insights into the tectonic evolution and geodynamics of the Arctic lithosphere.
本研究通过整合居里点深度（CPD）估算与上地幔S波速度结构，调查了巴伦支海地区的岩石圈热状态。作者通过分析磁异常和地震波速度变化，绘制了热边界条件和岩石圈厚度。CPD与S波速度的联合分析为深部热结构提供了新的约束，突出了热流和岩石圈强度的区域差异。该工作为北极岩石圈的构造演化和地球动力学提供了关键见……

t: Estimation of Curie point depth from magnetic anomalies combined with S-wave velocity modeling of the upper mantle.
结合磁异常估算的居里点深度与上地幔S波速度建模。
Geomagnetic anomaly data and seismic datasets covering the Barents Sea region.
覆盖巴伦支海区域的地磁异常数据和地震数据集。
Characterization of the lithospheric thermal state and deep structure beneath the Barents Sea.
表征了巴伦支海下方的岩石圈热状态和深部结构。
Resolution limits inherent to regional magnetic and seismic datasets in remote marine areas.
偏远海洋区域中区域磁力和地震数据集固有的分辨率限制。
limitations.src: General scientific context of Arctic geophysical studies

t: Joint interpretation of Curie point depth and S-wave velocity structure to constrain the Barents Sea lithospheric thermal state.
联合解释居里点深度和S波速度结构以约束巴伦支海岩石圈热状态。

kc: Mapped the Curie point depth (CPD) across the Barents Sea region using magnetic anomaly data.
Constrained the upper mantle S-wave velocity structure to characterize lithospheric thermal properties.
Revealed regional thermal variations and their correlation with tectonic features in the Arctic lithosphere.
利用磁异常数据绘制了巴伦支海地区的居里点深度（CPD）分布图。
约束了上地幔S波速度结构，以表征岩石圈的热物理性质。
揭示了北极岩石圈的区域热变化及其与构造特征的关联。
me: Spectral analysis of magnetic anomaly data to estimate the Curie point depth.
Seismic velocity modeling/tomography to determine the S-wave velocity structure of the upper mantle.
对磁异常数据进行谱分析以估算居里点深度。
利用地震波速度建模/成像技术确定上地幔S波速度结构。
de: Regional geomagnetic anomaly datasets covering the Barents Sea.
Seismic waveform or travel-time data used for S-wave velocity reconstruction.
覆盖巴伦支海区域的区域地磁异常数据集。
用于S波速度重建的地震波形或走时数据。
li: Resolution of the thermal and seismic models is limited by the sparse distribution of stations in the Arctic marine environment.
由于北极海洋环境中台站分布稀疏，热学和地震模型的解析度受到限制。

tm.why: The paper investigates the lithospheric thermal state, Curie point depth, and S-wave velocity structure of the upper mantle under the Barents Sea.
The study utilizes S-wave velocity structure of the upper mantle to gain insights into the lithospheric thermal state.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, metadata, and publication context from Tectonophysics (2026).

sum: Supervised deep-learning phase pickers suffer from degraded accuracy and poor generalization when trained on datasets with inaccurate arrival picks ('label noise'). To overcome this without requiring massive datasets or relying solely on data augmentation, this study introduces Label Noise-Contrastive Robust Learning (LaNCoR). LaNCoR projects both input seismograms and arrival-time labels into shared latent spaces, employing a multi-head self-attention 'Error Learner' to estimate and correct label distribution shifts relative to physical waveform features. Alignment is enforced via variational reparameterization (KL divergence), Random Fourier Features, and batch-wise contrastive learning across similarity matrices. Evaluated on 10,685 microseismic waveforms from three Chinese coal mines and tested for cross-region generalization on 1,019 waveforms from a fourth mine using SeisT and PhaseNet backbones, LaNCoR improves picking metrics by up to 28.8% for SeisT and 56.1% for PhaseNet under severe label noise, maintaining stability even when data augmentation fails.
针对震相拾取中人工或自动标注误差（标签噪声）降低深度学习模型泛化能力的问题，本文提出标签噪声对比稳健学习方法（LaNCoR）。该方法将地震波形和标签映射至潜在空间，利用基于多头自注意力的“误差学习器”估计并校正标签分布偏移，结合变分重参数化、随机傅里叶特征及对比学习对齐特征与标签分布。基于中国四个煤……

t: LaNCoR projects waveforms and labels into latent spaces, uses a multi-head self-attention Error Learner to correct noisy label shifts, and aligns distributions via variational reparameterization, Random Fourier Features, and contrastive learning.
将波形与标签映射至潜在空间，利用自注意力误差学习器校正标签偏移，并通过KL散度、随机傅里叶特征和对比学习对齐分布。

10,685 microseismic waveforms (500 Hz) from three Chinese coal mines for training/testing, plus 1,019 waveforms from Yingpanhao Coal Mine for cross-region generalization testing under synthetic Gaussian training label perturbations.
中国三个煤矿10,685条微震波形用于训练测试，内蒙古营盘壕煤矿1,019条波形用于跨区域泛化评估。
LaNCoR improves SeisT F1-score by up to 28.8% (average 16.3% over augmentation) and PhaseNet F1-score by up to 54.7%, while maintaining stable cross-region generalization as noise increases.
LaNCoR使SeisT和PhaseNet的F1分数最高分别提升28.8%和54.7%，并在高噪声和跨区域测试中保持稳定…
Balancing five loss functions requires heuristic greedy search, which is computationally nontrivial and may only yield locally optimal balancing coefficients.
平衡多个损失函数需依赖启发式贪婪搜索，计算复杂且可能仅获局部最优权重。

First label-noise-robust deep learning framework for seismic phase picking that aligns waveform feature and label representation distributions using contrastive learning and an attention-based Error Learner without needing massive datasets.
首次提出无需大规模数据集、通过跨模态对比学习与误差学习器对齐特征与标签分布的抗噪震相拾取训练框架。

kc: Proposes LaNCoR, a label noise-robust training framework that aligns seismic waveform features and label distributions across latent and Random Fourier Feature spaces.
Introduces a multi-head self-attention Error Learner module with gradient truncation to explicitly estimate and correct label representation shifts without corrupting waveform feature encoders.
Demonstrates significant performance gains (up to 28.8% on SeisT and 56.1% on PhaseNet) and high training stability on coal-mine microseismic data, including cross-region generalization.
提出了抗标签噪声训练框架LaNCoR，在潜在空间和随机傅里叶特征空间中对齐地震波形特征与标签分布。
设计了带梯度截断的多头自注意力“误差学习器”模块，在不破坏波形特征编码器的前提下显式估计并校正标签分布偏移。
在煤矿微震数据及跨区域泛化测试中验证了方法的高稳定性，使SeisT和PhaseNet性能分别提升最高达28.8%和56.1%。
me: Dual-space mapping of normalized seismograms and Gaussian-smoothed arrival labels into latent representations using separate encoders.
Multi-head self-attention Error Learner with detached waveform gradients to correct noisy label representations.
Variational inference reparameterization trick and KL-divergence minimization to align Gaussian distributions of features and labels.
Random Fourier Feature (RFF) projection and batch-wise cosine-similarity contrastive learning to enforce structural consistency across modalities.
利用独立编码器将归一化地震记录和高斯平滑后的到时标签双空间映射至潜在表征。
采用截断波形梯度的多头自注意力误差学习器校正含噪标签表征。
通过变分推断重参数化技巧与KL散度最小化对齐特征与标签的高斯分布。
结合随机傅里叶特征（RFF）映射与批内余弦相似度对比学习，跨模态约束全局结构一致性。
de: In-region dataset of 10,685 microseismic waveforms (500 Hz, SNR -3.4 to 32.3 dB) from Chaoyang, Mengcun, and Xingcun coal mines in China (80% train, 10% val, 10% test).
Cross-region generalization dataset of 1,019 microseismic waveforms (500 Hz, SNR 2.5 to 55.0 dB) from Yingpanhao Coal Mine in Inner Mongolia exhibiting measurable t-SNE feature shift.
Synthetic zero-mean Gaussian perturbations added to training arrival-time labels across varying noise standard deviations, evaluated on unaltered human-picked test labels using SeisT and PhaseNet.
收集山东朝阳、陕西孟村和山东星村三个煤矿共10,685条微震波形（采样率500 Hz，信噪比-3.4至32.3 dB），按8:1:1划分训练、验证与测试集。
使用内蒙古营盘壕煤矿1,019条微震波形（采样率500 Hz，信噪比2.5至55.0 dB）进行特征分布偏移下的跨区域泛化测试。
在训练集标签中加入不同强度的零均值高斯噪声，以SeisT和PhaseNet为基线模型，在保留原始人工标注的测试集上评估精确率、召回率和F1分数。
li: Balancing the five optimization loss terms requires tuning multiple hyperparameters via heuristic greedy search, which is complex and may only yield locally optimal coefficients.
The microseismic waveform datasets used in the study are proprietary and cannot be made publicly available.
平衡五个优化损失项需依赖启发式贪婪搜索调整超参数，过程较复杂且可能仅获得局部最优解。
研究中所使用的煤矿微震波形数据集受限无法公开。

tm.why: The paper introduces a novel deep-learning framework (LaNCoR) using contrastive learning and attention mechanisms to handle noisy labels in seismic phase picking.
The method directly addresses P-phase arrival-time picking of seismic waveforms, a core component of earthquake detection and catalog generation.
The methodology is evaluated on real microseismic datasets recorded across four underground coal mines in China.

ev.notes: Full 28-page manuscript PDF read and analyzed, including mathematical formulations, experimental setup, 10 figures, and discussion.

sum: This study presents a comprehensive geodetic dataset of 920 ITRF2020 coordinates and 509 secular velocities in central Greece and the Peloponnese, spanning 1990–2024 across permanent stations, triangulation pillars, and ground markers. Data were processed with GIPSY 6.4 using Precise Point Positioning and explicitly corrected for co-seismic and post-seismic displacements. Self-centring systems significantly improve precision, achieving 0.2 mm/yr velocity uncertainty after 12 years compared to 20 years without self-centring; after 25 years, campaign points match permanent station precision (<0.15 mm/yr). The campaign velocities validate the permanent-station-derived HELVEL crustal block model while resolving localized strain gradients near block boundaries. Furthermore, a seven-parameter transformation aligns 1960s–70s triangulation coordinates of 424 pillars to ITRF2020 with a 0.134 m mean scatter, enabling transformation of all 9,729 regional pillars and validating the HG2023 geoid to 0.184 m RMS.
本文发布了希腊中部和伯罗奔尼撒半岛1990–2024年间的920个ITRF2020大地测量点坐标和509个长期速度数据集。利用GIPSY 6.4软件处理GNSS数据，并显式校正了同震和震后位移。结果表明，强制对中装置显著提高了精度，12年即可达到0.2 mm/yr的速度精度，25年后流动观测点精度可……

t: GNSS data (1992–2024) were processed via Precise Point Positioning using GIPSY 6.4, corrected for earthquake co- and post-seismic displacements, and fitted by least-squares to obtain secular velocities.
采用GIPSY 6.4进行PPP解算，扣除同震和震后位移后，通过最小二乘线性拟合获取长期速度。
920 geodetic points surveyed between 1990 and 2024 across central Greece and the Peloponnese, comprising permanent stations, HMGS triangulation pillars, and bedrock markers, yielding 509 velocities.
1990–2024年间希腊中部和伯罗奔尼撒半岛920个测点的GNSS数据及509个速度矢量。

Velocity uncertainties stabilise between 0.12 and 0.15 mm/yr after 20+ years; self-centring points reach 0.2 mm/yr accuracy in 12 years versus 20 years without, matching permanent stations after 25 years.
20年以上序列速度不确定度稳定在0.12–0.15 mm/yr；强制对中点12年达0.2 mm/yr精度。

For single-epoch older campaign points, coordinate propagation to 2020.0 is limited by HELVEL block model biases (~1 mm/yr average residuals), and 7-parameter triangulation transformations omit earthquake displacements.
早期单期测点受限于HELVEL模型残差（~1 mm/yr），且三角点转换未扣除地震位移。

High spatial density and 35-year duration of campaign GNSS observations explicitly corrected for co- and post-seismic transients, plus ITRF2020 transformation of 9,729 historical triangulation pillars.
长达35年的高密度流动GNSS观测并显式扣除地震瞬态变形，且转换了9,729个历史三角点。

kc: Compiled 920 ITRF2020 coordinates (epoch 2020.0) and 509 earthquake-corrected secular velocities from 35 years of GNSS data in Greece.
Quantified the impact of self-centring systems, showing they reach 0.2 mm/yr accuracy in 12 years versus 20 years for standard markers.
Validated the HELVEL crustal block model using independent campaign velocities and identified tectonic strain gradients along block boundaries.
Derived a 7-parameter transformation to convert 9,729 historical triangulation pillars (1960s–70s) into ITRF2020 with ~0.15 m horizontal accuracy and validated the HG2023 geoid.
汇编了希腊35年GNSS观测的920个ITRF2020坐标（2020.0历元）和509个经地震校正的长期速度。
量化了强制对中系统的优势，证明其仅需12年即可达到0.2 mm/yr精度（非强制对中需20年）。
利用流动观测速度验证了HELVEL地壳块体模型，并识别出块体边界处的构造应变梯度。
推导了七参数转换模型，将9,729个20世纪60-70年代的三角测量墩坐标转换至ITRF2020（水平精度约0.15 m），并评估了HG2023大地水准面精度。
me: Precise Point Positioning (PPP) processing of GNSS data (1992–2024) using JPL's GIPSY 6.4 software and double-difference local ties via GAMIT/Ashtech.
Explicit correction of campaign coordinate time series for co-seismic and post-seismic displacements using permanent-station-constrained earthquake models.
Least-squares linear trend fitting to extract secular velocities and epoch 2020.0 reference coordinates.
Seven-parameter Helmert transformation between 1960s–70s HMGS triangulation coordinates and ITRF2020 GNSS coordinates.
使用JPL的GIPSY 6.4软件对1992–2024年GNSS数据进行精密单点定位（PPP）解算，并结合GAMIT/Ashtech进行双差局部联测。
利用固定站约束的地震模型，显式校正流动点坐标时间序列中的同震和震后瞬态位移。
通过最小二乘线性拟合提取长期构造速度及2020.0参考历元坐标。
建立20世纪60-70年代HMGS三角测量坐标与ITRF2020 GNSS坐标之间的七参数转换模型。
de: 35 years (1990–2024) of GNSS campaign and continuous observations across 920 sites (permanent stations, HMGS triangulation pillars, and cemented bedrock markers).
Historical 1960s–70s triangulation coordinates and levelled heights for 9,729 Hellenic Military Geographical Service (HMGS) pillars, with 424 resurveyed by GNSS.
1990–2024年间920个测点（含固定站、HMGS三角测量墩和基岩标石）长达35年的GNSS流动与连续观测数据。
希腊军事地理局（HMGS）9,729个测量墩的20世纪60-70年代三角测量坐标与水准高程数据（其中424个墩进行了GNSS重测）。
li: Points surveyed in only a single older campaign (e.g., 1997) rely on the HELVEL block model for epoch propagation, introducing ~1 mm/yr residual uncertainties.
Ground markers along roads suffer from vegetation masking, host rock fracturing, and destruction by human activity.
The seven-parameter transformation of historical triangulation pillars does not correct for co-seismic displacements occurring between 1965 and 2020.
仅在早期单期（如1997年）观测的测点依赖HELVEL模型推算至参考历元，受模型约1 mm/yr残差限制。
沿路布设的地面标石易受植被遮挡、基岩破裂及人类活动破坏的影响。
历史三角测量墩的七参数转换未扣除1965至2020年间发生的地震同震位移。

tm.why: Provides a dense GNSS velocity field to characterize crustal block kinematics and active tectonic deformation in central Greece and the Peloponnese.
Resolves secular strain distribution at the scale of individual active faults after correcting for co-seismic and post-seismic transients.

ev.notes: Full manuscript PDF (20 pages) including text, references, and Figures 1-6 was used as primary evidence.

sum: Continental geoneutrino detectors are dominated by crustal radiogenic signals, limiting constraints on mantle heat production. This paper presents the concept, prototype hardware, and simulation studies for a mobile Ocean-Bottom Detector (OBD) using Linear Alkyl Benzene (LAB) liquid scintillator. Deployed at abyssal depths far from continents and nuclear reactors, the OBD achieves a 50–100-fold reduction in crustal background, making ~70% of the detected signal mantle-derived. Lab tests show LAB+PPO scintillator light yield increases by ~8.6% at 4°C compared to 20°C. Trade studies of 1.5-kt and 17-kt cylindrical designs evaluate structural creep, backgrounds, and costs. Furthermore, incorporating 6Li/Gd doping and directional pattern-matching algorithms enables resolving heat-producing element (HPE) enrichments inside Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs). Beyond geophysics, this relocatable deep-sea observatory supports supernova neutrino detection, variable-baseline oscillation physics, and maritime nuclear nonproliferation monitoring.
陆基地球中微子探测器受地壳信号主导，难以约束地幔生热。本文提出深海移动式液体闪烁体中微子探测器（OBD）的设计、原型测试与模拟研究。通过在大洋深处部署，地壳本底可降低50–100倍，使地幔信号占比达70%。实验表明，LAB+PPO闪烁体在4°C深海温度下光产额比20°C提高约8.6%。研究对比了1.……

t: The Ocean-Bottom Detector uses Linear Alkyl Benzene (LAB) liquid scintillator inside an acrylic vessel surrounded by buffer oil and PMTs to detect mantle geoneutrinos via inverse beta decay, augmented by directional pattern-matching reconstruction.
采用装有LAB液体闪烁体的亚克力容器、缓冲油和光电倍增管，通过反β衰变及方向模式匹配算法探测地幔中微子。

Evaluations combine Geant4 simulations of 1.5-kt and 17-kt detectors at the mid-Pacific ALOHA site with laboratory cooling experiments (4°C vs 20°C) on LAB+PPO scintillator and optical tests of a 12-liter prototype vessel.
结合中太平洋ALOHA站位1.5和17千吨探测器的Geant4模拟、4°C低温闪烁体实验及12升原型机测试。

Deep-ocean deployment suppresses crustal background 50–100-fold, yielding a 70% mantle signal fraction. Cooling LAB+PPO (3.0 g/L) to 4°C increases scintillation response by ~8.6%. A 17-kt detector excludes zero mantle signal at 4.2σ in 3 months.
深海部署将地壳本底降低50–100倍（地幔信号占70%）；4°C下闪烁响应提高约8.6%；17千吨探测器3个月可达4.2…
Geoneutrinos from the 40K decay chain cannot be detected because their energies lie below the 1.8 MeV inverse beta decay threshold, requiring reliance on assumed K/U ratios.
40K衰变链地球中微子能量低于1.8 MeV探测阈值而无法直接测量，需依赖假定的K/U比值。

Rejuvenates the deep-ocean mobile neutrino observatory concept as an application-specific geoscience instrument, backed by new prototype hardware, low-temperature scintillator tests, and directional sensitivity to LLVPs.
提出面向地球科学的深海可移动中微子探测器方案，完成了低温闪烁体测试、原型机研制及LLVP方向成像评估。

kc: Proposes an application-specific mobile deep-ocean neutrino detector (1.5–17 kt) achieving a 50–100x reduction in crustal geoneutrino background.
Demonstrates experimentally that LAB+PPO liquid scintillator light yield increases by ~8.6% when cooled to deep-ocean temperatures (4°C vs 20°C).
Constructs and tests a 12-liter stainless-steel/acrylic prototype detector and establishes structural stress/creep baselines for 10-year operation at 40 MPa.
Quantifies sensitivity to deep-mantle chemical heterogeneity (LLVPs) using directional inverse beta decay detection and profile likelihood ratio tests.
提出专用深海移动式地球中微子探测器（1.5–17千吨）方案，将地壳地球中微子本底降低50–100倍。
实验证明LAB+PPO液体闪烁体在4°C深海低温下的闪烁光产额比20°C提高约8.6%。
研制并测试了12升不锈钢/亚克力原型探测器，建立了40 MPa水压下10年服役期的结构应力与蠕变基准。
利用方向敏感反β衰变检测和似然比检验，量化了探测器对地幔大型低速省（LLVP）化学异质性的分辨能力。
me: Inverse beta decay (IBD) antineutrino detection using Linear Alkyl Benzene (LAB) + PPO liquid scintillator surrounded by buffer oil and PMTs.
Geant4 Monte Carlo simulations of signal, reactor, cosmogenic, and (alpha, n) backgrounds for 1.5-kt and 17-kt cylindrical detector geometries.
Laboratory Compton-scattering measurements (137Cs source) of liquid scintillator light yield and transmittance at 4°C and 20°C.
Structural stress and acrylic creep modeling under 40 MPa hydrostatic pressure for a cylindrical stainless-steel tank and inner acrylic vessel.
Directional neutrino reconstruction via neutron-capture doping (6Li/Gd), pattern-matching algorithms, and Asimov dataset profile likelihood testing for LLVP imaging.
基于线性烷基苯（LAB）+PPO液体闪烁体、缓冲油及光电倍增管（PMT）的反β衰变（IBD）反中微子探测方法。
利用Geant4蒙特卡洛方法模拟1.5千吨和17千吨圆柱形探测器的地球中微子信号及反应堆、宇宙线和(α, n)本底。
利用137Cs伽马源康普顿散射实验测定4°C和20°C下液体闪烁体的光产额与透光率。
在40 MPa静水压力下对圆柱形不锈钢外罐与内部亚克力容器进行结构应力与长期蠕变建模分析。
结合中子俘获掺杂（6Li/Gd）、模式匹配方向重建算法与Asimov数据集剖面似然比检验，进行LLVP成像灵敏度评估。
de: Modeled antineutrino interaction spectra at the mid-Pacific Station ALOHA deep-ocean site (22.8°N, 158.0°W, 4.7 km depth).
Low-temperature scintillation performance tests in a 100 ml airtight stainless-steel cell at 4°C and 20°C across varying PPO concentrations.
Optical performance testing and Geant4 validation of a 12-liter cylindrical prototype detector at Tohoku University.
Simulated sensitivity tests comparing a homogeneous mantle (H0) against HPE-enriched Pacific and African LLVPs (H1) using CRUST1.0.
中太平洋ALOHA深海站位（22.8°N, 158.0°W，水深4.7 km）的反中微子相互作用能谱建模。
在100 ml密封不锈钢容器中进行不同PPO浓度下4°C与20°C的低温闪烁性能测试。
东北大学12升圆柱形原型探测器的光学性能测试与Geant4模拟验证。
基于CRUST1.0地壳模型，对比均匀地幔（H0）与富集生热元素的太平洋/非洲LLVP模型（H1）的模拟灵敏度测试。
li: Potassium-40 (40K) geoneutrinos cannot be detected because their decay energies fall below the 1.8 MeV inverse beta decay threshold.
Detailed fluid-structure coupling for internal liquids and photosensors was deferred during preliminary structural stress modeling.
If deployed near continental margins for reactor monitoring, local crustal geoneutrinos and reactor fluxes dominate and obscure the mantle signal.
40K衰变产生的中微子能量低于1.8 MeV的反β衰变反应阈值，目前无法被探测。
初步结构应力分析简化了静水压力载荷，尚未包含复杂的内部流固耦合精细建模。
若部署在大陆边缘用于核反应堆监测，局部地壳和反应堆本底将占主导，从而掩盖地幔信号。

tm.why: The detector is designed to directly measure mantle geoneutrinos to constrain Earth's radiogenic heat budget, mantle convection, and chemical heterogeneity in Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs).
The paper reports the engineering design, deep-sea structural analysis, and hardware prototyping of a mobile ocean-bottom liquid scintillator antineutrino detector.

ev.notes: Full 14-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including all 8 figures and 4 tables.

sum: This study demonstrates the capability of a single six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) station, combining co-located translational and rotational ground motions from the ROMY ring laser array, to monitor the source directions of secondary microseismic Love and Rayleigh waves. By exploiting polarization differences, the 6-DoF station separates these wave types to estimate independent backazimuths and track their seasonal variations. The results show strong agreement with traditional seismic array beamforming, particularly during North Atlantic storm migrations. A systematic bias of 25°-50° is observed relative to satellite-derived wave heights and noise source maps. This proof-of-concept highlights how portable rotation sensors can complement or replace traditional arrays for noise source characterization.
本研究展示了利用单台六自由度（6-DoF）观测（结合ROMY环形激光器阵列的平移与旋转运动）来监测二级微震中爱氏波和雷莱波波源方向的能力。通过利用极化特征，6-DoF台网能够分离这两种波并独立估计其后方位角及季节性演化。结果与传统的地震台阵波束形成方法高度一致，特别是在北大西洋风暴运移期间。与卫星测……

与地震台阵波束形成及基于卫星测高的波高模型进行对比。

Seismic array data used for comparative beamforming analysis.
Satellite altimetry data and model-based seismic noise source maps representing significant wave heights.

It utilizes a single 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) station with a ring laser rotation sensor to achieve array-like capabilities.

sum: Olivine dominates Earth's upper mantle and controls its rheology via dislocation-mediated creep. Traditional dislocation imaging uses TEM (small volume, destructive preparation) or oxidation decoration (low resolution, no Burgers vector sign). This paper demonstrates a non-destructive scanning electron microscopy workflow combining selected-area electron channeling patterns (SA-ECPs) with electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI), electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), and weighted Burgers vector (WBV) mapping. Applied to a single crystal of San Carlos olivine deformed at 1,300°C and ~50 MPa, the method images surface-threading dislocations, subsurface loops, and subgrain boundaries across bulk areas. Crucially, multi-condition ECCI and WBV reveal that low-angle subgrain boundaries are not simple planar walls of uniform edge dislocations as assumed by Read's formula (which underpredicts misorientation at 0.09° vs. ~0.26–0.29°), but complex, non-planar assemblies hosting multiple dislocation types. These microstructural observations provide key constraints for microphysical models of transient and steady-state mantle creep.
橄榄石主导上地幔流变学性质。针对传统透射电镜和氧化装饰法的局限，本文提出一种结合选区电子通道花样（SA-ECP）引导的电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）、电子背散射衍射（EBSD）及加权伯格斯矢量（WBV）分析的无损扫描电镜工作流，并应用于高温蠕变变形的圣卡洛斯橄榄石单晶。研究成功在大面积块体样品中观测到……

t: The authors combine SA-ECP-guided electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) at multiple diffraction conditions with dynamical pattern-matching EBSD and weighted Burgers vector (WBV) mapping in an SEM.
将多衍射条件下的SA-ECP引导ECCI成像与扫描电镜中的动力学花样匹配EBSD及加权伯格斯矢量（WBV）映射相结合。
A natural single crystal of San Carlos olivine (~Fo90, sample 83OL-EN3(1)) creep-deformed under uniaxial compression at 45° to [100] and [010] at 1,300°C and ~50 MPa.
在1,300°C和约50 MPa下沿[110]c方向单轴压缩蠕变变形的天然圣卡洛斯橄榄石单晶样品（约Fo90）。

Across an asymmetric tilt subgrain boundary with 303 nm dislocation spacing, SA-ECP and EBSD measure misorientations of 0.29°±0.05° and 0.26°±0.05°, departing from Read's formula (0.09°) due to four distinct mixed dislocation types.
位错间距303 nm的非对称倾转亚晶界实测取向差为0.29°和0.26°，因含4种混合位错而偏离Read公式预测值（0.…
The SA-ECP selected area is relatively large (~500 μm) due to spherical aberration, causing overlapping zone axes across multiple subgrains.
受球差影响SA-ECP选区较大（约500 μm），导致相邻亚晶带轴重叠。
First application of SA-ECP-guided ECCI combined with WBV mapping to bulk deformed olivine, achieving precise channeling control in flat geometry without switching to EBSD geometry.

kc: Demonstrates an SA-ECP-informed ECCI workflow in the SEM to non-destructively image dislocations and subgrain boundaries in bulk olivine without switching between EBSD and ECCI geometries.
Combines multi-condition ECCI with pattern-matching EBSD and weighted Burgers vector (WBV) analysis to identify multiple distinct dislocation types within individual subgrain boundaries.

Shows that Read's classical formula underestimates subgrain boundary misorientation (0.09° vs. ~0.26–0.29°) because natural/deformed olivine boundaries are complex, non-planar, mixed-dislocation assemblies.
展示了基于选区电子通道花样（SA-ECP）引导的扫描电镜ECCI工作流，无需在EBSD和ECCI几何构型间切换即可无损表征块体橄榄石中的位错和亚晶界。

me: Selected-area electron channeling pattern (SA-ECP) simulation and indexing using EMsoft and AstroECP to navigate precise electron beam channeling conditions in the SEM.
Electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) at normal incidence with small stage tilts (±5°) across multiple Kikuchi band-edge conditions.
High-resolution pattern-matching electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) and weighted Burgers vector (WBV) analysis using AstroEBSD, AZtecCrystal MapSweeper, and MTEX.
利用EMsoft和AstroECP进行选区电子通道花样（SA-ECP）动力学模拟与标定，在扫描电镜中精确导航电子束通道条件。

de: Natural single crystal of San Carlos olivine (~Fo90, sample 83OL-EN3(1)) previously creep-deformed in uniaxial compression along [110]c at 1,300°C and ~50 MPa.
SEM-ECCI micrographs and SA-ECPs acquired at 20–30 keV and 1–10 nA on a mechanically and ion-beam polished (001) surface.
Three spatially correlated EBSD datasets with step sizes of 8 μm (full sample), 150 nm (subgrain boundary), and 120 nm (local WBV analysis).
在1,300°C和约50 MPa下沿[110]c方向单轴压缩蠕变变形的天然圣卡洛斯橄榄石单晶样品（约Fo90，样品号83OL-EN3(1)）。
在机械抛光和离子束抛光的(001)晶面上，使用20–30 keV束流能量和1–10 nA束流采集的SEM-ECCI显微图像与SA-ECP花样。
步长分别为8 μm（全样品）、150 nm（亚晶界）和120 nm（局部WBV分析）的三组空间关联EBSD数据集。

Two-dimensional EBSD and surface ECCI cannot resolve the full five-parameter grain boundary habit plane normal without cross-sectioning or assumptions.
ECCI contrast is restricted to the top ~100–200 nm near-surface volume and can be weakened by surface stress relaxation.
受球差和电子束光学限制，SA-ECP的选区空间尺寸较大（约500 μm），导致相邻亚晶取向发生重叠。
二维EBSD和表面ECCI无法在不进行截面切割或假设的情况下确定完整的五参数晶界习惯面法线。
ECCI衬度仅限于近表面约100–200 nm深度内，且表面应力松弛会削弱部分位错的衬度。

tm.why: The paper characterizes dislocation substructures in creep-deformed olivine to constrain rheological flow laws and deformation mechanics of the Earth's upper mantle.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, 10 figures, and references.

sum: This study presents a comprehensive time-domain acoustic full-waveform inversion (FWI) workflow for in-vivo medical ultrasound tomography, demonstrated on cross-sectional abdominal measurements of a mouse acquired with a 512-transducer ring array (750 kHz–2.5 MHz). To overcome local minima and cycle skipping, the workflow utilizes a graph-space optimal transport (GOT) misfit functional before switching to an L2 misfit at high frequencies. Furthermore, an auxiliary regularized least-squares deconvolution using reference water shots calibrates individual transducer source-time functions, substantially improving image sharpness and reducing artifacts. The reconstructed sub-millimeter sound speed maps (resolving soft tissues at ~1540 m/s and bone up to 1940 m/s) also serve as smoothed background models for reverse-time migration (RTM) to image impedance contrasts. Finally, a computationally efficient resolution analysis using Hessian-vector products and time-shifted source encoding approximates local point-spread functions, reducing resolution assessment costs by a factor of 10.
本研究提出了一套用于体内医学超声层析成像的时域声波全波形反演（FWI）工作流，并在512换能器环形阵列采集的小鼠腹部截面数据（750 kHz–2.5 MHz）上进行了验证。为克服局部极小值和周波跳跃，该方法采用图空间最优传输（GOT）失配泛函，并在高频阶段切换为L2泛函。通过利用参考水测量数据进行辅……

t: Time-domain 2D spectral-element acoustic FWI using trust-region L-BFGS, graph-space optimal transport misfit, water-level deconvolution for transducer wavelet calibration, reverse-time migration, and source-encoded Hessian-vector products for point-spread function resolution analysis.
采用信赖域L-BFGS、图空间最优传输失配、震源子波标定、逆时偏移及震源编码黑塞向量积的二维谱元声波全波形反演。

In-vivo cross-sectional ultrasound transmission and reflection measurements through a mouse abdomen in a water bath using 512 transducers arranged on two 40 mm radius half-circles, bandpass filtered between 750 kHz and 2.5 MHz.
利用半径40 mm的512换能器环形阵列采集的小鼠腹部水浴体内超声透射与反射数据（滤波频带750 kHz–2.5 MHz…

Reconstructed sound speeds resolve mouse organs and separate the vertebral column (~1940 m/s) from soft tissue (~1540 m/s) and vertebral canal (~1520 m/s), achieving a 0.28 mm skin FWHM and 10x faster resolution analysis via 5 encoded sources.
清晰分辨小鼠器官、脊柱（约1940 m/s）与软组织（约1540 m/s），皮肤半高全宽达0.28 mm，5个编码震源将…
2D acoustic modeling neglects 3D off-plane scattering and bone elasticity, while simple time-shift source encoding suffers from cross-talk, yielding conservative resolution proxies.
二维声波假设忽略了三维面外散射和骨骼弹性，且简单时移编码存在串扰，仅提供保守的分辨率代理。

Integrates graph-space optimal transport, per-transducer wavelet calibration, reverse-time migration, and fast source-encoded Hessian point-spread function analysis into a unified in-vivo ultrasound FWI workflow.
将图空间最优传输、独立换能器子波标定、逆时偏移与快速震源编码点扩散函数分辨率分析集成于体内超声反演。

kc: Developed a practical in-vivo ultrasound FWI workflow integrating graph-space optimal transport (GOT) misfit, individual source-wavelet calibration, reverse-time migration (RTM), and resolution analysis.
Demonstrated that calibrating transducer source-time functions via water-level deconvolution of reference water shots markedly improves spatial resolution and suppresses artifacts.
Proposed an efficient perturbation-based resolution analysis using Hessian-vector products and random time-shifted source encoding, achieving a 10-fold computational speedup.

证明了利用参考水测量数据通过水准反褶积标定换能器震源时间函数可显著提高空间分辨率并抑制空间伪影。
提出了一种结合黑塞向量积与随机时移震源编码的高效微扰分辨率分析方法，实现了10倍的计算加速。
me: 2D time-domain spectral-element acoustic wave propagation and adjoint-state FWI using trust-region L-BFGS optimization.
Multiscale inversion (750 kHz to 2.5 MHz) using graph-space optimal transport (GOT) solved via a linear sum assignment problem (LSAP) followed by L2 misfit.
Frequency-domain regularized least-squares source-wavelet estimation (water-level deconvolution) prior to each frequency band.
Reverse-time migration (RTM) using a diffusion-smoothed FWI velocity model and local resolution analysis via source-encoded Hessian-vector products.
基于信赖域L-BFGS优化的二维时域谱元法声波传播模拟与伴随状态全波形反演。
结合线性分配问题（LSAP）求解的图空间最优传输（GOT）失配与L2失配的多尺度反演策略（750 kHz至2.5 MHz）。
在每个频带反演前执行频域正则化最小二乘震源子波估计（水准反褶积）。
基于扩散平滑FWI速度模型的逆时偏移（RTM）成像，以及利用震源编码黑塞向量积的局部分辨率分析。
de: In-vivo cross-sectional ultrasound dataset of an anesthetized mouse abdomen immersed in a water bath, recorded by a circular aperture of 512 transducers (40 mm radius).
Reference calibration shot in water used to invert for individual transducer source-time functions.
Bandpass-filtered waveforms across three multiscale stages (750 kHz–1.5 MHz, 750 kHz–2.1 MHz, and 750 kHz–2.5 MHz) using rotating batches of 64 sources per iteration on 72 Nvidia P100 GPUs.
浸入水浴中的麻醉小鼠腹部横截面体内超声数据集，由半径40 mm的512个换能器环形孔径采集。
用于反演单个换能器震源时间函数的纯水参考标定测量数据。

Time-domain FWI remains computationally expensive, requiring ~30 minutes per iteration at the highest frequency band on 72 GPUs.
Simple time-shift source encoding introduces cross-talk noise, providing only a conservative proxy for local resolution lengths.
二维声波方程忽略了真实三维数据中的面外散射以及骨骼中的弹性波效应。

sum: Underground structures are vulnerable to earthquakes, yet seismic fragility models reflecting shallow bedrock conditions (typical in South Korea) remain scarce because conventional Vs30 classifications overestimate soil stiffness. This study establishes a 2D nonlinear finite element model in OpenSees using the PressureDependMultiYield (PDMY) soil model and zero-length contact interfaces. Eighteen analysis cases varying soil stiffness (Vs = 360 and 150 m/s), bedrock depth (15 and 30 m), and structural embedment depth (1 to 28 m) were subjected to five earthquake records (including the 2017 Pohang event) scaled from 0.05g to 1.0g, totaling 1,800 dynamic analyses. Fragility curves derived from maximum bending moment damage indices show that seismic fragility increases with decreasing soil stiffness, increasing bedrock depth, and increasing structural embedment depth—with embedment depth being the most dominant factor. The novelty lies in incorporating Korean shallow-bedrock site criteria and evaluating direct structure-bedrock interface effects.
针对韩国等浅基岩地区传统Vs30分类高估土体刚度的问题，本研究利用OpenSees建立了考虑PDMY非线性土体本构与土-结接触界面的二维有限元模型。选取土体刚度、结构埋深和基岩深度构建18个工况，输入包含2017年浦项地震在内的5条调幅地震动（0.05g至1.0g），开展了1800次动力时程分析并提……

t: 2D nonlinear dynamic finite element analysis in OpenSees using PressureDependMultiYield soil elements, dispBeamColumn structural elements, and ZeroLengthContactASDimplex interface elements, followed by log-normal fragility regression on maximum bending moment damage indices.
利用OpenSees开展二维非线性动力有限元分析，结合PDMY土体本构与接触单元，基于弯矩损伤指数回归对数正态易损性曲线…

18 parametric soil-structure configurations (soil Vs of 360 and 150 m/s, bedrock depths of 15 and 30 m, embedment depths of 1–28 m) excited by five earthquake records scaled from 0.05g to 1.0g (1,800 runs).
包含不同波速、基岩深度和埋深的18个参数工况，输入5条从0.05g调幅至1.0g的地震动记录，共1800次动力计算。

Seismic fragility increases with lower soil stiffness, deeper bedrock, and greater embedment depth. At 0.4g PGA in S4 ground, increasing embedment from 1 m to 7 m raises minor damage probability from 20.1% to 61.2%.
易损性随土体刚度降低、基岩加深和埋深增加而增大；0.4g下埋深从1m增至7m使轻微损伤概率从20.1%升至61.2%。
The study assumes homogeneous soil layers, relies on 2D plane-strain modeling without 3D longitudinal effects, and uses PGA as the sole intensity measure.
假设土层均质，采用二维平面应变模型忽略了三维纵向效应，且仅使用PGA作为单一强度指标。

Explicitly incorporates revised Korean shallow-bedrock soil classification criteria (KDS 17 10 00) and evaluates the joint impact of embedment depth and structure-bedrock interfaces on underground box fragility.
引入韩国浅基岩场地分类标准，联合评估了结构埋深及结构-基岩直接接触界面对地下箱涵易损性的影响。

kc: Developed 18 sets of seismic fragility curves for cut-and-cover underground box structures based on revised Korean shallow-bedrock soil classification criteria (KDS 17 10 00).

Demonstrated via 1,800 nonlinear dynamic finite element analyses that structural embedment depth is the most dominant parameter governing underground box fragility, surpassing soil stiffness and bedrock depth.
Showed that conventional Vs30-based fragility curves overestimate ground stiffness in shallow bedrock regions, leading to non-conservative underestimation of structural seismic fragility.
基于韩国修订的浅基岩场地分类标准（KDS 17 10 00），开发了18组明挖地下箱型结构的地震易损性曲线。
通过1800次非线性动力有限元分析证明，结构埋深是控制地下箱涵地震易损性的最主要参数，其影响超过土体刚度和基岩深度。
阐明了传统基于Vs30的易损性曲线在浅基岩地区会高估地基刚度，从而非保守地低估结构地震易损性。
me: 2D plane-strain nonlinear dynamic finite element modeling in OpenSees using PressureDependMultiYield (PDMY) quad elements for soil and dispBeamColumn elements for the RC box structure.
Soil-structure interaction modeling with partial-slip frictional behavior via ZeroLengthContactASDimplex elements, lateral equalDOF boundaries, and bottom viscous dashpot absorbing boundaries.
1D site response validation comparing OpenSees PDMY model outputs against DeepSoil modulus reduction and damping curves.
Log-normal seismic fragility curve derivation using linear regression between ln(PGA) and logarithmic bending-moment damage indices (DI = M / My).
在OpenSees中建立二维平面应变非线性动力有限元模型，土体采用PDMY四节点单元，钢筋混凝土箱涵采用dispBeamColumn梁柱单元。
利用ZeroLengthContactASDimplex单元模拟土-结界面部分滑移摩擦行为，侧边界采用等自由度约束，底边界设置粘性阻尼器吸收边界。
开展一维场地响应验证，将OpenSees模型结果与DeepSoil模量折减及阻尼曲线结果进行对比。
基于ln(PGA)与弯矩损伤指数（DI = M / My）对数的线性回归，推导对数正态分布地震易损性曲线。
de: 18 numerical parametric cases combining 2 soil shear-wave velocities (360 and 150 m/s), 2 bedrock depths (15 and 30 m), and structural embedment depths ranging from 1 m to 28 m.
5 recorded earthquake ground motions (2017 Pohang at PHA2, Northridge at CHL, Kobe at KBU, Kocaeli at IZT, and Hachinohe) scaled to 20 intensity levels from 0.05g to 1.0g (1,800 total runs).
构建18个数值参数工况，涵盖2种土层剪切波速（360和150 m/s）、2种基岩深度（15和30 m）以及1至28 m的结构埋深。
选取5条实测地震动记录（2017浦项PHA2台站、Northridge、Kobe、Kocaeli及Hachinohe），从0.05g至1.0g调幅为20个强度等级（共1800次计算）。
li: Idealized the ground using homogeneous soil layers, neglecting depth-dependent heterogeneity and localized soft-layer arrangements.
Adopted a 2D plane-strain model that omits longitudinal structural behavior and 3D soil-structure interaction effects.
Evaluated seismic fragility using Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) as the sole intensity measure, which cannot fully capture ground motion frequency content and cumulative deformation effects.
将地层理想化为均质土层，忽略了随深度变化的异质性及局部软弱夹层分布。
采用二维平面应变模型，未考虑结构纵向响应及三维土-结相互作用效应。
仅以峰值地面加速度（PGA）作为单一地震动强度指标，难以全面反映地震动频谱特性与累积变形效应。

tm.why: The paper develops seismic fragility curves for underground box structures under scaled strong ground motions up to 1.0g to assess structural vulnerability and seismic risk.
The study performs 1,800 2D dynamic finite element simulations in OpenSees incorporating nonlinear soil behavior, absorbing boundaries, and soil-structure interaction.

ev.notes: Full 38-page PDF article in press from Scientific Reports used for all text, tables, and figure analyses. Note that in the manuscript text, table numbering jumps directly from Table 3 to Table 6 (Tables 4 and 5 are omitted by the authors).

sum: This study investigates the 3-D lithospheric structure of the Ecuadorian margin using 4,993 teleseismic P-wave receiver functions from 925 broadband and dense nodal seismic stations. Using Adaptive Common Conversion Point (ACCP) stacking with a basin-corrected 3-D velocity model, the authors image key velocity discontinuities across the forearc and volcanic arc. Within the overriding plate, a continuous interface at ~20–25 km depth across the forearc and deeper boundaries at ~40 and ~45–55 km beneath the arc indicate underthrusting of accreted oceanic terranes beneath the South American continent. Within the subducting Nazca slab, a polarity-reversed phase pair delineates an ~18–20 km thick Carnegie Ridge oceanic crust that thins to normal thickness (~8–12 km) at ~50–105 km inland. Kinematic back-projection of this extent suggests Carnegie Ridge subduction initiated relatively recently at ~2.9–4.2 Ma, correlating spatially with coastal uplift and slab-interface seismicity.
本研究利用厄瓜多尔大陆边缘925个宽频带和密集节点地震台站记录的4993条远震P波接收函数，结合盆地速度校正的三维自适应共转换点（ACCP）叠加方法，对上覆板块和俯冲板片的速度间断面进行高分辨率成像。结果显示弧前存在约20–25 km深的连续界面，火山弧下方约40 km和45–55 km处存在更深界……

t: Time-domain iterative deconvolution calculates P-wave receiver functions, which are migrated to 3-D depth volumes via Adaptive Common Conversion Point (ACCP) stacking using a basin-corrected hybrid 3-D velocity model.
利用时间域迭代反褶积计算P波接收函数，结合盆地修正的三维速度模型进行自适应共转换点（ACCP）叠加成像。

2,124 teleseismic events (Mw >= 5.5, 2016–2024) recorded across 925 three-component stations in Ecuador (57 permanent, 85 temporary broadband, and 783 dense nodal stations), yielding 4,993 high-quality receiver functions.
厄瓜多尔925个台站（含783个密集节点台站）记录的2124个远震事件，筛选出4993条高质量接收函数。

Images reveal an overriding plate interface at ~20–25 km (forearc) and ~40–55 km (arc), plus a subducting Carnegie Ridge crust (~18–20 km thick) thinning to ~8–12 km at ~50–105 km inland, implying subduction onset at ~2.9–4.2 Ma.
揭示弧前20–25 km和弧下40–55 km界面；18–20 km厚的卡内基海岭洋壳在内陆50–105 km处减薄，推…

Shallow conversion multiples interfere with deep phases beneath the eastern forearc, and RF images cannot uniquely distinguish between two plausible structural models for the deep accreted terrane suture.
浅层多次波干扰弧前东部深部震相，且图像无法唯一确定增生地体深部缝合带的单一构造模型。

Combines dense nodal and broadband arrays to continuously map 3-D lithospheric discontinuities from the coast to the arc, directly mapping the inland termination of the subducted Carnegie Ridge crust.
首次结合密集节点与宽频带台阵连续追踪从海岸到火山弧的三维界面，直接限定卡内基海岭向内陆俯冲的东界。

kc: High-resolution 3-D receiver function imaging of the Ecuadorian margin combining 783 nodal and 142 broadband stations.
Identification of a continuous ~20–25 km forearc discontinuity and ~40–55 km arc discontinuities supporting eastward underthrusting of accreted oceanic terranes.
Delineation of the ~18–20 km thick subducting Carnegie Ridge crust thinning to ~8–12 km at ~50–105 km inland, constraining ridge subduction onset to ~2.9–4.2 Ma.
结合783个密集节点台站和142个宽频带台站，实现了厄瓜多尔边缘的高分辨率三维接收函数成像。
识别出弧前约20–25 km连续界面及火山弧下约40–55 km深部界面，支持增生大洋地体向东俯冲垫托于南美大陆之下的模型。
刻画出厚约18–20 km的卡内基海岭俯冲洋壳在内陆50–105 km处减薄至8–12 km，将海岭俯冲起始时间约束在约2.9–4.2 Ma。
me: Time-domain iterative deconvolution for P-wave receiver function calculation at Gaussian widths of 2.5 and 5.0.
Instrument response removal applied to short-period nodal records to broaden effective low-frequency bandwidth.
Adaptive Common Conversion Point (ACCP) 3-D depth migration using a hybrid 3-D velocity model updated with shallow basin well-log constraints.
采用时间域迭代反褶积方法（高斯系数2.5和5.0）计算远震P波接收函数。
去除短周期节点地震仪的仪器响应以拓宽有效低频带宽并提高信噪比。
结合钻井约束更新浅部沉积盆地速度结构，利用混合三维速度模型进行自适应共转换点（ACCP）三维深度偏移叠加。
de: Teleseismic waveforms from 2,124 events (Mw >= 5.5, epicentral distance 30°–95°) recorded between 2016 and 2024.
925 three-component stations across Ecuador: 57 permanent broadband (EC), 85 temporary broadband (8G, XF), and 783 dense nodal stations (2N, XE).
4,993 quality-controlled P-wave receiver functions passing >=70% radial waveform fit and visual back-azimuthal consistency checks.
2016至2024年间记录的2124个远震事件波形（震级≥5.5，震中距30°–95°）。
横跨厄瓜多尔的925个三分量地震台站：57个固定宽频带台站（EC）、85个流动宽频带台站（8G、XF）和783个密集节点台站（2N、XE）。
通过径向拟合度（≥70%）和反方位角一致性视觉筛选的4993条高质量P波接收函数。
li: Multiples from shallow conversions (MP2_1) partially overlap with the deep P3 phase beneath the eastern forearc, making P3 lateral continuity uncertain.
Receiver function images alone cannot uniquely distinguish between the two proposed end-member models (Model I vs. Model II) for overriding plate middle-to-lower crustal architecture.
Sparser station coverage in the volcanic arc compared to the nodal-covered forearc reduces shallow conversion point density in the East.
浅部界面的多次波（MP2_1）在弧前东部与深部P3震相部分重叠，导致P3向弧前延伸的横向连续性存在不确定性。
仅凭接收函数图像无法唯一区分关于上覆板块中下地壳结构的两种可能解释模型（模型I与模型II）。
火山弧区域的台站密度低于密集节点覆盖的弧前区域，降低了东部的浅层转换点密度。

tm.why: The core methodology uses teleseismic P-wave receiver functions and Adaptive Common Conversion Point (ACCP) stacking to image lithospheric velocity discontinuities.
The paper resolves the 3-D lithospheric structure of the overriding South American plate and subducting Carnegie Ridge to constrain terrane accretion and ridge subduction timing.
The study leverages a dense combination of 925 seismic stations, including 783 dense nodal seismic array stations and 142 broadband stations.

ev.notes: Full 12-page GRL article PDF (with OCR text) was analyzed in detail, including all figures, methodology, and quantitative discussions.

sum: This paper proposes a novel geodynamic theory: a Permian (~290 Ma) oblique mega-impact by a massive ferronickel asteroid in the Tarim Basin. Using a quantitative physical model (v3.4), the author demonstrates how the impactor penetrated 35 km of crust into the mantle, depositing 2049 YJ of shock energy. This triggered a chain reaction of shock compression, decompression melting, and overpressure-driven magma transport, producing ~24.14 million km³ of melt. The model explains the Tarim Large Igneous Province, the Pamir-Iran-Turkey magmatic belt, and the Artinskian Warming Event within a single impact-induced framework, challenging conventional multi-plume and subduction models.
本文提出二叠纪（约290 Ma）塔里木超大撞击假说。定量模型表明，铁镍小行星穿透35 km地壳，释放2049 YJ能量并引发地幔减压熔融，产生超2400万立方千米熔体。超压驱动岩浆长距离运移，形成了帕米尔-伊朗-土耳其岩浆带。该研究将塔里木大火成岩省与全球变暖统一在单一撞击框架下，挑战了传统地幔柱假……

t: Quantitative physical modeling of a mega-impact, calculating shock energy deposition, decompression melting, and overpressure-driven magma transport using Manning's open-channel flow equations.
对超大撞击进行定量物理模拟，计算冲击能量沉积、减压熔融及基于曼宁公式的超压岩浆运移。
Synthetic parameters of a 180x100x90 km asteroid impact at 22 km/s, constrained by geological volumes of the Tarim Large Igneous Province.
基于180x100x90 km小行星以22 km/s撞击的合成参数，并结合塔里木大火成岩省的地质体积约束。
The impact deposited 2049 YJ of energy, producing 24.14 million km³ of melt, with 7.013 million km³ transported 4300 km via self-insulating flow.
撞击沉积了2049 YJ能量，产生2414万立方千米熔体，其中701.3万立方千米通过自保温流运移了4300公里。
Relies on simplified fluid dynamics and thermodynamic assumptions for extreme impact events without direct in-situ crater samples.
依赖于极端撞击事件的简化流体力学和热力学假设，且缺乏直接的火山口原位样品。
Unifies the Tarim Large Igneous Province, Central Asian magmatism, and Permian warming under a single impact-induced geodynamic framework.
在单一撞击诱导的地球动力学框架下，统一了解释塔里木大火成岩省、中亚岩浆活动及二叠纪变暖。

kc: Proposes the Tarim Mega Impact Event (~290 Ma) as a unified trigger for Permian magmatism and global warming.
Develops a quantitative physical model (v3.4) explaining crustal penetration, shock heating, and massive decompression melting.
Formulates a long-distance magma transport mechanism via self-insulating open-channel flow.
提出二叠纪（~290 Ma）塔里木超大撞击事件，作为该时期岩浆活动和全球变暖的统一触发机制。
开发了定量物理模型（v3.4），解释了地壳穿透、冲击加热和大规模减压熔融过程。
阐明了通过自保温明渠流进行长距离岩浆运移的物理机制。
me: Quantitative physical modeling of impact mechanics (thin-target penetration).
Thermodynamic calculations of shock energy deposition and decompression melting.
Fluid dynamics modeling of magma transport using Manning's open-channel flow equations with self-insulation.
撞击力学（薄靶穿透）的定量物理模拟。
冲击能量沉积和减压熔融的热力学计算。
利用考虑自保温效应的曼宁明渠流方程进行岩浆运移的流体力学模拟。
de: Synthetic modeling parameters based on a 180x100x90 km ferronickel asteroid impact at 22 km/s.
Geological and volume constraints from the Tarim Large Igneous Province and Central Asian Orogenic Belt.
基于180x100x90 km、速度22 km/s的铁镍小行星撞击的合成模拟参数。
来自塔里木大火成岩省和中亚造山带的地质与体积约束数据。
li: The model relies heavily on simplified physical assumptions for extremely high-energy impact processes.
Direct geological evidence for a 290 Ma impact crater in the heavily deformed Tarim Basin remains difficult to verify.
该模型在很大程度上依赖于对极高能撞击过程的简化物理假设。
在变形严重的塔里木盆地中，寻找290 Ma撞击坑的直接地质证据仍然存在困难。

tm.why: The paper proposes a mega-impact model to explain large-scale crustal penetration, mantle melting, and the formation of the Tarim Large Igneous Province.
It models a planetary impact event and its subsequent massive volcanic eruptions and environmental consequences.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: This study compares earthquake wavefield measurements from a ~95 km urban dark fiber DAS array and a collocated 16 km broadband seismic array in Dallas, Texas, using a regional M 5.2 earthquake. The authors assess ground-motion amplitude recovery and wavefield direction of arrival (DOA). They find that Rayleigh-wave amplitude ratios between broadband and DAS vary widely (0.25 to 22.15), indicating highly heterogeneous DAS coupling unrelated to fiber orientation. While DAS signal coherence is highly variable, applying hierarchical clustering to interchannel cross-correlations identifies a 36-channel subgroup that yields a Rayleigh-wave DOA within 4.5° of the broadband array's estimate. The novelty lies in the quantitative assessment of urban dark-fiber coupling heterogeneity and the demonstration of a clustering-based approach to overcome DAS noise and coupling issues for reliable wavefield tracking.
本文利用一次区域M 5.2地震，对比了德克萨斯州达拉斯市~95 km城市暗光纤DAS阵列与16 km宽频带地震台阵的波场观测。研究评估了DAS在恢复地动振幅和波场到达方向（DOA）方面的能力。结果显示，宽频带与DAS的瑞利波振幅比在0.25到22.15之间，表明DAS耦合具有极强的空间异质性。尽管D……

t: Hierarchical clustering applied to interchannel cross-correlations of DAS data to identify a coherent channel subgroup for direction of arrival (DOA) estimation.
对DAS通道间互相关应用层次聚类，以识别相干通道子集进行到达方向（DOA）估计。
Waveform data of a regional M 5.2 earthquake recorded by a ~95 km urban dark fiber DAS array and a 16 km broadband array in Dallas, Texas.
德克萨斯州达拉斯市~95 km城市暗光纤DAS阵列和16 km宽频带台阵记录的区域M 5.2地震波形数据。
Rayleigh-wave amplitude ratios between broadband and DAS range from 0.25 to 22.15; a 36-channel DAS subgroup resolved DOA within 4.5° of the broadband array.
宽频带与DAS的瑞利波振幅比在0.25至22.15之间；36通道的DAS子集解析出的DOA与宽频带台阵相差在4.5°以内…
Large amplitude variability and inconsistent signal coherence in DAS due to heterogeneous coupling and emplacement differences.
由于异质耦合和埋设差异，DAS存在巨大的振幅变率和不一致的信号相干性。
Quantitative demonstration of extreme urban DAS coupling heterogeneity and the use of hierarchical clustering to successfully recover wavefield direction of arrival.
定量展示了城市DAS极端的耦合异质性，并利用层次聚类成功恢复了波场到达方向。

kc: Quantified the high spatial heterogeneity of urban dark-fiber DAS coupling using a regional M 5.2 earthquake.
Demonstrated that DAS amplitude variations are dominated by coupling and emplacement differences rather than fiber orientation.
Applied a hierarchical clustering workflow on interchannel cross-correlations to select high-quality DAS channels for accurate direction of arrival (DOA) estimation.
利用区域 M 5.2 地震量化了城市暗光纤 DAS 耦合的高度空间异质性。
证明了 DAS 振幅变化主要受耦合和埋设差异控制，而非光纤走向。
应用了基于通道间互相关的层次聚类工作流，筛选出高质量 DAS 通道以实现精确的到达方向（DOA）估计。
me: Broadband and DAS wavefield comparison.
Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation.
Hierarchical clustering of interchannel cross-correlations to identify coherent sub-arrays.
宽频带与 DAS 波场对比分析。
波场到达方向（DOA）估计。
通道间互相关的层次聚类，用于识别相干子台阵。
de: Seismic data from a regional M 5.2 earthquake recorded on a ~95 km urban dark fiber DAS array and a collocated 16 km aperture broadband seismic array in Dallas, Texas.
记录于德克萨斯州达拉斯市~95 km城市暗光纤 DAS 阵列和共置的 16 km 口径宽频带地震台阵的区域 M 5.2 地震数据。
li: Highly variable DAS coupling and signal coherence limit straightforward amplitude and wavefield reconstruction.
Analysis is based on a single regional earthquake event.
高度可变的 DAS 耦合和信号相干性限制了直接的振幅和波场重建。
分析基于单一的区域地震事件。

tm.why: The paper compares earthquake wavefield measurements from an urban dark fiber distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) array with a broadband seismic array.
The study evaluates wavefield direction of arrival and amplitude recovery using a 16 km aperture broadband seismic array and a DAS array.

sum: This document presents an erratum to the previously published paper 'On the Seismic Hazard Regulations for NPP Sites in Europe: A Controversial Case in Slovenia'. It corrects specific errors or omissions in the original text, figures, or tables to ensure the scientific accuracy of the discussion regarding seismic hazard assessment and regulatory frameworks for nuclear power plants in Slovenia.
本文是针对此前发表的关于欧洲（特别是斯洛文尼亚）核电站（NPP）场地地震安全法规争议性案例研究论文的勘误。它纠正了原文中的特定错误或遗漏，以确保关于斯洛文尼亚核电站地震危险性评价和监管框架讨论的科学准确性。

Corrected statements or figures regarding seismic hazard regulations in Slovenia.

Limited to correcting the original paper's specific errors.

纠正了原文中关于欧洲核电站场地地震安全法规讨论的错误。
me: Errata correction of text, data, or figures from the original study.
对原始研究中的文本、数据或图表进行勘误修正。

sum: This study investigates how tectonic microplates affect plume-ridge interactions by comparing mantle Bouguer anomaly (MBA) gravity calculations across the Easter (EMP) and Juan Fernandez (JFMP) microplates in the eastern Pacific Ocean. Using 1-minute resolution bathymetry and free-air gravity data, the authors remove modeled water-crust and crust-mantle gravitational attractions assuming a 6-km constant crustal thickness. Both microplates exhibit higher average MBA along their eastern ridges than their western ridges, consistent with eastern rifts propagating into older, cooler, denser lithosphere. Despite geochemical and bathymetric evidence of Easter/Salas y Gomez plume influence on the EMP eastern rift, the isolated plume-related MBA difference between EMP and JFMP is minimal (4 mGal raw; 16 mGal after removing regional trends and propagating rift tips). The novelty lies in demonstrating via comparative microplate gravity analysis that thickened microplate lithosphere acts as a plug or thermal counterweight, masking typical hotspot gravity signatures.
本研究通过对比东太平洋复活节微板块（EMP）和胡安·费尔南德斯微板块（JFMP）的地幔布格重力异常（MBA），探讨微板块对地幔柱-洋中脊相互作用的影响。基于1弧分分辨率的水深和自由空气重力数据，假设6公里恒定地壳厚度计算了MBA。结果显示两个微板块东侧裂谷的平均MBA均高于西侧，这与东侧裂谷向更古老……

t: MBA was computed via Parker's (1972) method by subtracting gravitational attractions of water-crust (1.7 g/cm3) and crust-mantle (0.6 g/cm3) interfaces from free-air gravity assuming a 6-km crust, then lowpass filtered at 40 km.
假设6公里地壳厚度，利用Parker(1972)方法从自由空气重力中扣除水-壳和壳-幔界面引力计算MBA，并进行40公里…

1-minute resolution bathymetry from Smith and Sandwell (1997) constrained by shiptrack soundings, and free-air gravity anomalies from Sandwell and Smith (2009) covering the East Pacific Rise and Pacific-Antarctic Ridge (-5°S to -50°S).
东太平洋(-5°S至-50°S)1弧分分辨率的船测水深约束地形数据(Smith & Sandwell, 1997)和卫星…

Both microplates show higher average MBA on their eastern rifts than western rifts. The net plume-related differential MBA between EMP and JFMP is only ~4 mGal raw, or 16 mGal after removing regional trends and propagating rift tips.
两微板块东侧裂谷平均MBA均高于西侧；扣除线性趋势和扩展裂谷尖端后，EMP与JFMP间的地幔柱净MBA差异仅为16 mG…
Residual MBA (RMBA) removing lithospheric cooling could not be computed due to poorly constrained magnetic isochrons and complex, time-dependent 3D microplate rotation and rift propagation.
受限于微板块周围磁异常等时线约束不足及复杂的旋转演化历史，无法通过热模型计算剩余地幔布格异常(RMBA)。

First comparative MBA analysis of the Easter and Juan Fernandez microplates to isolate how microplate lithospheric structure modulates and suppresses geophysical signatures of plume-ridge interaction.
首次通过对比EMP和JFMP的重力异常，揭示微板块岩石圈结构如何调谐并抑制地幔柱-洋中脊相互作用的地球物理信号。

kc: Calculated and compared filtered mantle Bouguer gravity anomalies (MBA) across the Easter and Juan Fernandez microplates in the eastern Pacific.
Demonstrated that both microplates exhibit higher average MBA on their eastern rifts compared to their western rifts due to rift propagation into older, cooler lithosphere.
Isolated the gravity signal of the Easter/Salas y Gomez plume at the Easter microplate, finding a surprisingly small anomaly (4 to 16 mGal) compared to Iceland or Galapagos plumes.
Proposed that microplate lithospheric thickness acts as a thermal counterweight or lithospheric plug that suppresses standard plume-ridge gravity expressions.
计算并对比了东太平洋复活节微板块和胡安·费尔南德斯微板块的滤波地幔布格重力异常（MBA）。
证明两个微板块东侧裂谷的平均MBA均高于西侧，归因于东侧裂谷向更古老、更冷的岩石圈扩展。
提取了复活节微板块处地幔柱的重力信号，发现其异常幅度极小（4至16 mGal），远低于冰岛或加拉帕戈斯地幔柱。
提出微板块复杂的岩石圈厚度结构可作为热抵消项或“岩石圈塞子”，从而抑制典型的地幔柱-洋中脊重力异常表现。
me: Mantle Bouguer anomaly (MBA) calculation using Parker's (1972) Fourier-domain method assuming a 6 km crust and constant density contrasts (1.7 and 0.6 g/cm3).
2D spatial lowpass cosine tapered filtering (40 km cutoff wavelength) with boundary mirroring to suppress short-wavelength features and edge artifacts.
Comparative differential MBA metric between plume-affected (EMP) and non-plume-affected (JFMP) eastern and western microplate rifts, corrected for linear latitudinal trends and propagating rift tips.
采用Parker（1972）方法计算地幔布格异常（MBA），假设地壳恒定厚度为6 km，水-壳和壳-幔密度差分别为1.7和0.6 g/cm3。
应用截止波长为40 km的二维低通余弦锥形滤波器及边界镜像处理，以压制短波长特征和边缘效应。
构建受地幔柱影响（EMP）与不受影响（JFMP）的微板块东西裂谷差分MBA指标，并校正了纬度线性趋势和扩展裂谷尖端效应。
de: Global marine bathymetry database (Smith & Sandwell, 1997) at 1-minute resolution, masked to areas constrained by shiptrack depth soundings.
Satellite-altimetry-derived free-air gravity anomaly (FAA) database (Sandwell & Smith, 2009) at 1-minute resolution across the eastern Pacific (-5°S to -50°S).
1弧分分辨率的全球海洋水深数据库（Smith & Sandwell, 1997），仅保留有船测水深约束的区域。
东太平洋研究区（-5°S至-50°S）1弧分分辨率的卫星测高自由空气重力异常（FAA）数据库（Sandwell & Smith, 2009）。
li: Residual mantle Bouguer anomaly (RMBA) corrections for lithospheric cooling could not be calculated due to poorly constrained magnetic isochrons and complex, time-dependent 3D microplate kinematics.
Areas lacking shiptrack depth soundings had to be masked out because satellite-derived bathymetry cannot be circularly used in gravity anomaly calculations.
由于磁异常等时线约束不足以及微板块旋转和裂谷扩展导致的复杂三维时变几何结构，无法通过热模型计算剩余地幔布格异常（RMBA）。
缺乏船测水深约束的区域必须被掩膜剔除，因为卫星反演水深不能循环用于重力异常计算。

tm.why: The paper investigates mantle geodynamics, plume-ridge interactions, and lithospheric density structure around oceanic microplates using mantle Bouguer gravity anomalies and bathymetry.

ev.notes: Full 15-page PDF analysed, including methodology, equations, 5 figures, and 1 summary table.

sum: This study utilizes high-frequency receiver functions from a dense seismic deployment (298 nodal and 36 broadband seismometers) across the Central Andes (22°–24°S) to image crustal and mantle discontinuities. The authors image the subducting oceanic crust and Moho in the forearc, showing a transition to a coupled mantle wedge. Beneath the Puna Plateau, they find a complex Moho varying from ~58 km depth under the arc to ~64 km under the eastern plateau, likely influenced by lithospheric removal. They also identify the Altiplano-Puna Magma Body and other mid-to-upper crustal partial melt zones. In the east, west-dipping discontinuities associated with the Main Andean Detachment system merge into these melt zones at ~18–20 km depth, suggesting a structural link between crustal shortening and plateau magmatism.
本研究利用在安第斯中部（22°–24°S）部署的298个节点和36个宽频带地震仪数据，通过高频接收函数成像揭示了地壳和地幔的不连续面。在前弧区，观测到大洋地壳和莫霍面，指示了向耦合地幔楔的过渡；在普纳高原下方，莫霍面深度从弧下的58千米变化到东部的64千米，可能与岩石圈拆沉有关。此外，研究发现了阿尔……

t: High-frequency receiver function analysis applied to a dense temporary seismic array.
应用于密集临时地震台阵的高频接收函数分析方法。
Seismic waveform data from 298 nodal and 36 broadband seismometers deployed across northern Chile and Argentina from 2022 to 2024.
2022至2024年间在智利北部和阿根廷部署的298个节点和36个宽频带地震仪的波形数据。
Imaged Moho variations (58-64 km), widespread mid-crustal partial melt zones, and west-dipping detachments merging into these melt zones at 18-20 km depth.
成像了莫霍面变化（58-64千米）、广泛的中地壳部分熔融区，以及在18-20千米深度汇入熔融区的西倾拆离构造。
Resolution limits of receiver functions in highly heterogeneous 3D volcanic/magmatic environments.
接收函数在高度非均匀的三维火山/岩浆环境中的分辨率限制。
First high-density nodal/broadband RF imaging across this transect, linking deep detachment faults directly to mid-crustal magma bodies.
首次在该剖面进行高密度节点/宽频带接收函数成像，将深部拆离断层与中地壳岩浆体直接联系起来。

kc: Deployed a dense seismic array consisting of 298 nodes and 36 broadband stations across the Central Andes.
Imaged the subducting slab and Moho transition from serpentinized mantle to a coupled mantle wedge in the forearc.
Mapped Moho depth variations (58 to 64 km) beneath the Puna Plateau, linking them to lithospheric removal processes.
Identified widespread mid-to-upper crustal low-velocity zones representing partial melt, including the Altiplano-Puna Magma Body.
Revealed a structural connection where the Main Andean Detachment system merges into mid-crustal melt zones at 18–20 km depth.
在安第斯中部部署了由298个节点和36个宽频带台站组成的密集地震台阵。
成像了前弧区俯冲板块和莫霍面从蛇纹石化地幔向耦合地幔楔的过渡。
绘制了普纳高原下方莫霍面深度的变化（58至64千米），并将其与岩石圈拆沉过程联系起来。
识别出广泛分布的中上地壳低速带（代表部分熔融），包括阿尔蒂普拉诺-普纳岩浆体。
揭示了安第斯主拆离系在18-20千米深度汇入中地壳熔融区的结构联系。
me: High-frequency receiver function (RF) analysis to image crustal and mantle discontinuities.
Dense seismic array deployment and data processing.
用于成像地壳和地幔不连续面的高频接收函数（RF）分析。
密集地震台阵部署与数据处理。
de: Seismic waveform data from 298 nodal and 36 broadband seismometers deployed from 2022 to 2024 across northern Chile and Argentina (22°–24°S).
2022年至2024年期间在智利北部和阿根廷（22°–24°S）部署的298个节点和36个宽频带地震仪的地震波形数据。
li: Resolution of receiver functions is inherently limited by frequency and station spacing, particularly in complex 3D structures.
Interpretation of partial melt and lithospheric removal relies on structural imaging and requires geodynamic modeling for validation.
接收函数的成像分辨率受限于频率和台站间距，特别是在复杂的三维结构中。
对部分熔融和岩石圈拆沉的解释依赖于结构成像，需要地球动力学模拟进行验证。

tm.why: The study calculates high-frequency receiver functions to identify crustal and mantle discontinuities.
The paper investigates Moho variations, lithospheric removal, and crustal magma bodies beneath the Puna Plateau.

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) using the first-order VTI elastic wave equation often suffers from inconsistent state and adjoint-state equations, complicating programming and preventing the correct application of free-surface boundary conditions in the adjoint simulation. To resolve this, the authors propose a skew-adjoint formulation of the first-order VTI elastic wave equation. In this formulation, the forward and adjoint operators share the same mathematical form, differing only by a negative sign. This equivalence allows both equations to share identical free-surface boundary conditions and simulation codes. The method's accuracy and effectiveness are validated using two synthetic datasets, demonstrating improved inversion results under free-surface conditions.
针对一阶VTI弹性波动方程在FWI中状态与伴随方程不一致、导致编程复杂且伴随方程无法正确施加自由地表边界的问题，本文提出一种反对称伴随形式的一阶VTI弹性波动方程。该方程的算子与其伴随算子形式相同（仅差负号），允许状态与伴随方程采用一致的自由地表边界条件和模拟代码。通过两个合成数据集验证了该方法的有……

t: A skew-adjoint formulation of the first-order VTI elastic wave equation where the forward and adjoint operators share the same mathematical form, differing only by a negative sign.
一种一阶VTI弹性波动方程的反对称伴随表征，其前向和伴随算子形式相同，仅相差一个负号。
Two synthetic VTI elastic datasets used to test the formulation's performance and boundary condition consistency.
用于测试该公式性能和边界条件一致性的两个合成VTI弹性数据集。
Demonstrated that the proposed formulation successfully applies consistent free-surface boundary conditions and yields accurate FWI reconstruction results.
证明了所提公式成功应用了一致的自由地表边界条件，并获得了精确的FWI重建结果。
The performance and computational efficiency of the method have not been evaluated on real-world field seismic data.
该方法在实际野外地震数据上的性能和计算效率尚未得到评估。
Developing a mathematically equivalent skew-adjoint VTI wave equation that unifies forward and adjoint simulation codes and boundary conditions.
开发了数学上等效的反对称伴随VTI波动方程，统一了前向与伴随模拟代码及边界条件。

kc: Proposed a novel skew-adjoint formulation of the first-order VTI elastic wave equation for FWI.
Enabled consistent application of free-surface boundary conditions for both state and adjoint-state equations.
Reduced programming complexity by allowing the forward and adjoint wavefields to share the same simulation code.
提出了一种用于FWI的新型一阶VTI弹性波动方程反对称伴随表征。
实现了状态方程与伴随状态方程中自由地表边界条件的一致性应用。
通过使前向和伴随波场共享相同的模拟代码，降低了编程复杂度。
me: Skew-adjoint operator formulation for first-order VTI elastic wave equations.
Adjoint-state method for gradient calculation in full-waveform inversion.
Consistent free-surface boundary condition implementation.
一阶VTI弹性波动方程的反对称伴随算子表征。
用于全波形反演梯度计算的伴随状态法。
一致的自由地表边界条件实现。

使用两个合成VTI弹性数据集进行数值验证。

The proposed wave equation is formulated for vertically transverse isotropic (VTI) elastic media.

sum: This study investigates the landslide-induced tsunami in Tracy Arm Fjord, Alaska, on 10 August 2025, using broadband seismic data to recover the incomplete landslide force history. By fitting the reconstructed horizontal trajectory to post-event satellite imagery, the authors estimate a sliding mass of 120 ± 6 Mt and a residual speed of 54.1 ± 2.7 m/s. The total energy transferred from the landslide to the water is calculated as 1.76 ± 0.09 × 10^11 kJ (1.46 ± 0.07 kJ/kg). This force history provides a dynamic constraint for numerical simulations of landslide-induced tsunamis, demonstrating how seismic records can quantify energy transfer in environmental hazards.
本文利用宽频带地震数据重建了2025年8月10日阿拉斯加特雷西臂峡湾滑坡的受力历史。通过将重建轨迹与震后卫星图像拟合，估算出滑坡质量约1.2亿吨，残留速度约54.1米/秒，向水体传递的总能量约1.76×10^11千焦。该受力历史可作为海啸数值模拟的动态约束，为理解滑坡-海啸能量转化提供了关键观测证据……

t: Inversion of broadband seismic waveforms to recover the landslide force history, combined with trajectory fitting using post-event satellite imagery.
利用宽频带地震波形反演恢复滑坡受力历史，并结合震后卫星图像进行轨迹拟合。
Long-period broadband seismic records of the 10 August 2025 Tracy Arm Fjord landslide and post-event satellite imagery.
2025年8月10日特雷西臂峡湾滑坡的长周期宽频带地震记录及震后卫星图像。
Estimated a sliding mass of 120 ± 6 Mt, residual speed of 54.1 ± 2.7 m/s, and total transferred energy of 1.76 ± 0.09 × 10^11 kJ.
估算滑坡质量为1.2亿吨，残留速度为54.1米/秒，向水体传递能量为1.76×10^11千焦。
The seismic-derived force history is incomplete and requires external satellite constraints to resolve mass and velocity ambiguities.
地震反演得到的受力历史不完整，需要外部卫星约束来解决质量和速度的模糊性。
Quantifying the dynamic energy transfer of a landslide-induced tsunami by combining seismic force reconstruction with satellite-constrained trajectory modeling.
结合地震受力重建与卫星约束轨迹模型，定量评估滑坡海啸的动态能量传递。

kc: Recovered the incomplete landslide force history of the 10 August 2025 Tracy Arm Fjord event from broadband seismic data.
Estimated the sliding mass (120 ± 6 Mt) and residual speed (54.1 ± 2.7 m/s) by integrating seismic inversion with satellite imagery.
Quantified the energy transferred from the landslide to the water (1.76 ± 0.09 × 10^11 kJ) to generate the tsunami.

Trajectory reconstruction and best-fitting with post-event satellite imagery.

从地震数据中恢复的滑坡受力历史是不完整的，需要依赖卫星图像进行尺度和轨迹约束。

sum: Conventional manual fault interpretation in structurally complex seismic volumes is time-consuming and prone to human bias. This study evaluates Schlumberger's user-trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Fault Prediction Module within Petrel for automated 3D fault mapping in the Berenice Oil Field, Faghur Basin, Western Desert, Egypt. Using a full-stack time-domain 3D seismic volume (~9x8 km), the workflow combines ML-based self-supervised denoising, sparse interpreter fault labeling on just three seismic lines (<1% of total volume), U-Net style 3D fault probability cube generation, and geometric extraction via planarity and azimuth thresholds. The model achieved a Dice similarity coefficient exceeding 0.85, recovered 65% of manually mapped major faults, and resolved previously unmapped subtle low-throw faults (<15 ms TWT) critical for AEB-3E reservoir compartmentalization. The automated approach reduced total interpretation turnaround time by over 80% compared to manual picking while preserving structural continuity.
本研究在埃及西部沙漠Berenice油田应用斯伦贝谢Petrel平台中的用户训练卷积神经网络（CNN）断层预测模块，开展三维地震自动断层解释。方法结合了机器学习去噪、仅3条测线（占总数据量<1%）的稀疏人工标签训练、U-Net架构三维断层概率体生成，以及基于平面度和方位角阈值的断层点云提取与网格化。……

t: A U-Net style encoder-decoder CNN in Petrel 2025 is trained on denoised 3D seismic data and sparse manual fault labels, followed by probability thresholding (0.3) and planarity (0.55) / azimuth geometric filtering to extract fault surfaces.
基于去噪三维地震数据和稀疏人工标签训练U-Net风格CNN，结合概率、平面度与方位角阈值提取三维断层。

Full-stack time-domain onshore 3D seismic volume covering approximately 9 x 8 km in the Berenice Oil Field, Faghur Basin, Western Desert, Egypt, with training labels digitized on just three seismic lines (<1% of volume).
埃及西部沙漠Berenice油田约9×8 km陆上叠后时间域三维地震体，仅在3条测线（<1%）拾取训练标签。

The CNN model achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient >0.85, recovered 65% of manually mapped major faults across the 9x8 km volume, detected unmapped <15 ms low-throw faults, and reduced interpretation time by over 80%.
模型Dice系数超0.85，恢复65%已解释主断层，识别出<15 ms微幅断层，减少解释耗时80%以上。

Demonstrates that training a user-guided CNN on <1% of a 3D seismic volume resolves subtle (<15 ms) compartmentalizing faults in Egypt's Western Desert while cutting turnaround time by >80%.
证明仅用不足1%数据量训练CNN即可高效识别埃及西部沙漠复杂微幅断层并缩短80%工时。

Achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient >0.85 and delineated 65% of manually mapped faults while cutting interpretation time by over 80%.
Resolved previously unmapped subtle low-throw (<15 ms) faults that compartmentalize the Alam El Bueib (AEB-3E) reservoir unit.
仅使用不足1%地震数据体（3条测线）的训练标签，在构造复杂的Berenice油田实现了三维断层自动检测。

U-Net style encoder-decoder CNN classification trained on sparse user-picked fault labels (3 seismic sections) to generate a 3D fault probability cube.
Geometric attribute evaluation (planarity threshold 0.55, probability threshold 0.3, 4-voxel radius, azimuth 0-359 degrees) followed by point-cloud filtering and Python plugin stick extraction.
采用自监督卷积机器学习地震去噪模块压制随机噪声、多次波和采集脚印。
基于3条地震剖面的稀疏人工断层标签训练U-Net编码-解码CNN分类器，生成三维断层概率属性体。
通过几何属性评估（平面度阈值0.55、概率阈值0.3、4体素半径、全方位角）提取三维点云，并利用Python插件自动转换为断层棍和断层面。

sum: This paper theoretically investigates the conditions for homogeneous seismic body waves (qP, qSV, and qSH) in viscoelastic isotropic and transversely isotropic (VTI) media using the g*-Hamiltonian method. The authors demonstrate that while P- and S-waves are always homogeneous in viscoelastic isotropic media, qP- and qSV-waves in VTI media require four specific Q-factors to be equal, and qSH-waves require two Q-factors to be equal to remain homogeneous. These analytical derivations are validated through computational experiments on rock samples. The findings significantly simplify the calculation of slowness, ray-velocity vectors, and Snell's law at interfaces, addressing a major computational bottleneck in viscoelastic anisotropic ray tracing.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of applying surface-trained multi-station deep learning (DL) seismic phase pickers to borehole arrays without retraining. The authors develop input adaptation strategies, specifically rotating borehole traces so that P- and S-wave energies align with the channels expected by the model (CubeNet). Tested on borehole data from the Preston New Road 2 (PNR2) hydraulic fracturing site, UK, this rotation strategy increases successful P- and S-wave picks by 9.5% and 13% points, respectively, for microearthquakes (-1.5 <= Mw <= 1.2). This leads to a 65% increase in located earthquakes in a one-hour test period. The workflow operates 1.86 times faster than real-time, demonstrating a practical, computationally efficient route to deploying existing surface-trained models on borehole geometries.

sum: This study presents the first seismic characterization of the unexpected 23 November 2025 explosive eruption of Hayli Gubbi volcano in Afar, Ethiopia, using 13 regional broadband stations (195–2060 km distance). Due to emergent body waves, the authors pick low-frequency (0.01–0.1 Hz) surface-wave arrivals to jointly invert for epicentral coordinates, origin time, and Rayleigh wave group velocity (~3,000 m/s) via a Gauss-Newton method. The eruption sequence features high-frequency precursory pulses repeating every ~50 s, followed by a main phase consisting of two distinct events separated by ~211 s (occurring 20 minutes after initial satellite-detected gas release) releasing 5–20 GJ of seismic energy, and later normal-faulting secondary events. 3-D spectral-element waveform modeling (SALVUS) confirms that reproducing the main waveforms requires two separate isotropic (explosive/collapse) source excitations rather than a fault mechanism, highlighting how sparse regional networks can monitor under-instrumented volcanoes.

sum: Oceanic transform faults (OTFs) exhibit adjacent seismic and creeping segments, yet the mechanical controls on this segmentation remain unclear. Using one year of data from 16 ocean bottom seismometers at the westernmost Gofar transform fault (G3), the authors apply deep-learning phase and polarity pickers (PickBlue and RPNet) and SKHASH to build a catalog of 2323 microearthquake focal mechanisms—an order of magnitude larger than previous OTF catalogs. Stress inversion shows a uniform strike-slip stress regime, but faulting types vary systematically along strike: pure strike-slip (~31% overall) dominates seismic rupture zones, while reverse and oblique-reverse mechanisms cluster in creeping rupture barriers. Coulomb failure modeling demonstrates that elevated pore-fluid pressure and mechanical weakness within the barriers explain the non-strike-slip abundance. Furthermore, the 2008 M6 mainshock increased focal mechanism diversity across all segments. Comparisons with Blanco and Chain transforms suggest local mechanical properties broadly govern OTF segmentation.
针对大洋转换断层地震破裂段与蠕滑屏障分段的物理机制，本研究利用Gofar转换断层G3段16台海底地震仪一年的数据，结合深度学习拾取模型（PickBlue与RPNet）及SKHASH反演，构建了包含2323个微震震源机制的目录（比以往目录大一个数量级）。应力反演显示区域应力场均匀，但断层类型沿走向系统……

t: Deep-learning models (PickBlue and RPNet) pick P-wave onsets and first-motion polarities from OBS waveforms, which are inverted for focal mechanisms via SKHASH, followed by stress inversion and Coulomb failure simulations.
利用PickBlue和RPNet拾取OBS波形初动极性，经SKHASH反演震源机制，并开展应力反演与库仑破裂模拟。
One year of continuous waveform data from 16 broadband ocean bottom seismometers (2008 network ZD) and a 31,251-event microearthquake catalog along ~80 km of the G3 Gofar transform fault.
2008年Gofar断层G3段16台宽频带OBS连续波形数据及31,251个微震目录，最终获得2323个震源机制解。

Pure strike-slip events comprise 31% of the 2323 mechanisms and dominate rupture zones, whereas reverse and oblique-reverse events cluster in creeping barriers, explained by elevated pore-fluid pressure.

The 16-station OBS network geometry limits individual focal mechanism precision (average uncertainty 34.5°–38.2°), requiring reliance on statistical patterns across hundreds of events rather than individual solutions.
