sum: This study investigates how lithospheric age, thermal structure, and seismic anisotropy affect uppermost mantle Pn velocities across the Mendocino Fracture Zone (MFZ) in the eastern Pacific. Using hydroacoustic data from 13 ocean-bottom electromagnetic instruments, the author analyzes 217 Pn arrivals from 19 regional earthquakes (Mw 2.4–5.4) crossing 8–33 Ma oceanic lithosphere. After applying an empirical azimuthal anisotropy correction, corrected Pn velocities range from 7.60 to 8.15 km/s, increasing systematically with lithospheric age and decreasing Moho temperature. Half-space cooling models indicate a velocity-temperature sensitivity of -0.45 km/s per 100 °C, matching continental peridotite estimates. Furthermore, the paper compiles Pn measurements from 13 global oceanic transform faults and fracture zones, revealing a coherent nonlinear logarithmic increase in Pn velocity with lithospheric age (r = 0.86), demonstrating that conductive cooling is the first-order control on uppermost mantle velocities beneath oceanic fracture zones.
本研究利用东太平洋门多西诺断裂带（MFZ）13台海底电磁仪的水声通道数据，拾取了19次区域地震（震级2.4–5.4）的217条Pn波走时，探讨岩石圈年龄、热结构和各向异性对最上地幔Pn速度的影响。经经验方位各向异性校正后，Pn速度为7.60–8.15 km/s，随岩石圈年龄（8–33 Ma）增加和莫……

t: Path-averaged Pn velocities are calculated from manually picked hydroacoustic travel times corrected for CRUST1.0 crustal thickness and empirical azimuthal anisotropy (Hess, 1964), then compared against Moho temperatures from a Half-Space Cooling model.
从水声波形手动拾取Pn走时，经CRUST1.0地壳厚度和经验方位各向异性校正后计算速度，并与半空间冷却莫霍面温度对比。

217 Pn arrivals from 19 regional earthquakes (magnitude 2.4–5.4, epicentral distances 311–588 km) recorded between October and December 2017 by 13 differential pressure gauge hydroacoustic channels on a 200-km N-S OBEM array across the MFZ.
2017年横跨MFZ的13台海底电磁仪水声通道记录的19次区域地震（震级2.4–5.4）共217条Pn波走时数据。

Anisotropy-corrected Pn velocities range from 7.60 to 8.15 km/s, exhibiting a temperature sensitivity of -0.45 km/s per 100 °C at the Moho and a global logarithmic age relationship VPn = 7.69 + 0.13 ln(age) (r = 0.86).
校正后Pn速度为7.60–8.15 km/s，莫霍面温度敏感性为-0.45 km/s/100°C，全球速度与年龄符合对数…

Limited azimuthal ray-path coverage prevents independent inversion for seismic anisotropy, while global catalog epicenter mislocations and purely conductive cooling assumptions introduce velocity and thermal uncertainties.
有限的方位角覆盖无法独立反演各向异性，且震中定位偏差和纯传导冷却假设引入了不确定性。

First hydroacoustic Pn velocity analysis across the Mendocino Fracture Zone paired with the most extensive global compilation of Pn velocities and lithospheric ages exclusively across oceanic transform faults and fracture zones.
首次给出横跨门多西诺断裂带的水声Pn波速，并建立了迄今最全面的全球大洋转换断层与断裂带Pn速度汇编。

kc: Provides 217 new path-averaged Pn velocity measurements across the Mendocino Fracture Zone (8–33 Ma lithosphere) using ocean-bottom hydroacoustic records.
Separates thermal cooling effects from transform-parallel shear anisotropy using an empirical azimuthal anisotropy correction, yielding corrected Pn velocities of 7.60–8.15 km/s.
Establishes an apparent Pn velocity-temperature sensitivity of -0.45 km/s per 100 °C at the oceanic Moho using half-space cooling models.

Compiles a global synthesis of Pn velocities across 13 oceanic transform faults and fracture zones, demonstrating a logarithmic increase of Pn velocity with lithospheric age (VPn = 7.69 + 0.13 ln(age), r = 0.86).
利用海底水声记录提供了横跨门多西诺断裂带（8–33 Ma岩石圈）的217个新路径平均Pn波速测量结果。
采用经验方位各向异性校正分离了热冷却效应与平行转换断层的剪切各向异性，获得7.60–8.15 km/s的校正Pn速度。
结合半空间冷却模型，确定了大洋莫霍面处约-0.45 km/s/100 °C的视Pn速度-温度敏感性系数。
汇编了全球13个大洋转换断层和断裂带的Pn速度数据集，证明Pn速度随岩石圈年龄呈对数增长（VPn = 7.69 + 0.13 ln(age), r = 0.86）。
me: Manual Pn arrival-time picking on 2.5 Hz high-pass filtered differential pressure gauge (DPG) hydroacoustic waveforms.
Path-averaged Pn velocity calculation with Moho depth and crustal travel-time/distance corrections based on CRUST1.0.
Empirical azimuthal anisotropy correction derived from Hess (1964) over back-azimuths of 0° to 110°.
Half-space cooling (HSC) thermal modeling along 1-km ray-path intervals to estimate path-averaged and maximum Moho temperatures.
在2.5 Hz高通滤波后的差分压力计（DPG）水声波形上手动拾取Pn波初至走时。
基于CRUST1.0模型进行莫霍面深度及地壳走时/距离校正，计算路径平均Pn波速度。
基于Hess (1964) 在0°至110°反方位角范围内的经验趋势进行方位各向异性校正。
沿射线路径按1 km间隔进行半空间冷却（HSC）热模拟，估算路径平均和最大莫霍面温度。
de: Hydroacoustic DPG records sampled at 62.5 Hz from 13 out of 21 ocean-bottom electromagnetic (OBEM) stations deployed across the MFZ from October to December 2017.
217 Pn ray paths from 19 regional earthquakes (magnitudes 2.4–5.4, epicentral distances 311–588 km) cataloged by ISC and WILBER3/IRIS.
Global oceanic crustal age grid (Seton et al., 2020) and CRUST1.0 crustal thickness model.
Global literature compilation of Pn velocity and lithospheric age across 13 oceanic transform faults and fracture zones in the Pacific and Atlantic.
2017年10月至12月布设在门多西诺断裂带的21台海底电磁仪（OBEM）中13台站点的62.5 Hz水声DPG记录。
来自ISC和WILBER3/IRIS目录的19次区域地震（震级2.4–5.4，震中距311–588 km）产生的217条Pn射线路径。
全球洋壳年龄网格（Seton et al., 2020）和CRUST1.0地壳厚度模型。
太平洋和大西洋13个大洋转换断层及断裂带的Pn波速与岩石圈年龄全球文献汇编。
li: Limited crossing azimuthal ray-path coverage prevents an independent tomographic inversion for seismic anisotropy.
Earthquake epicenter and depth uncertainties in global catalogs (up to 5–25 km mislocation) and picking errors introduce ±0.11–0.21 km/s velocity uncertainties.
Half-space cooling models assume purely conductive cooling and neglect hydrothermal circulation, melt retention, and poro-viscoelastic deformation.
有限的交叉方位角射线覆盖阻碍了对地震各向异性的独立层析成像反演。
全球地震目录中的震中和深度不确定性（高达5–25 km的定位偏差）及拾取误差引入了±0.11–0.21 km/s的速度不确定性。
半空间冷却模型假设纯传导冷却，忽略了热液循环、熔体滞留和孔隙粘弹塑性变形。

tm.why: The study investigates how oceanic lithospheric cooling, age, and thermal structure control uppermost mantle Pn velocities across the Mendocino Fracture Zone and global oceanic transform faults.
The paper evaluates directional variations in Pn velocities and applies an empirical azimuthal anisotropy correction to separate shear-induced fabric effects from thermal effects.
The measurements are derived from hydroacoustic differential pressure gauge channels on an array of 13 ocean-bottom electromagnetic instruments.

ev.notes: All metadata, quantitative results, figure analyses, and verbatim source anchors were extracted directly from the 13-page published PDF.

sum: Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) volcano monitoring is often hindered by tropospheric noise, especially topographically correlated atmospheric phase screens (APS) and turbulent delays over small spatial scales (20x20 km). Weather-model corrections like GACOS struggle at these scales. This paper introduces LiCSAtmo, an empirical correction algorithm using Independent Component Analysis (ICA) in either spatial (sICA) or temporal (tICA) domains to isolate and subtract atmospheric components without external data. By using cumulative interferograms to maximize low-rate deformation variance during PCA preprocessing and leveraging temporally rich Sentinel-1 time series (~300 acquisitions) for tICA, the method separates deformation that is spatially coincident with topography. Tested on synthetic data, Campi Flegrei, and Vesuvius, LiCSAtmo resolves apparent seasonal subsidence reversals at Vesuvius (~-15 mm/yr) and reduces root-mean-square error against GNSS by 67% (0.006 m vs. 0.017 m for GACOS). Integrating these advances into the LiCSAlert monitoring tool enables detection of subtle deformation rate changes.
本文提出了一种名为LiCSAtmo的InSAR时间序列大气校正新方法，利用空间或时间独立成分分析（sICA/tICA）盲源分离技术识别并去除对流层噪声。针对小尺度（20×20 km）火山区域，该方法通过累积干涉图最大化低速率形变方差，并利用高时间采样率的Sentinel-1数据在时间域分离与地形重合……

t: LiCSAtmo applies spatial or temporal Independent Component Analysis (FastICA after PCA whitening on cumulative interferograms) to decompose InSAR time series into independent sources, discarding atmospheric components to reconstruct noise-free displacement time series.
利用空间或时间独立成分分析（sICA/tICA）分解累积InSAR时间序列，剔除大气分量后重构无噪位移序列。

Tested on 480 synthetic InSAR time series (SyInterferoPy, inflation rates 0.01–1.0 m/yr) and ~7-year Sentinel-1 descending InSAR time series (LiCSAR/LiCSBAS) at Campi Flegrei and Vesuvius, validated against continuous GNSS stations.
使用480组合成InSAR序列及坎皮佛莱格瑞和维苏威火山约7年的Sentinel-1数据，并用GNSS验证。

At Vesuvius (station BKNO), LiCSAtmo removes seasonal atmospheric reversals and achieves an RMSE of 0.0056 m against GNSS, outperforming the original data (0.0145 m), GACOS weather model (0.0173 m, a 67% reduction), and linear correction (0.0234 m).
在维苏威火山消除季节性伪影，GNSS对比RMSE达0.0056米，比GACOS模型（0.0173米）降低67%。
The method is restricted to small scenes (~20 x 20 km) where topographically correlated APSs do not vary spatially, and tICA requires ~300 acquisitions to converge well.
仅适用于约20×20 km的小场景，且tICA需要约300景的高时间采样数据才能有效收敛。

First empirical InSAR atmospheric correction to reconstruct time series by omitting ICA noise components in either space or time, enabled by cumulative-interferogram variance maximization and 300-acquisition tICA.
首次结合累积干涉图方差最大化与时空双域ICA重构来经验性滤除InSAR地形相关与湍流大气噪声。

kc: Developed LiCSAtmo, an ICA-based empirical atmospheric correction method that isolates and removes both topographically correlated and turbulent APSs from InSAR time series.
Demonstrated that using cumulative interferograms rather than incremental ones maximizes deformation variance so low-rate signals are retained during PCA dimensionality reduction.
Implemented temporal ICA (tICA) on long Sentinel-1 time series (~300 acquisitions) to separate volcanic deformation that is spatially coincident with topography at stratovolcanoes.
Reduced RMSE against GNSS at Vesuvius by 67% (0.006 m vs. 0.017 m) compared to the state-of-the-art GACOS weather-model correction.
开发了基于ICA的经验大气校正方法LiCSAtmo，可从InSAR时间序列中分离并去除地形相关和湍流大气相位屏（APS）。
证明了使用累积干涉图而非增量干涉图可最大化形变信号方差，从而确保低速率形变信号在PCA降维步骤中被保留。
在长序列Sentinel-1数据（约300景）上实现了时间独立成分分析（tICA），解决了层状火山形变与地形空间重合导致的统计不独立问题。
在维苏威火山与GNSS对比验证中，相比先进的GACOS气象模型校正方法，将均方根误差降低了67%（0.006米对比0.017米）。
me: Spatial and temporal Independent Component Analysis (sICA and tICA) via FastICA with PCA whitening and dimensionality reduction.
Bootstrapping (200 iterations) combined with HDBSCAN and t-SNE clustering to robustly identify repeatable independent components.
Variance maximization using cumulative interferograms or random subsets of all possible interferogram pairs prior to PCA.
Time series reconstruction by omitting atmospheric ICs and multiplying retained deformation ICs by their cumulative time courses.
结合PCA白化与降维的FastICA空间与时间独立成分分析（sICA和tICA）。
利用200次自助法重采样（Bootstrapping）结合HDBSCAN和t-SNE聚类算法，稳健地识别可重复的独立成分。
在PCA预处理前使用累积干涉图或所有可能干涉对的随机子集以最大化形变信号方差。
通过剔除大气独立成分并将保留的形变成分与其累积时间历程相乘来重构校正后的时间序列。
de: 480 synthetic InSAR time series generated with SyInterferoPy spanning 1–7 years and Mogi inflation rates from 0.01 to 1.0 m/year.
Sentinel-1 descending InSAR time series (~6.5–7 years, 2014–2021) processed with LiCSAR and LiCSBAS over Campi Flegrei and Vesuvius, Italy.
Continuous daily GNSS displacement time series (including station BKNO at Vesuvius) and GACOS/ECMWF weather-model products for validation.
利用SyInterferoPy生成的480组合成InSAR时间序列，时间跨度1至7年，Mogi点源膨胀速率为0.01至1.0米/年。
使用LiCSAR和LiCSBAS处理的意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞和维苏威火山2014至2021年（约6.5–7年）Sentinel-1降轨InSAR时间序列。
用于验证对比的连续每日GNSS位移时间序列（包括维苏威火山的BKNO站点）以及GACOS/ECMWF气象模型数据。
li: Limited to small InSAR scenes (~20 x 20 km) because topographically correlated APS spatial variability over larger regions violates single-component assumptions and increases computational cost.
Temporal ICA (tICA) requires temporally rich datasets (~300 acquisitions) and ~2.75 years of baseline data to isolate low-rate (~0.02 m/yr) deformation.
When deformation and topography do not overlap, tICA underperforms sICA due to the much smaller number of temporal samples compared to spatial pixels.
仅适用于小范围InSAR场景（约20×20 km），更大区域内地形相关大气延迟的空间变化及像素激增会限制该方法的应用。
时间ICA（tICA）需要高时间采样率的数据集（约300景影像）及约2.75年的基线长度才能分离约0.02米/年的低速率形变。
当形变与地形不重合时，由于时间样本数远少于空间像素数，tICA的表现不如sICA。

tm.why: The paper develops an atmospheric correction and unrest monitoring algorithm specifically tailored for volcano deformation studies at Campi Flegrei and Vesuvius.
The method uses Independent Component Analysis (ICA), PCA, HDBSCAN, and t-SNE within the LiCSAtmo and LiCSAlert frameworks to separate deformation from noise.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF of the JGR: Solid Earth article was analyzed, including all sections, equations, and Figures 1 to 10.

sum: This study develops a high-resolution 3D S-wave velocity model down to 120 km depth beneath Northeast China using a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for eikonal tomography. The model successfully maps the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and low-velocity anomalies beneath Quaternary intraplate volcanoes. Key findings include a thick lithosphere beneath the Songliao Basin (SLB) and distinct lithospheric structures that explain the chemical differences between sodic and potassic volcanism. Sodic volcanism in the south and west is facilitated by asthenospheric mobility driven by the Big Mantle Wedge, whereas the Wudalianchi and Nuominhe potassic volcanoes lack such deep convection. This work demonstrates the power of PINNs in resolving complex tectonic and volcanic systems.
本研究基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）程控层析成像框架，构建了中国东北地区深至120公里的高分辨率三维S波速度模型。该模型精细刻画了火山区下方的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）及低速异常。研究发现松辽盆地下方存在显著的高速异常（代表较厚岩石圈），并揭示了不同火山群（钠质与钾质）的深部动力学差异：南部和西……

t: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework applied to eikonal tomography for high-resolution 3D S-wave velocity inversion.
将物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架应用于程控层析成像，进行高分辨率三维S波速度反演。
Regional seismic wave travel-time or dispersion data across Northeast China, covering crustal and uppermost mantle depths.
覆盖中国东北地区的区域地震波走时或频散数据，涵盖地壳和最上部地幔深度。
Revealed a thick lithosphere beneath the Songliao Basin and mapped LAB undulations explaining sodic vs. potassic volcanic mechanisms.
揭示了松辽盆地下方的厚岩石圈，并刻画了能解释钠质与钾质火山机制的LAB起伏。
Potential resolution limits at the model's maximum depth of 120 km due to surface wave sensitivity.
由于面波敏感性限制，在模型最大深度（120公里）处可能存在潜在的分辨率限制。
First application of PINN-based eikonal tomography to image the lithosphere-asthenosphere system and volcanic plumbing in Northeast China.
首次将基于PINN的程控层析成像应用于成像中国东北的岩石圈-软流圈系统及火山通道。

kc: Developed a high-resolution 3D S-wave velocity model down to 120 km beneath Northeast China using a PINN-based eikonal tomography framework.
Characterized the transitional lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) and its undulations beneath volcanic regions.
Provided a geodynamic explanation for the chemical variations (sodic vs. potassic) of Quaternary intraplate volcanoes based on deep mantle wedge dynamics.
利用基于PINN的程控层析成像框架，构建了中国东北深至120公里的高分辨率三维S波速度模型。
精细刻画了火山区下方过渡性的岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）及其起伏特征。
基于深部地幔楔动力学，为第四纪板内火山的化学成分差异（钠质与钾质）提供了地球动力学解释。
me: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) applied to solve the eikonal equation for seismic tomography.
3D S-wave velocity inversion integrating crustal and uppermost mantle constraints.
将物理信息神经网络（PINN）应用于求解程控方程以进行地震层析成像。
结合地壳和最上部地幔约束进行三维S波速度反演。
de: Regional seismic travel-time or dispersion data across Northeast China (implied by the eikonal tomography application).
覆盖中国东北地区的区域地震走时或频散数据（由程控层析成像应用所引入）。
li: Resolution at the maximum depth of 120 km may be limited by the frequency band and sensitivity of the surface waves used.
受限于所用面波的频段和敏感性，在120公里最大深度处的分辨率可能有限。

tm.why: The paper develops a 3D S-wave velocity model using eikonal tomography.
The tomography is based on a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework.
The study images the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary and interprets upper mantle convection.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the JGR Solid Earth abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Repeated filling and drying cycles of ancient Lake Cahuilla over the past millennium deformed the crust and upper mantle in the Salton Trough. This study constrains the regional lithospheric rheology by combining a novel LiDAR Shoreline Assessment (LSA) method—which extracts 43 new paleo-shoreline elevations from 1-m and 7-m airborne LiDAR and mobile truck-mounted LiDAR—with 20–25 years of continuous GPS vertical velocity measurements. Using a two-layer model of an elastic plate overlying a viscoelastic half-space convolved with lake loading history from 900 to 2022 CE, the authors jointly invert displacement and velocity data. The best-fitting rheology has an elastic plate thickness of 30 [±2] km and a mantle relaxation time of 25 [+10, -6] years (viscosity ~5.5×10^19 Pa·s). The model also predicts up to 9–10 cm of uplift over 150 years if the modern Salton Sea completely desiccates.
本研究利用高分辨率机载与车载LiDAR地形数据及20-25年的GPS垂直速度数据，约束了南加州索尔顿海槽的岩石圈流变学特征。作者开发了LiDAR海岸线评估（LSA）新方法，从建造性沙坝中提取了43个新的古卡维亚湖海岸线高程点，并结合900至2022年的湖泊水荷载历史，采用弹性板覆盖粘弹性半空间的双层……

t: Jointly fits a two-layer elastic-viscoelastic rebound model to LiDAR-derived paleo-shoreline elevations and GPS vertical velocities using a summed chi-squared grid search over plate thickness H and Maxwell relaxation time tau.
通过卡方网格搜索，利用双层弹性-粘弹性回弹模型联合拟合LiDAR古海岸线高程与GPS垂直速度。

Combines 1-m and 7-m airborne LiDAR DEMs, 12-m TanDEM-X data, mobile truck-mounted LiDAR intensity profiles, historical Lake Cahuilla/Salton Sea water levels (900–2022 CE), and 20–25-year ESESES GPS vertical velocities.
结合1米和7米机载LiDAR、12米TanDEM-X、车载LiDAR、历史湖水位及20-25年GPS垂直速度。

Inversion yields a best-fit elastic plate thickness of 30 [±2] km and relaxation time of 25 [+10, -6] years (viscosity ~5.5×10^19 Pa·s), predicting up to 9–10 cm uplift 150 years after complete Salton Sea desiccation.
最佳拟合弹性板厚30[±2] km，弛豫时间25[+10,-6]年；索尔顿海干涸150年后可隆升9-10 cm。
The model neglects lateral variations in plate thickness or relaxation time, lateral pore-pressure diffusion, and non-secular vertical motions from groundwater pumping and postseismic deformation.
未考虑流变学横向变化、孔隙压力横向扩散以及地下水抽取和震后形变噪声。

Introduces the LiDAR Shoreline Assessment (LSA) technique to measure constructional berms in remote areas and integrates 20–25-year GPS vertical velocities with continuous modern Salton Sea water levels.
提出LSA方法客观测量偏远沙坝高程，并融合长时序GPS速度与现代连续水位记录。

kc: Developed the LiDAR Shoreline Assessment (LSA) histogram method to objectively measure 43 paleo-shoreline elevations on constructional sand berms.
Jointly inverted paleo-shoreline vertical displacements and 20–25-year GPS vertical velocities to tightly constrain elastic thickness (30 ± 2 km) and relaxation time (25 [+10, -6] years).
Demonstrated that complete desiccation of the modern Salton Sea could induce up to 9–10 cm of viscoelastic uplift over 150 years.
开发了LiDAR海岸线评估（LSA）直方图方法，客观测量了建造性沙坝上的43个古海岸线高程。
联合反演古海岸线垂直位移和20-25年GPS垂直速度，紧密约束了弹性板厚度（30 ± 2 km）和弛豫时间（25 [+10, -6]年）。
证明如果现代索尔顿海完全干涸，在150年内可能引起高达9-10厘米的粘弹性回弹隆升。
me: LiDAR Shoreline Assessment (LSA) using 0.1-m binned elevation histograms across 50-m-wide shoreline profiles to detect constructional berm landward minima.
Two-layer viscoelastic rebound forward modeling (elastic plate over Maxwell viscoelastic half-space) convolved with historical lake loads from 900 to 2022 CE.
Joint chi-squared grid search over plate thickness (H = 20–60 km) and relaxation time (tau = 0–60 years) with L-moment uncertainty estimation.
Mobile truck-mounted LiDAR backscatter intensity profiling to identify tufa-covered cliff shorelines.
LiDAR海岸线评估（LSA），利用50米宽海岸线剖面的0.1米分箱高程直方图来检测建造性沙坝向陆侧局部最低点。
双层粘弹性回弹正演模拟（麦克斯韦粘弹性半空间上的弹性板），与900至2022年的历史湖泊荷载进行卷积。
对板厚（H = 20–60 km）和弛豫时间（tau = 0–60年）进行联合卡方网格搜索，并利用L-矩估计不确定性。
利用车载移动LiDAR后向散射强度剖面识别钙华覆盖陡崖的古海岸线。
de: Broad-coverage 1-m USGS aircraft LiDAR DEM, 7-m INEGI aircraft LiDAR in Mexicali, and 12-m TanDEM-X elevation data at Cerro Prieto sill.
Long-term (20–25 years) continuous GPS vertical velocities across Southern California processed with the ESESES algorithm (accuracy ~0.2 mm/yr).
Historical water level reconstructions for six Lake Cahuilla highstands (900–1733 CE) and continuous Salton Sea records (1905–2022 CE).
Truck-mounted dual Riegl LiDAR and spherical camera survey at La Quinta and Fish Creek Mountains tufa sites.
大范围1米分辨率USGS机载LiDAR数字高程模型、墨西哥卡利地区7米INEGI机载LiDAR数据以及Cerro Prieto岩槛12米TanDEM-X高程数据。
使用ESESES算法处理的南加州长期（20-25年）连续GPS垂直速度数据（精度约0.2 mm/yr）。
古卡维亚湖六次高水位期（公元900-1733年）的历史水位重建以及索尔顿海连续水位记录（1905-2022年）。
在La Quinta和Fish Creek山脉钙华遗址开展的车载双Riegl LiDAR与球形相机测量。
li: The viscoelastic model is laterally homogeneous and neglects lateral variations in plate thickness or relaxation time across the geothermally active Salton Trough.
Lateral diffusion of pore pressure is not accounted for in the rebound model.
GPS vertical velocities contain strong non-secular noise from groundwater pumping in geothermal/agricultural fields, postseismic relaxation, and tectonic subsidence.
粘弹性模型假设横向均匀，忽略了地热活跃的索尔顿海槽在板厚或弛豫时间上的横向变化。
回弹模型未考虑孔隙压力的横向扩散。
GPS垂直速度包含来自地热/农业区地下水抽取、震后弛豫和构造沉降的强烈非长期背景噪声。

tm.why: The paper derives the lithospheric elastic plate thickness and mantle relaxation time in Southern California by modeling viscoelastic rebound from ancient Lake Cahuilla unloading.
The study performs a joint chi-squared grid search inversion of shoreline elevation displacements and GPS vertical velocities to constrain lithospheric rheology parameters.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF read and analyzed, including all equations, methods, figures (Figs. 1–8), and discussion.

sum: This study investigates the interseismic and coseismic mechanics of normal faults in southern Tibet through the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake. The authors invert 2014–2023 InSAR strain rates for interseismic slip deficit rates across 132 normal faults, perform finite-fault coseismic slip inversion using four InSAR tracks (Sentinel-1, Lutan-1, ALOS-2), and conduct 3D Discontinuous Galerkin dynamic rupture simulations constrained by InSAR and four strong-motion stations. Results reveal that the Dingri earthquake ruptured two asperities separated by a shallow high-strength slip gap above the hypocenter, causing a slow initiation (~1.2–1.3 km/s) followed by rapid northward propagation (~2.7 km/s). Southward rupture was arrested by a ~37° fault bend, while northward termination correlated with a low slip deficit rate barrier. Across southern Tibet, normal faults slip at 1–3 mm/yr and accumulate moment equivalent to Mw 5.3–7.2 earthquakes every 500 years, providing a unified framework linking interseismic locking to dynamic rupture.
本研究结合2025年定日Mw 7.1地震探讨藏南正断层的震间与同震力学机制。利用2014–2023年InSAR应变率反演132条正断层的震间滑动亏损率，基于四轨InSAR数据反演同震有限断层滑动，并结合强震动记录开展三维间断有限元动力学破裂模拟。结果显示定日地震破裂了两个凹凸体，震源上方存在高强度浅……

t: Integrates elasticity-based interseismic slip deficit inversion, Steepest Descent Method finite-fault InSAR slip inversion, and 3D Discontinuous Galerkin spontaneous dynamic rupture simulations using linear slip-weakening friction.
结合弹性应变率震间滑动亏损反演、SDM同震有限断层反演与三维间断有限元（DG）自发动力学破裂模拟。

Uses 2014–2023 InSAR horizontal velocities across southern Tibet, four coseismic InSAR tracks (Sentinel-1 ascending/descending, Lutan-1, ALOS-2), and 0.02–0.25 Hz waveforms from four strong-motion stations.
使用2014–2023年藏南InSAR水平速度场、四轨同震InSAR数据及4个强震台0.02–0.25 Hz波形。

The Dingri earthquake (Mw 7.09 kinematic, Mw 7.02 dynamic) ruptured two asperities with up to ~4 m slip, transitioning from slow initiation (1.2–1.3 km/s) to rapid propagation (2.7 km/s) with 4.8 MPa stress drop.
定日地震破裂两个凹凸体（最大滑动约4 m），呈慢速起始（1.2–1.3 km/s）转快速扩展（2.7 km/s），平均应…

Coseismic InSAR scenes were acquired 12–32 days after the mainshock and contain postseismic deformation; absolute fault stress cannot be measured to definitively distinguish low-stress from high-strength barriers.
同震InSAR含震后12–32天形变；断层绝对应力未知，难以完全区分低应力与高强度障碍体。

Provides the first detailed interseismic slip deficit map for 132 normal faults in southern Tibet and links interseismic locking to 3D coseismic dynamic rupture mechanics of the 2025 Dingri earthquake.
首次给出藏南132条正断层震间滑动亏损图，并将震间闭锁与2025年定日地震三维同震动力学过程相联系。

kc: Constructed the first detailed map of interseismic slip deficit rates across 132 normal faults and 15 strike-slip faults in southern Tibet using 2014–2023 InSAR velocity fields.
Resolved coseismic finite-fault slip of the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake on the Dengmecuo fault using Sentinel-1, Lutan-1, and ALOS-2 InSAR data, identifying two asperities and a shallow slip gap.
Developed a 3D listric nonplanar Discontinuous Galerkin dynamic rupture model jointly constrained by InSAR and strong-motion waveforms, reproducing the two-phase slow-to-fast rupture evolution.
Quantified 500-year seismic moment accumulation rates across southern Tibet normal faults (corresponding to Mw 5.3–7.2 events) and showed ~89% of moment accumulates on faults vs ~11% off-fault.
利用2014–2023年InSAR速度场构建了藏南132条正断层和15条走滑断层的首幅精细震间滑动亏损率图。
联合Sentinel-1、陆探一号和ALOS-2同震InSAR数据反演了2025年定日Mw 7.1地震在登么错断层上的滑动分布，识别出两个凹凸体及浅部滑动空区。
建立了受InSAR和强震动波形联合约束的三维铲状非平面间断有限元（DG）动力学破裂模型，重现了先慢后快的两阶段破裂演化。
量化了藏南正断层500年尺度的地震矩积累率（对应Mw 5.3–7.2地震），发现约89%的地震矩积累在断层面上，约11%表现为断层外弥散变形。
me: Elasticity-based surface strain rate calculation and Bayesian least-squares inversion for interseismic fault slip deficit rates without rigid block assumptions.
Coseismic kinematic finite-fault slip inversion using the Steepest Descent Method (SDM) in a layered Crust 1.0 model with grid-searched fault dip (57°W).
3D spontaneous dynamic rupture simulations using a nodal Discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method with a 250 m triangular mesh on a listric fault embedded in the USTClitho2.0 3D velocity model.
Triaxial stress projection scheme and depth-dependent linear slip-weakening friction parameterized via a data-driven strategy to fit InSAR and strong-motion records.
基于弹性连续介质计算地表应变率，并采用带先验约束的贝叶斯最小二乘法直接反演断层震间滑动亏损率（无需刚性块体假设）。
基于Crust 1.0分层地壳模型和最速下降法（SDM）反演同震有限断层滑动分布，并通过网格搜索确定最优倾角（57°W）。
采用节点间断有限元（DG）方法在三维USTClitho2.0速度模型中开展铲状非平面断层（250 m三角网格）三维自发动力学破裂模拟。
采用三轴应力投影方案与随深度变化的线性滑动弱化摩擦准则，通过数据驱动策略设定摩擦参数以同时拟合InSAR与强震动记录。
de: Interseismic horizontal velocity field across southern Tibet (2014–2023) derived from InSAR at ~25 km spatial resolution.
Four tracks of coseismic D-InSAR LOS displacements: ascending/descending Sentinel-1, ascending Lutan-1, and descending ALOS-2 (5,806 downsampled data points total).
Three-component strong-motion ground velocity waveforms from four regional stations (D0001, D0004, D0007, DS002) bandpass filtered between 0.02 and 0.25 Hz.
Sensitivity experiments comparing listric vs constant-dip (57°) fault geometries and varying frictional barrier parameters.
空间分辨率约25 km的2014–2023年藏南InSAR震间水平速度场数据。
四轨同震D-InSAR视线向（LOS）形变数据：升降轨Sentinel-1、升轨陆探一号（Lutan-1）和降轨ALOS-2（降采样后共5,806个观测点）。
4个区域强震动台站（D0001、D0004、D0007、DS002）的三分量地面速度波形记录（0.02–0.25 Hz带通滤波）。
对比铲状断层与恒定倾角（57°）断层几何形态以及不同摩擦障碍体参数的动力学敏感性数值实验。
li: Coseismic InSAR acquisitions spanned 12–32 days post-mainshock, inevitably including early postseismic deformation in the kinematic model.
Absolute on-fault stress states cannot be directly measured, leaving ambiguity between low-stress and high-strength barrier mechanisms at the northern termination and shallow slip gap.
Historical earthquake catalogs for normal faults in southern Tibet are incomplete, limiting seismic hazard assessments to fixed time-interval (500 or 1,000 yr) moment accumulation estimates.
同震InSAR数据获取于主震后12–32天，运动学反演结果不可避免地混入了早期震后形变信号。
断层绝对应力状态无法直接测量，北端破裂终止区与浅部滑动空区究竟受控于低应力还是高强度障碍体仍存在一定多解性。
藏南正断层系统的历史地震目录不完整，导致地震危险性评估仅能基于固定时间间隔（500或1000年）的地震矩累积估算。

tm.why: The study performs finite-fault slip inversion and 3D Discontinuous Galerkin dynamic rupture simulations of the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake.
It links interseismic fault locking (slip deficit rates on 132 normal faults) with coseismic slip and on-fault stress-strength heterogeneities.
It uses strong-motion records to constrain dynamic rupture models and quantifies 500-year seismic moment accumulation and earthquake potential across southern Tibet.

ev.notes: Full 14-page JGR: Solid Earth PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), and all 8 figures.

sum: Standard depth uncertainties in wide-angle crustal models propagate assumed picking errors while ignoring intra-gather correlation and velocity-depth trade-offs. This study revisits the 210-km Perur–Chikmagalur profile across the Dharwar Craton using an audited ledger of 2,000 primary first arrivals, 9,919 reflections, and 852 later-turning P4 phases from seven shots. Using a reciprocity-based fast-marching table for rapid 6-interface Gauss-Newton inversion, the authors implement nested leave-one-shot-out validation, receiver-block bootstrapping, delete-one-shot jackknifing, synthetic transition recovery, and a nonlinear velocity perturbation ensemble. Withheld Moho reflections (PmP) are predicted to 73 ms RMS (standardized MSE 2.12). Exact window means place the Moho at 46.9 km (west) and 39.4 km (central), a 7.47 km contrast. Within-shot bootstrap spread is ±0.10 km, whereas between-shot deletion gives ±0.40 km, and admissible velocity models span 6.46–8.64 km. Furthermore, paired reflections confirm an upper-crustal low-velocity layer (~3.16 km thick), though its internal velocity shape remains unresolved.
广角地壳模型的传统深度不确定性通常仅传递拾取误差，忽略了同炮道集内相关性及速度-深度折衷。本文重新审视横跨达尔瓦尔克拉通210公里的Perur-Chikmagalur测线（7炮共2000个初至、9919个反射及852个P4震相）。利用基于互易原理的快速行进表实现6界面高斯-牛顿快速反演，开展了嵌套留……

t: Eikonal fast-marching solver and reciprocity-based traveltime lookup table with discrete Fermat minimization for simultaneous 6-reflector Gauss-Newton inversion, calibrated via nested leave-one-shot-out validation, 10-km receiver block bootstrap, and nonlinear velocity ensembles.
结合程函快速行进与互易走时查找表反演6个反射界面，利用留一炮验证、分块自助法与非线性速度集标定不确定性。

Audited ledger of 12,911 wide-angle picks from 7 shots along the 210-km Perur–Chikmagalur profile across the Dharwar Craton: 2,000 P1–P2 first arrivals, 9,919 reflections from 6 interfaces, and 852 later-turning P4 arrivals.
达尔瓦尔克拉通210公里测线7炮共12,911个广角拾取：2,000个初至折射、9,919个反射及852个P4回折震相。

Exact window means place the Moho at 46.915 km (WDC) and 39.448 km (CDC), a 7.466 km contrast. Uncertainty spans ±0.100 km (within-shot bootstrap), ±0.398 km (delete-one-shot SE), and 6.457–8.639 km across admissible velocity models.
西、中块莫霍面深46.92和39.45公里（差7.47公里）；炮内标准差0.10公里，炮间标准误0.40公里，速度容许范…

First arrivals do not constrain velocity below ~16 km, leaving Moho depth dependent on an inherited velocity field; unmodeled near-surface weathering and aperture extrapolation degrade held-out refraction predictions.
初至波仅约束16公里以上速度，深部依赖先验速度；未建模风化层与孔径外推导致留出折射预测偏差较大。

Replaces optimistic pick-error propagation in wide-angle seismology with leakage-free shot-grouped cross-validation and explicitly separated uncertainty axes for within-shot dependence, shot leverage, recovery bias, and velocity-depth trade-offs.
摒弃传统拾取误差传递，建立无泄漏整炮交叉验证，并将炮内相关、炮间杠杆、恢复偏差和速度折衷分离报告。

kc: Reconciled and permanently identified 12,911 wide-angle traveltime picks across the Dharwar Craton, disambiguating shallow low-velocity layer (LVL) reflections (P2, P3) from later-turning P4 refractions.

Developed a reciprocity-based fast-marching lookup table and discrete Fermat search that enables rapid simultaneous Gauss-Newton refitting of six crustal reflectors across hundreds of bootstrap and cross-validation folds.

Demonstrated via leakage-free nested leave-one-shot-out validation that assigned pick uncertainties understate held-out reflection errors (PmP RMS 72.8 ms, standardized MSE 2.12) and severely fail on refractions (102.6 ms RMS) due to aperture extrapolation and unmodeled near-surface weathering.

Separated uncertainty into distinct axes for the 7.47 km WDC–CDC Moho depth contrast: ±0.10 km within-shot bootstrap SD, ±0.40 km between-shot SE, -0.36 to -0.48 km recovery bias, and 6.46–8.64 km admissible nonlinear velocity range.
Proved the existence of an ~3.16 km thick upper-crustal LVL using 1,260 paired P2/P3 reflections and P4 branch reachability, while showing its internal velocity gradient remains non-unique.
核对并永久标识了达尔瓦尔克拉通12,911个广角走时拾取记录，消除了浅部低速层反射（P2、P3）与后续回折震相（P4）的编码混淆。
开发了基于互易原理的快速行进查找表和离散费马搜索算法，支持在数百次自助法和交叉验证折中同时对六个地壳反射界面进行快速高斯-牛顿重拟合。
通过无泄漏嵌套留一炮交叉验证证明，给定拾取误差低估了留出反射预测误差（PmP均方根72.8毫秒，标准化均方误差2.12），且因孔径外推和未建模近地表风化层导致折射预测严重失效（均方根102.6毫秒）。
将西-中达尔瓦尔莫霍面深度落差（7.47公里）的不确定性分解为独立维度：炮内分块自助标准差±0.10公里、炮间标准误±0.40公里、恢复偏差-0.36至-0.48公里，以及非线性速度容许范围6.46–8.64公里。
利用1,260对P2/P3配对反射及P4分支可达性证实了厚约3.16公里的上地壳低速层的存在，同时指出其内部速度梯度形态仍具非唯一性。
me: Fast-marching eikonal solver (h = 0.25 km) with analytic source-circle initialization for first-arrival refraction traveltimes and steepest-descent ray reconstruction.

Reciprocity-based surface-to-subsurface traveltime lookup table (112 depths x 85 lateral columns) coupled with discrete Fermat minimization and Gauss-Newton updates for simultaneous 6-reflector depth inversion.
Leakage-free nested leave-one-complete-shot-out cross-validation for regularization tuning and out-of-sample empirical coverage calibration.
Non-circular moving-block bootstrap in receiver coordinates (10-km primary block length, 500 replicates) and delete-one-shot jackknife for spatial and gather-level dependence.

Nonlinear velocity-depth perturbation ensemble (47 unique rebuilt velocity fields across ±3% cosine masks) and 750 noisy synthetic Moho transition inversions for model-class and recovery bias evaluation.
采用带解析源圆初始化的快速行进程函求解器（网格0.25公里）计算初至折射走时，并通过最速下降法重构射线。
构建基于互易原理的地表-地下走时查找表（112深度×85横向列），结合离散费马极小化与高斯-牛顿更新，实现6个反射界面深度的同时反演。
采用无泄漏的嵌套留一整炮交叉验证进行正则化参数优选及样本外经验覆盖率标定。
采用检波器坐标下的非循环移动分块自助法（主块长10公里，500次重复）和删一炮刀切法，评估空间相关性与炮集级依赖性。
构建非线性速度-深度扰动集合（基于±3%余弦掩膜的47个独立速度场）及750次含噪合成莫霍面过渡带反演，以评估模型类不确定性与恢复偏差。
de: 210-km NE–SW Perur–Chikmagalur 3-component wide-angle seismic profile across the Dharwar Craton recorded by CSIR-NGRI with 7 shot points (30–36 km spacing).

Reconciled permanent ledger of 12,911 phase observations (offsets up to 175.1 km): 2,000 primary P1–P2 refractions, 9,919 primary reflections (P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, PmP), 852 later-turning P4 arrivals, 112 ambiguous P2/P2 picks, and 28 near-source P1 picks.

Phase-specific grid scan of 6,624 candidate upper-crustal LVL models testing top offsets, mean thicknesses (1.75–5.50 km), core velocities (5.2–6.6 km/s), and internal velocity shapes (sharp, linear, cosine).
Targeted synthetic PmP recovery experiment across 15 Moho transition geometries (centers at 100, 110, 120 km; widths 0–100 km) with 50 noise realizations each.
由CSIR-NGRI采集的横跨达尔瓦尔克拉通210公里NE–SW向Perur–Chikmagalur三分量广角地震测线（7个炮点，间距30–36公里）。
经核对的12,911条震相观测永久台账（最大炮检距175.1公里）：含2,000个P1–P2初至折射、9,919个主反射（P2至PmP）、852个P4回折波、112个模糊拾取及28个近源拾取。
针对上地壳低速层的6,624个候选模型特定震相网格扫描，测试顶界偏移、平均厚度（1.75–5.50公里）、核心速度（5.2–6.6 km/s）及内部速度形态（突变、线性、余弦）。
针对15种莫霍面过渡带几何形态（中心位于100、110、120公里；宽度0–100公里）、每种含50次独立噪声实现的PmP目标合成恢复实验。
li: First-arrival refractions have no ray coverage below ~16 km depth, so Moho depth conversion (39–47 km) relies entirely on an inherited lower-crustal velocity model and a declared ±3% perturbation design choice.

The refraction parameterisation bounds velocities at ≥4.8 km/s (production field ≥5.2 km/s), omitting low-velocity weathered near-surface material and causing a systematic +94.4 ms held-out bias on direct P1 arrivals.

With only seven shot gathers arranged along a 1-D line, outer folds are not exchangeable (withholding end-shot SP1 forces uncalibrated aperture extrapolation) and preclude distribution-free conformal guarantees.
The synthetic Moho transition bias correction centers on plateau depths of 47 and 39 km, presupposing that the recovered ~8 km contrast is already approximately correct.
初至折射波在约16公里深度以下无射线覆盖，因此莫霍面深度转换（39–47公里）完全依赖于继承的下地壳速度模型及预设的±3%速度扰动设计。
折射参数化将速度下限设为4.8 km/s（生产速度场≥5.2 km/s），忽略了近地表低速风化层，导致直达波P1在留出预测中产生+94.4毫秒的系统性早到偏差。
测线仅含一维排列的7个炮集，各折之间不具可交换性（留出端点SP1会导致向未采样孔径外推），无法提供免分布的保形预测保证。
合成莫霍面过渡带偏差校正构建于47和39公里的平台深度之上，预先假定了所恢复的约8公里落差大致正确。

tm.why: The paper performs wide-angle refraction and reflection travel-time inversion using fast-marching eikonal solvers and Gauss-Newton updates to image crustal velocity and reflector depths.

The central focus of the paper is calibrating predictive uncertainty, separating within-shot bootstrap, between-shot jackknife, synthetic recovery bias, and nonlinear velocity-depth trade-off ensembles.
The study investigates the Moho depth contrast and an upper-crustal low-velocity layer across the Western and Central Dharwar Craton in southern India.

ev.notes: Full 56-page PDF manuscript (including all main text, 5 tables, 13 main figures, and 14 supplementary figures/1 supplementary table) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: Classical Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle skipping, source-signature uncertainty, and starting-model sensitivity due to trace-by-trace waveform comparisons. This paper introduces source-centred Time-Reversal Full Wavefield Inversion (TRFWI), which reformulates velocity model building as a wavefield-focusing problem. Recorded seismic data are reversed in time and backpropagated through a trial velocity model; the objective functional maximizes the energy focused at the known source location and onset time. Because the focusing functional behaves like the source wavelet autocorrelation, it varies smoothly and unimodally near the true velocity, mitigating cycle skipping and eliminating penalty parameters required in extended-source methods. Furthermore, multiples and scattered waves contribute constructively to refocusing. Tested on a 3-parameter 2D synthetic acoustic model with diving and reflected waves using random search and Nelder-Mead optimization, TRFWI accurately recovers the reference velocity and spatial gradients, demonstrating a viable wavefield-centric alternative to FWI.
传统全波形反演（FWI）因依赖逐道波形对比，易受周波跳跃和初始模型误差影响。本文提出以震源为中心的时间反转全波场反演（TRFWI），将速度建模转化为波场聚焦问题。该方法将记录数据时间反转并在试算速度模型中反向传播，通过最大化已知震源位置和发震时刻的聚焦能量来反演速度。该聚焦泛函表现类似震源子波自相关……

t: Recorded seismic data are time-reversed and backpropagated through a trial velocity model; inversion maximizes an energy-based focusing functional evaluated at the known source position and onset time.
将记录数据时间反转并在试算速度模型中反向传播，最大化已知震源位置和发震时刻的能量聚焦泛函。
A 2D synthetic acoustic single-shot gather generated using a 20-Hz Ricker wavelet at 50 m depth in a linear-gradient velocity model with a 300-m deep reflector.
含300米深反射层的二维线性梯度声波模型，由50米深处20 Hz雷克子波激发生成的单炮合成记录。
After 100 iterations of random search and Nelder-Mead refinement, TRFWI recovered V0 = 0.8506 km/s, gradz = 0.63, and gradx = 0.19, closely matching true values (0.850, 0.6, 0.2).
经100次随机搜索与Nelder-Mead迭代，反演得V0=0.8506 km/s、gradz=0.63、gradx=0…
The demonstration is restricted to transmission data inversion in a simple 3-parameter synthetic model; reflection data inversion and high-dimensional optimization challenges remain unresolved.
目前仅限于简单三参数合成透射波数据反演，尚无反射波反演结果且高维优化具挑战。

Replaces trace-by-trace waveform-misfit minimization with source-centred time-reversal wavefield focusing, naturally incorporating multiples and avoiding cycle skipping without extended-source penalty parameters.
以震源时间反转聚焦替代逐道波形拟合差，无需惩罚参数即可避免周波跳跃并利用多次波。

kc: Formulates Time-Reversal Full Wavefield Inversion (TRFWI) based on maximizing backpropagated wavefield energy at the known source location and onset time.
Demonstrates that the focusing functional is unimodal and smooth near the true velocity model, inherently mitigating classical cycle skipping without extended-source penalty parameters.
Derives the adjoint-state gradient equations for the source-focusing objective functional alongside derivative-free global optimization demonstrations.
提出了基于已知震源位置和发震时刻反向传播波场能量最大化的时间反转全波场反演（TRFWI）。
证明了聚焦泛函在真实速度模型附近平滑且呈单峰分布，无需扩展震源惩罚参数即可天然缓解传统周波跳跃。
推导了震源聚焦目标泛函的伴随状态梯度方程，并展示了无导数全局优化反演实例。
me: Time-reversal acoustics backpropagation using finite-difference acoustic modeling.
Energy-based wavefield focusing objective functional evaluated around the source location and zero-onset time window.
Random search combined with derivative-free Nelder-Mead simplex refinement (100 iterations).
Theoretical derivation of the adjoint-state gradient with a delta-function adjoint source at the true source location and onset time.
基于有限差分声波模拟的时间反转声学反向传播。
在震源位置和零发震时刻窗口附近评估的基于能量的波场聚焦目标泛函。
结合无导数Nelder-Mead单纯形精化的随机搜索优化（100次迭代）。
以真实震源位置和发震时刻的Delta函数作为伴随源的伴随状态梯度理论推导。
de: 2D synthetic acoustic medium parameterized by reference velocity V0 (0.850 km/s), vertical gradient gradz (0.6 1/s), and lateral gradient gradx (0.2 1/s), plus a horizontal reflector at 300 m depth.
Single common-shot gather generated by a 20-Hz Ricker wavelet at 50 m depth recorded along a surface receiver array.
二维合成声学介质，由参考速度V0（0.850 km/s）、垂向梯度gradz（0.6 1/s）和横向梯度gradx（0.2 1/s）参数化，并在300米深处设有一水平反射层。
由50米深处的20 Hz雷克子波激发、地表检波器阵列接收的单炮道集。
li: Currently demonstrated only on a 3-parameter 2D synthetic transmission-dominated dataset using a single shot gather.
No inversion results are yet available for reflection-dominated velocity updates or complex multi-parameter field datasets.
Gradient-based optimization may only be effective when the starting model is already close to the true solution.
目前仅在使用单炮道集的三参数二维合成透射波主导数据集上进行了验证。
尚未提供反射波数据速度反演或复杂多参数实际资料的应用结果。
基于梯度的优化可能仅在初始模型接近真实解时才有效。

tm.why: Introduces Time-Reversal Full Wavefield Inversion (TRFWI) as a focusing-based alternative to classical full waveform inversion, including adjoint-state gradient derivations.
Replaces classical trace-by-trace waveform-misfit objective functions with a time-reversal wavefield-focusing functional to mitigate cycle skipping and non-uniqueness.

sum: This study investigates the paleoseismic history of the North Liuleng Shan fault (NLSF) in the northern Shanxi Graben System, China, using trench excavations, radiocarbon and optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating, and morphotectonic analysis. The authors identify the two most recent surface-rupturing paleoearthquakes, dating them to approximately 8327 ± 1125 a B.P. and 20,560 ± 750 a B.P., which indicates a recurrence interval of 12,233 ± 450 years. Correlation with adjacent fault segments suggests potential cascading ruptures capable of generating Mw 7.0 earthquakes. Given that the northeastern section of the NLSF has been quiescent for about 8,000 years, the study highlights a significant, underappreciated intraplate seismic hazard in this region.
本研究通过槽探开挖、放射性碳与光释光（OSL）测年及微地貌分析，揭示了华北山西地堑系北部北六棱山断裂带（NLSF）的古地震历史。研究确定了最近两次地表破裂型古地震事件，分别发生于约8327 ± 1125年前和20,560 ± 750年前，表明其复发间隔约为12,233 ± 450年。与相邻断裂段的对……

t: Trench excavations combined with radiocarbon and optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating, alongside morphotectonic analysis, were used to reconstruct the paleoseismic history.
结合放射性碳和光释光（OSL）测年的探槽开挖以及微地貌分析，用于重建古地震历史。
Stratigraphic, structural, and geochronological data from trench walls and sediment samples along the North Liuleng Shan fault.
沿北六棱山断裂带探槽剖面和沉积物样品的层序、结构及年代学数据。
Identified two paleoearthquakes at ~8327 and ~20,560 a B.P., yielding a 12,233-year recurrence interval and potential cascading Mw 7.0 ruptures.
识别出约8327和20,560年前的两次古地震，得出12,233年的复发间隔及潜在的Mw 7.0级级联破裂。
The paleoseismic history is limited to only two events, and cascading rupture models rely on correlation rather than direct physical evidence.
古地震历史仅限于两次事件，且级联破裂模型依赖于对比而非直接物理证据。
Provides the first well-constrained paleoseismic recurrence interval and cascading rupture assessment for the North Liuleng Shan fault.
首次为北六棱山断裂带提供了约束良好的古地震复发间隔和级联破裂评估。

kc: Determined the timing of the two most recent surface-rupturing paleoearthquakes on the North Liuleng Shan fault.
Estimated a recurrence interval of approximately 12,233 years for major earthquakes on this fault.
Identified potential cascading rupture behavior with adjacent segments, capable of producing Mw 7.0 events.
Highlighted the high seismic hazard of the northeastern NLSF due to its ~8 ky quiescence.
确定了北六棱山断裂带最近两次地表破裂型古地震的具体时间。
估算出该断裂带大地震的复发间隔约为12,233年。
识别出与相邻断裂段可能存在的级联破裂行为，可产生Mw 7.0级地震。
指出由于近8000年的静默，北六棱山断裂东北段具有极高的地震危险性。

Radiocarbon (14C) dating of organic materials.
Optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating of sediments.
Morphotectonic analysis of fault scarps and landforms.
通过探槽开挖与编录识别古地震层位。
对有机质材料进行放射性碳（14C）测年。
对沉积物进行光释光（OSL）测年。
对断层崖及地貌进行微地貌分析。

Stratigraphic and structural observations from trench walls along the North Liuleng Shan fault.
Morphotectonic measurements of fault-related landforms.
探槽样品放射性碳和OSL测年的年代学数据。
北六棱山断裂带沿线探槽剖面的地层和结构观测。
断裂相关地貌的微地貌测量数据。
li: The paleoseismic record is limited to only the two most recent events, which may not fully represent long-term recurrence variability.
Cascading rupture scenarios are inferred from correlation with adjacent segments rather than direct physical rupture modeling.
古地震记录仅限于最近两次事件，可能无法完全代表长期的复发变化规律。
级联破裂情景是通过与相邻段的对比推断出来的，而非直接的物理破裂模拟。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the intraplate seismic hazard and recurrence intervals of a major active fault in China.
The study investigates the rupture history, recurrence intervals, and potential cascading ruptures of fault segments.

sum: Back-propagating earthquake rupture (BPR), where secondary slip migrates opposite to the main rupture front, is observed in both regular earthquakes and slow slip events, yet the role of fluids remains unclear. Using 2D anti-plane hydro-mechanical simulations governed by rate-and-state friction, this study investigates how pore-fluid pressure controls BPR on homogeneous and heterogeneous faults. The authors find that the ratio of initial shear stress to effective normal stress (τ0/σeff) governs rupture modes: low τ0/σeff produces self-healing pulse-like ruptures with incomplete stress release (stress undershoot) and recurrent BPRs, whereas high τ0/σeff drives continuous crack-like ruptures without BPR. Furthermore, localized patches of elevated or reduced pore pressure act as dynamic barriers or asperities, causing abrupt slip-rate and shear-stress perturbations that trigger BPR. The study establishes an analytical Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics energy framework showing BPR initiates when local stress drop exceeds the critical threshold for backward re-rupture.

t: 2D anti-plane dynamic rupture simulations using the Hydro-Mechanical-Earthquake Cycles (H-MECs) code, coupling elastic deformation with rate-and-state fault friction and pore-fluid pressure.
使用H-MECs代码进行二维反平面动态破裂模拟，耦合弹性变形、速率-状态摩擦与孔隙水压。
Synthetic 2D strike-slip fault models (5 km long) loaded at constant far-field rate, testing uniform stress profiles (τ0/σeff from 0.3 to 0.9) and a 100 m differential pore-pressure patch at 3 km.
5公里长的二维走滑断层合成数值实验，测试0.3–0.9的应力比及3公里处的100米孔隙压异常斑块。

Increasing τ0/σeff from 0.33 to 0.53 transitions rupture from pulse-like with recurrent BPRs to crack-like without BPR, while increasing cumulative slip from 0.1 to 0.2 m and rupture speed from 0.05 to 0.2 m/s.
τ0/σeff从0.33增至0.53使破裂由含BPR的脉冲型转为无BPR的裂纹型，破裂速度从0.05增至0.2 m/s。
The 2D single-segment fault model neglects 3D multi-fault interactions, does not produce supershear BPR, and omits active poroelastic diffusion during rupture.
简化的二维单一断层忽略了三维复杂几何与流体扩散，且未产生超剪切BPR。
Quantifies how fluid-modulated effective normal stress and localized pore-pressure patches control BPR, supported by an analytical fracture-mechanics energy threshold for backward re-rupture.
阐明了流体调制有效正应力与局部水压斑块触发BPR的机制，并建立了反向再破裂能量阈值准则。

kc: Demonstrates that low initial shear-to-effective-normal stress ratios (τ0/σeff) promote self-healing pulse-like ruptures with back-propagating earthquake rupture (BPR) fronts.
Shows that localized hydraulic heterogeneity (high or low pore-pressure patches) triggers BPR via transient slip-rate acceleration/deceleration and steep stress gradients.
Establishes an analytical fracture-mechanics and energy-balance criterion showing BPR nucleates when residual stress and local stress drop exceed the backward critical threshold.
证明了低初始剪应力与有效正应力之比（τ0/σeff）会促进伴随反向传播破裂（BPR）前缘的自愈合脉冲型破裂。
揭示了局部水力非均质性（高或低孔隙水压斑块）通过瞬态滑移率加减速和陡峭应力梯度触发BPR的机制。
建立了基于断裂力学和能量平衡的解析准则，证明当残余应力和局部应力降超过反向临界阈值时会成核BPR。
me: 2D anti-plane full-space dynamic rupture simulations using the Hydro-Mechanical-Earthquake Cycles (H-MECs) code.
Coupled elastic bulk deformation and fault slip governed by rate-and-state friction with prescribed pore-fluid pressure profiles.
Linear Elastic Fracture Mechanics (LEFM) analytical energy-balance modeling comparing numerical dynamic stress drops against critical forward and backward fracture energy thresholds.
使用水-力耦合地震周期（H-MECs）代码进行二维反平面全空间动态破裂数值模拟。
将弹性体变形与受速率-状态摩擦定律及孔隙流体压力分布控制的断层滑移相耦合。
利用线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）解析能量平衡模型，将数值动态应力降与正向和反向临界断裂能阈值进行对比。
de: Synthetic parametric suite varying τ0/σeff from 0.3 to 0.9 across effective normal stresses of 30 MPa and 40 MPa on a 5 km fault.
Homogeneous fault models (Models M1–M4) versus heterogeneous models embedding a 100 m differential pore-pressure patch at x = 3 km (Models M5 and M6).
在5公里断层上，针对30 MPa和40 MPa有效正应力、将τ0/σeff从0.3变化至0.9的合成参数化数值实验。
均质断层模型（M1–M4）与在3公里处嵌入100米差异孔隙水压斑块的非均质断层模型（M5和M6）对比实验。
li: Uses a simplified 2D single planar fault segment, neglecting 3D effects and complex fault geometries like branches, bends, and step-overs.
Does not capture supershear BPR speeds and exhibits lower rupture velocities and stress drops than natural large earthquakes due to low background stress.
Poroelastic effects such as permeability evolution and pore-fluid diffusion during rupture are not explicitly resolved.
采用简化的二维单一平面断层段，忽略了三维效应以及分叉、弯曲和阶区等复杂断层几何结构。
由于背景应力较低，未能捕捉到超剪切BPR速度，且模拟的破裂速度和应力降低于自然界大地震。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the physical mechanisms and energy balance of back-propagating earthquake ruptures (BPR) using dynamic rupture simulations.
The study models rate-and-state frictional sliding coupled with pore-fluid pressure on faults and links the findings to rapid tremor reversals in slow slip events.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page PDF document (including ETH Library cover page and full Geophysical Research Letters article text and figures).

sum: This study evaluates four common hypotheses regarding Gutenberg-Richter b-value variations around large earthquakes using the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) catalog (2000–2025). Applying the b-positive estimator, sequence separation, and rigorous statistical testing (b-significant and paired t-tests) across 62 independent M >= 6 sequences, the authors test whether b-values vary non-randomly (H1), drop before mainshocks (H2), rise after mainshocks (H3), or localize in low b-value regions (H4). Results support H1 (predominantly spatially) and H4 (nearby b-values are lower by ~0.05), but find no evidence for systematic pre-event drops (H2) or post-event increases (H3). Furthermore, sequence b-values strongly correlate with an independent 3D background b-value map. The novelty lies in demonstrating through a 324-case robustness analysis that first-order b-value variations among sequences are governed by static location-dependent crustal properties rather than temporal stress cycles.
本研究利用2000至2025年日本气象厅（JMA）地震目录，评估了关于大地震序列b值变化的四个假设。作者采用b-positive估计器、序列分离方法及严格的统计检验，对62个独立的M>=6地震序列进行了分析。研究证实b值存在显著的空间非随机变化（H1），且主震倾向于发生在低b值区域（H4，平均低约0……

t: The authors apply the b-positive estimator to 62 separated M>=6 earthquake sequences in Japan, using the b-significant method and paired one-sided t-tests to evaluate spatio-temporal b-value hypotheses.
对日本62个独立M>=6地震序列应用b-positive估计器，结合b-significant和配对t检验评估b值时空假…
The JMA earthquake catalog (January 2000 to July 2025), restricted to depths <=150 km, coastal distances <=40 km, and Mc=0.7, totaling 1,757,289 events and yielding 62 independent M>=6 sequences.
2000至2025年JMA目录（深度<=150km，离岸<=40km，Mc=0.7），共175.7万事件，筛选出62个独…

No evidence supports pre-event b-value drops (p=0.56) or post-event increases (p=0.59). Nearby b-values (<L/2) are lower by 0.05 (p=0.00), and independent background maps strongly predict sequence b-values (slope 1.05).
无证据支持震前b值下降(p=0.56)或震后上升(p=0.59)；主震近场b值低0.05(p=0.00)，且与独立背景图…
Isotropic spherical sequence definitions ignore fault geometry, and only 11 of 62 sequences have enough seismicity within L(M)/2 to test localized temporal changes.
球对称序列定义忽略了断层几何，且仅11个序列在半破裂长度内有足够数据检验局部时间变化。

Demonstrates via STAI-robust statistics, 324 parameter combinations, and an independent 3D Voronoi map that sequence b-values are controlled by static mainshock location rather than temporal evolution.
通过抗STAI统计、324种参数检验及独立背景图，证明序列b值受控于主震静态空间位置而非时间演化。

kc: Statistically tested four major hypotheses of spatio-temporal b-value variations across 62 independent M >= 6 earthquake sequences in Japan.
Demonstrated no statistically significant evidence for pre-mainshock b-value decreases or post-mainshock b-value increases on regional scales.
Showed that b-values within half a rupture length of mainshocks are systematically lower by ~0.05 than surrounding regions, though this is small compared to inter-sequence variability (0.5 to 1.2).
Verified that sequence b-values can be accurately predicted by an independent 3D background seismicity b-value map (slope 1.05, intercept -0.04).
对日本62个独立的M>=6地震序列进行了严格的统计检验，评估了关于b值时空演化的四个主要假设。
证明在区域尺度上不存在统计显著的主震前b值下降或主震后b值上升。
发现主震半个破裂长度内的b值比外围系统性偏低约0.05，但该差异远小于不同序列间的总体空间变化（0.5至1.2）。

me: Magnitude of completeness (Mc) estimation via maximum curvature method with a +0.2 correction factor.
b-value estimation using the b-positive method to mitigate short-term aftershock incompleteness (STAI).
Sequence separation filtering out events within 2L(M) and 100 days of other M >= 6 earthquakes to ensure statistical independence.
Hypothesis testing via the b-significant method, paired one-sided Student's t-tests on transformed b-values, and 3D random Voronoi tessellation mapping.
采用最大曲率法并加上0.2的校正因子来估计完备震级（Mc）。
使用b-positive方法估计b值，以消除短期余震目录不完备性（STAI）的偏差。
通过序列分离剔除其他M>=6地震2倍破裂长度及100天内的事件，以确保各序列的统计独立性。
利用b-significant方法、转换b值的配对单侧t检验以及3D随机Voronoi剖分制图进行假设检验。
de: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) earthquake catalog from January 2000 to July 2025 (depths <= 150 km, coastal distance <= 40 km, Mc = 0.7, totaling 1,757,289 events).
62 independent M >= 6 earthquake sequences spanning up to 10 years before and 100 days after each mainshock (excluding the first day of aftershocks).
Sensitivity and robustness experiments across 324 distinct parameter combinations (varying coastal distance, depth, 2D/3D distance, mainshock magnitude threshold, time windows, and scaling laws).
2000年1月至2025年7月的日本气象厅（JMA）地震目录（深度<=150 km，离岸距离<=40 km，Mc=0.7，共1,757,289个事件）。
筛选出的62个独立M>=6地震序列，涵盖主震前最多10年及震后100天（剔除震后第一天余震）。
涵盖324种参数组合的敏感性与稳健性实验（改变离岸距离、深度、2D/3D距离定义、主震震级阈值、时间窗及破裂长度经验关系）。
li: Sequences are defined using isotropic spherical/cylindrical distances rather than detailed 3D fault plane geometries or sophisticated declustering.
Focuses on large-scale, first-order effects, which may miss highly localized b-value variations within a few kilometers of the fault plane.
Small sample sizes within half a rupture length (< L(M)/2) limit statistical power, leaving only 11 of 62 sequences with sufficient pre- and post-mainshock data.
序列基于各向同性的球对称距离定义，未结合精细的断层几何形态或复杂的去丛集算法。
研究聚焦于大尺度的一阶效应，可能会遗漏断层面几公里范围内高度局部化的b值时空变化。

tm.why: The study performs a rigorous statistical analysis of earthquake frequency-magnitude distributions (b-values) across 62 M>=6 sequences using the JMA earthquake catalog.
The paper directly evaluates whether temporal and spatial b-value variations can be used for operational earthquake forecasting and traffic-light hazard assessment.
The work links b-value spatial variations to fault zone asperities, crustal rock properties, and differential stress regimes around mainshock ruptures.

ev.notes: Full 11-page Geophysical Research Letters article PDF (12 pages including ETH cover sheet) was read and analyzed in detail, including all 4 figures, equations, methods, and statistical test results.

sum: Using Sentinel-1 InSAR observations from 2017 to 2023 and Bayesian source inversion (BEAT), this study identifies 12 intraplate, aseismic slow-slip events (Mw 4.71–5.06) at 1,640–2,410 m depths in the Montney Formation near the Rocky Mountain Fold and Thrust Belt wedge toe. Triggered by hydraulic fracturing, these events involve 10–20 cm of shearing over several square kilometers along a near-horizontal, bedding-parallel roof detachment. The cumulative seismic moment released by these 12 slow-slip events is orders of magnitude larger than that of the ~2,300 induced earthquakes (ML ≥ 1.5) recorded since 2005. Only half of the slow-slip events are accompanied by ML ≥ 1.5 seismicity, showing that aseismic slip can occur independently of seismic rupture. While low moment rates prevent felt surface shaking, the 10–20 cm slip frequently shears steel well casings, posing a major subsurface economic hazard and revealing how overpressure drives tectonic wedge propagation.
本研究利用2017–2023年Sentinel-1 InSAR数据及贝叶斯震源反演（BEAT），在落基山脉褶皱冲断带楔形体前缘的Montney组识别出12次水力压裂触发的板内无震慢滑移事件（Mw 4.71–5.06，深度1640–2410米）。慢滑移发生于近水平顺层顶板滑脱断层，平均滑动量10–20……

t: Processed 12-day Sentinel-1 interferograms via GAMMA to detect dipole surface deformation, then applied the Bayesian Earthquake Analysis Tool (BEAT v2.0) using triangular dislocations to invert for fault geometry, depth, and slip.
利用GAMMA处理12天Sentinel-1干涉图提取形变，并通过BEAT v2.0贝叶斯框架反演断层几何与滑动量。

Sentinel-1 ascending and descending 12-day interferograms over a 200x300 km area in Northeast British Columbia (2017–2023), paired with BCER records of >1,200 hydraulic fracturing treatments and ~2,300 earthquakes.
2017–2023年BC省东北部Sentinel-1干涉图，结合逾1200次水力压裂记录和约2300次地震目录。

Identified 12 slow-slip events (Mw 4.71–5.06) at 1,640–2,410 m depths with 10–20 cm average slip on near-horizontal bedding planes, releasing orders-of-magnitude more seismic moment than ~2,300 induced earthquakes.
识别出12次Mw 4.71–5.06顺层慢滑移（深1640–2410米，滑动10–20厘米），释放矩远超区域地震总和。
Dense vegetation causes rapid InSAR coherence loss, restricting analysis to 12-day interferograms and potentially missing smaller slow-slip events with insufficient surface deformation.
茂密植被导致快速失相干，且受InSAR分辨率限制无法排除地表形变不足的更小慢滑移事件。
Documents an unprecedented 100-km-scale activation of 12 InSAR-detectable Mw 4.71–5.06 intraplate slow-slip events triggered by fluid injection in a foreland fold-and-thrust belt.
首次发现流体注入触发前陆褶皱冲断带100公里尺度的12次Mw 4.71–5.06板内慢滑移事件。

kc: Detected 12 intraplate slow-slip events (Mw 4.71–5.06) over a 100 km strike near the Rocky Mountain Fold and Thrust Belt wedge toe using Sentinel-1 InSAR.
Demonstrated via Bayesian inversion that slow slip occurs on near-horizontal bedding-parallel detachment faults (10–20 cm average slip) at 1,640–2,410 m depths.
Established a statistically definitive spatiotemporal link (p = 10^-13%) between hydraulic fracturing treatments, slow-slip events, and borehole casing deformation.
Showed that slow-slip events release orders-of-magnitude more cumulative seismic moment than ~2,300 regional earthquakes, and often occur without ML ≥ 1.5 seismicity.
利用Sentinel-1 InSAR在落基山脉褶皱冲断带前缘100公里范围内检测到12次板内慢滑移事件（Mw 4.71–5.06）。
通过贝叶斯反演证明慢滑移发生在1640–2410米深处的近水平顺层滑脱断层上（平均滑动10–20厘米）。
建立了水力压裂作业、慢滑移事件与钻孔套管变形之间确凿的时空关联（巧合概率仅10^-13%）。
证明慢滑移释放的累积地震矩比区域内约2300次地震大几个数量级，且常在无ML ≥ 1.5地震伴随的情况下独立发生。
me: InSAR processing of 12-day Sentinel-1 interferograms using GAMMA software with 16x4 multilooking, Goldstein filtering, and minimum-cost-flow phase unwrapping.
Bayesian source inference using the Bayesian Earthquake Analysis Tool (BEAT v2.0) with elliptical fault planes discretized by triangular dislocations.
Statistical probability analysis and pore-pressure diffusion calculations to evaluate triggering by hydraulic fracturing versus alternative mechanisms.
使用GAMMA软件处理12天周期的Sentinel-1干涉图，结合16x4多视处理、Goldstein自适应滤波和最小费用流相位解缠。
使用贝叶斯地震分析工具（BEAT v2.0）和三角位错离散椭圆断层面进行慢滑移震源机制的贝叶斯推断。
通过统计概率分析和孔隙压力扩散计算，评估水力压裂触发机制并排除替代机制。
de: Periodic Sentinel-1 ascending (tracks 064/166) and descending (tracks 013/086) interferograms covering 200 x 300 km in Northeast British Columbia (2017–2023).
BC Energy Regulator (BCER) public records of >1,200 hydraulic fracturing treatments, saltwater disposal wells, and well casing deformation reports.
Regional earthquake catalog (ML ≥ 1.5) from 2005 to 2023 (~2,300 events) and 2D seismic reflection profiles.
2017–2023年不列颠哥伦比亚省东北部200×300公里区域的Sentinel-1升轨（064/166）和降轨（013/086）干涉图。
不列颠哥伦比亚省能源监管局（BCER）超过1200次水力压裂作业、盐水回注井及套管变形的公开记录。
2005–2023年区域地震目录（ML ≥ 1.5，约2300次事件）及二维反射地震剖面。
li: Rapid coherence loss in the densely vegetated region restricted analysis to 12-day interferograms.
Smaller slow-slip events or deeper events with insufficient surface deformation cannot be excluded due to InSAR detection limits.
Three of the 12 detected slow-slip events had unresolved source mechanisms in the Bayesian inversion.
研究区茂密植被导致的快速失相干将分析限制在12天周期的干涉图内。
受InSAR检测阈值限制，无法排除地表形变不足的更小或更深部慢滑移事件。
12次慢滑移事件中有3次未能通过贝叶斯反演解析出震源机制。

tm.why: The paper detects and analyzes 12 intraplate, aseismic slow-slip events with magnitudes Mw 4.71–5.06 on a bedding-parallel roof detachment fault.
The slow-slip events and concomitant induced earthquakes are triggered by hydraulic fracturing treatments in the Montney Formation.
Fault source parameters and uncertainties are inferred using the Bayesian Earthquake Analysis Tool (BEAT) constrained by InSAR surface displacements.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 13-page GRL article PDF including all figures, Table 1, and text sections.

sum: This study establishes a unified empirical scaling relation between seismic potency ($P$) and local magnitude ($M_L$) spanning $-1.8 \le M_L \le 7.5$. By combining near-source observations from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment, dense nodal data from Ridgecrest, and regional broadband data from San Jacinto, the authors extend potency-magnitude scaling to microearthquakes. They employ Bayesian spectral inference to obtain robust potency estimates. The combined datasets follow a continuous quadratic relation: $M_P = 0.040 M_L^2 + 0.556 M_L + 1.133$. Synthetic modeling demonstrates that wave attenuation, source scaling, and the finite Wood-Anderson passband contribute to the observed nonlinearity. This relation provides a practical empirical conversion between local magnitude and physical source size across nine orders of magnitude.
本研究建立了地方震级（-1.8<=ML<=7.5）与地震功率的统一二次定标关系。结合加拿大微地震、加州密集节点及宽频数据，利用贝叶斯谱反演估计功率。合并数据遵循连续二次关系。模拟表明，衰减、震源定标和仪器频带限制共同导致了该非线性。该关系为震级与物理震源大小转换提供了实用公式。

t: Bayesian spectral inference to estimate seismic potency and synthetic waveform modeling to evaluate the effects of attenuation and instrument bandpass.
利用贝叶斯谱反演估计地震功率，并结合合成波形模拟评估衰减与仪器频带的影响。
Seismic waveforms from the Tony Creek Microseismic Experiment, Ridgecrest nodal array, San Jacinto broadband network, and a regional earthquake catalog.
结合加拿大微地震实验、加州密集节点、区域宽频带及地震目录数据。
A continuous quadratic scaling relation: MP = 0.040ML^2 + 0.556ML + 1.133, extending down to ML ~ -1.8.
建立了低至-1.8级的统一二次定标关系，将功率与地方震级有效关联。
The scaling relation coefficients may exhibit regional variations due to differences in attenuation and local instrumentation.
定标关系的具体系数可能因区域介质衰减和观测系统的不同而有所变化。
Extending the quadratic potency-magnitude scaling relation to microearthquakes (ML >= -1.8) using a combination of near-source and regional datasets.
首次将地震功率与地方震级的二次定标关系推广至微地震级别（低至-1.8级）。

kc: Extended the potency-magnitude scaling relation down to microearthquakes (ML ~ -1.8).
Established a unified quadratic scaling relation valid across nine magnitude units.
Demonstrated through synthetic modeling that attenuation and instrument bandpass limitations can cause the observed scaling nonlinearity.
将地震功率-震级定标关系推广至微地震级别（ML ~ -1.8）。
建立了跨越九个震级单位的统一二次定标关系。
通过合成模拟证明了介质衰减和仪器频带限制会导致观测到的定标非线性。
me: Bayesian spectral inference for robust seismic potency estimation.
Synthetic waveform modeling to investigate the physical and observational causes of scaling nonlinearity.
利用贝叶斯谱反演进行稳健的地震功率估计。
利用合成波形模拟研究定标非线性的物理与观测成因。
de: Near-source recordings from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment (western Canada).
Dense nodal seismic data from the Ridgecrest earthquake sequence (California).
Regional broadband seismic data from the San Jacinto Fault Zone (California).
Regional catalog of larger earthquakes.
加拿大西部Tony Creek双微地震实验的近源记录。
加州Ridgecrest地震序列的密集节点地震数据。

sum: This study investigates the stability of water-bearing aluminous silica phases in subducted oceanic crust under deep lower mantle conditions (94–134 GPa, 2,100–2,500 K) using MgO-Al2O3-Fe2O3-SiO2-H2O systems. The authors demonstrate that NiAs-type silica (Nt) is stabilized by high alumina content and H2O along normal geotherms, whereas alumina-poor systems yield CaCl2-type silica (Ct). At depths exceeding 2,300 km, aluminous silica coexists with pyrite-type FeOOH. These experimental findings reveal that water storage in the deep lower mantle is highly sensitive to bulk composition, H2O concentration, and P-T conditions, suggesting that subducted oceanic crust can effectively transport water to the core-mantle boundary, significantly influencing deep mantle mineralogy and geodynamics.

sum: Early seismic studies inferred thick magmatic underplating beneath the Hawaiian Ridge, whereas modern active-source imaging has not detected it. To test its seismic detectability, Fujimoto and Dunn performed 2D P-SV finite-difference elastic wavefield simulations across Kaʻena Ridge based on recent tomography, comparing models with and without imposed 4–8 km thick underplated layers against wide-angle ocean-bottom seismograph (OBS) data. The simulations demonstrate that a thick, laterally extensive underplate produces diagnostic signatures—specifically a >21 km outward shift in Pn crossover distance, Pn arrival delays up to ~1 s, and basal reflections (Pm2P)—none of which appear in modern observations. Sensitivity tests reveal that underplated layers thinner than ~1 km or with Vp ≥ 7.75 km/s are seismically indistinguishable. Furthermore, volcanic-edifice crustal multiples mimic deep underplate reflections, and thick low-velocity moat sediments explain prior receiver-function delays, reconciling legacy interpretations with normal oceanic crust.
早期地震研究推断夏威夷海岭下存在厚层岩浆底侵，但现代主动源成像并未发现该结构。为此，本研究基于近期Kaʻena海岭层析成像速度模型，开展二维P-SV有限差分弹性波场模拟，将包含4–8 km厚底侵层的合成记录与现代广角海底地震仪（OBS）数据直接对比。结果表明，厚且横向延伸的底侵层会产生显著的诊断性震……

sum: This study presents a PRISMA 2020 systematic literature review of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) methods for earthquake monitoring, focusing on Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). Searching Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar yielded 252,223 initial records, from which 138 peer-reviewed studies (2021–2025) were retained using a ≥70% quality threshold. Results show a paradigm shift toward CNNs, LSTMs, Transformers, hybrid models, and Bayesian uncertainty-aware frameworks (supervised: 32.6%, unsupervised: 25.4%, Bayesian: 21.7%, hybrid/semi-supervised: 20.3%). While DAS enables meter-scale, continuous strain-rate monitoring, challenges persist in magnitude calibration, massive data volumes, scarce labeled datasets, and cross-regional generalization. Unlike prior reviews focusing solely on conventional networks or single ML techniques, this work unifies conventional and DAS-based seismic monitoring, compares 19 algorithm classes across performance metrics, and outlines future directions in physics-informed learning, self-supervised pretraining, and multimodal fusion.

sum: Talc lubricates the slab–mantle interface and transports water into subduction zones, yet its stability is typically evaluated under closed-system, silica-saturated conditions. Using a hydrothermal diamond anvil cell (HDAC), in-situ Raman spectroscopy, and Deep Earth Water (DEW) thermodynamic modeling up to 33.8 kbar and 875 °C, this study investigates talc dehydration in open-system, water-rich, low-silica environments characteristic of natural subduction interfaces. Under these conditions, talc undergoes metasomatic dehydration producing forsterite and a silica-bearing aqueous fluid, rather than enstatite and quartz. This shifts the dehydration boundary to ~705 °C at 10 kbar and ~650 °C at 30 kbar—90 to 170 °C lower than silica-saturated limits. Crucially, this new boundary intersects slab thermal profiles at ~80 km depth across both cold (Mariana) and hot (Cascadia) subduction zones, providing a unified mineralogical mechanism for the geophysically observed maximum depth of slab–mantle decoupling (MDD).

sum: This paper introduces SCMLPick, an open-source SeisComP module designed to bridge the gap between advanced machine learning (ML) phase pickers and real-time seismic monitoring workflows. While ML pickers significantly improve low-magnitude earthquake detection, their real-time deployment has been hindered by high computational demands and latency. SCMLPick addresses this by continuously processing real-time waveform streams, reducing average phase-picking latency from over 10 minutes (in postprocessing) to less than 60 seconds. Evaluated against the Texas Seismological Network (TexNet) postprocessing system, SCMLPick achieved over 98% event matching for magnitudes M >= 1.0 with high arrival-time consistency. This tool enables operational networks to leverage ML-based detection in real-time.
本文介绍了SCMLPick，一个旨在将先进机器学习（ML）震相拾取器集成到实时地震监测工作流中的SeisComP模块。虽然ML拾取器能显著提高低震级地震的检测率，但其高计算需求和延迟限制了实时应用。SCMLPick通过连续处理实时波形数据，将平均震相拾取延迟从10分钟以上缩短至60秒以内。在德克萨斯……

sum: This study investigates the origin of mantle-derived CO2 emanations in the Cheb Basin (Western Ohře Rift, Bohemian Massif) by coupling 1D and 2D finite-difference lithospheric thermal models with MELTS phase equilibria calculations and an experimentally calibrated melt CO2 solubility model. Using an olivine nephelinite proxy composition emplaced at 30 km depth (0.8 GPa), the authors simulate crystallization and devolatilization dynamics. Results reveal highly non-linear CO2 exsolution peaking around 1100–1200 °C. During active magma emplacement, CO2 release scales linearly with the magma accretion rate; post-emplacement, mean degassing scales inversely with the square of underplate thickness. Observed surface CO2 fluxes (~100 t/day) can be explained either by active magma replenishment (~0.001 km3/year) or a recently emplaced (<1 Ma) underplate. Long-term degassing evidenced by 35 Ma of travertine deposits requires episodic magma emplacement.
本研究通过耦合一维和二维有限差分岩石圈热模型、MELTS相平衡计算及熔体CO2溶解度模型，探讨了波希米亚地块西部奥赫热裂谷Cheb盆地CO2逸出的成因。以30 km深度（0.8 GPa）的橄榄石霞石岩为初始成分模拟结晶脱气动态。结果表明CO2脱气呈高度非线性，在1100–1200 °C附近达到峰值。……

t: Couples 1D and 2D finite-difference conductive cooling models with MELTS phase equilibria calculations and the Eguchi & Dasgupta (2018) melt CO2 solubility model to compute CO2 exsolution rates during magma crystallization.
将1D和2D有限差分热传导模型与MELTS相平衡及熔体CO2溶解度模型耦合，计算结晶脱气速率。

Uses major-element composition of primitive olivine nephelinite (ca. 40 wt% SiO2, 15 wt% MgO) at 0.8 GPa (30 km depth) and 1387 °C liquidus, tested across emplacement rates of 0.001–30 m/year and thicknesses of 0.1–10 km.
采用0.8 GPa、1387 °C下原始橄榄石霞石岩成分，测试0.001–30 m/年就位速率和0.1–10 km厚度。
Active emplacement CO2 flux scales linearly as JCO2 (t/day) ≈ 72 × 10^3 Jm (m/year); observed ~100 t/day fluxes require active recharge of ~0.001 km3/year or a recently emplaced (<1 Ma) underplate.
活跃期CO2通量与就位速率呈线性关系；100吨/天通量需约0.001 km3/年补给或<1 Ma的近期底侵。
Calculated deep degassing fluxes neglect finite fluid transport velocity through the crust, heterogeneous evolving permeability networks, and temporary fluid storage at permeability barriers.
深部脱气计算忽略了地壳流体有限平流速度、非均质渗透率网络及渗透率屏障的暂时封存。

First integration of lithospheric conductive cooling models with thermodynamic phase equilibria and CO2 solubility to quantitatively test magmatic underplating as the source of Cheb Basin CO2 emanations.
首次将岩石圈热模型与相平衡及CO2溶解度结合，定量检验Cheb盆地CO2逸出的岩浆底侵成因。

kc: Coupled lithospheric conductive cooling models with MELTS phase equilibria and silicate melt CO2 solubility models to quantify magmatic underplate degassing.
Demonstrated contrasting scaling laws for CO2 flux during active emplacement (linear with accretion rate) versus post-emplacement cooling (inversely proportional to thickness squared).
Constrained the timing (<1 Ma) and magma recharge rates (~0.001 km3/yr) required to sustain observed ~100 t/day CO2 fluxes in the Western Ohře Rift.
将岩石圈热传导冷却模型与MELTS相平衡及硅酸盐熔体CO2溶解度模型耦合，定量模拟了岩浆底侵体脱气过程。
揭示了活跃就位期（与增生速率线性相关）与就位后冷却期（与厚度平方成反比）截然不同的CO2通量标度律。
约束了维持奥赫热裂谷西部约100吨/天观测CO2通量所需的底侵时间（<1 Ma）和岩浆补给速率（约0.001 km3/年）。
me: Gibbs free energy minimization via MELTS software to determine solid fraction and residual melt composition during cooling at 0.8 GPa.
CO2 solubility calculation in evolving silicate melt using the parameterization of Eguchi and Dasgupta (2018).
2D cylindrically symmetric and 1D explicit finite-difference conductive heat transfer modeling accounting for latent heat of crystallization.
利用MELTS软件进行吉布斯自由能最小化计算，确定0.8 GPa下冷却过程中的固相分数和残余熔体成分。
采用Eguchi和Dasgupta (2018)的参数化模型计算演化硅酸盐熔体中的CO2溶解度。
包含结晶潜热的二维柱对称和一维显式有限差分热传导数值模拟。

Exploratory 2D thermal simulations testing instantaneous (3 km sill at 15, 4, 1 Ma) vs. episodic (eleven 275 m sills) emplacement.
1D parametric study spanning magma emplacement rates of 0.001–30 m/year and final thicknesses of 0.1–10 km.

测试瞬时侵入（15、4、1 Ma时3 km厚岩床）与幕式侵入（11次275 m厚岩床）的二维热模拟试验。
涵盖岩浆就位速率0.001–30 m/年及最终厚度0.1–10 km的一维参数化研究。

sum: This paper addresses the gap between research and practice in physics-based probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA), which utilizes 3D numerical simulations of ground motion. The authors compare traditional PSHA with current physics-based approaches, revealing that 'method aleatory variability'—apparent aleatory variability arising from simulation simplifications—is often omitted in physics-based calculations. They emphasize the critical need to separate and quantify apparent aleatory variability and epistemic uncertainty, noting that validation misfits often conflate these two sources. The paper outlines how simulation simplifications lead to method aleatory variability, discusses integration methods, and provides actionable recommendations to advance physics-based PSHA into practical engineering applications.
本文探讨了基于物理（3D数值模拟）的概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）从研究走向工程实践的差距。作者对比了传统与基于物理的PSHA，指出当前物理模拟计算中缺失了因模拟方法简化带来的“方法偶然不确定性”。文章强调了合理分离与量化偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的重要性，指出验证偏差常混淆这两者。最后，本文总结了……

t: Comparative framework analyzing traditional GMPE-based PSHA and physics-based 3D numerical ground-motion simulations to identify gaps in uncertainty quantification.
对比传统基于GMPE的PSHA与基于物理的3D数值模拟，构建不确定性量化分析框架。
Conceptual review and synthesis of existing 3D simulation validation studies and PSHA methodologies; no new primary observational dataset is introduced.
对现有3D模拟验证研究和PSHA方法的概念性评述与综合，未引入新的观测数据集。

Separating the effects of simulation simplifications from incorrect input parameters during validation remains highly challenging.

First systematic conceptualization of 'method aleatory variability' in physics-based PSHA and formalizing recommendations to bridge the research-to-practice gap.
首次系统化提出物理PSHA中的“方法偶然不确定性”概念，并制定了弥合科研与实用差距的建议。

Clarifies the conflation of method aleatory variability and parametric epistemic uncertainty in simulation validation misfits.
Provides a structured framework and recommendations for transitioning physics-based ground motion simulations into practical PSHA.

sum: This study presents three years (2022–2025) of horizontal acoustic ranging observations across the caldera of Axial Seamount, a hotspot volcano on the Juan de Fuca Ridge. Using seafloor transponders defining three baselines (1.8, 1.6, and 3.3 km), the authors detect 30 cm of asymmetric extension across the caldera, with 24 cm concentrated on the eastern baseline. By modeling these horizontal data alongside vertical geodetic observations, they demonstrate that the deformation is primarily driven by volumetric inflation rather than fault-accommodated slip. The results point to a dual-source inflation model: a deeper pressure source associated with a stacked sill complex beneath the southern caldera, and a smaller, shallower source beneath the northeastern caldera where eruptions typically originate. This provides critical constraints on magma reservoir dynamics at mid-ocean ridges.
本研究利用海底水平声学测距获取了轴向海山破火山口2022-2025年的观测数据。结果显示破火山口存在30厘米的非对称扩张。结合垂直大地测量数据建模表明，该变形主要由体积膨胀而非断层运动引起。研究提出了双压力源模型：南部破火山口下方的深部岩席群压力源，以及东北部下方的浅部小压力源。该成果为理解洋中脊岩……

Three years (2022-2025) of acoustic ranging data along 1.8-km, 1.6-km, and 3.3-km baselines across Axial Seamount caldera.

Observed 30 cm of asymmetric extension (24 cm on the eastern baseline) indicating volumetric inflation from a deep southern sill complex and a shallow northeastern source.
观测到30厘米的非对称扩张（东侧基线达24厘米），表明存在深部南部岩席和浅部东北部双膨胀源。
Limited spatial coverage with only three baselines and potential sensitivity to seawater velocity fluctuations.

First long-term horizontal geodetic measurements at Axial Seamount, distinguishing volumetric inflation from fault-slip mechanisms.

sum: This paper presents a dual-criteria signal-identification model for earthquake early warning (EEW) to distinguish micro-fracture precursor signals from ambient noise. The model relies on two physical criteria: the arrival-time difference between P- and S-waves (to determine source distance) and the energy-attenuation ratio between P- and S-waves (to distinguish seismic events from non-seismic noise like traffic or machinery). By requiring both criteria to be met, the system reduces false alarms and shifts EEW from passive mainshock detection to active precursor monitoring, potentially extending warning times to hours or days.
本文提出一种用于地震预警的双准则信号识别模型，旨在从环境噪声中提取微破裂前兆。该模型基于两个物理准则：一是P波和S波的到时差（确定震源距离），二是两者的能量衰减比（区分地震与非地震噪声）。双准则验证显著降低了虚警率，使系统从被动等待主震转为主动监测前兆，有望将预警时间延长至数小时或数天。

t: A dual-criteria identification method using P- and S-wave arrival-time differences and energy-attenuation ratios to distinguish seismic precursors from ambient noise.
利用P波和S波到时差及能量衰减比的双准则识别方法，区分地震前兆与环境噪声。
Conceptual framework designed for high-sensitivity seismic sensors capable of detecting nanometer-scale ground displacements.
针对能够检测纳米级地面位移的高灵敏度地震传感器设计的概念性框架。
The model theoretically reduces false alarms and extends the warning window from seconds to hours or days by actively monitoring micro-fracture precursors.
该模型理论上降低了虚警率，并通过主动监测微破裂前兆将预警时间延长至数小时或数天。
Practical implementation challenges in highly heterogeneous crustal structures and the requirement for continuous high-sensitivity real-time data processing.
在高度非均匀地壳结构中的实际应用挑战，以及对连续高灵敏度实时数据处理的要求。
Shifting EEW from passive mainshock P-wave detection to active precursor monitoring using a dual physical criteria verification scheme.
利用双重物理准则验证方案，将地震预警从被动的主震P波检测转变为主动的前兆监测。
