sum: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle-skipping when low-frequency data are missing or the initial velocity model is poor, and inaccuracies in the source wavelet further degrade velocity reconstructions. Conventional convolution-based source-independent methods eliminate wavelet dependence but distort waveforms, introducing errors in local-scale traveltime calculations. This paper introduces a waveform-preserving source-independent wave-equation-based local-scale traveltime inversion (WPS-LTI) method. By applying both convolution and Wiener deconvolution with direct-wave reference traces, WPS-LTI synchronizes the source wavelets between observed and synthetic data while preserving original waveform characteristics. A sliding Gaussian window decomposes traces locally to compute cross-correlation traveltime shifts, recovering accurate low-wavenumber velocity models for subsequent FWI. Numerical experiments on noisy and noise-free Marmousi models (without data below 4 Hz) and the marine streamer SEG Chevron 2014 blind test dataset (using simultaneous-source grouping) confirm that WPS-LTI + WPS-FWI achieves superior resolution and robustness against wavelet errors.
全波形反演（FWI）在缺失低频数据或初始模型较差时易发生周期跳跃，且震源子波误差会严重降低反演精度。传统基于参考道褶积的源无关方法虽能消除子波影响，但会引起波形畸变并导致局部走时计算错误。本文提出保波形源无关波动方程局部尺度走时反演（WPS-LTI）方法，利用直达波参考道同时进行褶积和维纳反褶积，在……

t: WPS-LTI applies sliding Gaussian windows to decompose traces locally, synchronizes wavelets via reference-trace convolution and Wiener deconvolution, and minimizes cross-correlation traveltime shifts using adjoint-state gradients.
利用滑动高斯窗进行局部波形分解，通过直达波参考道褶积与维纳反褶积统一子波，并利用伴随状态法最小化局部互相关走时差。
Tested on the 2D Marmousi model (>4 Hz, 90° rotated and 0.2 s delayed wavelet, SNR = -5.34 noise) and the 1,600-shot SEG Chevron 2014 marine streamer blind test dataset (3–10 Hz).
采用滤除4 Hz以下低频且含错相延迟子波与强噪声的Marmousi模型，以及1600炮SEG Chevron 2014海…

On Marmousi, WPS-LTI + WPS-FWI (1.1 s window) improved SSIM from 0.8915 to 0.9562 and SNR from 18.07 to 21.92 dB (0.9516 SSIM and 21.48 dB SNR under noise), and matched well logs at 39.375 km on Chevron data.
Marmousi反演SSIM达0.9562、SNR达21.92 dB（含噪时为0.9516和21.48 dB），Chev…
Strong noise degrades far-offset signals requiring prior denoising, large Gaussian windows risk multi-event interference, and 3D applications require subsampling and parallel acceleration.

Introduces reference-trace Wiener deconvolution alongside convolution into local-scale wave-equation traveltime inversion, eliminating wavelet dependence while avoiding convolution-induced waveform distortion.
在局部波动方程走时反演中联合引入参考道褶积与反褶积，消除子波依赖的同时避免波形畸变。

kc: Proposed the WPS-LTI method combining reference-trace convolution and Wiener deconvolution to eliminate source wavelet errors without distorting seismic waveforms.
Derived the objective function, weighting factor, adjoint source, and gradient for waveform-preserving source-independent local-scale traveltime inversion.
Analyzed local-scale traveltime errors and demonstrated how multi-source/receiver stacking suppresses random gradient noise from unmatched reflections/refractions.
Validated the multi-scale WPS-LTI + WPS-FWI workflow on the Marmousi model and the SEG Chevron 2014 marine blind test dataset with simultaneous-source encoding.
提出结合参考道褶积与维纳反褶积的WPS-LTI方法，在不引起地震波形畸变的前提下消除震源子波误差。
推导了保波形源无关局部尺度走时反演的目标函数、防零分母加权因子、伴随源及梯度表达式。
分析了局部尺度走时误差，阐明了多震源多检波器叠加如何压制未匹配反射/折射波引起的梯度随机噪声。
在Marmousi模型及结合同时源编码的SEG Chevron 2014海洋盲测数据集上验证了多尺度WPS-LTI+WPS-FWI流程的有效性。

Waveform-preserving source-independent processing via reference-trace convolution and frequency-domain Wiener deconvolution using direct waves.
Adjoint-state gradient computation with a denominator-canceling weighting factor to ensure numerical stability.
Multi-scale windowing strategy (gradually decreasing Gaussian window length) and simultaneous-source grouping for marine streamer geometry.

sum: Downhole distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) captures high-resolution microseismic wavefields but suffers from strong stochastic interrogator noise. This study evaluates curvelet-transform denoising across four default thresholding strategies (MAD, quiet-window, ECDF-percentile, and knee-point) using synthetic data and field recordings from a horizontal shale-gas monitoring well in southwest China. Because curvelets partition the frequency–wavenumber plane into multiscale directional wedges, curved microseismic wavefronts concentrate into a few coefficients (top 1% carrying 97.1% energy), whereas random noise spreads uniformly. While MAD, quiet-window, and ECDF-percentile perform well at default settings (delivering ~14.2–14.8 dB SNR gains), the mainstream DASPy knee-point default (beta = 0.2) fails because its threshold sits inside the noise body. The authors recommend MAD per-sub-band soft thresholding as an out-of-the-box default requiring no noise reference window. On field data, MAD curvelet denoising recovers weak P-, S-, and reflected phases and outperforms 2D wavelet and Goldstein FK filtering in STA/LTA detections.
针对井下分布式声波传感（DAS）微地震数据的强随机噪声问题，本文构建了曲波变换去噪框架，并在合成数据与中国西南页岩气水平监测井实测数据上系统评估了四种默认阈值策略（MAD、静寂窗、ECDF分位数和拐点法）。曲波在频波域进行多尺度方向性楔形剖分，使弯曲微地震波前能量高度集中（前1%系数占97.1%能量……

t: Applies the Fast Discrete Curvelet Transform (5 scales, 32 angles) to 2D DAS records and performs per-wedge soft thresholding using noise standard deviation estimated via Median Absolute Deviation (MAD, k = 2.0), followed by inverse FDCT.
对二维DAS记录应用快速离散曲波变换，利用中位数绝对偏差（MAD，k=2.0）按楔形子带估计噪声标准差并进行软阈值处理。

Evaluated on synthetic 256-channel borehole DAS records (SNR = -5 dB) and continuous field DAS data (1 m spacing, 10 m gauge length, 1 kHz downsampled) from fracturing stages S15 and S25 in a southwest China shale gas well.
使用256道合成井下DAS数据（-5 dB）及中国西南页岩气水平井第15、25压裂段连续实测DAS数据（道距1 m，标距…

On synthetic data (SNR = -5 dB), MAD, quiet-window, and ECDF-percentile yield 14.2–14.8 dB SNR gains, whereas default knee-point yields 2.7 dB. On field data, MAD increases STA/LTA detections from 137 to 190 (S15) and 152 to 181 (S25).
合成测试中MAD等三种策略提升信噪比14.2–14.8 dB（默认拐点法仅2.7 dB）；实测数据STA/LTA检测事件…

The uniform per-wedge AWGN model does not capture non-Gaussian, non-stationary DAS noise such as optical fading or thermal baseline wander, and field testing is restricted to one well and interrogator.

Systematically benchmarks four curvelet thresholding rules for downhole DAS microseismic data, diagnoses why the DASPy knee-point default fails, and establishes reference-free MAD as a robust out-of-the-box standard.
系统评测了井下DAS微地震四种曲波阈值默认参数，揭示了DASPy默认拐点法失效机理，确立了无需参考窗的MAD稳健标准。

kc: Systematically benchmarked four curvelet thresholding strategies (MAD, quiet-window, ECDF-percentile, knee-point) on synthetic and field downhole DAS microseismic data.
Diagnosed the failure of the default knee-point threshold (beta = 0.2) in the DASPy toolbox, showing it sits at the 41st percentile inside the noise body rather than the noise tail.
Recommended per-sub-band MAD soft thresholding (k = 2.0) as a robust, reference-window-free default that handles non-stationary field noise.
Demonstrated on southwest China shale-gas field DAS data that curvelet MAD denoising recovers buried P-waves and fracture reflections, boosting STA/LTA event detections by 19–39%.
在合成和实测井下DAS微地震数据上系统评估了四种曲波阈值策略（MAD、静寂窗、ECDF分位数、拐点法）。
诊断出DASPy工具箱默认拐点阈值（β=0.2）失效的原因：其阈值位于累积分布41%分位数附近（噪声主体内部）而非噪声尾部。
推荐将无需参考窗的子带MAD软阈值（k=2.0）作为稳健默认方案，避免了非平稳实测噪声下参考窗选择的难题。
在中国西南页岩气田实测DAS数据中验证了曲波MAD去噪可恢复被淹没的P波和裂缝反射波，使STA/LTA微地震事件检测数量提升19%–39%。

Benchmarking against 2D Daubechies-4 wavelet VisuShrink thresholding and adaptive Goldstein FK filtering, plus STA/LTA event detection.

tm.why: The paper develops and evaluates a curvelet-transform denoising framework specifically for downhole distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) microseismic data.

ev.notes: Full 22-page MDPI Sensors PDF was analyzed, including mathematical equations, synthetic parameter sweeps, field data applications from southwest China, STA/LTA detection tables, and appendices.

sum: This study investigates the strain partitioning and deformation mechanisms of asymmetric regional 'scale-folds' in the Vrancea tectonic half-window of the Southeastern Carpathians. By analyzing Cretaceous to earliest Miocene strata using surface-to-depth projections and kinematic correlation, the authors demonstrate that initial fold formation was followed by gradual out-of-sequence deformation partitioning along the orogenic strike. A kilometer-scale décollement fold in the center transitions to low-angle thrusting and frontal splays at the margins, accommodated by a regional tear fold. This mechanical decoupling within weak layers explains differential exhumation and refines the understanding of contractional deformation in rheologically contrasting stratigraphy.
本研究探讨了东喀尔巴阡山脉Vrancea构造半窗口内非对称区域“尺度褶皱”的应变分配与变形机制。通过对白垩纪至早中新世地层的地表-深部投影及运动学分析，研究表明初始褶皱形成后，沿造山带走向发生了渐进的序列外变形分配。中心区域的公里级脱耦褶皱向边缘转变为低角度逆冲和前缘分支断裂，并由区域撕裂褶皱进行调……

t: Kinematic analysis and surface-to-depth projections of scale-fold structures to reconstruct deformation history.

Structural, stratigraphic, and depth data of Cretaceous to earliest Miocene strata in the Vrancea tectonic half-window.
东喀尔巴阡山脉Vrancea构造半窗口内白垩纪至早中新世地层的结构、地层和深度数据。
Demonstration of out-of-sequence strain partitioning along-strike, transitioning from a central décollement fold to marginal low-angle thrusts.
证实了沿走向的序列外应变分配，表现为从中部脱耦褶皱向边缘低角度逆冲的过渡。
Reliance on surface-to-depth projections and existing models rather than new high-resolution subsurface geophysical imaging.
依赖于地表-深部投影和现有模型，而非全新的高分辨率地下地球物理成像。
Defining the tear fold mechanism that accommodates strike-parallel strain partitioning and explaining differential exhumation in scale-folds.

sum: Earthquakes disrupt terrestrial ecosystems via landslides and land-cover changes, yet global carbon accounting typically omits these geophysical disturbances. This study quantifies global earthquake-induced carbon losses using a dynamic, data-driven counterfactual framework that integrates USGS earthquake records (Mw ≥ 6.0 from 2006–2018), MODIS land cover, multi-pool carbon density maps, and TRENDY dynamic global vegetation models. Across 106 statistically significant events, earthquakes caused a cumulative loss of 38.86 ± 6.23 Tg C by 2022, with the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake alone reducing carbon storage by 67.66 ± 1.94 Tg C. Forest ecosystems required five to six years to begin recovery following secondary succession. Notably, 84.6% of affected countries are emerging and developing economies; in Nepal and Ecuador, post-earthquake carbon losses exceeded half of their land-use change emissions. This work establishes a global benchmark for geophysical carbon losses to inform national carbon budgets.
地震通过触发滑坡和改变土地覆盖破坏陆地碳储存，但全球碳核算普遍忽略了这一过程。本研究构建了动态数据驱动的反事实框架，结合USGS强震目录（2006-2018年，Mw≥6.0）、MODIS土地覆盖、碳密度地图及TRENDY动态全球植被模型，量化了全球地震引发的碳损失。分析106次显著地震事件发现，截至……

t: A counterfactual framework using InVEST and TRENDY vegetation models compares observed post-earthquake carbon storage (within MMI ≥ 6 zones) against a hypothetical no-earthquake baseline with fixed pre-seismic land cover.
结合InVEST与TRENDY模型构建反事实框架，对比MMI≥6区域内观测到的震后碳储量与固定震前土地覆盖的无震基线。
USGS terrestrial earthquakes (Mw ≥ 6.0, 2006–2018, filtered to 106 events), 500 m MODIS MCD12Q1 land cover, ORNL and SoilGrids 2.0 carbon density maps, and five TRENDY DGVM outputs.
2006-2018年USGS陆地强震（筛选出106次）、MODIS土地覆盖、ORNL与SoilGrids碳密度图及5个T…
Global strong earthquakes (2006–2018) caused a cumulative loss of 38.86 ± 6.23 Tg C by 2022 (67.66 ± 1.94 Tg C from Wenchuan alone), with forests requiring 5–6 years to begin recovery.
全球强震至2022年累计造成38.86±6.23 Tg C损失（汶川地震达67.66±1.94 Tg C），森林需5-6…

Attributing all land-use change in affected zones to earthquakes may overestimate impacts due to droughts or human activities; coarse TRENDY factors and uncorrelated pixel errors also limit precision.
将影响区内土地变化全归因于地震可能因干旱或人类活动而高估影响，且假设网格误差不相关。

Provides the first systematic global quantification of terrestrial ecosystem carbon losses and multi-year recovery trajectories induced by strong earthquakes, establishing a benchmark for geophysical disturbances in carbon accounting.
首次系统量化了全球强震引起的陆地生态系统碳损失及多年恢复轨迹，建立了碳核算基准。

kc: Developed a dynamic counterfactual framework isolating earthquake-induced carbon losses from climate-driven vegetation trends.
Quantified global cumulative terrestrial carbon losses from 2006–2018 strong earthquakes (Mw ≥ 6.0) at 38.86 ± 6.23 Tg C by 2022.
Revealed a 5–6 year ecological turning point for post-seismic forest recovery and secondary succession.
Demonstrated major national disparities, showing earthquake carbon losses in Nepal and Ecuador exceed 60% of their post-seismic land-use emissions.
开发了动态反事实评估框架，将地震引起的碳损失与气候驱动的植被动态分离。
量化了2006-2018年全球强震（Mw≥6.0）截至2022年的累计陆地碳损失为38.86±6.23 Tg C。
揭示了震后森林恢复和次生演替存在5-6年的生态转折点。
揭示了显著的国家差异，尼泊尔和厄瓜多尔的震后碳损失超过其同期土地利用排放的60%。
me: Empirical Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI ≥ 6) attenuation modeling to delineate seismic impact zones.
Spatiotemporal carbon density reconstruction combining static baseline maps (Above-C, Below-C, Soil-C, Dead-C) with TRENDY S2 DGVM ensemble scaling factors.
Counterfactual scenario analysis using the InVEST model to compare observed post-earthquake land-use changes against a fixed pre-earthquake land-use baseline.
Gaussian error propagation and Z-test filtering at the 95% confidence level across 500 m pixels.
利用经验修正麦加利烈度（MMI≥6）衰减模型划定地震影响区。
结合静态基线碳密度图（地上、地下、土壤、死亡有机碳）与TRENDY S2模型集合时间缩放因子，进行时空动态碳密度重构。
使用InVEST模型进行反事实情景分析，对比观测到的震后土地利用变化与固定震前土地利用基线。
在500米像素尺度上进行高斯误差传递和95%置信水平的Z检验过滤。

MODIS MCD12Q1 annual land-cover data at 500 m resolution across 17 IGBP classes.
ORNL DAAC above/below-ground biomass carbon (300 m), SoilGrids 2.0 soil organic carbon (250 m), and forest inventory dead carbon ratios.
Five TRENDY Dynamic Global Vegetation Models (DLEM, IBIS, LPJ-GUESS, LPJmL, LPX-Bern) under the S2 protocol.
USGS地震目录（2006-2018年，Mw≥6.0），从2307个全球事件筛选出106个统计显著的陆地地震事件。
500米分辨率的MODIS MCD12Q1年度土地覆盖数据（包含17个IGBP类别）。
ORNL DAAC地上/地下生物量碳（300米）、SoilGrids 2.0土壤有机碳（250米）及全球森林清查死亡碳比例估算数据。
S2协议下的5个TRENDY动态全球植被模型（DLEM、IBIS、LPJ-GUESS、LPJmL、LPX-Bern）输出数据。
li: All land-use changes within MMI ≥ 6 impact zones are attributed to earthquakes, potentially overestimating impacts by conflating droughts, climate variability, or human activities.
TRENDY temporal scaling factors represent coarse-scale averages applied uniformly within land-use types, potentially overlooking fine-scale spatial variability.
Uncertainty propagation assumes uncorrelated errors across grid cells, which may underestimate regional uncertainty.
将MMI≥6影响区内的土地利用变化归因于地震，可能混淆干旱、气候变化或人类活动，从而高估地震影响。
TRENDY时间缩放因子代表粗尺度平均值并在同一土地类型内统一应用，可能忽略细尺度空间变异性。
不确定性传递假设网格单元间的误差不相关，这可能会低估区域尺度的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the environmental and ecological impacts of strong earthquakes on global terrestrial carbon storage through surface disturbances like coseismic landslides.
The study uses empirical macroseismic intensity prediction equations (MMI ≥ 6) to define earthquake impact zones and assess cascading land-surface hazards.

ev.notes: Full 8-page PDF article analyzed, including abstract, main text, 4 figures, and methods.

sum: This study utilizes a dense broadband seismic array and receiver functions to image the mantle transition zone (MTZ) beneath Tibet. By correcting for upper mantle heterogeneity using a high-resolution tomographic model, the authors quantify lateral variations in temperature and water content. They find that the MTZ contains at least 0.31 wt.% H2O on average and is underlain by a low-velocity layer (LVL) above the 410-km discontinuity. A pronounced north-south asymmetry is observed: the northern MTZ is warm and wet, while the southern MTZ is cooler and drier but has a more extensive LVL. The authors propose that cold lithosphere sinking into the southern MTZ displaced water-rich mantle material upward, causing dehydration, LVL formation, and water-rich upwelling, which potentially triggered Miocene porphyry copper mineralization.
本研究利用密集台网接收函数成像与层析成像校正，定量估算了青藏高原地幔过渡带（MTZ）的温度与含水量。结果显示MTZ平均含水量超0.31 wt.%，且410km面之上存在低速层。MTZ结构呈南北不对称：北部偏暖偏湿，南部偏冷偏干。南部下沉的冷岩石圈排挤出富水物质并引发上涌，为斑岩铜矿提供了深部动力学解……

t: Receiver function imaging of the 410 and 660 km discontinuities, corrected for 3D upper mantle velocity heterogeneity using a high-resolution tomographic model to estimate MTZ thickness and velocity perturbations.
利用接收函数对地幔过渡带成像，并结合高分辨率层析成像模型进行三维速度校正。
Teleseismic waveform data recorded by a dense broadband seismic array and existing regional deployments across the Tibetan Plateau.
青藏高原密集宽频带地震台网及已有区域台网记录的远震波形数据。

The Tibetan MTZ contains at least 0.31 wt.% H2O on average, showing north-south asymmetry (warm/wet north vs. cool/dry south) and an extensive low-velocity layer above the 410-km discontinuity in the south.
地幔过渡带平均含水量超0.31 wt.%，且南部410千米之上存在广泛的低速层。
Uncertainties in mineral physics parameters and the spatial resolution of tomographic models used for velocity corrections.
矿物物理参数的不确定性及层析成像速度校正的空间分辨率限制。
Quantifying both water content and temperature variations in the Tibetan MTZ, linking lithospheric sinking to water-rich mantle upwelling and metallogenesis.
定量估算过渡带含水量与温度，将岩石圈下沉与富水上涌及成矿联系。

kc: Obtained high-resolution receiver function images of the mantle transition zone (MTZ) beneath Tibet.
Quantified lateral variations in temperature and water content within the Tibetan MTZ, revealing an average of at least 0.31 wt.% H2O.
Identified a pronounced north-south asymmetry in MTZ properties and a low-velocity layer (LVL) above the 410-km discontinuity.
Proposed a geodynamic model of water-rich mantle upwelling triggered by lithospheric sinking, linking deep mantle hydration to surface porphyry copper deposits.
获得了青藏高原下方地幔过渡带（MTZ）的高分辨率接收函数图像。
定量估算了西藏MTZ内部温度和含水量的横向变化，揭示其平均含水量至少为0.31 wt.%。
发现了MTZ性质显著的南北不对称性，以及410千米不连续面之上发育的低速层（LVL）。
提出了岩石圈下沉触发富水地幔上涌的动力学模型，将深部地幔水化与地表斑岩铜矿联系起来。

Correction for 3D upper mantle velocity heterogeneity using a high-resolution seismic tomography model.

sum: This study presents the Petrinja Earthquake Sequence Machine Learning Catalogue (PESMLC) covering the 2020–2022 Mw 6.4 Petrinja sequence in Croatia. Using continuous waveforms from up to 56 permanent and temporary stations, the authors apply EQTransformer (trained on INSTANCE) for phase picking, PyOcto for phase association, and NonLinLoc with source-specific station travel-time corrections (SSST) for relocation. PESMLC contains 41,989 events, achieving 96% and 85% match rates against two detailed manual catalogs while doubling the number of detected microearthquakes and constraining seismicity to shallower depths (4.5–14 km) due to balanced P and S picks. Crucially, the authors demonstrate that unfiltered ML catalogs bias strict magnitude of completeness estimators upward and Omori p-values downward (p = 0.797 vs. 0.908 after filtering). Quality filtering resolves both biases, demonstrating how automated workflows and network densification enhance routine monitoring.
本研究利用深度学习构建了2020–2022年克罗地亚Petrinja Mw 6.4地震序列目录（PESMLC）。基于多达56个固定和临时台站的连续波形，研究采用INSTANCE训练的EQTransformer拾取震相、PyOcto进行关联、NonLinLoc-SSST重定位，共检测出41,989个事……

t: Continuous waveforms are picked using EQTransformer (trained on INSTANCE) with 50 s overlapping windows, associated via PyOcto using network-adaptive thresholds, and relocated with NonLinLoc applying 3D source-specific station travel-time corrections (SSST).
利用INSTANCE训练的EQTransformer拾取震相，PyOcto动态阈值关联，结合NonLinLoc-SSST…

Continuous 3-component waveforms from 28 December 2020 to 30 November 2022 across up to 56 stations (35 permanent CR broadband stations plus temporary OP-Net and PM-Net deployments), validated against HHC and CEC manual catalogs.
2020年12月至2022年11月多达56个固定与临时台站的连续波形，并与HHC和CEC人工目录对比。

PESMLC detects 41,989 events in ~3 days of processing, matching 96% of HHC and 85% of CEC manual events, identifying 14,274 high-quality new events, and recovering an Omori decay exponent of p = 0.908 after quality filtering.
3天内检测出41,989个事件，匹配率达96%和85%，新增14,274个高质量事件，过滤后p=0.908。
Automated amplitude picking slightly underestimates local magnitudes, and closely timed earthquakes with overlapping codas can be missed or merged when S-picks fail minimum associator requirements.
自动振幅拾取略微低估地方震级，且尾波重叠的密集事件易因关联条件限制而被合并或漏检。

Demonstrates that unfiltered ML detections bias strict completeness estimators (MBS, K-S) upward and Omori p-exponents downward, and validates ML catalog performance against two independent manual catalogs across network densification.
揭示未过滤ML目录会推高严格Mc估计并压低Omori衰减指数p，结合双人工目录验证了质量过滤与台网加密的作用。

kc: Constructed a 22-month, 41,989-event machine learning catalog (PESMLC) for the 2020–2022 Mw 6.4 Petrinja earthquake sequence in just 3 days of processing.
Validated PESMLC against two independent manual catalogs (HHC and CEC), achieving 96% and 85% match rates while identifying 14,274 high-quality new microseismic events.
Demonstrated that balanced P- and S-wave picks (51% P, 49% S) constrain hypocentral depths to shallower crustal levels (4.5–14 km) than P-dominated manual catalogs.
Proved that low-quality ML detections artificially inflate strict magnitude of completeness (Mc) estimators (MBS, K-S) and bias Omori decay p-values downward unless quality-filtered.
仅用3天处理时间构建了涵盖22个月、包含41,989个事件的2020–2022年Petrinja Mw 6.4地震序列机器学习目录（PESMLC）。
与两个独立人工目录（HHC和CEC）对比验证，匹配率分别达96%和85%，并新识别出14,274个高质量微震事件。
证明均衡的P波和S波拾取（51% P，49% S）比以P波为主的人工目录能更好地将震源深度约束在浅部地壳（4.5–14 km）。
证实低质量ML检测会人为推高严格的完备震级（Mc）估计值（MBS、K-S）并使Omori衰减指数p偏低，而质量过滤可消除该偏差。
me: Automated P and S phase picking using EQTransformer trained on the INSTANCE dataset via SeisBench (60 s windows, 50 s overlap, 0.05 probability threshold).
Phase association using PyOcto with network-adaptive criteria (≥5 picks before 4 Jan 2021; ≥7 picks with ≥3 P and ≥3 S picks after network densification).
Probabilistic relocation using NonLinLoc with iterative 3D source-specific station travel-time corrections (SSST) and pick-probability weighting, plus HypoDD testing.
Statistical completeness (MAXC, MBS, K-S via SeismoStats) and Omori–Utsu aftershock decay analysis using sliding-window log-space fitting and Ogata (1983) MLE.
通过SeisBench调用在INSTANCE数据集上训练的EQTransformer进行P波和S波自动拾取（60秒窗口，50秒重叠，0.05概率阈值）。
使用PyOcto进行震相关联，并根据台网密度调整标准（2021年1月4日前≥5个拾取；加密后≥7个拾取且包含≥3个P和≥3个S）。
利用NonLinLoc结合震源特定台站走时校正（SSST）和拾取概率加权进行非线性重定位，并测试了HypoDD。
使用SeismoStats评估完备震级（MAXC、MBS、K-S），并采用滑动窗口对数拟合与Ogata (1983)最大似然估计分析Omori–Utsu余震衰减。
de: Continuous 3-component seismic waveforms from 28 December 2020 to 30 November 2022 across up to 56 stations (35 permanent CR broadband, 5 OP-Net short-period, 16 PM-Net broadband).
Benchmark comparison against two manual catalogs: the 6-month Herak & Herak (2023) catalog (HHC, 13,770 events) and the 22-month Croatian Earthquake Catalogue (CEC, 22,958 events).
2020年12月28日至2022年11月30日期间多达56个台站（35个CR固定宽频带、5个OP-Net短周期、16个PM-Net宽频带）的连续三分量波形数据。
与两个人工目录进行基准对比：6个月的Herak & Herak (2023)目录（HHC，13,770个事件）和22个月的克罗地亚地震目录（CEC，22,958个事件）。
li: Automated maximum S-wave amplitude picking without individual quality control systematically underestimates local magnitudes (by ~0.1 magnitude units on average).
Closely spaced events in time with overlapping codas during early intense aftershock activity can be merged or missed due to inflexible associator criteria.
ML phase picks exhibit small systematic delays compared to manual picks (0.08–0.11 s for P waves and 0.19–0.23 s for S waves).
未经逐一质量控制的自动最大S波振幅拾取会系统性低估地方震级（平均低估约0.1个震级单位）。
在序列早期密集余震阶段，时间间隔极短且尾波重叠的事件可能因固定的关联阈值而被合并或漏检。
与人工拾取相比，ML震相拾取存在微小的系统性延迟（P波延迟0.08–0.11秒，S波延迟0.19–0.23秒）。

tm.why: The paper constructs and validates a 41,989-event earthquake catalog for the 2020–2022 Mw 6.4 Petrinja sequence using automated phase picking, association, and relocation.
The core workflow uses the deep-learning EQTransformer phase picker trained on the INSTANCE dataset via SeisBench and evaluates ML catalog biases.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 18-page Seismica PDF, including all text sections, equations, 9 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This study analyzes the long-duration Palghar earthquake swarm in western India (initiated in 2018) to understand its seasonal variations. Relocating ~8300 events reveals two narrow N-S clusters. Time-domain regional waveform full moment tensor inversion of 33 ML ≥ 3.5 events shows dominant normal faulting with high non-DC components (~42%). During the post-monsoon period (highest rainfall), pure normal faulting occurs along N-S strikes with reduced static stress drops and increased non-DC components. In summer, faulting transitions to oblique-normal along NNE-SSW planes. The authors conclude that vertical rainwater loading during the post-monsoon transitions to a combination of regional compressive stress and remnant water loading in summer, sustaining the swarm.
本文研究了印度西部帕尔加尔长期地震群的季节性震源特征。通过重定位约8300个地震，发现其呈南北向双带状分布。对33个ML≥3.5地震进行区域波形全矩张量反演，结果显示以正断层动作用为主且含有约42%的高非双力偶（non-DC）成分。在雨季后（降雨量最高），地震表现为纯正断层、应力降降低且非双力偶成分……

t: Time-domain regional waveform full moment tensor inversion and stress inversion to determine focal mechanisms and stress regimes.
利用时域区域波形全矩张量反演和应力反演确定震源机制和应力状态。
Relocated catalog of ~8300 earthquakes and regional waveforms of 33 ML ≥ 3.5 events from the Palghar swarm, western India.
印度帕尔加尔地震群约8300个重定位地震目录及33个ML≥3.5事件的区域波形。
Post-monsoon shows pure normal faulting (N-S strike, reduced stress drops, high non-DC), while summer shows oblique-normal faulting (NNE-SSW strike) due to tectonic-hydrological interplay.
雨季后表现为纯正断层（应力降降低、高非双力偶），夏季因构造-水文作用转为斜滑正断层。
Analysis of source parameters and stress inversion is restricted to a relatively small subset of larger events (ML ≥ 3.5).
震源参数和应力反演仅局限于相对较少的大地震（ML ≥ 3.5）子集。
First demonstration of seasonal transitions in earthquake focal mechanisms and stress drops within a rain-induced swarm, linking hydrological loading to tectonic stress.
首次展示了降雨诱发地震群中震源机制和应力降的季节性转变，将水文载荷与构造应力相联系。

kc: Relocated ~8300 earthquakes of the Palghar swarm, identifying two narrow N-S oriented clusters.
Determined focal mechanisms and source parameters for ML ≥ 3.5 events, revealing dominant normal faulting with high non-DC components (~42%).
Identified a distinct seasonal transition in faulting styles: pure normal faulting during post-monsoon vs. oblique-normal faulting during summer.
Proposed a physical mechanism where the interplay of vertical rainwater loading and regional tectonic stress sustains the long-duration swarm.
重定位了帕尔加尔地震群的约8300个地震，识别出两个狭窄的南北向地震带。
确定了ML ≥ 3.5事件的震源机制和震源参数，揭示了以正断层为主且含有高非双力偶成分（~42%）的特征。
发现了断层运动样式的明显季节性转变：雨季后为纯正断层，而夏季转变为斜滑正断层。
提出了垂直雨水载荷与区域构造应力相互作用维持这一长期地震群的物理机制。

Time-domain regional waveform full moment tensor inversion.
Stress inversion from focal mechanisms.
Frequency spectra analysis for source parameter estimation.
双差地震重定位技术。

用于估算震源参数（如静态应力降）的频率谱分析。

Catalog of ~8300 relocated earthquakes.
Waveform data for 33 ML ≥ 3.5 earthquakes used for moment tensor inversion.

sum: Large intraplate earthquakes far from plate boundaries remain poorly understood. Using ambient-noise tomography from a dense array of 117 short-period nodal seismometers (~5 km spacing), this study images the 3D upper- to mid-crustal shear-wave velocity (Vs) structure beneath northern Hainan Island, site of the 1605 Qiongbei M7.5 earthquake and Holocene basaltic volcanism. The Vs model reveals two shallow low-velocity zones (LVZs) at 0.5–10 km depth: a strong anomaly (up to -10%) beneath volcanic cones and a weaker anomaly (-2% to -4%) along the seismogenic Maniao-Puqian and Puqian-Qinglan conjugate fault system. Both LVZs connect near ~6 km depth and merge into a deeper (12–30 km) low-velocity and low-resistivity magmatic reservoir fed by the Hainan mantle plume. The authors conclude that volatile-rich magmatic fluids migrated upward and laterally into the fault network, elevating pore pressure, weakening the crust, and promoting the 1605 intraplate rupture.

sum: Slow slip events (SSEs) in the Cascadia subduction zone show distinct along-strike segmentation in recurrence intervals and seismic moments. To quantify the physical controls behind this variability, this study integrates geodetic coupling inversions of inter-SSE and long-term GNSS velocities from 446 stations with a Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo inversion of 2D quasi-dynamic rate-and-state friction simulations, accelerated by 10^5 via scientific machine-learning reduced-order modeling (ROM). Results demonstrate that low effective normal stress (2.7–6.1 MPa, implying near-lithostatic pore-fluid pressures of 99.3%–99.7%) primarily governs SSE recurrence intervals, whereas inter-SSE coupling controls SSE moment. While inter-SSE GNSS coupling is similarly high along strike (~60%–69%), long-term coupling varies from ~0% in the south to ~42% in central Cascadia. Consequently, transient SSEs recover the entire slip deficit in southern Cascadia but leave persistent deficits of ~30% and ~42% in northern and central Cascadia, providing a unified physics-based and geodetic explanation for ETS segmentation.
卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带慢滑移事件（SSE）在复发间隔和地震矩上表现出沿走向分段性。本研究结合446个GNSS站点的事件间与长期速度场耦合反演，以及由科学机器学习降阶模型（ROM）加速10^5倍的二维准动态速率-状态摩擦模型贝叶斯反演。结果表明，低有效正应力（2.7–6.1 MPa）主要控制SSE复发间隔，……

sum: This paper introduces Mollified Elastic Dislocation Theory (MEDT) to address two major limitations of Classical Elastic Dislocation Theory (CEDT): unphysical stress singularities on faults and the assumption of infinitely thin fault zones. By utilizing Cortez blob mollified displacement discontinuity Green's functions, MEDT represents deformation across spatially distributed fault zones of finite scale (epsilon), yielding singularity-free displacements and stresses. The authors leverage AI to analytically integrate the mollified source solution over arbitrary planar triangular elements, providing closed-form solutions for complex fault geometries. They demonstrate that the fault-zone width scale is decoupled from the mesh length scale. Finally, they apply these mollified kernels to construct numerically stable collocation boundary element models that incorporate extended fault zones, material heterogeneity, and non-planar topography.

sum: Near-surface heterogeneity strongly distorts land seismic wavefields, introducing trace-specific, frequency-dependent phase perturbations that surface-consistent processing cannot fully correct. Furthermore, conventional workflows lack a direct, quantitative metric for phase reliability, relying instead on indirect amplitude or SNR diagnostics. This paper introduces circular phase variance as a data-driven seismic quality-control attribute. By treating wrapped seismic phases as circular random variables and normalizing complex spectra to unit magnitude within sliding local trace ensembles, the method quantifies phase dispersion directly without phase unwrapping or wavelet models. Controlled synthetic experiments using a Klauder wavelet and von Mises phase perturbations validate that circular variance accurately recovers imposed spatial and spectral phase variability. Application to 3D land prestack gathers demonstrates that conventional time processing reduces phase variance mainly at low frequencies (<25 Hz) and mid-to-far offsets, while high frequencies remain noise-dominated despite apparent amplitude bandwidth extension.
近地表非均匀性会引起单道、频率相关的相位畸变，传统地表一致性处理难以消除，且缺乏直接量化相位可靠性的指标。本文引入基于圆统计的“相位方差”作为地震质量控制属性。该方法将包裹相位视为圆随机变量，在局部滑动道集窗口内对复频谱进行单位幅值归一化，无需相位解缠或子波假设即可直接量化局部相位离散度。基于Kla……

在局部滑动窗内将地震道变换至频率域并归一化为单位相量，计算平均合向量长度与圆相位方差 V(ω)=1-R̄(ω)。

Evaluated on a 10,000-trace synthetic Klauder-wavelet gather with spatially varying von Mises phase noise, and a 300-ms deep reflection window from a 10,000-trace 3D land CMP supergather before and after conventional processing.

In 3D land field data at 16 Hz, conventional processing reduces mid-offset circular variance from 0.81 to 0.59 (and mid-to-far offsets from ~0.71 to ~0.40), but shows no phase coherence improvement above ~25 Hz despite boosted amplitudes.

Introduces circular statistics (circular variance) as an automatic, unwrapping-free, model-independent prestack seismic QC attribute that isolates frequency-dependent phase coherence from amplitude effects.

Provides an objective criterion to define effective seismic bandwidth based on phase coherence for phase-sensitive workflows like FWI and AVO.

证明传统振幅谱和基于叠加的信噪比（SNR）会掩盖高频相位不相干性，从而高估可用频带宽度。

li: When multiple coherent wave modes (e.g., ground roll, guided waves, or crossing reflections) interfere in the same window, phase distributions become multimodal, complicating simple signal-plus-noise interpretation.
Statistical stability of circular variance depends on ensemble size; small windows exhibit higher estimator scatter, requiring large ensembles (e.g., 1,000–2,000 traces) for smooth QC diagnostics.
当面波、导波或交叉反射波等多种相干波场在同一窗口内干涉时，相位分布呈多峰形态，使单一信号加噪声的解释复杂化。
圆方差的统计稳定性依赖于道集大小；小窗口估计波动较大，用于平滑质量控制诊断时需较大道集（如1,000–2,000道）。

tm.why: The paper explicitly quantifies localized, frequency-dependent phase perturbations and speckle-like phase randomization induced by near-surface small-scale scattering.
The study focuses on dense single-sensor land acquisition and develops an ensemble-based quality-control metric for multi-channel prestack sensor arrays.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, mathematical derivations of circular statistics and von Mises distribution, synthetic Klauder wavelet benchmark, 3D land CMP supergather field application, and Appendix A on ensemble size stability.

sum: This study develops a novel finite-fault dynamic rupture inversion framework using a GPU-accelerated curved grid finite-difference method. The method is designed to handle complex topography and non-planar fault geometries efficiently. After validating the algorithm through synthetic tests, the authors apply it to reconstruct the dynamic rupture process of the 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquake, providing insights into its stress state and rupture propagation.
本研究开发了一种基于GPU加速曲线网格有限差分法的有限断层动力学破裂反演框架。该方法旨在高效处理复杂的非平直断层几何和地形。在通过合成测试验证算法后，作者将其应用于重建2017年九寨沟地震的动力学破裂过程，为该地震的应力状态和破裂传播特征提供了新的见解。

t: A GPU-accelerated curved grid finite-difference method is developed to simulate and invert finite-fault dynamic rupture processes.
开发了GPU加速的曲线网格有限差分方法，用于模拟和反演有限断层动力学破裂过程。
Synthetic test datasets and real seismic waveform data from the 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquake.
合成测试数据集以及2017年九寨沟地震的实际地震波形数据。
The method successfully reconstructs the dynamic rupture parameters and stress state of the 2017 Jiuzhaigou earthquake.
该方法成功重建了2017年九寨沟地震的动力学破裂参数和应力状态。
Computational cost remains high for very high-frequency simulations, and results are sensitive to velocity model uncertainties.
极高频模拟的计算成本较高，且结果对速度模型不确定性敏感。
Combining GPU acceleration with curved grid finite-difference methods specifically for dynamic rupture inversion under complex geometries.
将GPU加速与曲线网格有限差分法结合，用于复杂几何动力学破裂反演。

sum: This study performs high-pressure, high-temperature electrical conductivity measurements (7–15 GPa, up to 1585°C) on carbonated peridotite and basalt to investigate carbonate-rich melt formation and connectivity in the upper mantle. Surprisingly, conductivity decreases by up to a factor of 10 at the solidus. This drop is attributed to the extraction of incompatible charge-carrier ions (H, Na, K) into the melt and anisotropic melt distribution. These findings suggest that channelized carbonate-rich melt in a depleted mantle does not significantly enhance bulk conductivity at electromagnetic sounding scales, successfully reconciling previous discrepancies between electrical and seismic estimates of mantle melt content.
本研究在7-15 GPa和1585°C下测量了碳酸盐化橄榄岩和玄武岩的电导率。发现固相线处电导率意外下降达10倍，这是由于不相容离子转移至熔体及熔体各向异性分布所致。该结果表明通道化碳酸盐熔体在电磁尺度上不会显著提高地幔电导率，从而协调了电磁与地震对上地幔熔体估算的长期争议。

t: High-pressure, high-temperature electrical conductivity measurements of carbonated mantle rocks at 7–15 GPa and up to 1585°C.
在7-15 GPa和1585°C下对碳酸盐化地幔岩石进行的高温高压电导率测量。
Experimental electrical conductivity data of carbonated peridotite and carbonated basalt compositions.
碳酸盐化橄榄岩和碳酸盐化玄武岩组分的实验电导率数据。
Conductivity decreases by up to a factor of 10 at the solidus due to ion depletion and anisotropic melt distribution.
由于离子消耗和熔体各向异性分布，固相线处的电导率下降了达10倍。
Laboratory-scale measurements may not fully represent the geometric complexity of melt networks at mantle scales.
实验室尺度的测量可能无法完全代表地幔尺度熔体网络的几何复杂性。
Identifies a conductivity drop at the solidus, explaining why electromagnetic studies underestimate melt compared to seismic studies.
发现了固相线处的电导率下降，解释了为何电磁研究比地震研究低估了熔体含量。

kc: Measured electrical conductivity of carbonated peridotite and basalt at upper mantle conditions (7–15 GPa).
Discovered an unexpected conductivity drop at the solidus temperature.
Reconciled the discrepancy between electromagnetic and seismic estimates of upper mantle melt content.
测量了上地幔条件（7-15 GPa）下碳酸盐化橄榄岩和玄武岩的电导率。
发现了固相线温度下电导率意外下降的现象。

sum: This study investigates the competition between thermal pressurization (TP) and dilatant strengthening (DS) during spontaneous laboratory ruptures. The authors conducted triaxial stick-slip experiments on fluid-saturated, saw-cut, thermally cracked Westerly granite under effective confining pressures of 30–60 MPa, utilizing direct on- and off-fault pore pressure (Pp) transducers and laser vibrometry. Results demonstrate a systematic transition from co-seismic on-fault Pp rise (TP-dominated, up to ~7 MPa) to Pp drop (DS-dominated, up to ~20 MPa) with increasing cumulative shear strain, accompanied by a fast–slow–fast slip velocity sequence spanning three orders of magnitude. Analytical modeling and scanning electron microscopy confirm that early TP weakening diminishes as gouge accumulation and a ~60 µm near-fault damage zone widen the shear zone and enhance inelastic dilatancy. Notably, fracture energy scales identically with slip across both regimes, proving that fault structural evolution governs hydromechanical rupture dynamics.
本研究通过三轴黏滑实验探讨了流体饱和断层中热增压（TP）与扩容强化（DS）的竞争机制。实验在30–60 MPa有效围压下对含锯切面的热致裂Westerly花岗岩进行加载，并直接测量断层面上下的孔隙水压（Pp）。随累积剪切应变增加，同震Pp响应呈现从上升（TP主导，达~7 MPa）向下降（DS主导，达……

t: Triaxial stick-slip experiments on fluid-saturated saw-cut Westerly granite using six direct on- and off-fault pore pressure transducers, acoustic emission sensors, laser vibrometry, post-mortem SEM crack profiling, and 1D undrained adiabatic modeling.
对饱和锯切花岗岩开展三轴黏滑实验，结合断层内外孔隙水压传感器、激光测振、电镜裂隙统计与一维不排水绝热模型。
Four thermally cracked Westerly granite samples (WGF7–WGF10) with 30° polished saw-cut faults sheared at 0.3 µm/s axial displacement rate under effective confining pressures of 30, 45, and 60 MPa.
在30、45和60 MPa有效围压下，以0.3 µm/s轴向速率剪切4个含30°抛光锯切面的热致裂Westerly花岗岩…

Co-seismic on-fault pore pressure transitions from ~7 MPa rises (TP) to ~20 MPa drops (DS) across a fast–slow–fast slip velocity sequence, while fracture energy scales as a power law with slip (exponent 1.15–1.60) for both.
同震断层孔隙水压从上升约7 MPa（TP）转变为下降约20 MPa（DS），伴随快-慢-快滑移序列，且两类事件断裂能均随…
Lack of direct normal displacement and shear-zone temperature measurements prevents strictly ruling out compaction, and experiments omit interseismic healing and sealing present in natural faults.
缺乏法向位移与原位温度的直接测量，且实验未考虑天然断层震间期的水热愈合与封闭过程。
First experimental demonstration of both opposing co-seismic pore pressure responses (TP rise to DS drop) and a fast–slow–fast rupture spectrum on a single evolving fault under continuous loading.
首次在单一连续加载演化断层上实验证实同震孔隙水压升降反转（TP向DS转变）及快-慢破裂滑移谱共存。

kc: Direct experimental measurement of on- and off-fault pore pressure evolution during spontaneous triaxial stick-slip ruptures in granite.
Observation of a systematic transition from co-seismic pore pressure rise (TP) to drop (DS) paired with a fast–slow–fast slip velocity spectrum on a single evolving fault.
Microstructural and analytical demonstration that shear zone widening and near-fault damage zone development (~60 µm half-thickness) drive the shift from TP to DS.
Demonstration that fracture energy scales uniformly with fault slip (power-law exponent 1.15–1.60) regardless of whether TP or DS dominates.
在花岗岩自发三轴黏滑破裂过程中直接实验测量了断层面上和断层面外的孔隙水压演化。
在单一演化断层上观测到同震孔隙水压从上升（TP）到下降（DS）的系统性转变，以及伴随的快-慢-快滑移速度谱。
通过显微结构与解析模型证实，剪切带增宽及近断层损伤带（半厚度约60 µm）发育驱动了TP向DS的转变。
证实无论TP还是DS占主导，断裂能均随断层滑移量呈统一的幂律标度关系（指数为1.15–1.60）。
me: Triaxial stick-slip friction experiments on saw-cut, thermally cracked Westerly granite at 30–60 MPa effective confining pressures.
Direct high-frequency monitoring of on-fault and off-fault pore pressure via sleeve-mounted transducers, paired with acoustic emission sensors and laser vibrometry.
1D undrained, adiabatic thermo-hydro-mechanical analytical modeling to invert for effective shear zone thickness and cumulative plastic porosity.
Post-mortem scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and grid-based crack density profiling to quantify gouge thickness and near-fault damage zone decay.
Spring-slider stiffness analysis and slip-weakening fracture energy integration.
在30–60 MPa有效围压下对含锯切面的热致裂Westerly花岗岩开展三轴黏滑摩擦实验。
利用镶嵌于橡胶套内的传感器直接监测断层内外孔隙水压，并结合声发射传感器与激光测振仪测量动态滑移速率。
采用一维不排水绝热热-流-固耦合解析模型，反演有效剪切带厚度与累积塑性孔隙度。
利用实验后扫描电镜（SEM）及网格裂隙密度剖面法，定量表征断层泥厚度与近断层损伤带衰减特征。
开展弹簧-滑块刚度稳定性分析及滑移弱化断裂能积分计算。
de: Four triaxial stick-slip experiments (WGF7, WGF8, WGF9, WGF10) on cylindrical Westerly granite samples (85 mm length, 40 mm diameter, 30° saw-cut fault, initial RMS roughness 2.6–5.3 µm).
Synchronous 100 Hz recordings of axial stress, LVDT displacement, fluid pump volume, and 6 local pore pressure transducers, plus 1.5 MHz laser vibrometer velocity records.
Post-experiment SEM cross-sectional mosaic covering ~75 mm of the fault length in sample WGF10.
对4个圆柱形Westerly花岗岩样品（长85 mm，直径40 mm，30°锯切断层面，初始均方根粗糙度2.6–5.3 µm）开展的三轴黏滑实验（WGF7–WGF10）。
100 Hz同步记录的轴向应力、LVDT位移、流体泵体积和6个局部孔隙压力传感器数据，以及1.5 MHz激光测振仪速度记录。
WGF10样品实验后覆盖约75 mm断层长度的扫描电镜（SEM）横截面拼接图像。
li: Lack of direct co-seismic measurements of normal fault displacement and in-situ shear-zone temperature prevents strictly excluding minor shear-induced compaction effects.
Simplified 1D undrained, adiabatic analytical equations assume constant hydromechanical parameters and neglect thermal/hydraulic diffusion during rupture.
Laboratory stick-slip cycles omit interseismic hydrothermal healing and sealing processes that occur in natural fault zones.
缺乏对同震断层法向位移和剪切带原位温度的直接测量，无法完全排除微弱剪切压实效应的干扰。
简化的一维不排水绝热解析方程假设水力力学参数恒定，且忽略了破裂过程中的热扩散和水力扩散。
实验室黏滑循环忽略了天然断层带在震间期发生的水热愈合与胶结封闭过程。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault hydromechanics, competing frictional weakening/strengthening mechanisms (thermal pressurization vs. dilatancy), and a fast–slow–fast slip spectrum during triaxial stick-slip experiments.
The study analyzes co-seismic rupture transitions, stress drops, slip velocities, and fracture energy scaling with slip during spontaneous laboratory ruptures.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 30-page manuscript PDF including abstract, methodology, experimental results, theoretical modeling, microstructural analysis, and all 13 figures and 1 table.

sum: This study investigates whether structural variations in the incoming Cocos Plate control along-strike megathrust slip differences between the Guerrero Gap (GG, hosting slow-slip events) and adjacent earthquake-generating segments offshore Mexico. Using multichannel seismic reflection imaging and 2D traveltime tomography of downward-continued 15-km streamer data from the 2022 ¡ME GUSTA! cruise, the authors characterize sediment thickness, fault throws, P-wave velocities, and Effective Medium Theory-based water content across three trench-perpendicular profiles. Results show minimal along-strike variation in sediment cover (77–90 m), basement roughness, and upper crustal hydration (Layer 2A pore water 3.1–4.0 wt%, structural water 2.0–2.2 wt%). Bend-faulting is restricted to within 20 km of the trench with modest throws, likely due to reduced slab pull from the Guerrero flat slab. However, fluid-rich seamounts (carrying ~12% more structural water) are roughly twice as abundant outboard of GG and Oaxaca, correlating with deep long-term SSEs, though unable to fully explain shallow slip differences.
本研究探讨墨西哥近海科科斯板块结构是否控制格雷罗地震空区（GG，以慢滑移为主）与邻近大震频发段之间的逆冲断层滑移差异。利用2022年¡ME GUSTA!航次采集的15公里长排列多道地震反射和向下延拓走时层析成像数据，结合有效介质理论，反演了三条垂直海沟剖面的沉积层厚度、断层落差、P波速度及含水量。结……

t: Kirchhoff downward continuation of 15-km streamer data exposes crustal refractions for 2D regularized traveltime tomography, followed by Monte Carlo Effective Medium Theory modeling to estimate pore and structural water contents.
对15公里拖缆数据做基尔霍夫向下延拓并开展二维走时层析成像，结合蒙特卡洛有效介质理论反演孔隙水与结构水含量。

Three margin-perpendicular active-source multichannel seismic profiles (MG01, MG06, MG07) collected offshore Acapulco, Mexico during the 2022 ¡ME GUSTA! cruise using a 6,600 cu.in. airgun array and 15-km streamer.
2022年¡ME GUSTA!航次在墨西哥阿卡普尔科外海采集的三条垂直海沟主动源多道地震剖面（15公里拖缆）。
Sediment thickness (77–90 m) and Layer 2A structural water (2.0–2.2 wt%) and pore water (3.1–4.0 wt%) vary little along-strike; bend-faulting reduces Layer 2A Vp by 5.7% within 20 km of the trench.
沉积物厚度（77–90米）及2A层结构水（2.0–2.2 wt%）和孔隙水（3.1–4.0 wt%）沿走向变化小；海沟2…
Thin sediment cover prevents reliably distinguishing reactivated abyssal hill faults from newly formed bend faults or inactive faults in bathymetry and seismic data.
极薄的沉积层覆盖导致难以在水深地形和地震剖面上区分活化断层、新生成弯曲断层与非活动断层。

First high-resolution comparison of incoming Cocos Plate hydration and seamount distribution across the Guerrero Gap, showing seamounts store 12% more structural water and correlate with deep SSE zones.
首次高分辨率对比格雷罗空区内外入海板块水合状态，发现富水海山（多含12%结构水）丰度与深部慢滑移区吻合。

kc: High-resolution seismic reflection and traveltime tomography across three margin-perpendicular profiles reveal limited along-strike variability in incoming Cocos Plate sediment thickness, faulting, and upper crustal hydration.

Effective Medium Theory modeling demonstrates that the upper oceanic crust (Layer 2A) acts as a major reservoir for free pore water (3.1–4.0 wt%) with comparatively low structurally bound water (2.0–2.2 wt%).

Bending-related fault reactivation and velocity reduction (~5.7% in Layer 2A) are confined to a narrow ~20 km zone near the trench with small fault throws, attributed to reduced slab-pull from flat-slab subduction.

Bathymetric and tomographic analyses show fluid-rich seamounts carry ~12% more structural water and cover ~13% of the incoming plate outboard of Guerrero and Oaxaca versus 6.8% in between, linking seamounts to deep long-term SSEs.
通过三条垂直陆缘剖面的高分辨率地震反射和走时层析成像，揭示科科斯板块沉积物厚度、断层和上地壳水合作用沿走向变化有限。
有效介质理论建模表明，上洋壳（2A层）是自由孔隙水的主要储层（3.1–4.0 wt%），而结构结合水含量相对较低（2.0–2.2 wt%）。
与弯曲相关的断层活化和速度降低（2A层降低约5.7%）局限于距海沟约20公里的狭窄带内且落差较小，这归因于平板俯冲降低了板片拉力。
水深和层析成像分析显示，富流体海山多携带约12%的结构水，在格雷罗和瓦哈卡外海覆盖率达约13%（中间区域仅6.8%），表明海山与深部长期慢滑移事件存在关联。
me: Multichannel seismic (MCS) reflection processing and pre-stack time/depth migration to image seafloor, basement, Moho, and fault offsets.
Kirchhoff downward continuation (DC) of 15-km streamer data to 75 m above the seafloor to expose short-offset upper crustal first-arrival refractions.
2D iterative regularized damped least-squares traveltime tomography (VMTomo) using shortest-path and bending raytracing.
Monte Carlo Effective Medium Theory (EMT) modeling with oblate spheroidal cracks to partition total porosity into free pore water and hydrous alteration minerals (structural water).
Residual topography analysis removing conductive thermal subsidence and sediment loading to estimate the spatial onset of plate bending.
多道地震（MCS）反射波处理及叠前时间/深度偏移，用于成像海底、基底、莫霍面及断层错距。
将15公里拖缆数据进行基尔霍夫向下延拓（DC）至海底上方75米处，以揭示近偏移距上地壳初至折射波。
采用最短路径和弯曲射线追踪算法的二维迭代正则化阻尼最小二乘走时层析成像（VMTomo）。
基于扁球形裂隙假设的蒙特卡洛有效介质理论（EMT）建模，将总孔隙度划分为自由孔隙水和含水蚀变矿物（结构水）。
扣除热沉降和沉积物载荷的剩余地形分析，以估算板块弯曲变形的空间起始位置。

Three margin-perpendicular profiles (MG01 outside the Guerrero Gap, MG06 and MG07 outboard of the Guerrero Gap) with 50 m shot spacing, 18 s record length, and 2 ms sampling rate.
Semi-automatically picked first-arrival crustal refraction traveltimes (405,227 picks on MG06; 507,747 on MG07; 386,277 on MG01).
High-resolution multibeam bathymetry (75 × 75 m grid) for fault scarp and seamount polygon mapping across the Middle America Trench.

半自动拾取的地壳折射波初至走时数据（MG06测线405,227个，MG07测线507,747个，MG01测线386,277个）。
中美洲海沟研究区高分辨率多波束水深数据（75 × 75米网格），用于断层陡坎测量和海山多边形圈定。
li: Thin sediment cover (77–90 m) makes it difficult to distinguish reactivated abyssal hill faults from newly created bend faults or inactive faults in bathymetry.
Lack of vertical seismic resolution at depth prevents resolving whether small offsets extend down to the Moho.
Presence of a large seamount and Michoacán Trough intraplate deformation on profiles MG01 and MG06 obscures background seaward velocities, leaving only MG07 for baseline unbent velocity comparison.
Absence of seafloor instrumentation offshore Oaxaca prevents confirming whether shallow short-term SSEs also occur there alongside subducting seamounts.
极薄的沉积物覆盖（77–90米）使得在水深地形上难以区分活化的深海丘陵断层、新生成的弯曲断层或非活动断层。
深部地震垂直分辨率的下降导致无法分辨小规模断层错距是否延伸至莫霍面。
MG01和MG06测线上的大型海山和米却肯海槽板内变形掩盖了远海背景速度，仅剩MG07可用于未弯曲背景速度对比。
瓦哈卡近海缺乏海底观测仪器，无法证实该区在海山俯冲的同时是否也发生浅部短期慢滑移事件。

tm.why: The paper characterizes the upper crustal structure, sediment thickness, bending-related faulting, and hydration state of the incoming Cocos Plate prior to subduction.
The authors apply 2D first-arrival P-wave traveltime tomography to downward-continued long-offset marine streamer data to derive upper crustal velocity models.
The study directly investigates how incoming plate structures, fluid content, and seamount distributions modulate along-strike variations in megathrust slip and slow-slip events (SSEs).

sum: This study investigates the Variscan crust-mantle interaction in the French Massif Central (FMC) using a high-pressure mafic granulite. By integrating petrology, phase equilibrium modeling, trace element thermometry, and U-Pb geochronology, the authors reconstruct a P-T-t path showing hydration and cooling from ~900-975°C to ~700-800°C at 13-11 kbar, dated at 354.6 ± 4.6 Ma, followed by decompression below 9 kbar. One-dimensional thermal modeling demonstrates that these conditions match the thermal interaction of a crustal translithospheric diapir exhuming through the shallow lithospheric mantle. The novelty lies in providing quantitative petrological and thermal modeling evidence for translithospheric diapirism as a key mechanism for crust-mantle interaction and exhumation in the FMC.
本研究通过对法国中央高原（FMC）高压基性麻粒岩进行岩石学、相平衡模拟、微量元素温度计和U-Pb年代学联合分析，探讨了海西期壳幔相互作用。结果显示，该岩石在13-11 kbar压力下经历了从~900-975°C到~700-800°C的显著冷却与水化作用（年龄为354.6 ± 4.6 Ma），随后发生……

t: Integrated petrology, phase equilibrium modeling, trace element thermometry, multi-mineral U-Pb geochronology, and 1D thermal modeling of crustal translithospheric diapirs.
整合了岩石学、相平衡模拟、微量元素温度计、多矿物U-Pb年代学及一维地壳跨岩石圈底辟热模拟。
Petrological, geochemical, and geochronological data from a high-pressure mafic granulite in the French Massif Central, along with synthetic 1D thermal modeling results.
法国中央高原高压基性麻粒岩的岩石学、地球化学和年代学数据，以及合成的一维热模拟结果。
Identified cooling from ~900-975°C to ~700-800°C at 13-11 kbar at 354.6 Ma, followed by decompression, matching 1D thermal models of a crustal diapir in the lithospheric mantle.
确定了在354.6 Ma、13-11 kbar下从~900-975°C到~700-800°C的冷却及随后的减压，与底辟热…
The geodynamic interpretation relies on simplified 1D thermal models and assumes representative mineral behavior during complex metamorphic overprinting.
地球动力学解释依赖于简化的一维热模型，并假设了复杂变质超叠加过程中代表性的矿物行为。
Provides the first quantitative link between high-pressure granulite P-T-t paths and translithospheric diapir thermal models in the French Massif Central.
首次在法国中央高原建立了高压麻粒岩P-T-t轨迹与跨岩石圈底辟热模型之间的定量联系。

kc: Reconstructed a detailed P-T-t-fluid path for high-pressure mafic granulites in the French Massif Central.
Constrained the timing of cooling/hydration (354.6 ± 4.6 Ma) and subsequent decompression (348.5 Ma and 337.9 Ma) using multi-mineral U-Pb geochronology.
Proposed a new petrogenetic model for the FMC centered on translithospheric diapirism supported by 1D thermal modeling.
重建了法国中央高原高压基性麻粒岩详细的P-T-t-流体演化轨迹。
利用多矿物U-Pb年代学约束了冷却/水化（354.6 ± 4.6 Ma）及随后的减压（348.5 Ma和337.9 Ma）时间。
提出了一项以跨岩石圈底辟作用为核心的FMC新岩石成因模型，并得到一维热模拟的支持。
me: Phase equilibrium modeling to constrain P-T conditions.
Trace element thermometry and U-Pb geochronology of titanite, apatite, and rutile.
One-dimensional thermal modeling of crustal translithospheric diapirs.
相平衡模拟以约束温压（P-T）条件。
榍石、磷灰石和金红石的微量元素温度计与U-Pb年代学分析。
地壳跨岩石圈底辟的一维热力学数值模拟。
de: Petrological observations and mineral chemistry of a high-pressure mafic granulite sample from the French Massif Central.
U-Pb isotopic data for titanite, apatite, and rutile.
Synthetic P-T paths generated from 1D thermal models.
法国中央高原高压基性麻粒岩样品的岩石学观测与矿物化学数据。
榍石、磷灰石和金红石的U-Pb同位素数据。

Geochronological constraints rely on closure temperatures of different minerals which can be affected by fluid alteration.
热学模型简化为一维，可能无法捕捉复杂的地下三维底辟几何形状和流动动力学。

tm.why: The paper investigates crust-mantle interaction, lithospheric thermal evolution, and translithospheric diapirs using petrology and thermal modeling.

sum: This paper investigates the physical mechanisms and stress interactions between deep slow slip events (SSEs) and the updip seismogenic zone on megathrust faults. Using numerical simulations of earthquake cycles incorporating rate-and-state friction, the authors analyze how episodic slow slip modulates the timing, size, and recurrence intervals of megathrust earthquakes. The study highlights that deep SSEs do not merely release stress silently but actively load the seismogenic zone, potentially triggering or delaying major ruptures depending on their spatial-temporal relationship. This provides key insights into the physical links between slow earthquakes and devastating megathrust events.
本文研究了超大型逆冲断层深部慢滑移事件（SSE）与浅部发震带之间的应力相互作用。通过数值模拟方法，探讨了周期性慢滑移如何调节大地震的复发间隔、破裂规模和发震时刻。研究表明，深部慢滑移不仅无震释放应力，还会向发震带传导应力，从而主动调制地震周期。该成果对理解慢地震与大地震的物理联系具有重要意义。

t: Numerical modeling of megathrust seismic cycles incorporating rate-and-state friction to simulate episodic slow slip and earthquakes.
结合速率-状态摩擦定律的超大型逆冲断层地震周期数值模拟，用以模拟周期性慢滑移与大地震。
Synthetic modeling of fault slip and stress evolution, potentially compared with geodetic (GNSS/InSAR) observations of slow slip.
断层滑移与应力演化的合成数值模拟，并与慢滑移的大地测量（GNSS/InSAR）观测进行对比。
Deep slow slip events systematically modulate the stress state of the updip seismogenic zone, altering earthquake recurrence intervals and rupture patterns.
深部慢滑移事件系统地调制了浅部发震带的应力状态，从而改变了大地震的复发间隔和破裂模式。
Simplified fault geometry and homogeneous rheology in numerical models may not capture full 3D structural complexities.
数值模拟中采用的简化断层几何和均匀流变学可能无法完全捕获真实的三维结构复杂性。
Quantifying the long-term feedback loop and stress coupling between deep transient slow slip and megathrust earthquake cycles.
定量化了深部瞬态慢滑移与超大型逆冲断层地震周期之间的长期反馈机制和应力耦合关系。

Demonstrated how episodic slow slip modulates the recurrence intervals and rupture patterns of large earthquakes.
Provided a theoretical framework linking geodetic observations of slow slip to long-term seismic hazard assessment.
定量化了深部慢滑移带与发震逆冲断层之间的应力传递机制。

Quasi-dynamic or fully dynamic modeling of fault slip and stress evolution.

Potential sensitivity of the results to poorly constrained rate-and-state friction parameters.

结果可能对约束较弱的速率-状态摩擦参数具有高敏感性。

It models the stress interactions and rupture behavior of megathrust earthquake cycles.

sum: This study presents a comprehensive seismological validation of a physics-based ground motion simulation (PBS) framework that couples an extended-source stochastic kinematic rupture model (PULSYN) with 1D Discrete Wavenumber (DWN) wave propagation up to 10 Hz. The authors generated a database of 94,500 three-component synthetic records across three Italian fault geometries, five magnitudes (Mw 5.5–7.5), ten rupture realizations, three EC8 soil classes, and various distances and azimuths. Simulated peak, spectral, cumulative, and energy-based intensity measures (PGA, PGV, SA, CAV, Arias Intensity, and Relative Energy Input) are compared against empirical Ground Motion Models (GMMs) via standardized residual decomposition into between-event, within-event, site-to-site, and single-station terms. Results show total residuals mostly fall within ±0.5 to ±1.0 empirical standard deviations, confirming overall consistency while diagnosing interpretable biases linked to Vs30-based shallow attenuation parameterizations, 1D scattering limitations, and fault-specific deep crustal models.
本研究对结合扩展震源随机运动学破裂模型（PULSYN）与一维离散波数（DWN）波传播（上限10 Hz）的物理地面运动模拟（PBS）方法进行了系统的地震学验证。研究构建了包含3种意大利断层几何、5个震级（Mw 5.5–7.5）、10次破裂实现及45种浅层场地模型的94,500条三分量合成记录数据库。通……

A synthetic database of 94,500 three-component ground-motion records (850,500 time histories) spanning 150 events (3 Italian faults, Mw 5.5–7.5, 10 realizations) and 630 receiver configurations across 45 EC8 A, B, and C soil profiles.

Standardized total residuals remain mostly within ±0.5σ and bounded by ±1σ across all IMs, though spectral IMs exhibit a monotonic Vs30 site-to-site residual trend (+0.5σ at 200 m/s to -1.0σ at 1000 m/s).
各指标标准化总残差大多集中在±0.5σ且不超出±1σ，但谱指标在软土（+0.5σ）至硬土（-1.0σ）间呈现Vs30单调…
1D horizontally layered modeling omits 3D basin, topographic, and lateral scattering effects, has a 10 Hz frequency cutoff, and uses a simplified Vs-based shallow Qs relation.
一维层状介质忽略了三维盆地、地形及横向散射效应，最高频率限为10 Hz，且浅层Qs参数化较为简化。

Provides a systematic multi-IM seismological validation and variance decomposition of 1D DWN-PULSYN synthetic ground motions across both peak/spectral and integral/energy-based metrics over a broad parameter space.
首次在广泛参数空间内结合峰值、谱值及能量积分多指标与方差分解对DWN-PULSYN合成地震动进行系统验证。

kc: Developed a large-scale synthetic ground-motion database of 94,500 three-component records (850,500 single-component time histories) spanning diverse source, path, and site configurations.
Proposed and applied a multi-intensity-measure seismological validation framework using standardized residual and variance decomposition (between-event, within-event, site-to-site, single-station).
Demonstrated that 1D DWN coupled with PULSYN extended-source modeling reproduces empirical GMM medians and variability within ±1σ across peak, spectral, and integral/energy-based metrics.
Identified physically interpretable residual trends related to Vs30 shallow Qs parameterization, corner-frequency scaling, and regional crustal velocity/attenuation structures.
构建了包含94,500条三分量记录（850,500条单分量时程）的大规模物理合成地面运动数据库，涵盖多种震源、路径和场地条件。
提出并应用了基于标准化残差与方差分解（事件间、事件内、场地间、单台）的多强度指标地震学验证框架。
证明了一维DWN结合PULSYN扩展震源模拟在峰值、谱值及能量积分指标上能够再现经验GMM的中位数趋势和变异性（±1σ以内）。
揭示了与Vs30浅层Qs衰减参数化、拐角频率标度律以及区域深部地壳结构相关的可物理解释的残差趋势。

Parameterized 45 shallow soil profiles (EC8 classes A, B, C) using Vs-dependent Vp/Vs ratios and randomized quality factors Qs = Vs*1000/X (X in [5, 15]).
Evaluated peak/spectral IMs (PGA, PGV, SA at 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 s) and cumulative/energy IMs (Arias Intensity, CAV, Relative Energy Input VEIr).
Decomposed residuals against empirical GMMs into between-event, within-event, site-to-site, and single-station components normalized by empirical standard deviations.

Three regional deep crustal velocity and attenuation models derived from nonlinear surface-wave dispersion inversion, paired with 15 shallow soil profiles each (recorded station stratigraphies from ESM).

150 simulated earthquake scenarios (3 faults x 5 magnitudes Mw 5.5–7.5 x 10 stochastic realizations) recorded across 630 virtual receiver configurations (7 distances from 5 to 100 km, 6 azimuths, 15 soil profiles).

tm.why: The paper validates physics-based ground motion simulations against empirical Ground Motion Models across multiple engineering intensity measures for seismic hazard and structural assessment.
The simulations compute 1D anelastic wave propagation up to 10 Hz using the Discrete Wavenumber (DWN) method coupled with kinematic extended-source models.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 earthquake swarm in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo volcanic complex, Aegean Sea. Using seismological and geodetic observations, the authors demonstrate a cascading unrest sequence driven by elastic stress transfer. Pressurization of the Santorini magma reservoir triggered a 9-kilometer-long dike intrusion originating from the neighboring Kolumbo reservoir. This dike intrusion subsequently triggered a Mw 6.2 aseismic slip transient on a 17-kilometer-long segment of the Amorgos fault. Upward-propagating seismicity within the dike suggests buoyancy-driven, segmented opening. The findings highlight that magmatic and tectonic unrest in rift zones can propagate across large spatial scales through sequential elastic stress relay, linking multiple distinct reservoirs and faults.
本研究分析了2025年爱琴海克里斯蒂亚纳-圣托里尼-哥伦布火山群的地震序列。结合地震与大地测量观测，作者揭示了由弹性应力传递驱动的连锁活动：圣托里尼岩浆房加压触发了哥伦布火山下方9公里长岩脉的侵入，该岩脉随后在阿莫尔戈斯断层上触发了矩震级6.2级的无震滑动。岩脉内向上传播的地震活动指示了浮力驱动的分……

t: Joint analysis of seismicity catalogs and geodetic data to model elastic stress transfer, dike intrusion, and fault slip.
结合地震目录与大地测量数据，对弹性应力传递、岩脉侵入和断层滑动进行联合建模。
Seismological and geodetic observations of the 2025 Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo earthquake swarm in the Aegean Sea.
2025年爱琴海克里斯蒂亚纳-圣托里尼-哥伦布群震的地震与大地测量观测数据。

tm.why: The paper investigates magmatic unrest, dike intrusion, and volcanic processes in the Christiana-Santorini-Kolumbo complex.
It models the triggering of an earthquake swarm and a Mw 6.2 aseismic slip transient on the Amorgos fault.
It analyzes dike-triggered aseismic slip transients and stress transfer along fault networks.

sum: The high abundance and chondritic relative proportions of highly siderophile elements (HSEs) in Earth's mantle have traditionally been explained by the 'late veneer' hypothesis—post-core-formation accretion of chondritic material. However, previous partitioning experiments were limited to lower pressures and temperatures. This study presents 13 laser-heated diamond anvil cell (LH-DAC) experiments quantifying the metal-silicate partitioning of Re, Os, Ir, Pd, and Au at deep magma ocean conditions (40–81 GPa, 3500–4500 K) and reducing conditions. Using nano-XRF, SEM-EDS, and TEM, the authors demonstrate that metal-silicate partition coefficients decrease by several orders of magnitude with increasing temperature. Incorporating these values into multistage core formation models reproduces observed bulk silicate Earth HSE abundances and chondritic ratios (including Re/Os and Pt/Os) without invoking a substantial late veneer, suggesting Earth's volatiles were delivered primarily during early accretion.
地幔中强亲铁元素（HSEs）的高丰度及球粒陨石相对比例传统上归因于核形成后的“晚期增生”。本研究利用激光加热金刚石对顶砧（LH-DAC）在深部岩浆洋温压条件（40–81 GPa，3500–4500 K）下开展了13组实验，结合同步辐射纳米X射线荧光（nano-XRF）和电镜技术，定量测定了Re、Os……

t: Laser-heated diamond anvil cell experiments at 40–81 GPa and 3500–4500 K combined with FIB recovery, nano-XRF trace analysis, Margules thermodynamic corrections, and multistage core formation modeling.
结合40–81 GPa和3500–4500 K的LH-DAC实验、FIB取样、nano-XRF分析及多阶段地核形成模拟。
13 superliquidus LH-DAC partitioning experiments using synthetic MORB or pyrolite glasses and four Fe-HSE starting alloys, analyzed across four laser-heating facilities and ESRF ID16b.
利用合成MORB或地幔岩玻璃与四种Fe-HSE合金开展的13组超液相线LH-DAC分配实验数据。

Metal-silicate partition coefficients decrease by orders of magnitude at high temperatures; multistage accretion models yield 0.350, 2.40, 1.800, 8.03, and 11.00 ppb for Re, Os, Ir, Pd, and Au in the mantle.
高温下分配系数降低数个数量级；模型计算出地幔Re、Os、Ir、Pd、Au丰度与观测高度一致。
Experiments cannot resolve the ~5% similarity in Re and Os partition coefficients required by Os isotopes, and modeled mantle Au abundances exceed bulk silicate Earth estimates.
实验精度不足以直接确认Re和Os分配系数5%以内的相似度，且模拟的Au丰度偏高。
First experimental determination of Re, Os, Ir, Pd, and Au metal-silicate partitioning at actual deep magma ocean P-T conditions, resolving the mantle siderophile excess without a late veneer.
首次在真实深部岩浆洋温压下测定五种HSE分配系数，无需晚期增生即解决亲铁元素过剩问题。

kc: Measured metal-silicate partition coefficients for five HSEs (Re, Os, Ir, Pd, Au) at extreme magma ocean conditions (40–81 GPa, 3500–4500 K).
Demonstrated a strong negative temperature dependence of HSE siderophile behavior, lowering partition coefficients by orders of magnitude.
Reproduced bulk silicate Earth HSE abundances and chondritic Re/Os and Pt/Os ratios via multistage core formation modeling without requiring a late veneer.
测定了极端岩浆洋条件下（40–81 GPa，3500–4500 K）五种强亲铁元素（Re、Os、Ir、Pd、Au）的金属-硅酸盐分配系数。
证实了强亲铁元素的亲铁性具有显著的负温度依赖性，高温下分配系数降低数个数量级。
通过多阶段地核形成模型重现了全硅酸盐地球的HSE丰度及球粒陨石比值，无需引入晚期增生假说。
me: Laser-heated diamond anvil cell (LH-DAC) experiments at 40–81 GPa and 3500–4500 K under reducing conditions (~IW-2 to IW-1).
Sample recovery via focused ion beam (FIB) and major element characterization via FEG-SEM-EDS and TEM.
Trace element quantification in quenched silicate melt using synchrotron nano-X-ray fluorescence (nano-XRF) at 60 nm resolution.
Thermodynamic correction to infinite dilution using a Margules mixing model and integration into multistage planetary accretion models.
在还原条件下（约IW-2至IW-1）开展40–81 GPa和3500–4500 K的激光加热金刚石对顶砧（LH-DAC）实验。
利用聚焦离子束（FIB）回收样品，并通过场发射扫描电镜（FEG-SEM-EDS）和透射电镜（TEM）表征主量元素及纳米金属颗粒。
利用60 nm分辨率的同步辐射纳米X射线荧光（nano-XRF）定量测定淬火硅酸盐熔体中的微量HSE浓度。
应用Margules混合模型进行无限稀释热力学修正，并将数据整合至多阶段行星增生与核形成模型中。
de: 13 successful superliquidus LH-DAC runs using synthetic MORB or pyrolite glasses equilibrated with Fe-HSE alloys.
Synchrotron nano-XRF elemental maps and spectra acquired at ESRF ID16b beamline.
TEM-EDS characterization of bimodal metallic nano-nugget populations in quenched silicates.
使用合成洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）或地幔岩玻璃与Fe-HSE合金开展的13组超液相线LH-DAC成功实验。
在欧洲同步辐射装置（ESRF）ID16b线站获取的nano-XRF元素分布图与光谱数据。
淬火硅酸盐中双峰分布金属纳米颗粒的TEM-EDS表征数据。
li: Experimental precision is insufficient to confirm the exact 5% similarity in Re and Os partition coefficients required by Os isotopes.
Modeled Au concentrations exceed bulk silicate Earth estimates, requiring additional depletion mechanisms or revised BSE abundance estimates.
Valence states of HSEs in the silicate melt could not be directly determined and were assumed to be zero-valent.
实验精度尚不足以直接证实Os同位素所要求的Re和Os分配系数在5%以内的极高相似度。
模型计算出的地幔Au浓度高于全硅酸盐地球估计值，需额外耗竭机制或修正BSE估计值。
无法直接测定硅酸盐熔体中HSE的价态，实验中假设其为零价态。

tm.why: The paper investigates deep Earth differentiation, magma ocean conditions, and core-mantle partitioning of highly siderophile elements using high-pressure mineral physics experiments.
