sum: This study investigates bimodal double-frequency (DF) microseisms with spectral peaks at ~1 s and ~3 s recorded by six under-ice ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) at the eastern Gakkel Ridge, Arctic Ocean. Polarization and ERA5 wave correlation analyses demonstrate that both peaks originate from a single source region in the St. Anna Trough (~500 km away), contrasting with traditional dual-source explanations. While the ~6 s ocean waves explain the 3 s peak, 1D Rayleigh-wave dispersion modeling reveals that thin seafloor sediments (~0–400 m) at the receivers induce a group-velocity minimum (Airy phase) near 1 s in the fundamental or first-overtone modes, focusing energy at 1 s. Extending the analysis to 583 global OBS deployments confirms that bimodal DF microseisms predominantly occur where sediment thickness is under ~500 m, establishing local sediment modulation as a globally widespread mechanism shaping oceanic ambient noise.
本研究分析了北冰洋Gakkel洋脊冰下6台海底地震仪（OBS）记录到的1秒和3秒双峰双频（DF）微震。极化分析与海浪相关性表明，两个谱峰均源于圣安娜海槽同一源区，打破了远近双源激发的传统认识。一维瑞利波频散模拟证实，台站下方小于400米的薄沉积层使基阶或一阶高阶模在1秒附近产生群速度极小值（艾里相）……

t: The authors combine PSD probability density functions, 3-component eigendecomposition polarization analysis, Pearson correlation with ERA5 wave heights, and 1D Rayleigh-wave dispersion modeling (CPS) to link bimodal DF microseisms to Airy-phase focusing.
结合PSD概率密度、三分量极化分析、ERA5波高相关性分析与一维瑞利波频散模拟。

Six broadband OBSs deployed at the eastern Gakkel Ridge from August to September 2024 (JASMInE-2), two Arctic onshore stations, 583 global OBS deployments, ERA5 wave reanalysis, AMSR2 sea ice, and GlobSed sediment thickness.
东Gakkel洋脊6台OBS、2个陆地台站、全球583个OBS、ERA5海浪、海冰及沉积厚度数据。
Five of six Arctic OBSs show bimodal DF microseisms at ~1 s and ~3 s originating from the St. Anna Trough; 1D modeling and 583 global OBSs show ~0–500 m sediments cause 1 s Airy-phase focusing.
5台北极OBS呈源于圣安娜海槽的1秒和3秒双峰微震；全球薄沉积区（<500米）产生1秒艾里相聚焦。
Local 1D dispersion models simplify the actual 3D geological structure, and observations are restricted to late summer/autumn when the Barents–Kara marginal ice zone is closest.
一维局部模型简化了真实三维地质结构，且观测仅涵盖夏秋季节。

Proposes and globally validates a single-source, sediment-modulated Airy-phase focusing mechanism (<500 m sediment) for bimodal DF microseisms, complementing the classic dual-source (near-field vs. far-field) paradigm.
提出并全球验证了薄沉积层艾里相聚焦形成单一源区双峰微震的新机制。

kc: Identified a distinct bimodal DF microseism pattern (peaks at ~1 s and ~3 s) beneath Arctic sea ice originating from a single marginal-sea source region (St. Anna Trough).

Demonstrated via 1D Rayleigh-wave dispersion modeling that thin receiver-side sediments (<500 m) create an Airy-phase group-velocity minimum near 1 s for fundamental (R0) or first-overtone (R1) modes.
Validated the universality of sediment-modulated bimodal DF microseisms across 583 global OBS deployments, linking spectral morphology to GlobSed sediment thickness.
在北极海冰下识别出源自单一边缘海源区（圣安娜海槽）的1秒和3秒双峰双频微震特征。
通过一维瑞利波频散模拟证实，接收端薄沉积层（<500米）使基阶或一阶高阶模在1秒附近产生艾里相群速度极小值。
利用全球583个OBS台站数据验证了沉积层调制双峰微震的普适性，将频谱形态与沉积层厚度联系起来。
me: Power spectral density (PSD) probability density function (PDF) estimation on continuous OBS records.
Three-component frequency-dependent polarization analysis after Rayleigh-wave horizontal orientation correction.
Pearson correlation between DF microseism PSD time series and ERA5 significant wave height grids.
1D Rayleigh-wave phase- and group-velocity dispersion modeling using Computer Programs in Seismology (CPS).
基于连续OBS记录的功率谱密度（PSD）概率密度函数（PDF）估计。
瑞利波水平方位校正后的三分量频率依赖极化分析。
双频微震PSD时间序列与ERA5有效波高网格数据的皮尔逊相关性分析。
利用CPS程序进行一维瑞利波相速度与群速度频散正演模拟。
de: Continuous seismic records from 6 broadband OBSs deployed at the eastern Gakkel Ridge (JASMInE-2 expedition, Aug–Sep 2024) and 2 onshore stations (KBS, TIXI).
Vertical-component seismic records from 583 global open-ocean broadband OBS deployments from IRIS, GEOFON, and RESIF.
ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis ocean wave and wind parameters, AMSR2 sea-ice concentration, and GlobSed global sediment thickness model.
2024年8-9月中国第14次北极科考（JASMInE-2）在东Gakkel洋脊布设的6台宽频带OBS及2个陆地台站（KBS、TIXI）连续记录。
来自IRIS、GEOFON和RESIF数据中心的全球583个开阔大洋宽频带OBS垂直分量记录。
ECMWF ERA5再分析海浪与风场参数、AMSR2海冰密集度数据以及GlobSed全球沉积物厚度模型。
li: 1D layered dispersion models simplify actual 3D geological and bathymetric variations across the Gakkel Ridge.
The Arctic OBS deployment duration was relatively short (August to September 2024), capturing only late-summer/autumn sea-ice conditions.
Rayleigh-wave polarization analysis has an inherent 180-degree azimuthal ambiguity requiring auxiliary sea-ice and wave data to resolve.
一维层状频散模型简化了Gakkel洋脊实际的三维地质与水深变化。
北极OBS观测期较短（2024年8月至9月），仅反映了夏末秋初的海冰状态。
瑞利波极化分析存在固有的180度方位角模糊性，需借助海冰和海浪数据加以消除。

tm.why: The study investigates the generation, spectral distribution, and propagation modulation of double-frequency microseisms, the most energetic component of the seismic ambient noise field.
The primary dataset consists of under-ice Ocean-Bottom Seismometer (OBS) recordings from the Gakkel Ridge as well as a global synthesis of 583 OBS deployments.
The research explores how seasonal Arctic sea ice controls microseism source regions and couples ocean-wave activity to the seafloor.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), and all 10 main figures.

sum: During the 2024 Mw 4.8 Tewksbury, New Jersey earthquake, strong-motion stations N4.N62A (Caumsett) and LD.PAL (Lamont-Doherty) in southeastern New York recorded anomalously large positive 1-Hz pseudospectral-acceleration residuals. This study conducts detailed geophysical site characterization combining active-source (MASW) and passive ambient-noise array (MAM) surface-wave testing with HVSR and directional spectral-ratio measurements. At Caumsett, joint inversion of Rayleigh-wave dispersion and HVSR peak frequency (0.93 Hz) resolves ~177 m of coastal-plain sediments over crystalline bedrock; 1D theoretical transfer functions match earthquake site-to-site (S2S) residuals, confirming deep sediment resonance. Conversely, Lamont-Doherty exhibits hard-rock conditions (VS30 = 1,630 m/s) where 1D models fail to explain low-frequency amplification. Two ambient-noise arrays across the Palisades ridge reveal repeatable, ridge-perpendicular amplification near 2 Hz at LD.PAL matching S2S residuals (0.6–2 Hz), demonstrating topographic amplification and underscoring the need for site-specific, non-ergodic ground-motion models.
针对2024年新泽西州Mw 4.8地震中纽约东南部N4.N62A和LD.PAL强震台记录到的巨大1Hz正残差，本研究结合主动源（MASW）、被动源微动台阵（MAM）面波测试、HVSR及方向谱比法开展了精细场地表征。反演表明Caumsett台下方存在约177米厚的沉积层覆盖于结晶基岩之上，基阶共振频率……

t: Combined active-source MASW and passive MAM surface-wave dispersion with HVSR measurements for neighborhood-algorithm VS inversion, plus azimuthal standard spectral ratios (SSR) of ambient noise compared against 1D Thomson-Haskell transfer functions, ergodic GMM site terms, and earthquake S2S residuals.
结合主动源MASW、被动源MAM面波频散与HVSR联合反演剪切波速，并对比背景噪声方向性标准谱比、一维理论传递函数、遍历…

2024 Mw 4.8 Tewksbury earthquake strong-motion residuals, S2S residuals from up to 41 events, MASW sledgehammer lines, MAM broadband arrays up to 2,150 m diameter at Caumsett, and two 10-station overnight ambient-noise arrays across the Palisades ridge at Lamont-Doherty.
2024年Mw 4.8地震残差、41次地震S2S残差、Caumsett最大2150米孔径台阵及Lamont两期跨山脊10…

Caumsett has VS30 = 349 m/s, ~177 m sediment thickness, and f0 = 0.93 Hz matching 1D transfer functions and S2S peaks (1.0 and 2.5 Hz). Lamont-Doherty has VS30 = 1,630 m/s and repeatable ridge-perpendicular amplification of ~1.6 near 2 Hz.
Caumsett台VS30为349 m/s，沉积厚约177米，基频0.93 Hz；LD.PAL台VS30为1630 m/…
Smooth ergodic models fail to capture sharp modal resonances or 3D ridge topography, while local river noise and buried utilities contaminated several ambient-noise array stations at Lamont-Doherty.
平滑遍历模型无法捕捉尖锐模态共振和地形效应，且哈德逊河噪声与地下管线干扰了部分台站。

First side-by-side field verification showing that two nearby CEUS strong-motion stations with equally large 1-Hz Tewksbury earthquake residuals are governed by opposite mechanisms: deep coastal-plain sediment resonance versus hard-rock ridge topographic amplification.
首次通过野外观测证实美东两邻近台站相似的1Hz强震正残差分别由深层沉积共振和硬岩山脊地形放大主导。

kc: Demonstrated that comparable 1-Hz positive ground-motion residuals at two stations 38 km apart arise from entirely different physical mechanisms (1D deep sediment resonance vs. 3D topographic amplification).

Resolved deep shear-wave velocity profiles down to 2,500 m at Caumsett using multi-scale MASW and MAM arrays (up to 2,150 m aperture), confirming a ~177 m sediment column with a 0.93 Hz fundamental resonance.

Quantified repeatable directional topographic amplification (factor ~1.6 near 2 Hz at LD.PAL, >1.4 at crest stations) perpendicular to the Hudson River Palisades ridge using two seasonal ambient-noise array deployments.
证明了相距38公里的两个台站相似的1Hz强震正残差源于完全不同的物理机制（一维深层沉积共振与三维地形放大）。
利用多尺度MASW和最大孔径2150米的MAM台阵反演了Caumsett台深达2500米的剪切波速结构，证实了约177米厚沉积层及0.93 Hz基阶共振。
通过两次跨季节背景噪声台阵布设，量化了Palisades山脊垂直走向的可重复方向性地形放大效应（LD.PAL台2 Hz处放大约1.6倍，山脊顶部超1.4倍）。
me: Active-source Multichannel Analysis of Surface Waves (MASW) using cylindrical-wave frequency-domain beamforming and passive Microtremor Array Measurements (MAM) using 3-component beamforming.
Single-station Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) with Voronoi tessellation spatial weighting, jointly inverted with Rayleigh dispersion via a neighborhood algorithm.

Directional Standard Spectral Ratio (SSR) analysis of ambient noise rotated across azimuths, compared against 1D Thomson-Haskell transfer functions, ergodic CEUS models, and earthquake Site-to-Site (S2S) residuals.
采用柱面波频域波束形成处理主动源多道面波（MASW），结合三分量波束形成处理被动源微动台阵（MAM）提取频散曲线。
计算单台水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）并进行Voronoi泰森多边形空间加权，利用邻域算法开展瑞利波频散与椭率峰值的联合反演。
开展多方位角旋转的背景噪声方向性标准谱比（SSR）分析，并与一维Thomson-Haskell理论传递函数、CEUS遍历模型及地震台站间（S2S）残差进行对比。
de: Ground-motion recordings and 1-Hz PSA residuals from the 2024 Mw 4.8 Tewksbury, New Jersey earthquake and S2S residuals from up to 41 earthquakes.
Caumsett field campaign: 46-m MASW linear geophone arrays (Rayleigh and Love waves) and four sequential broadband MAM arrays (C50, C300, T500, C2150) plus borehole log S136718.
Lamont-Doherty field campaign: MASW, C50 and C300 MAM arrays, and two 10-station broadband topographic-amplification ambient-noise deployments (LamTA01 in July 2025, LamTA02 in November 2025).
2024年新泽西州Tewksbury Mw 4.8地震的强震记录与1Hz伪谱加速度残差，以及多达41次地震的台站间（S2S）残差数据。
Caumsett野外观测：46米MASW线性检波器排列（瑞利波与勒夫波）、四个宽频带MAM台阵（C50、C300、T500、C2150）及S136718钻孔测井记录。
Lamont-Doherty野外观测：MASW、C50与C300微动台阵，以及两期各10台宽频带地震仪的地形放大背景噪声观测（2025年7月LamTA01和11月LamTA02）。
li: At Lamont-Doherty, buried utilities and research infrastructure corrupted the C50 array dispersion and low-frequency HVSR data, and Hudson River noise contaminated toe-of-slope station St-07.
Smooth ergodic linear site-amplification models parameterized by VS30 or sediment thickness fail to capture sharp site-specific modal resonances and 3D topographic effects.
Lamont-Doherty场地的地下管线和科研设施干扰了C50台阵频散与低频HVSR数据，且哈德逊河局部噪声污染了坡脚台站St-07。
基于VS30或沉积层厚度的平滑遍历线性场地放大模型无法捕捉尖锐的特定场地模态共振峰及三维地形效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates physical site-effect mechanisms causing large positive 1-Hz ground-motion residuals at two strong-motion stations to inform non-ergodic ground-motion models.
The study extensively relies on passive microtremor array measurements (MAM), HVSR, and ambient-noise standard spectral ratios to characterize deep velocity profiles and topographic amplification.

ev.notes: Full 43-page PDF (33-page main article + 10-page supplementary material) read and analyzed in detail, including all 11 main figures and supplementary figures/tables.

sum: Understanding convective flow and rising plumes in planetary mantles requires quantitative 4D velocity measurements in high-Prandtl-number fluids, which were previously lacking for multi-plume systems. This study presents an end-to-end experimental and computational workflow to measure and analyze 4D flow in viscous Rayleigh-Bénard convection (Pr > 3000, Ra = 1.9e6) using corn syrup in a basally heated tank. A customized 3D Scanning Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (SSPIV) system captures the 4D velocity field, mitigating optical distortions via custom filtering. The velocity data are post-processed using backward-time Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponents (FTLE) to identify Lagrangian Coherent Structures (LCS) as objective material boundaries of plumes. HDBSCAN clustering, K-D trees, and minimum-spanning trees isolate plume clusters, locate centers, and quantify spacing, while ray-tracing of optical distortion constrains stem width (6±1 mm). The results reveal rich dynamics like merging, branching, and detachment, providing a powerful tool for studying mantle plumes.
研究行星地幔对流和上升地幔柱需要高普朗特数流体的定量四维速度测量。本文提出了一套完整的实验与计算流程，利用玉米糖浆在底部加热水箱中模拟粘性瑞利-贝纳德对流（Pr > 3000，Ra = 1.9e6）。通过定制的三维扫描立体粒子图像测速（SSPIV）系统获取四维速度场，并滤除光学畸变。随后利用后向有限……

t: The workflow combines 3D Scanning Stereoscopic PIV velocity measurements with backward-time Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent (FTLE) Lagrangian analysis, HDBSCAN clustering, K-D trees, and minimum-spanning trees to objectively isolate plumes and quantify their centers and spacing.
结合3D扫描立体PIV、后向FTLE拉格朗日分析、HDBSCAN聚类、K-D树和最小生成树，客观分离地幔柱并量化其中心与…

A plexiglass tank (405×275×405 mm) filled with temperature-dependent corn syrup (Pr > 3000, Ra = 1.9×10^6) was basally heated to 80 °C and scanned across 69 planes over 60 epochs (~130 s each), yielding 16,560 particle images.
在装有玉米糖浆（Pr>3000，Ra=1.9e6）的水箱底部加热至80°C，扫描69个平面共60个周期，获取16,560…

Detected plumes increased from 6 (Epoch 6) to 17 (Epoch 40), reducing mean spacing from 147.34 mm to 76.52 mm. Plume stem width remained roughly constant at 6±1 mm (~65 km scaled to Earth), with rich merging and branching dynamics.
地幔柱数量从6个增至17个，平均间距从147.34毫米减至76.52毫米；柱茎宽度保持在6±1毫米，展现出合并与分叉等动…

Temporal interpolation across the ~130 s scanning interval is the dominant error source, causing artificial widening of FTLE ridges along the plume stem, alongside incomplete spatial coverage near tank boundaries.
约130秒扫描周期的时间插值是主要误差源，导致FTLE脊沿柱茎变宽，且靠近水箱壁和底部的空间覆盖不完整。

First laboratory 4D velocity measurement of multiple interacting laminar plumes in high-Prandtl-number (Pr >= 1000) convection, paired with the first scalable HDBSCAN clustering and minimum-spanning tree analysis of 3D FTLE plume structures.
首次在实验室实现高普朗特数多相互作用层流地幔柱的四维速度测量，并首次结合HDBSCAN与最小生成树分析三维FTLE结构。

kc: First quantitative 4D velocity measurements of multiple interacting laminar plumes in high-Prandtl-number (Pr > 3000) viscous convection using an upgraded SSPIV system.
Development of an objective, transport-based plume identification pipeline combining backward-time FTLE (Lagrangian Coherent Structures), HDBSCAN clustering, K-D trees, and minimum-spanning trees.
Novel exploitation of tracer-depleted dark regions and optical distortion shadows (validated via GPU ray-tracing) to tightly bound plume stem width (6±1 mm, scaling to ~65 km in Earth) and head size.
利用升级的SSPIV系统，首次在高普朗特数（Pr > 3000）粘性对流中实现了多个相互作用层流地幔柱的定量四维速度测量。
开发了结合后向FTLE（拉格朗日相干结构）、HDBSCAN聚类、K-D树和最小生成树的客观物质输运地幔柱识别与统计流程。
创新性地利用示踪剂缺失暗区和光学畸变阴影（经GPU光线追踪验证），严格约束了地幔柱茎宽度（6±1毫米，对应地球尺度约65公里）和冠部尺寸。
me: 3D Scanning Stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (SSPIV) with photogrammetric calibration, optical flow, and non-local means filtering for optical distortion removal.
Lagrangian Coherent Structure (LCS) analysis via backward-time Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent (FTLE) computation using fourth-order Runge-Kutta advection of >17 million tracers.
Spatial point-cloud analysis using HDBSCAN for isolating plume clusters, K-D trees for finding local upwelling velocity maxima (plume centers), and minimum-spanning trees for unbiased plume spacing.
GPU-accelerated 3D ray-tracing simulations (photon) to model refractive index gradients and constrain plume stem width from optical distortion bands.
三维扫描立体粒子图像测速（SSPIV），结合摄影测量校准、光流法以及用于消除光学畸变的非局部均值滤波。
通过四阶龙格-库塔法逆向平流超过1700万个示踪粒子，计算后向有限时间李雅普诺夫指数（FTLE）以进行拉格朗日相干结构（LCS）分析。
利用HDBSCAN空间点云聚类分离地幔柱簇，使用K-D树搜索局部上升速度极大值（柱中心），并构建最小生成树计算无偏地幔柱间距。
利用GPU加速的三维光线追踪模拟（photon）建立折射率梯度模型，从光学畸变带约束地幔柱茎宽度。
de: Laboratory Rayleigh-Bénard convection experiment in a 405 × 275 × 405 mm plexiglass tank filled with Gateway Du-Crose 3 corn syrup seeded with 30 ppm silver-coated polymer spheres.
Basal heating from 25 °C to 80 °C (Ra = 1.9 × 10^6, Pr > 3000, viscosity contrast γ = 65), scanning 69 planes at 5 mm intervals across 60 epochs (~130 s per epoch, 16,560 total images).
在405 × 275 × 405毫米有机玻璃水箱中进行的实验室瑞利-贝纳德对流实验，工作流体为掺有30 ppm镀银聚合物微球的Gateway Du-Crose 3玉米糖浆。
底部从25 °C加热至80 °C（Ra = 1.9 × 10^6，Pr > 3000，粘度比γ = 65），以5毫米间隔扫描69个平面，共采集60个周期（每周期约130秒，总计16,560张图像）。
li: Limited scanning temporal resolution (~130 s per epoch) requires temporal interpolation that widens FTLE ridges along the plume stem.
Incomplete spatial coverage near tank walls due to frame occlusion and exclusion of the bottom 5–7.5 mm thermal boundary layer to avoid severe optical distortion.
Simplified experimental boundary conditions compared to Earth's mantle: uniform fixed basal temperature, rigid upper lid, and absence of secular cooling or compositional heterogeneity.
有限的扫描时间分辨率（每周期约130秒）需要进行时间插值，导致沿地幔柱茎的FTLE脊变宽。
受水箱框架遮挡以及为避免严重光学畸变而排除底部5–7.5毫米热边界层的影响，靠近水箱壁的空间覆盖不完整。
与地球地幔相比实验边界条件较为简化：底部温度均匀固定、顶部为刚性盖层，且未包含长期冷却或成分不均一性。

tm.why: The paper presents an experimental fluid dynamics methodology to measure and analyze 4D plume-bearing viscous convection at high Prandtl numbers, directly modeling mantle convection and hotspot plume dynamics.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 43-page manuscript PDF, including main text, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D.

sum: This paper introduces a direction-aware masked autoencoder (DA-MAE) designed for self-supervised pretraining on 3D post-stack seismic data. Unlike conventional masked autoencoders, DA-MAE explicitly distinguishes lateral reflector structures from vertical waveform characteristics in its token representation, masking geometry, and reconstruction constraints. Evaluated on field surveys, the method demonstrates that reconstruction performance is highly sensitive to lateral token resolution. Crucially, when transferred to cross-area acoustic impedance inversion with sparse well-log data, the pretrained representations significantly improve impedance prediction in target areas. The study highlights that optimal pretraining configurations differ between reconstruction and downstream inversion tasks, offering practical insights for seismic self-supervised learning.
本文提出一种用于三维叠后地震数据自监督预训练的方向感知掩码自编码器（DA-MAE）。该方法在Token表示、掩码几何和重建约束中显式区分横向反射结构与纵向波形特征。在实际工区数据上的测试表明，重建性能对横向Token分辨率更为敏感。在跨区域声阻抗反演应用中，即使井资料稀少，预训练表征也能显著提升目标……

t: A direction-aware masked autoencoder (DA-MAE) that incorporates lateral reflector structure and vertical waveform characteristics into token representation, masking geometry, and reconstruction constraints.
一种方向感知掩码自编码器（DA-MAE），在Token表示、掩码几何和重建约束中融入横向反射结构与纵向波形特征。
Three field seismic surveys: one independent survey for masked reconstruction experiments, and two additional field areas with sparse well-log data for cross-area acoustic impedance inversion.
三个实际地震工区：一个独立工区用于掩码重建实验，另两个带稀疏测井的工区用于跨区域声阻抗反演。
Reconstruction is highly sensitive to lateral token resolution. Pretrained representations remain effective in target areas, significantly improving cross-area acoustic impedance prediction.
重建对横向Token分辨率高度敏感；预训练表征在目标区域保持有效，显著提升了跨区域声阻抗预测精度。
Preferred token scales and masking strategies vary between reconstruction and inversion, meaning reconstruction fidelity does not directly guarantee optimal transferability.
重建与反演任务偏好的Token尺度和掩码策略不同，重建保真度无法直接保证最优的迁移效果。
Explicitly distinguishes lateral reflector structures from vertical waveform characteristics in 3D post-stack data during self-supervised masked pretraining.
在自监督掩码预训练中，首次显式区分三维叠后地震数据中的横向反射结构与纵向波形特征。

kc: Proposed DA-MAE, a self-supervised pretraining framework tailored for 3D seismic data by incorporating directional characteristics (lateral reflectors vs. vertical waveforms).
Demonstrated successful transferability of pretrained representations to cross-area acoustic impedance inversion with sparse well-log data.
Revealed that reconstruction fidelity alone is not a reliable indicator of downstream transferability, as preferred token scales and masking strategies vary between tasks.
提出了DA-MAE，一种结合方向特征（横向反射面与纵向波形）的、专为三维地震数据定制的自监督预训练框架。
证明了预训练表征在稀疏测井数据约束下，向跨区域声阻抗反演任务迁移的成功可行性。
揭示了仅凭重建保真度不足以作为下游迁移能力的可靠指标，因为不同任务偏好的Token尺度和掩码策略存在差异。
me: Direction-aware masked autoencoder (DA-MAE) for 3D post-stack seismic data.
Direction-specific token representation and masking geometry.
Reconstruction constraints focusing on reflector continuity and waveform fidelity.
Transfer learning for downstream acoustic impedance inversion.
用于三维叠后地震数据的方向感知掩码自编码器（DA-MAE）。
方向特异性的Token表示和掩码几何结构。
侧重于反射面连续性和波形保真度的重建约束。
用于下游声阻抗反演的迁移学习。
de: Masked reconstruction experiments on an independent 3D field seismic survey.
Cross-area acoustic impedance inversion evaluated using two additional field datasets with sparse well-log control.
在独立的三维实际地震工区上进行掩码重建实验。
利用另外两个具有稀疏测井控制的实际工区数据集评估跨区域声阻抗反演效果。
li: The performance and optimal hyperparameters (token scales, masking strategies) are task-dependent and require empirical tuning.
Relies on post-stack seismic data; performance on pre-stack data or other seismic attributes remains to be tested.
模型性能和最优超参数（如Token尺度、掩码策略）具有任务依赖性，需要经验性调整。
依赖于叠后地震数据，在叠前数据或其他地震属性上的表现仍有待测试。

tm.why: The paper proposes a direction-aware masked autoencoder (DA-MAE) for self-supervised pretraining on 3D seismic data.
The pretrained model is applied to cross-area acoustic impedance inversion, which is a classic geophysical inverse problem.

ev.notes: No PDF available; analyzed based on the detailed abstract.

sum: How water is retained and transported beyond the 660-km discontinuity into the lower mantle remains a key geophysical question. This study investigates hydrogen-bond symmetrization in single-crystal (Al, H)-bearing CaCl2-type SiO2—a major constituent of subducted oceanic crust—up to 62 GPa and 800 K using diamond anvil cell experiments combined with synchrotron infrared spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, and X-ray diffraction. At 300 K, hydrogen-bond symmetrization occurs at ~28–33 GPa, increasing the bulk modulus by 8–16% and stiffening the crystal structure. Crucially, high-temperature Raman measurements up to 800 K reveal a strong negative Clapeyron slope (~ -24 to -27 K/GPa), lowering the onset pressure to ~11–12 GPa. Consequently, under realistic mantle temperatures, CaCl2-type SiO2 directly adopts a stiff, hydrogen-bond symmetrized state near the base of the transition zone, immobilizing hydrogen and acting as a primary deep-water carrier to the core-mantle boundary.
本研究利用金刚石对顶砧结合同步辐射红外光谱、拉曼光谱和单晶X射线衍射技术，在高达62 GPa和800 K条件下研究了俯冲洋壳主要矿物——含(Al, H)的CaCl2型SiO2中的氢键对称化过程。实验表明，300 K时氢键对称化发生在约28–33 GPa，使体弹模量增加8%–16%，显著硬化晶体结构；……

t: High-pressure diamond anvil cell experiments combining synchrotron infrared spectroscopy (to 47 GPa, 300 K), single-crystal XRD (to 62 GPa, 300 K), and externally heated Raman spectroscopy (to 62 GPa, 800 K).
结合同步辐射红外光谱、单晶X射线衍射及外加热拉曼光谱的高温高压金刚石对顶砧实验。

Two Kawai-type multi-anvil synthesized single-crystal compositions, Si0.929Al0.071O2H0.033 ((Al7.1, H3.3)-SiO2) and Si0.898Al0.102O2H0.064 ((Al10.2, H6.4)-SiO2), compressed in neon pressure-transmitting medium.
大腔体压机合成的(Al7.1, H3.3)-SiO2和(Al10.2, H6.4)-SiO2单晶，以氖气作为传压介质。
Hydrogen-bond symmetrization occurs at ~30 GPa (300 K), increasing bulk modulus K0 by 8% (255 to 276 GPa) and 16% (283 to 329 GPa), while heating to 800 K drops the transition pressure to ~11–12 GPa.
300 K下约30 GPa发生氢键对称化，体弹模量增加8%–16%；800 K下相变压力降至约11–12 GPa。
Persistence of hydrogen-bond symmetrization or superionic hydrogen in the deeper alpha-PbO2-type SiO2 phase near the core-mantle boundary remains unconfirmed by direct experiments.
核幔边界附近α-PbO2型SiO2中是否仍保持氢键对称化或超离子态尚待实验证实。
First experimental determination of the P-T phase diagram and lattice stiffening of hydrogen-bond symmetrization in (Al, H)-bearing CaCl2-type SiO2 up to 62 GPa and 800 K.
首次实验测定含(Al, H)的CaCl2型SiO2达62 GPa和800 K的氢键对称化相图及晶格硬化效应。

kc: Measured hydrogen-bond symmetrization in two compositions of single-crystal (Al, H)-bearing CaCl2-type SiO2 up to 62 GPa and 800 K using synchrotron IR, Raman, and XRD.
Demonstrated that hydrogen-bond symmetrization increases the bulk modulus by 8% to 16%, significantly stiffening the Si-O framework.
Discovered a strong negative Clapeyron slope (-23.8 to -26.7 K/GPa) that lowers the symmetrization onset pressure from ~30 GPa at 300 K to ~11-12 GPa at 800 K.
Proposed a comprehensive deep-mantle water cycle model linking slab dehydration, mid-mantle seismic scatterers, LLSVPs, and elevated water contents in ocean island basalts.
利用同步辐射红外、拉曼和X射线衍射技术，在高达62 GPa和800 K下测量了两种成分单晶含(Al, H)的CaCl2型SiO2的氢键对称化。
证明氢键对称化使体弹模量增加8%至16%，显著增强了Si-O骨架的刚度。
发现了显著的负克拉伯龙斜率（-23.8至-26.7 K/GPa），使对称化起始压力从300 K时的约30 GPa降至800 K时的约11–12 GPa。
提出了完整的深部地幔水循环模型，将板片脱水、中下地幔地震散射体、大型低剪切波速省(LLSVPs)及洋岛玄武岩高水含量联系起来。
me: Multi-anvil synthesis of hydrated Al-bearing CaCl2-type SiO2 single crystals at 24 GPa and 2173 K.
High-pressure single-crystal synchrotron Fourier-transform infrared (FT-IR) spectroscopy up to 47 GPa at 300 K.
Externally heated diamond anvil cell (DAC) micro-confocal laser Raman spectroscopy up to 62 GPa and 800 K.
High-pressure synchrotron single-crystal X-ray diffraction (XRD) up to 62 GPa at 300 K and Birch-Murnaghan equation of state fitting.
在24 GPa和2173 K条件下利用大腔体压机合成含水富铝CaCl2型SiO2单晶。
在300 K、高达47 GPa条件下开展高压单晶同步辐射傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）测量。
利用外加热金刚石对顶砧（DAC）开展高达62 GPa和800 K的显微共聚焦激光拉曼光谱实验。
在300 K、高达62 GPa条件下进行高压同步辐射单晶X射线衍射（XRD）测量及Birch-Murnaghan状态方程拟合。
de: Two synthesized single-crystal compositions: (Al7.1, H3.3)-SiO2 (run 1K3783) and (Al10.2, H6.4)-SiO2 (run 1K3774) characterized by electron microprobe and NMR.
Synchrotron IR OH-stretching wavenumber tracks from 8 to 47 GPa at BL01B (NSRL, Hefei).
High P-T Raman shift datasets for A1g, B2g, and A2g modes across four isotherms (300, 500, 650, and 800 K) up to 62 GPa.
Single-crystal XRD pressure-volume compression curves up to 62 GPa collected at PETRA III (P02.2) and SSRF (BL17UM) using neon pressure medium.
经电子探针和核磁共振表征的两种合成单晶样品：(Al7.1, H3.3)-SiO2（1K3783）和(Al10.2, H6.4)-SiO2（1K3774）。
在合肥光源BL01B线站获取的8至47 GPa同步辐射红外OH伸缩振动波数演化数据。
在300、500、650和800 K四条等温线上高达62 GPa的A1g、B2g和A2g模式高温高压拉曼频移数据集。
在PETRA III (P02.2)和上海光源(BL17UM)以氖气为传压介质采集的高达62 GPa的单晶XRD压力-体积压缩曲线。
li: High-pressure infrared spectroscopy and single-crystal XRD measurements were restricted to 300 K, relying solely on Raman spectroscopy for high-temperature (up to 800 K) constraints.
Experimental temperatures only reached 800 K, requiring extrapolation to actual mantle geotherms (>1500 K).
Whether hydrogen-bond symmetrization or superionic hydrogen persists after the deeper phase transition to alpha-PbO2-type SiO2 near the core-mantle boundary remains unconfirmed by experiments.
高压红外光谱和单晶XRD测量仅在300 K下进行，高温（达800 K）下的相变约束完全依赖拉曼光谱。
实验温度最高仅达800 K，推演至实际地幔温度（>1500 K）需要外推。
核幔边界附近相变为α-PbO2型SiO2后是否仍保持氢键对称化或超离子态氢，尚待未来实验证实。

tm.why: The paper investigates high-pressure mineral physics of hydrous aluminous silica to constrain deep-mantle water transport, subducted oceanic crust fate, and lower-mantle seismic scatterers.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, methods, results, geophysical implications, and all 4 figures.

sum: This study investigates whether deep seismic models trained via distinct architectures and objectives learn convergent, reusable internal representations of elastic waves. Comparing the compact convolutional-recurrent phase picker PNSN and the multi-task convolutional-Transformer model SeismicXM (alongside PhaseNet and EQTransformer), the authors test representational similarity and transfer across three tasks: laboratory acoustic emission (AE) picking, receiver function (RF) quality classification, and ambient-noise correlation function (NCF) dispersion decoding. Using learning-delta Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) and signed kernel alignment referenced to matched random networks, they show that PNSN and SeismicXM organize 512 unseen AE records concordantly. Native earthquake phase outputs from all four models directly detect and track displaced AE arrivals without weight tuning. Frozen features also support RF classification and nonlinear NCF dispersion decoding, though standardized random features and period-wise median baselines remain competitive. Novel waveform interventions reveal that convergence depends on calibration and onset position.
本研究探讨不同架构与目标的地震深度学习模型是否能学习到收敛且可复用的弹性波内部表征。作者对比了紧凑型相位拾取模型PNSN与多任务模型SeismicXM（及PhaseNet和EQTransformer），在实验室声发射（AE）、接收函数（RF）质量分类和背景噪声互相关（NCF）频散解码三项任务中进行了……

t: The authors compare internal representations of pretrained earthquake encoders (PNSN, SeismicXM, PhaseNet, EQTransformer) using learning-delta RSA and signed kernel alignment referenced to matched random topologies, alongside zero-shot arrival transfer and frozen-feature probing.
采用扣除随机网络几何的学习增量RSA与有符号核对齐比较预训练编码器表征，结合零样本迁移与冻结特征探针。

Experiments use three locked public datasets: 4,655 unique radial receiver functions, 11,771 laboratory acoustic emission records across 12 channels, and 20,549 one-component ambient-noise correlation functions with 2–50 s phase-velocity dispersion curves.
使用4,655条径向接收函数、12通道11,771条实验室声发射记录及20,549条背景噪声互相关与频散曲线。

PNSN and SeismicXM representations align on 512 AE records (RSA 0.414, kernel alignment 0.201). All four models transfer natively to AE picking (balanced accuracy 0.71–0.93). SeismicXM nonlinear ensembles beat random topology on NCF dispersion (0.0538 vs 0.0561 km/s MAE).
PNSN与SeismicXM在512条AE上表征一致(RSA 0.414)；四模型零样本检测AE准确率达0.71–0.9…

Standardized random features match pretrained encoders on RF classification, the period-wise median beats neural NCF dispersion predictions, and missing RF/AE metadata limit station-disjoint and physical-time inference.
标准化随机特征在RF分类中表现相当，周期中位数基线优于NCF神经预测，且缺少部分台站与采样率元数据。

First rigorous demonstration of random-referenced internal representational convergence across distinct seismic deep learning architectures and systematic boundary testing across scale (AE) and waveform operators (RF, NCF).
首次严格证明不同地震深度学习架构间扣除随机偏置后的内部表征收敛，并系统界定了跨尺度与跨算子迁移边界。

kc: Establishes representational convergence (via learning-delta RSA and signed kernel alignment) between a compact phase picker (PNSN) and a multi-task foundation model (SeismicXM) on unseen laboratory acoustic emissions.

Demonstrates zero-shot cross-scale arrival transfer of four released earthquake models (PNSN, SeismicXM, PhaseNet, EQTransformer) to detect and localize displaced laboratory AE onsets without fitting neural weights.

Evaluates frozen-feature transfer to deconvolved receiver-function quality control and nonlinear sequence decoding of ambient-noise correlation dispersion curves against rigorous random-topology and transparent statistical baselines.

Conducts waveform interventions (phase randomization, onset/late removal, polarity reversal) and synthetic two-arrival boundary tests showing that geometric agreement is conditional on calibration and signal family.
通过学习增量RSA和有符号核对齐，确立了紧凑拾取模型PNSN与多任务模型SeismicXM在未知实验室声发射波形上的表征收敛性。
证明了四个已发布的地震模型（PNSN、SeismicXM、PhaseNet、EQTransformer）无需调整神经网络权重即可零样本跨尺度检测和定位实验室声发射初至。
评估了冻结特征在反褶积接收函数质量控制和背景噪声频散曲线非线性解码中的迁移能力，并与随机拓扑及统计基线进行了严格对比。
通过相位随机化、初至/尾部移除、极性反转等波形干预及合成双到时包络测试，揭示了表征几何一致性受特征校准和信号家族限制。
me: Learning-delta Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) and signed kernel alignment subtracting mean random-network geometry
Zero-shot native-output phase probability transfer with validation-locked scalar thresholds and displaced-window arrival tracking
Frozen-encoder linear/logistic probing and factorial standardization controls for receiver function classification
Staged pooled, temporal-linear, temporal-MLP inference ensemble, and distance-conditioned residual decoding for NCF dispersion curves
Waveform perturbations (fixed-spectrum Fourier phase randomization, boundary-matched linear onset/late replacement, polarity reversal)
扣除随机网络平均几何结构的学习增量表征相似性分析（RSA）与有符号核对齐
结合验证集锁定标量阈值与位移窗口到时追踪的零样本原生相位概率跨尺度迁移
用于接收函数分类的冻结编码器线性/逻辑回归探针及特征标准化因子控制实验
用于背景噪声互相关（NCF）频散曲线的分阶段池化、时间线性、时间MLP集成及距离残差解码

For NCF dispersion prediction, the simple training-set period-wise median baseline achieves lower absolute velocity MAE (0.0506 km/s) than the pretrained SeismicXM nonlinear ensemble (0.0538 km/s).
Missing metadata (such as AE sampling rate/specimen identities and RF station/event identifiers) restrict AE localization to samples rather than seconds and prevent station-disjoint RF evaluation.

Internal geometric convergence is not universal across all four earthquake model pairs or synthetic two-arrival Ricker packets, and depends on single released checkpoints without source-training seed variation.

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates representational convergence and zero-shot/frozen-feature transfer across four deep learning earthquake models (PNSN, SeismicXM, PhaseNet, EQTransformer).
A primary evaluation task is the zero-shot transfer of earthquake phase-picking and detection models to detect and localize laboratory acoustic emissions.
Ambient-noise correlation functions (NCFs) and surface-wave dispersion curve decoding are used as a core mechanism test for continuous propagation quantities.

sum: This study investigates the water-carrying capacity of subducted potassium feldspar under deep mantle conditions. Using in situ high-pressure and high-temperature synchrotron X-ray diffraction and ex situ Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, the authors demonstrate that K-feldspar transforms into a hydrated hollandite-type structure near 400 km depth, incorporating up to ~1.97 wt.% water. This phase remains stable through the mantle transition zone before dehydrating between 720 and 780 km depth. The released water in the topmost lower mantle can suppress the formation of bridgmanite. This mechanism provides a novel mineral physics explanation for the observed depression of the 660-km discontinuity in and around penetrating slabs, addressing limitations of previous basalt- and akimotoite-based models.
本研究探讨了俯冲钾长石在深部地幔条件下的载水能力。利用原位高温高压同步辐射X射线衍射和离位红外光谱技术，研究发现钾长石在约400公里深度转化为含水霍兰石型结构，含水量高达1.97 wt.%。该相在穿过地幔过渡带时保持稳定，并在720至780公里深度发生脱水。释放的水分进入下地幔顶部，抑制了秋本石向桥……

t: In situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction and ex situ Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy under high pressure and temperature.
利用高温高压下的原位同步辐射X射线衍射和离位傅里叶变换红外光谱进行分析。
Experimental phase transition and water content data of potassium feldspar under simulated mantle transition zone conditions.
在模拟地幔过渡带条件下，获取钾长石的实验相变及含水量数据。
Hydrated hollandite-type structures carry up to ~1.97 wt.% water and dehydrate at 720-780 km, suppressing bridgmanite formation.
含水霍兰石相载水达1.97 wt.%，在720-780公里脱水并抑制桥石形成。
The study is based on laboratory mineral physics experiments which simplify real-earth slab compositions.
研究基于实验室矿物物理实验，简化了真实地球板块的化学成分。
Identifies subducted feldspar-derived hollandite as a key deep-mantle water carrier explaining 660-km discontinuity anomalies.
首次确定俯冲长石源霍兰石为深部地幔关键载水介质，解释了660公里界面异常。

kc: Demonstrated that subducted potassium feldspar transforms into a hydrated hollandite-type structure near 400 km depth.
Quantified the water-carrying capacity of this hydrated phase to be up to ~1.97 wt.%.
Identified a dehydration interval between 720 and 780 km depth, releasing water into the topmost lower mantle.
Proposed a new mechanism where released water suppresses bridgmanite formation, explaining the depression of the 660-km discontinuity.
证实了俯冲钾长石在约400公里深度转化为含水的霍兰石型结构。
定量测定该含水相的载水能力最高可达约1.97 wt.%。
确定了720至780公里深度之间的脱水区间，将水分释放到下地幔最顶部。
提出了一种新机制，即释放的水分抑制了桥石的形成，从而解释了660公里不连续面的下凹。
me: In situ high-pressure and high-temperature synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD).
Ex situ synchrotron Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract published in PNAS, detailing the experimental methods (synchrotron XRD, FTIR), quantitative results (~1.97 wt.% water, 720-780 km dehydration), and geodynamical implications (660-km discontinuity depression).

sum: This study applies machine learning and similarity-based detection techniques to enhance microseismic catalogs at the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory (Southern Italy). By integrating data from the permanent ISNet network, a temporary dense array of 200 stations, and two DAS systems, the authors successfully lower the catalog completeness magnitude to M 0. This multi-scale approach illuminates active seismogenic structures at decametric resolution. Furthermore, the study demonstrates the transferability of machine learning models to identify P- and S-wave arrivals directly on native DAS records, bridging the gap between conventional seismic networks and high-resolution fiber-optic monitoring.
本研究在意大利南部埃尔皮尼亚近断层观测站应用机器学习和相似性检测技术构建高精度微震目录。通过整合ISNet永久台网、包含200个台站的临时密集阵列以及两套DAS系统，成功将目录完备震级降至M 0，在十米级尺度上刻画了活动发震构造。此外，研究展示了将机器学习模型应用于原生DAS记录中P波和S波震相识别……

t: Combines machine learning phase pickers and similarity-based template matching to detect microseismicity across permanent networks, dense arrays, and DAS.

Seismic waveforms from the permanent ISNet network, a 200-station temporary dense array, and two DAS systems in Southern Italy.

sum: The authors present the Ryukyu Area Centroid Moment Tensor (RACMT) catalog for earthquakes (Mw > 4.0) using regional full-waveform inversion. By applying K-means clustering-based stress inversion, they map detailed deformation transitions across the Ryukyu subduction system. In the subducting Philippine Sea Plate, deformation transitions from eastern normal faulting to western strike-slip faulting. The overriding plate exhibits perpendicular extension from the Okinawa Trough opening and Ryukyu Arc stretching. Widespread lateral extension in the deep slab suggests enhanced trench retreat and slab rollback. The study highlights how toroidal mantle flow around the western slab edge drives back-arc opening and fore-arc stretching, providing crucial insights into subduction geodynamics.
本文构建了琉球区域矩张量（RACMT）目录（Mw > 4.0），利用区域全波形反演和基于K-means聚类的应力反演，系统分析了琉球俯冲带的变形特征。研究发现，俯冲菲律宾海板块的变形从东部的正断层向西部的走滑断层过渡；覆载板块表现出冲绳海槽张裂和琉球岛弧拉伸引起的垂直延伸。深部板块广泛的侧向延伸表明……

The catalog is restricted to events with Mw > 4.0, and mantle flow patterns are inferred indirectly from stress orientations.

Comparison of focal mechanisms and centroid depths with the Global CMT (GCMT) catalog.

sum: This study presents a rapid, first-hours source characterization and static Coulomb failure stress (ΔCFS) analysis of the 24 September 2026 Mw 5.3–5.4 Şanlıurfa earthquake in southeastern Türkiye. Utilizing regional waveform data within a 200 km radius, the author performs a double-couple grid search using vertical-component first motions, yielding an oblique focal mechanism. Due to a large azimuthal gap (207.7°), the solution remains highly underconstrained. Okada elastic half-space modeling is used to calculate ΔCFS fields for alternative nodal planes, identifying consensus-positive stress transfer sectors 5–10 km west and east of the epicenter. The study demonstrates that rapid static stress maps are highly sensitive to source geometry and location uncertainties, emphasizing the need for dense near-source monitoring and regional moment-tensor inversion rather than deterministic predictions.
本研究对2026年土耳其Mw 5.3–5.4级地震进行快速震源表征与静态库仑应力分析。利用区域波形初动极性网格搜索获得斜滑机制，但受限于207.7°方位角空区。基于Okada模型计算的库仑应力显示震中东西两侧5–10 km处应力增加。结果表明快速应力图高度依赖于震源几何与定位，强调了近源监测的必要性……

利用P波初动极性进行双力偶网格搜索，并结合Okada模型计算静态库仑应力转移。

sum: This study presents an integrated workflow combining simultaneous pre-stack seismic inversion, machine learning, and geostatistics to build a regional 3D lithofacies model for the Jeju Basin, offshore Korea. First, pre-stack inversion of seismic data yields rock properties. Next, neural networks are trained on well-log data to predict lithofacies. Finally, Sequential Indicator Simulation expands these 2D predictions into a 3D model. The workflow successfully captures key geological features like faults and sedimentary structures with improved spatial continuity compared to well-log-only methods. Validation against an independent borehole demonstrates the model's reliability and its potential applicability to frontier exploration areas with sparse well control and limited 3D seismic coverage.
本研究结合叠前地震反演、机器学习和地质统计学，构建了韩国济州盆地三维岩相模型。首先通过叠前反演获取岩石物理参数，再利用神经网络预测岩相，最后用序贯指示模拟扩展为三维模型。该模型准确刻画了断层和沉积构造，空间连续性优于传统测井模拟。独立井验证证实了其在少井、无三维地震覆盖的边际勘探区的应用潜力。

t: An integrated workflow combining simultaneous pre-stack seismic inversion for rock properties, neural network training for lithofacies prediction, and Sequential Indicator Simulation for 3D geostatistical modeling.
结合叠前地震反演获取岩石物性、神经网络预测岩相以及序贯指示模拟构建三维地质模型的集成工作流。
Seismic reflection data and well-log data from the Jeju Basin, offshore Korea, including an independent borehole used for blind validation.

The assessment of the workflow's applicability beyond 3D seismic coverage is limited by being based on only a single validation well.

sum: This study investigates the tectonic evolution of the North Altyn Ocean by analyzing magmatic records, including a newly reported 537 Ma juvenile I-type granodiorite. By reviewing zircon Hf isotopes, crustal thickness, geobarometry, and magma oxygen fugacity, the authors reconstruct a prolonged 100 Ma Wilson cycle. The cycle initiated with southward subduction before 537 Ma, transitioned to slab rollback and crustal thinning at 500-470 Ma, and concluded with final ocean closure at 450-440 Ma. This provides crucial constraints on the accretion of the Tarim block to northern Gondwana.
本研究通过分析北阿尔金造山带的岩浆岩记录（包括新发现的537 Ma初生I型花岗闪长岩），结合锆石Hf同位素、地壳厚度、温压计及氧逸度等指标，重建了北阿尔金洋长达1亿年的威尔逊循环。研究表明，该洋盆在537 Ma前开始向南俯冲，在500-470 Ma经历板块回撤与地壳减薄，最终在450-440 Ma闭……

Reporting the oldest Phanerozoic magmatic record (537 Ma) and mapping a continuous 100 Ma tectonic transition.

sum: This paper presents a particle-level analytical approach to dynamic fracture, moving beyond classical continuum mechanics where stresses vanish on free crack faces. By analyzing an exactly solvable model with varying dissipation and isotropic elastic moduli, the authors construct a catalog of 100,000 crack solutions to investigate stability. They demonstrate that tensile cracks can propagate faster than the shear wave speed. This supershear/supersonic propagation is stabilized by weak interfaces, high dissipation, and small system sizes. The findings reveal that the supersonic energy transport required at the crack tip can originate from dissipation as well as hyperelasticity, challenging classical velocity limits in dynamic fracture.
本文提出了一种粒子级的动力学断裂解析方法，超越了传统的连续介质力学框架。通过对具有不同耗散和各向同性弹性模量的精确可解模型进行分析，作者构建了包含10万个裂纹解的数据库以研究其稳定性。研究表明，张性裂纹的传播速度可以超越剪切波速。这种超剪切传播的稳定性在微弱界面、高耗散和小系统尺寸下会得到增强。结果……

动力学断裂的粒子级离散建模，用以获取不同耗散和弹性模量下的精确解析解。
A synthetic catalog of 100,000 exact dynamic crack solutions generated using the analytical model.

Tensile cracks can stably propagate faster than the shear wave speed, with stability enhanced by weak interfaces, high dissipation, and small system sizes.

sum: This study introduces 'Pick Aggregator,' a multimodel ensemble machine learning approach that runs parallel computations on SeisBench to combine eight ML pickers pretrained on land and ocean data. Applied to onshore (PR) and offshore (ZZ OBS) networks in Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands from 2015 to 2016, the method successfully aggregates picks and associates them using a Gaussian Mixture Model Associator. The resulting catalog contains 10,948 events (an 115.8% increase in relocated events compared to the USGS catalog). The high-resolution catalog reveals an intense seismic swarm at 20–40 km depth, suggesting an incipient slab tear and a differential rollback mechanism.

sum: This study investigates the 2021 Mw 5.3 Baicheng earthquake in Xinjiang, China, using multisource InSAR observations. By analyzing coseismic deformation fields from ascending and descending Sentinel-1 SAR datasets, the authors map the surface displacement and invert for the fault geometry and slip distribution. The results reveal that the earthquake activated a previously unmapped oblique-normal fault, which is structurally linked to the main strike-slip fault system. This finding highlights the complexity of deformation in the southern Tian Shan thrust belt, where strike-slip and normal faulting can coexist and interact. The study provides crucial insights into regional seismic hazards and fault interaction mechanisms in complex tectonic regimes.
本研究利用多源InSAR观测分析了2021年拜城Mw 5.3级地震。通过处理Sentinel-1升降轨数据获取同震形变场，并反演了断层几何与滑移分布。结果表明，此次地震激活了一条此前未被制图的斜向正断层，该断层与主走滑断层系统存在构造关联。这一发现揭示了南天山冲断带复杂的形变特征，为理解该区域地震危……

sum: This study investigates the Sayanggou metasedimentary fragment in the southern East Kunlun accretionary belt using detrital zircon U–Pb geochronology, Hf isotopes, Monte Carlo unmixing, and multidimensional scaling. The results reveal prominent Ediacaran and older Neoproterozoic age populations with negative εHf(t) values, indicating derivation from recycled ancient crust. Statistical comparison with global databases identifies a Gondwanan signature, linking the fragment to contemporary basins in the South Qiangtang Block and peri-Gondwanan margins. The fragment was likely accreted during early Paleozoic Proto-Tethyan subduction. This provides critical geological evidence that the Qaidam and South Qiangtang blocks occupied close paleogeographic positions within the peri-Gondwanan domain during the Ediacaran, advancing our understanding of Precambrian supercontinent reconstructions and terrane dispersal.
本研究利用碎屑锆石U-Pb年代学和Hf同位素，结合蒙特卡洛模拟研究东昆仑萨扬沟变质沉积岩屑。结果显示其具有埃迪卡拉纪年龄和负εHf(t)值，源自古老地壳重熔。对比证实其具有北冈瓦纳亲缘性，与南羌塘地块密切相关，于早古生代增生。该成果揭示了埃迪卡拉纪柴达木与南羌塘地块邻近的古地理位置，为超大陆重建提供……

Field samples and detrital zircon geochronological/isotopic data from the Sayanggou metasedimentary fragment in the southern East Kunlun accretionary belt.

sum: This paper presents EEWCAN, a collaborative attention network framework designed for earthquake early warning (EEW). Unlike conventional empirical methods or single-task machine learning models, EEWCAN integrates global and local attention mechanisms to simultaneously estimate epicentral distance (EEWCAN-Dis) and magnitude (EEWCAN-Mag) from single-station waveforms. Crucially, the estimated epicentral distance is fed into the magnitude estimation model to exploit their physical correlation. Tested on Japan's Kyoshin network (K-NET/KiK-net) data, the model achieves reliable predictions using just 3 seconds of P-wave data, outperforming baseline models and demonstrating its potential for rapid EEW.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of determining accurate focal depths for shallow offshore earthquakes in the Mariana subduction zone due to sparse station coverage. The authors utilize the depth-sensitive optimal period of short-period Rayleigh-wave amplitude spectra from local and regional seismic data to estimate the depths of moderate-sized events. The resolved depths show significant differences compared to IRIS (up to 17.5 km) and Global CMT (up to 12.5 km) catalogs, which often use fixed shallow depths (10 or 12 km). The method is validated using depth phase modeling for the largest Mw 5.9 event, yielding a consistent depth of 27.9 ± 0.3 km compared to 24.4 ± 1.4 km from the amplitude spectra. This work highlights the necessity of reassessing earthquake depths in offshore subduction zones.
本文针对马里亚纳俯冲带因台站稀疏导致浅源地震震源深度难以精确测定的问题，利用对深度敏感的短周期雷利波振幅谱最佳周期，重新测定了该地区中强浅源地震的震源深度。结果表明，反演深度与IRIS和Global CMT目录存在显著偏差，纠正了目录中常用的10 km和12 km固定深度。通过对最大Mw 5.9地震……

sum: During the 24 June 2026 Mw 7.5 Venezuela earthquake, Caraballeda suffered massive building collapses, but no strong-motion stations existed within 10 km of the rupture. This study reconstructs the bidirectional near-fault ground-motion pulse using two fixed CCTV videos. By tracking the frame-by-frame frictional sliding of a traffic delineator post (calibrated via 15 in situ friction tests, μ = 0.42 ± 0.03) and solving an inverse problem with Ricker wavelet trains, the authors infer the critical ground acceleration and validate it against the oscillation of a nearby light pole. The maximum horizontal motion (RotD100) reached a PGV of 202 cm/s and an incremental velocity of 366 cm/s, coinciding with the simultaneous collapse of eight buildings visible in the footage. The reconstructed 1-s spectral displacement exceeds directivity- and directionality-adjusted NGA-West2 median predictions by 1.32 standard deviations and surpasses Venezuelan seismic design code levels by an average factor of 1.88.
2026年6月24日委内瑞拉Mw 7.5地震导致卡拉瓦列达大量建筑倒塌，但破裂带10公里内无强震记录。本研究利用两段监控视频重建了近断层双向地面运动脉冲。通过逐帧追踪交通标柱的摩擦滑移（结合15次原位摩擦测试，μ=0.42±0.03），利用雷克子波序列反演地面加速度，并用路灯杆的独立摇摆响应进行验证……

t: The authors invert for bidirectional ground acceleration parameterized as Ricker wavelets by minimizing the RMSE between simulated 2D Coulomb-friction sliding-block displacements and homography-corrected, two-camera fused CCTV trajectories of a delineator post, validating against light-pole cantilever oscillations.
通过将地面加速度参数化为雷克子波，最小化二维库仑摩擦滑块模拟位移与双摄融合追踪轨迹的均方根误差来反演双向地面运动，并用灯…

Two 1920x1080 fixed CCTV cameras in Caraballeda (<100 m from the USGS fault projection) recorded a sliding traffic delineator post and oscillating 10.98-m light pole, supplemented by post-earthquake geometric surveys and 15 in situ pavement friction tests.

The reconstructed pulse reaches a maximum horizontal (RotD100) PGV of 202 cm/s and incremental velocity of 366 cm/s (NS PGV 197 cm/s, PGA 0.89g), exceeding directivity-adjusted NGA-West2 1-s spectral displacement by 1.32 standard deviations and Venezuelan code by 1.88x.

Because the inversion only targets the long-period critical pulse and omits high-frequency motion, the inferred PGA is a lower bound, and wavelet curve-fitting does not constrain rupture velocity.

Unlike prior CCTV studies that retrieved only scalar macroseismic intensities or fault slip, this work reconstructs full bidirectional near-fault ground-motion time histories and response spectra from incidental video.

sum: This paper proposes a new geodynamic mechanism for subduction initiation along circum-supercontinent passive margins prior to supercontinent breakup. Utilizing the stratified structure of the cratonic lithospheric mantle (buoyant upper layer, weak mid-lithospheric discontinuity, and dense lower layer), the authors demonstrate that external perturbations like plume underplating or melt infiltration can trigger the delamination of the dense lower cratonic lithosphere. This delamination causes the remaining buoyant continent to uplift, weakening the adjacent passive margin and decoupling the continental and oceanic lithosphere. The resulting density contrast initiates a new ocean-continent subduction zone. This mechanism provides a self-consistent explanation for the rapid formation of continental arcs before Rodinia and Pangea broke up, offering a key driver for the supercontinent cycle.
本文提出一种超大陆裂解前被动陆缘俯冲启动的新机制。基于克拉通岩石圈地幔的三层结构，研究表明地幔柱底侵或熔体入渗可触发高密度克拉通下地幔剥落。这导致剩余陆壳隆升，弱化邻近被动陆缘并使洋陆岩石圈解耦，最终因密度差诱发新的洋陆俯冲。该机制解释了超大陆裂解前陆缘弧的快速形成，是超大陆旋回的关键驱动力。

t: Geodynamic numerical modeling of mantle convection and lithospheric deformation incorporating a stratified cratonic lithospheric mantle.

sum: This work introduces a deep-learning-based neural-operator surrogate model to perform global terrain correction of continental heat flow. Traditional three-dimensional heat-conduction simulations for terrain correction are computationally prohibitive at global scales. By training a neural operator on 3D heat-conduction simulations, the authors achieve highly accelerated and accurate terrain corrections, significantly improving the efficiency of crustal thermal structure modeling.

sum: This study utilizes distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) data from two nearby fiber-optic cables in central Shikoku, Japan, to analyze nine small earthquakes. By applying waveform cross-correlation to measure differential travel times, the authors relocated the hypocenters with high precision, revealing a compact cluster aligned along a major geological boundary. Additionally, they used the empirical Green's function (EGF) method on P-wave DAS data to estimate corner frequencies and stress drops (ranging from 0.6 to 2 MPa). The dense spatial sampling of DAS provided smoother spectral ratios and better-constrained source parameters than conventional seismic stations, highlighting the potential of DAS for detailed microearthquake characterization.

sum: Off Iwate in the shallow Japan Trench, tectonic tremor and repeating/regular earthquakes overlap spatially and occur episodically. To explain this coexistence, this study performs 2D in-plane fully dynamic earthquake-cycle simulations using a spectral boundary integral equation method governed by aging-law rate-and-state friction. A 300 m 1D planar fault is modeled with five 30 m velocity-weakening (VW) patches separated by four 12 m velocity-strengthening (VS) patches, under uniform effective normal stress. While an isolated VW patch only generates aseismic slip because its length is below the rapid-slip threshold, the multi-patch heterogeneous fault produces aseismic slip, sub-seismic slip, and fast earthquakes nearly synchronously. The novelty lies in showing that transient slip propagating through intervening VS patches leaves them at slightly elevated shear stress (differences ≤0.01 in normalized shear stress), modifying loading conditions around adjacent VW patches and relaxing nucleation-size constraints to trigger fast earthquakes.
日本海沟浅部岩手县外海的构造颤动与重复/常规地震在空间上重叠且呈幕式共生。本研究采用基于速率-状态摩擦定律的完全动力学谱边界积分方程法，在300米长的一维平面断层上交替设置5个速度弱化（VW）斑块和4个速度强化（VS）斑块进行地震周期模拟。孤立VW斑块仅产生无震滑移，而多斑块非均质断层能近乎同步地产……

t: 2D in-plane fully dynamic spectral boundary integral equation earthquake-cycle simulations under aging-law rate-and-state friction on a 300 m 1D fault with five 30 m VW patches and four 12 m VS patches.
采用完全动力学谱边界积分方程法，在含5个VW和4个VS斑块的300米断层上进行地震周期模拟。
Observational catalogs of tectonic tremor and repeating earthquakes off Iwate (Aug 2016–Dec 2019), paired with synthetic event catalogs generated under slow tectonic loading (V_pl = 1 mm/yr).
2016–2019年岩手县外海构造颤动与重复地震目录，以及1 mm/yr加载率下的合成事件目录。

An isolated 30 m VW patch produces only aseismic slip, whereas a five-VW-patch fault generates aseismic, sub-seismic, and fast earthquake slip driven by subtle VS/VW shear-stress elevations (≤0.01 in normalized stress).
孤立VW斑块仅产生无震滑移，而五斑块断层通过微弱应力抬升（归一化应力≤0.01）产生快慢地震。

The 1D fault geometry, simple sinusoidal (a - b) heterogeneity with uniform normal stress, and velocity-threshold event classification limit direct quantitative comparison with natural 2D fault zones.

Demonstrates that transient slip in intervening VS patches elevates surrounding shear stress and relaxes nucleation-size constraints, allowing slow and fast earthquakes to emerge from identical effective normal stress.

Demonstrated that multi-patch interactions allow VW patches smaller than the theoretical rapid-slip nucleation size (h*_RA ≈ 38 m) to host dynamic earthquakes (~15 m nucleation zone).
Identified that transient slip in intervening VS patches elevates surrounding shear stress, and subtle stress differences (≤ 0.01 in friction) control peak slip velocity transitions.

Event classification based on peak slip velocity V_max into earthquakes (>10^-1 m/s), sub-seismic slip (10^-3 to 10^-1 m/s), and aseismic slip (10^-7 to 10^-3 m/s).

sum: This Zenodo repository presents source data and derived catalogs for long-term marine acoustic and seismic monitoring. The dataset is acquired using distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) on submarine fiber-optic cables. To process the massive volume of continuous DAS data, deep learning algorithms are applied for signal detection and classification, enabling the identification of marine seismic events and acoustic signals. This dataset serves as a valuable resource for marine seismology, environmental monitoring, and the development of machine learning workflows for fiber-optic sensing.

sum: Mid-mantle (660–2,000 km) seismic reflectors beneath subduction zones are traditionally attributed to thermo-chemical anomalies or phase transitions, yet deep (>1,000 km) double reflectors remain enigmatic. This study investigates whether the pressure-induced (100)[001] to (010)[100] slip transition in bridgmanite can produce detectable deformation-induced anisotropic discontinuities. Combining 3D geodynamic subduction modeling (ASPECT), polycrystal plasticity (VPSC), and global spectral-element wavefield simulations (AxiSEM3D) down to 4 s period, the authors analyze synthetic SS precursors (SdS) via fourth-root vespagrams. They demonstrate that horizontally flattened slabs generate two distinct signals: a shallower slab-base reflection and a deeper (~1,470 km) positive-polarity reflection from the bridgmanite fabric transition across all azimuths. Applying this framework to real seismic array recordings from CNSN and RESIF reveals positive-polarity S1000S arrivals beneath Alaska-Aleutians and Middle America, demonstrating that mantle flow and mineral deformation can create observable seismic interfaces without isotropic velocity or density contrasts.
俯冲带下中地幔（660–2000 km）地震反射通常归因于热化学异常或相变，但深部双反射现象仍难以解释。本研究结合三维地球动力学俯冲模拟（ASPECT）、多晶塑性织构计算（VPSC）与全球谱元法全波形模拟（AxiSEM3D），利用聚束阵列方法分析了布里奇曼石(100)[001]/(010)[100]……

t: The authors couple 3D ASPECT free-subduction models with VPSC polycrystal plasticity to compute pressure-dependent bridgmanite fabrics, then simulate 4-s global 3D wavefields in AxiSEM3D and analyze SS precursors using fourth-root vespagrams.
耦合ASPECT俯冲模拟与VPSC织构计算，利用AxiSEM3D模拟4秒全球波场并进行四次根慢度谱台阵分析。

Synthetic 4-11 s transverse waveforms across a 3,000-station array at 110° distance, supplemented by real teleseismic recordings of the 2019 El Salvador (CNSN) and 2022 Easter Island (RESIF) earthquakes.
3000个台站合成切向波形，以及CNSN和RESIF记录的萨尔瓦多和复活节岛远震数据。

The bridgmanite fabric transition (~0.5% velocity contrast, ξ~1.02) generates a clear S1470S arrival with positive polarity across all azimuths, while the slab interface produces a shallower S1290S reflection.
布里奇曼石织构转变（~0.5%波速差）在所有方位角产生正极性S1470S震相，板片底界产生较浅的S1290S反射。
High VPSC computational cost restricts Lagrangian tracer resolution, requiring an ad-hoc 25-km untextured bridgmanite layer to artificially enforce a sharp elastic transition.
VPSC计算量大限制网格分辨率，需人为设定25公里无织构层来锐化间断面。

First 3D full-waveform proof-of-concept showing that pressure-dependent bridgmanite slip transitions beneath slabs generate detectable positive-polarity SS precursors explaining deep mid-mantle double reflectors.
首次通过三维全波形模拟证实布里奇曼石滑移转变可产生正极性SS前驱波，解释深部双反射体。

kc: Coupled 3D thermo-mechanical free-subduction simulations (ASPECT), viscoplastic self-consistent (VPSC) bridgmanite fabric modeling, and 3D global full-waveform modeling (AxiSEM3D) down to 4 s period.

Demonstrated that the pressure-induced (100)[001] to (010)[100] slip transition in bridgmanite creates a detectable mid-mantle anisotropic discontinuity (~0.5% velocity contrast) producing clear SS precursors.

Showed that for horizontally flattened slabs, the deeper anisotropic discontinuity consistently yields positive-polarity SdS reflections across all azimuths, acting as an apparent seismically slow layer.

Provided real-data array evidence of double mid-mantle reflectors beneath Alaska-Aleutians (S800S, S1000S) and Middle America (S850S, S1000S) supporting the deformation-induced discontinuity mechanism.
耦合了三维热力学自由俯冲模拟（ASPECT）、粘塑性自洽（VPSC）布里奇曼石织构建模和短周期（4秒）三维全球全波形模拟（AxiSEM3D）。
证实布里奇曼石中压力诱导的(100)[001]向(010)[100]滑移转变可形成可探测的中地幔各向异性间断面（约0.5%波速差异），并产生清晰的SS前驱波。
表明对于水平展平的板片，深部各向异性间断面在所有方位角下均产生正极性SdS反射，表现为视低速层特征。
提供了阿拉斯加-阿留申（S800S、S1000S）和中美洲（S850S、S1000S）下方双中地幔反射体的实测台阵证据，支持变形诱导间断面机制。
me: 3D thermo-mechanical modeling of intra-oceanic free subduction using ASPECT and Geodynamic World Builder.
Lagrangian pathline tracing and Viscoplastic Self-Consistent (VPSC) polycrystal plasticity modeling for pressure-dependent bridgmanite crystallographic preferred orientation (CPO).

Elastic tensor decomposition (Browaeys & Chevrot) to isolate purely anisotropic 21-component elastic perturbations superimposed on isotropic PREM, plus Perple_X thermodynamic modeling for harzburgite slab properties.
Global 3D spectral-element wavefield modeling using AxiSEM3D down to 4 s minimum period with Fourier expansion order 400.
Array seismological processing including fourth-root vespagram stacking, bootstrap resampling, reflection coefficient analysis, and 3D ray-tracing back-projection.
使用ASPECT和Geodynamic World Builder进行洋内自由俯冲的三维热-力学数值模拟。
采用拉格朗日流线追踪与粘塑性自洽（VPSC）多晶塑性方法，模拟压力依赖的布里奇曼石晶格优选方位（CPO）演化。
利用弹性张量分解提取纯各向异性21分量微扰并叠加至PREM模型，结合Perple_X热力学软件计算方辉橄榄岩板片的各向同性弹性性质。
利用AxiSEM3D进行最短周期达4秒的全球三维谱元法波场模拟（傅里叶展开阶数设为400）。
采用地震台阵处理技术，包括四次根慢度谱（vespagram）叠加、自助法（bootstrap）重采样、反射系数计算及三维射线追踪反投影定位。
de: Preliminary simple-shear two-layer bridgmanite synthetic test (900-1,200 km and 1,200-1,500 km) recorded on a 146-receiver circular array at 115° epicentral distance.

Subduction-driven 3D synthetic wavefield experiments (purely anisotropic mantle, isotropic harzburgite slab-only, and combined slab + anisotropic mantle) recorded across a 3,000-receiver rectangular array at 110° distance along dip-parallel, along-strike, and intermediate azimuths.
Real teleseismic transverse-component SS precursor recordings from the 2019-05-30 El Salvador earthquake recorded by the China National Seismic Network (CNSN) sampling beneath Alaska-Aleutians.
Real teleseismic transverse-component SS precursor recordings from the 2022-07-12 Easter Island earthquake recorded by the French Seismological Network (RESIF) sampling beneath Middle America.

俯冲驱动的三维合成波场实验（纯各向异性地幔、纯各向同性方辉橄榄岩板片、以及板片+各向异性地幔组合模型），由震中距110°处的3000个台站矩形台阵在平行倾向、平行走向和中间方位角记录。
中国国家数字地震台网（CNSN）记录的2019年5月30日萨尔瓦多地震远震切向分量SS前驱波数据，采样阿拉斯加-阿留申下方中地幔。

li: High computational cost of VPSC limits spatial resolution of Lagrangian tracers, requiring an ad-hoc 25-km thick untextured bridgmanite zone to artificially sharpen the slip-transition interface.
Geodynamic subduction simulations neglect mantle phase transitions and mid-mantle viscosity jumps, which would affect slab dynamics and strain localization.
Mineral physics constraints on bridgmanite slip system activities and critically resolved shear stresses (CRSS) at high pressures and temperatures still carry experimental uncertainties.
VPSC计算成本高昂限制了拉格朗日示踪粒子的空间分辨率，需人为引入25公里厚的无织构布里奇曼石薄层来锐化滑移转变界面。
地球动力学俯冲模拟忽略了地幔相变和中地幔粘度跃变，这些因素会影响板片动力学行为和应变局部化。
高温高压下布里奇曼石滑移系活度及临界分切应力（CRSS）的矿物物理实验约束仍存在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates mid-mantle seismic discontinuities formed specifically by the pressure-induced (100)[001] to (010)[100] crystallographic slip transition in bridgmanite.
It couples 3D geodynamic free-subduction modeling with mantle fabric calculations to explain double underside reflections beneath subducting slabs in the mid-mantle (660-2,000 km).
Global 3D full-waveform simulations are performed at short periods (down to 4 s) using the AxiSEM3D spectral-element solver with full 21-component elastic tensors.

sum: This study investigates the Late Pleistocene shortening rate of the Tugulu anticline within the Northern Tian Shan fold-and-thrust belt. By analyzing deformed geomorphic surfaces and fault-related folding mechanisms, the authors determine the slip and shortening rates of the underlying thrust fault. These quantitative constraints are crucial for understanding the kinematic evolution of active structures in the Tian Shan region and provide essential inputs for regional seismic hazard assessment and earthquake potential evaluation.
本研究调查了北天山褶皱冲断带内吐谷鲁背斜的晚更新世缩短速率。通过分析变形的地貌面和断裂相关褶皱机制，作者确定了深部逆冲断层的滑移和缩短速率。这些定量约束对于理解天山地区活动构造的运动学演化至关重要，并为区域地震危险性评估和地震潜力评价提供了关键输入。

t: Geomorphic profiling of deformed terraces combined with fault-related fold modeling and geochronological dating.

High-resolution topographic data (DEMs), field geomorphic surveys, and geochronological samples from the Tugulu anticline.
吐谷鲁背斜的高分辨率地形数据（DEM）、野外地貌调查和年代学样品。

测年不确定性以及褶皱运动学模型中简化的结构假设。

提供了吐谷鲁背斜最新的晚更新世滑移速率，细化了区域地震危险性评估。

sum: Sea level fingerprints link rapid land-ice mass changes to spatial sea surface height (SSH) patterns via gravitational, deformational, and rotational effects, yet the spatial resolving power of this ill-conditioned inverse problem remains unclear. This study introduces a Physics-Informed Direct Iterative Fourier Neural Operator (PI-DIFNO) operating directly on disjoint, irregular ice and ocean point clouds via Vandermonde matrices, constrained by a frozen forward neural emulator through cycle-consistency loss. Across 30,000 synthetic Greenland Ice Sheet (GrIS) realizations, broad mass-loss patterns are recovered, but fine-scale structure (<300 km) is strongly prior-dependent. The authors derive an empirical error law separating wavelength and amplitude effects, establishing a fingerprint-only accuracy ceiling of R² ≈ 0.79 for a satellite-altimetry reference field. While the leading three principal components explain 99.76% of SSH variance, finer ice structure resides in weak higher-order modes that compete with basin-scale sterodynamic ocean variability in real 1993–2019 altimetry observations.
本研究开发了物理信息直接迭代傅里叶神经算子（PI-DIFNO），利用范德蒙德矩阵直接映射不重叠的非规则冰盖与海洋点云，并通过冻结的正演模拟器施加循环一致性物理约束。基于3万个合成格陵兰冰盖质量变化样本及1993–2019年卫星测高数据，系统量化了海平面指纹反演的尺度分辨率。研究推导了分离波长与振幅效……

t: Develops a Physics-Informed Direct Iterative Fourier Neural Operator (PI-DIFNO) using precomputed Vandermonde matrices to map directly between disjoint irregular point clouds, constrained via cycle-consistency loss through a frozen forward neural emulator.
开发了PI-DIFNO，利用范德蒙德矩阵直接映射不重叠的非规则点云，并通过冻结正演模拟器施加循环一致性物理损失。

Three synthetic Gaussian random field ensembles of Greenland ice-thickness change (single, multi, coastal; 10,000 samples each) solved via the pseudo-spectral Sea Level Equation (degree 512), plus 1993–2019 satellite altimetry SSH rates.
采用512阶伪谱海平面方程生成的三组各1万个格陵兰冰厚变化合成样本，以及1993–2019年卫星测高SSH数据。

Forward DIFNOs achieve 0.24%–0.35% error (0.3 ms inference). Inverse PI-DIFNOs have 30.1%–33.0% data error but <3.1% cycle error, obeying a scale-dependent error law with an accuracy ceiling of R² ≈ 0.79 for realistic Greenland ice loss.
正演误差仅0.24%–0.35%（耗时0.3毫秒）；反演遵循尺度依赖误差定律，真实格陵兰冰损失的纯指纹反演上限为R²≈0…

Deterministic PI-DIFNO returns a single prior-conditioned realization rather than a posterior distribution, and cannot directly invert noisy observed SSH rates without mapping residual sterodynamic variability into spurious ice features.
确定性模型仅输出单一先验条件解，且无法直接反演含海洋动力噪声的实测SSH数据。

First systematic, scale-resolved quantification of Greenland ice-loss structure recoverable from SSH fingerprints, introducing an irregular-grid cycle-consistent neural operator and a universal empirical error law.
首次系统量化了海平面指纹恢复格陵兰冰损失的尺度分辨率，提出了非规则点云循环一致神经算子与经验误差定律。

kc: Developed Direct Iterative Fourier Neural Operator (DIFNO) and physics-informed PI-DIFNO to map between disjoint irregular point clouds using precomputed Vandermonde matrices and cycle-consistency loss.
Formulated a universal empirical error law separating ice-change amplitude from correlation wavelength, establishing a fingerprint-only accuracy ceiling of R² ≈ 0.79 for realistic Greenland ice loss.
Demonstrated via PCA that while 3 modes capture 99.76% of SSH fingerprint variance, at least 20 higher-order modes are required to distinguish fine-scale ice loss geometries.

Projected 1993–2019 satellite altimetry SSH rates onto leading fingerprint PCs to recover the large-scale Greenland signal and revealed that residuals correlate with basin-scale bathymetry (Rs > 0.55).
开发了直接迭代傅里叶神经算子（DIFNO）及物理信息PI-DIFNO，利用预计算范德蒙德矩阵与循环一致性损失直接连接不重叠的非规则点云。
提出了分离冰变化振幅与相关波长的经验误差定律，确定了真实格陵兰冰损失在纯海平面指纹反演下的精度上限（R² ≈ 0.79）。
通过主成分分析（PCA）证明，虽然前3个模态占SSH指纹方差的99.76%，但区分精细尺度冰损失几何结构至少需要20个高阶模态。
将1993–2019年卫星测高SSH变化率投影至主导指纹主成分以恢复大尺度格陵兰信号，并发现残差与盆地尺度海底地形显著相关（Rs > 0.55）。
me: Direct Iterative Fourier Neural Operator (DIFNO) using Vandermonde matrices for direct Fourier transforms on disjoint irregular point clouds without grid interpolation.
Cycle-consistency physics-informed training (PI-DIFNO) embedding a pre-trained, frozen forward DIFNO emulator to penalize unphysical inverse predictions.
Multi-objective gradient surgery (PCGrad and CAGrad) and amplitude-weighted L1 loss to resolve conflicting gradients between data and physics losses.
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Random Forest classification to quantify where fine-scale ice mass information resides within smooth SSH fields.
直接迭代傅里叶神经算子（DIFNO），利用范德蒙德矩阵在不相交的非规则点云上直接进行傅里叶变换，无需网格插值。
循环一致性物理信息训练（PI-DIFNO），嵌入预训练且冻结的正演DIFNO模拟器以惩罚不符合物理规律的反演预测。
采用多目标梯度手术（PCGrad和CAGrad）及振幅加权L1损失，解决数据损失与物理损失之间的梯度冲突。
结合主成分分析（PCA）与随机森林分类，量化精细尺度冰质量信息在平滑海平面高度场中的分布。
de: Three synthetic Gaussian Random Field (GRF) ensembles (single, multi, coastal; 10,000 samples each) solved via pseudo-spectral Sea Level Equation up to spherical harmonic degree 512 using PREM.
Out-of-distribution reference Greenland ice-sheet mass balance field (1992–2020) derived from calibrated radar altimetry (Simonsen et al., 2021).
Reprocessed satellite altimetry SSH rates (1993–2019) around Greenland corrected for GIA, peripheral glaciers, and wind-stress curl (Coulson et al., 2022).
Architecture ablation against DeepONet and FCN baselines, plus near-shore observation mask restriction tests (50–250 km from coast).
基于PREM模型和512阶球谐伪谱海平面方程计算的三个合成高斯随机场（GRF）集合（单波长、多波长、近岸；各10,000个样本）。
由校准雷达测高得出的分布外参考格陵兰冰盖质量平衡场（1992–2020年，Simonsen et al., 2021）。
格陵兰周边经GIA、外围冰川和风应力旋度校正的重处理卫星测高SSH变化率数据（1993–2019年，Coulson et al., 2022）。
与DeepONet和全连接网络（FCN）基线的架构消融实验，以及近岸50–250公里观测掩膜限制测试。
li: The inverse PI-DIFNO is deterministic and strongly prior-dependent, producing only a single ice change field per fingerprint rather than a full posterior distribution.
The forward model assumes an instantaneous elastic 1-D Earth (PREM) with a fixed shoreline, neglecting 3-D viscoelastic mantle structure and lateral variations.
PI-DIFNO cannot be directly applied to raw observed SSH rates because unmodeled sterodynamic ocean variability gets mapped into spurious ice-change features.
逆向PI-DIFNO是确定性的且高度依赖先验分布，每个指纹仅输出单一冰变化场而非完整的后验概率分布。
正演模型假设固定海岸线和一维弹性地球（PREM），忽略了三维粘弹性地幔结构和横向不均匀性。
由于未建模的海洋动力变率会被映射为虚假的冰变化特征，PI-DIFNO无法直接用于原始观测SSH变化率的反演。

tm.why: The paper systematically quantifies the scale-dependent resolving power, non-uniqueness, and accuracy ceiling of an ill-conditioned geophysical inverse problem mapping sea surface height fingerprints to ice mass loss.

The authors develop a novel Physics-Informed Direct Iterative Fourier Neural Operator (PI-DIFNO) handling disjoint irregular point clouds with cycle-consistency loss for geophysical forward emulation and inversion.
The study focuses on cryosphere geophysics, specifically recovering Greenland Ice Sheet mass change from sea level fingerprints caused by elastic solid-Earth deformation, gravity, and rotation.

sum: Standard 1-D pseudo-spectral Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) solvers evaluate viscoelastic Earth responses by explicitly re-summing all past load increments at each time step, creating an O(N^2) computational bottleneck. This paper introduces SLEvolve v1.0, which exploits the exponential structure of normal-mode viscoelastic relaxation kernels to reformulate the viscous history sum as an exact recursive update of a finite set of modal states. This reduces asymptotic complexity to O(N) while reproducing full-history solutions to machine precision (<10^-11 m). Combined with hardware-aware optimizations—in-memory resident states, binary I/O, pruned and multithreaded on-the-fly spherical-harmonic transforms—and physics-inspired workflow accelerations (extrapolated inner starts, warm starts, and partially relaxed initial topography guesses), SLEvolve achieves up to a 4,000-fold speed-up across forward Antarctic projections and multi-cycle ice-age benchmarks. Released in Fortran and Python, the work also demonstrates a benchmark-harnessed AI-assisted software modernization workflow.
传统一维伪谱冰川均衡调整（GIA）求解器通过逐步累加所有历史载荷计算粘弹性响应，存在O(N^2)计算瓶颈。本文提出开源求解器SLEvolve v1.0，利用简正模粘弹性松弛核的指数形式，将粘性历史求和重构为有限模态状态的精确递归更新，将复杂度降至O(N)且保持机器精度（误差<10^-11 m）。结合……

t: Replaces the O(N^2) explicit load-history convolution in 1-D normal-mode sea-level solvers with an exact O(N) recursive state-space update of modal states, combined with pruned multithreaded spherical-harmonic transforms and warm/extrapolated iteration starts.
用模态状态的精确O(N)递归状态更新替代O(N^2)历史卷积，结合多线程球谐变换与外推/热启动加速。

Evaluated on three 512x1024 Gauss-Legendre grid benchmarks using PREM elastic structure: a 550-step Antarctic RCP8.5 projection, a 1200-step 240-kyr two-glacial-cycle run, and a 50-step 25-kyr ICE-NADI-1 deglaciation run.
在512x1024网格和PREM模型上测试三个算例：550步南极预测、1200步双冰期旋回和50步消冰期。
Reproduces legacy solutions to <10^-11 m while cutting Case 1 runtime from 6.8 h to 10.9 s (2,222x speed-up) and a 1200-step glacial-cycle pass from 27.8 h to 24.7 s (4,054x speed-up).
重现原解达10^-11 m精度，550步运行从6.8小时缩至10.9秒，1200步从27.8小时缩至24.7秒（快405…

Restricted to linear rheologies representable by finite exponential sums on 1-D radially symmetric Earth models; nonlinear stress-dependent creep and exact 3-D lateral viscosity coupling are excluded.
仅适用于一维地球模型的有限指数和线性流变，不支持非线性蠕变与精确三维横向粘度耦合。

First exact O(N) recursive normal-mode state-space formulation of the full gravitationally self-consistent 1-D sea-level equation, eliminating O(N^2) history summation without temporal truncation or coarsening.
首次建立一维自引力海平面方程的精确O(N)简正模状态递归形式，无需截断或粗化历史。

kc: Establishes an exact recursive state-space representation for all six viscous history terms of the normal-mode sea-level equation with variable time steps, reducing complexity from O(N^2) to O(N) and state storage from 17 GB to 53 MB.
Formulates a state-update placement rule that advances modal states once before the nonlinear inner Picard iteration, preserving exact algebraic equivalence (<10^-11 m) with full-history solvers.

Introduces three iterative workflow optimizations: linear time extrapolation for inner loop starts, inter-pass warm starts, and a segment-based partially relaxed initial-topography guess for ice-age runs.
Implements hardware-aware optimizations including continuous in-memory execution, binary I/O, transform pruning (from 5n+6 to 3n+2 transforms), and multithreaded on-the-fly Legendre transforms.
Releases open-source SLEvolve v1.0 in both Fortran and Python, developed via a benchmark-harnessed AI-assisted engineering workflow achieving up to 4,000-fold speed-ups.
建立了变时间步长简正模海平面方程全部六个粘性历史项的精确递归状态空间表示，将复杂度从O(N^2)降至O(N)，状态存储从17 GB降至53 MB。
提出了状态更新位置规则，在非线性内层Picard迭代前仅推进一次模态状态，保持与全历史求解器在机器精度（<10^-11 m）上的严格等价。
引入三项迭代工作流优化：内层迭代的线性时间外推初值、跨外层迭代的热启动，以及基于分段部分松弛响应的冰期初始地形估计。
实现了硬件感知优化，包括内存连续执行、二进制I/O、球谐变换裁剪（从5n+6减至3n+2）以及多线程即时Legendre变换。
发布了Fortran和Python双版本的开源SLEvolve v1.0，展示了基准测试约束下的AI辅助软件工程流程，实现最高4000倍加速。
me: Exact recursive state-space update of normal-mode viscoelastic relaxation states exploiting the exponential decay kernel.
State-update placement rule outside the nonlinear Picard inner loop for shoreline migration and marine ice grounding.
Segment-based partially relaxed Love-number evaluation for initial topography estimation in ice-age outer iterations.
Linear time extrapolation of sea-level increments and inter-pass warm-starting of spectral fields and masks.
Spherical-harmonic transform acceleration via FFTW, BLAS matrix multiplication with north-south symmetry, and OpenMP on-the-fly Legendre recurrence with transform pruning.
利用指数衰减核特性的简正模粘弹性松弛状态精确递归状态空间更新算法。
在海岸线迁移与海冰接地非线性Picard内层迭代外部执行的状态更新位置规则。
用于冰期外层迭代初始地形估计的分段部分松弛Love数评估方法。
海平面增量的线性时间外推初值以及跨迭代步的谱域场和掩膜热启动策略。
基于FFTW、利用南北对称性的BLAS矩阵乘法、OpenMP即时Legendre递推以及变换裁剪的球谐变换加速。
de: Case 1 (Forward projection): 550 annual steps from 1950 CE on a 512x1024 Gauss-Legendre grid driven by an extended RCP8.5 Antarctic Marine Ice Sheet Instability simulation.
Case 2 (Ice-age benchmark): 1200 steps of 0.2 kyr from 240 ka over two glacial cycles combining a Northern Hemisphere simulation with ICE-6G_C Antarctica.
Case 3 (Deglaciation outer-iteration benchmark): 50 steps of 0.5 kyr from 25 ka using the ICE-NADI-1 ice history with up to 8 outer passes for initial topography convergence.
算例1（未来预测）：基于扩展RCP8.5南极海洋冰盖不稳定性模拟，从1950 CE开始的550个年度步长（512x1024 Gauss-Legendre网格）。
算例2（冰期基准测试）：结合北半球模拟与南极ICE-6G_C模型，从240 ka开始跨越两个冰期旋回的1200个0.2 kyr时间步。
算例3（末次消冰期外层迭代测试）：使用ICE-NADI-1冰盖历史从25 ka开始的50个0.5 kyr时间步，包含最多8次初始地形外层迭代。
li: Restricted to linear viscoelastic rheologies whose relaxation kernel can be expressed or fitted as a finite sum of exponentials; nonlinear stress-dependent creep is outside this construction.
Assumes a 1-D radially symmetric Earth structure; laterally varying 3-D viscosity couples spherical-harmonic degrees and would make a degree-by-degree recurrence only approximate.
In coupled or adaptive time-stepping systems, rejected steps require saving and restoring modal states before committing.
仅适用于松弛核可表示为有限指数和的线性粘弹性流变学，不支持非线性应力依赖蠕变。
假设一维径向对称地球结构；三维横向变化粘度会耦合不同球谐阶数，使逐阶递归仅能作为近似。
在耦合或自适应时间步长系统中，若时间步被拒绝，必须在提交前保存并恢复模态状态。

tm.why: The paper models Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA), solving the gravitationally self-consistent sea-level equation for the viscoelastic response of the solid Earth's lithosphere and mantle to surface ice and ocean loads.

The work introduces algorithmic complexity reduction from O(N^2) to O(N), multithreaded on-the-fly spherical-harmonic transforms, and hardware-aware HPC optimizations yielding up to 4,000-fold speed-ups.
The solver directly targets cryosphere-solid Earth interactions, specifically Antarctic ice-sheet projections and glacial-cycle ice-age simulations.
