sum: In teleseismic P-wave source inversion, residual P-wave arrival-time picking errors shift entire waveforms, creating temporally correlated errors that destabilize inferred rupture models. This study proposes a waveform-shift covariance approach (ShiftCov) that constructs the picking-error data covariance matrix directly from finite time shifts of observed waveforms and a Gaussian time-shift probability distribution. Incorporated into potency density tensor inversion (PDTI) with ABIC hyperparameter estimation, the method is tested on 125 synthetic datasets differing only in picking errors, and applied to the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake. Compared to conventional inversion neglecting picking uncertainty (FixedPick) and a linear Taylor-expansion approximation (LinearCov), ShiftCov reduces normalized model RMSE by ~0.09 and slashes inter-dataset model variability (spread-RMS) to under 40%, despite similar waveform fits. On real Wenchuan data, ShiftCov prevents picking errors from being overfitted as spurious high-frequency rupture complexity, yielding smoother and more reliable slip models.
在远震P波震源反演中，P波到时拾取残差会导致整体波形时移，产生时间相关的波形误差并降低反演稳定性。本文提出一种波形时移协方差方法（ShiftCov），利用观测波形的有限时移和时移概率分布直接构建拾取误差数据协方差矩阵，并将其整合到基于ABIC的地震矩率密度张量反演（PDTI）中。基于125组仅拾取误……

t: Constructs a P-wave picking-error covariance matrix by evaluating second moments of finite time-shifted observed waveforms weighted by a Gaussian time-shift distribution, integrated into ABIC-based potency density tensor inversion.
基于观测波形有限时移二阶矩和高斯分布构建P波拾取误差协方差矩阵，并融入基于ABIC的PDTI反演。
Evaluated on 125 synthetic teleseismic P-wave datasets across 66 stations with realistic Wenchuan noise and 2.5% Green's function error, plus real 2008 Wenchuan earthquake broadband records.
采用66个台站含真实噪声与格林函数扰动的125组合成远震P波数据，以及2008年汶川地震实测波形。
ShiftCov reduced normalized model RMSE by ~0.09 (0.338 vs 0.427 for FixedPick) and reduced inter-dataset spread-RMS to 0.097 (<40% of FixedPick's 0.256 and LinearCov's 0.246).
ShiftCov将模型RMSE降至0.338（降幅约0.09），模型离散度降至0.097（不足传统方法的40%）。
Fixes the width of the time-shift distribution and applies a common scaling hyperparameter across stations, while neglecting cross-covariances between different error sources.
固定了时移分布宽度并使用全台站统一缩放超参数，且忽略了不同误差项间的交叉协方差。
First formulation of a finite waveform-shift covariance matrix constructed directly from observed waveforms to account for temporally correlated P-wave picking errors in source inversion.
首次直接由观测波形构建有限时移协方差矩阵，在震源反演中量化P波拾取时间相关误差。

kc: Formulated a finite waveform-shift covariance matrix (ShiftCov) directly from observed waveforms and an empirical onset-slope timing uncertainty relation.
Demonstrated via 125 synthetic datasets that ShiftCov reduces model RMSE by ~0.09 and cuts inter-dataset variability (spread-RMS) to less than 40% of conventional approaches.
Showed that finite-shift evaluation vastly outperforms first-order linear Taylor approximation (LinearCov) and single-pass cross-correlation time correction (CorrPick).
Revealed that standard L2 waveform residuals cannot distinguish model accuracy, and demonstrated on the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake that ShiftCov mitigates overfitting.
基于观测波形和初动斜率时移不确定性经验关系，构建了有限波形时移协方差矩阵（ShiftCov）。
通过125组合成数据证明，ShiftCov比传统方法降低模型RMSE约0.09，并将模型间离散度（spread-RMS）降至40%以下。
证明有限时移计算显著优于一阶线性泰勒近似（LinearCov）以及基于互相关的单次时间校正重反演（CorrPick）。
揭示传统L2波形残差无法有效评估模型精度，并在2008年汶川地震应用中证实ShiftCov能抑制过拟合。
me: Potency density tensor inversion (PDTI) with five basis double-couple components and time-adaptive smoothing.
Finite waveform-shift covariance (ShiftCov) and first-order linear derivative covariance (LinearCov) construction.
Empirical estimation of picking-error variance from pre-arrival background noise variance and P-wave onset slope.
Hyperparameter optimization via Akaike's Bayesian Information Criterion (ABIC) and Cholesky decomposition for general NNLS compatibility.
采用五个基本双力偶分量和时间自适应平滑约束的地震矩率密度张量反演（PDTI）。
构建有限波形时移协方差（ShiftCov）及一阶线性导数近似协方差（LinearCov）。
利用P波到时前的背景噪声方差和初动斜率经验估计拾取误差方差。
基于赤池贝叶斯信息准则（ABIC）优化超参数，并提出基于Cholesky分解的通用非负最小二乘（NNLS）融合方案。
de: 125 synthetic teleseismic P-wave datasets across 66 stations with realistic noise levels derived from the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake and 2.5% Green's function perturbations.
Comparative evaluation of four schemes: ShiftCov, LinearCov, FixedPick (no picking uncertainty), and CorrPick (cross-correlation alignment + reinversion).
Real-data application to 66 broadband vertical-component teleseismic P-wave records from the 2008 Mw 7.9 Wenchuan earthquake.
基于66个台站生成的125组合成远震P波数据集，融合了2008年汶川地震真实背景噪声水平及2.5%的格林函数扰动。
对比评估四种反演方案：ShiftCov、LinearCov、FixedPick（忽略拾取误差）和CorrPick（互相关时移校正后重反演）。
应用于2008年汶川Mw 7.9地震的66个宽频带垂直分量远震P波实测记录。
li: Applies a fixed time-shift distribution width with a common station scale factor to fit within the ABIC hyperparameter framework.
Neglects cross-covariances between background noise, Green's function errors, and P-wave picking errors, and relies on an empirical tuning parameter (epsilon = 1).
为适配ABIC超参数框架，固定了时移分布宽度并对所有台站背景噪声与拾取误差协方差使用统一缩放因子。
忽略了背景噪声、格林函数误差与P波拾取误差之间的交叉协方差，且依赖经验调节参数（ε = 1）。

tm.why: The paper develops a method to stabilize teleseismic P-wave source inversion (potency density tensor inversion) for earthquake rupture processes.
It formulates a new data error covariance matrix to account for temporally correlated waveform-shift errors in inverse problems.
The method uses Akaike's Bayesian Information Criterion (ABIC) to estimate hyperparameters balancing Green's function, background noise, and picking-error covariances.

ev.notes: Full 36-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF including mathematical derivations, synthetic benchmarks, Wenchuan application, 2 tables, and 8 figures.

sum: This study investigates a deep earthquake swarm (25-35 km depth) near the Moho beneath northern Yamaguchi, Japan, active since February 2025. Using hypocenter relocation and moment-tensor analysis, the authors map the spatiotemporal evolution and source mechanisms of the swarm. Relocated events reveal complex geometries, including inclined planar structures and horizontal features, with diffusion-like migration indicating fluid diffusivity of 0.12-4.57 m^2/s. Diverse moment-tensor solutions with significant non-double-couple components suggest that fluid-pressure perturbations propagated through a pre-existing heterogeneous fracture network. This work provides key evidence of transient deep fluid-related seismicity near the Moho in a region lacking recent surface volcanism, highlighting the role of deep fluids in intraplate seismogenesis.
本研究剖析了自2025年2月起在日本山口县北部莫霍面附近（25-35 km深）持续的深源地震群。通过震源重定位和矩张量分析，研究了其时空演化和震源机制。重定位结果显示出复杂的几何结构，且部分序列表现出扩散式迁移（表观扩散系数为0.12-4.57 m^2/s）。矩张量解的多样性及显著的非双力偶成分表明……

t: Hypocenter relocation and moment-tensor analysis to resolve the spatiotemporal evolution and source mechanisms of the deep earthquake swarm.
采用震源重定位和矩张量分析方法，解析深源地震群的时空演化与震源机制。
Seismic waveform data of the deep earthquake swarm near the Moho beneath northern Yamaguchi, Japan, active since February 2025.
2025年2月起在日本山口县北部莫霍面附近记录到的深源地震群地震数据。
Relocated hypocenters at 25-35 km depth show diffusion-like migration (diffusivity 0.12-4.57 m^2/s) and diverse moment-tensor solutions with non-double-couple components.
25-35 km深处的重定位震源显示出扩散式迁移（扩散率0.12-4.57 m^2/s）及含非双力偶成分的多样化矩张量解…
The study relies on indirect seismic observations without direct physical sampling of deep fluids near the Moho.
该研究依赖于间接的地震观测，缺乏对莫霍面附近深部流体的直接物理采样。
Demonstrates transient deep fluid-driven seismicity near the Moho in a region without recent surface volcanism, mapping a pre-existing fracture network.
揭示了无近期地表火山活动区域莫霍面附近的瞬态深部流体驱动地震活动，并描绘了预存裂隙网。

kc: Relocated the deep earthquake swarm near the Moho in northern Yamaguchi, Japan, revealing distinct temporal-spatial geometries.
Estimated apparent fluid diffusivities of 0.12-4.57 m^2/s from diffusion-like hypocenter migration.
Identified diverse moment-tensor solutions with significant non-double-couple components, indicating fluid-driven reactivation of heterogeneous fractures.
对日本山口县北部莫霍面附近的深源地震群进行了重定位，揭示了明显的时空几何结构。
根据震源的扩散式迁移特征，估算出表观流体扩散系数为0.12-4.57 m^2/s。
识别出具有显著非双力偶成分的多样化矩张量解，表明流体驱动了非均匀裂隙的活化。
me: Hypocenter relocation to resolve fine-scale spatial structures of the swarm.
Moment-tensor analysis to determine focal mechanisms and non-double-couple components.
Spatiotemporal migration analysis to estimate fluid diffusivity.
震源重定位以解析地震群的精细空间结构。
矩张量分析以确定震源机制及非双力偶成分。
时空迁移分析以估算流体扩散系数。
de: Seismic waveform data from the deep earthquake swarm beneath northern Yamaguchi, Japan, starting in February 2025.
自2025年2月开始的日本山口县北部深源地震群的地震波形数据。
li: Lack of direct in-situ fluid measurements to independently verify the fluid-pressure propagation model.
缺乏直接的原位流体测量数据来独立验证流体压力传播模型。

tm.why: The study uses hypocenter relocation to investigate the spatiotemporal evolution of a deep earthquake swarm.
The study performs moment-tensor analysis to investigate source processes and non-double-couple components.
The swarm is located near the Abu Monogenetic Volcano Group and is associated with deep fluid migration.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the abstract and metadata from Crossref since no PDF was available.

sum: Traditional tsunami hazard assessments in the Cascadia Subduction Zone (CSZ) rely on homogeneous or quasi-homogeneous ('t-shirt') earthquake slip distributions. This study evaluates how relaxing the homogeneous slip assumption alters tsunami inundation hazards at Ocean Shores (WA), Newport (OR), and Crescent City (CA). Using the FakeQuakes method constrained by four geodetic coupling models, the authors generate 200 stochastic heterogeneous rupture scenarios (Mw 9.0–9.2) and simulate tsunami inundation with GeoClaw. While the deterministic XL1 scenario produces extreme inundation depths (>90th percentile), heterogeneous ruptures drive horizontal inundation limits further inland due to near-trench source complexity and local coseismic coastal subsidence. At the 1-in-2475-year exceedance threshold, heterogeneous inundation limits roughly match evacuation lines in Ocean Shores and Newport, but significantly exceed both official evacuation boundaries and ASCE 7-22 tsunami design zones in Crescent City.
卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带传统海啸危险性评估依赖均匀或准均匀震源滑移模型。本研究利用四个大地测量耦合模型约束的FakeQuakes方法，生成200个随机非均匀破裂情景（Mw 9.0–9.2），并结合GeoClaw模拟了三个沿海地点的海啸淹没。结果表明，虽然确定性XL1模型产生的淹没深度处于第90百分位以上，但……

t: The authors generate 200 geodetically constrained stochastic ruptures using FakeQuake across four coupling models, then simulate tsunami propagation and coastal inundation for 2 hours using the 2D nonlinear shallow-water code GeoClaw.
利用FakeQuake基于四个耦合模型生成200个随机破裂，并用GeoClaw模拟2小时海啸淹没。

200 stochastic ruptures (100 L-like Mw 9.0–9.1 and 100 XL-like Mw 9.1–9.2) on Slab 2.0 geometry, combined with SRTM15+ bathymetry and 1/3 arcsec coastal DEMs at Ocean Shores, Newport, and Crescent City.
Slab 2.0上的200个L/XL类随机破裂，结合SRTM15+水深及三个沿海地点的1/3角秒DEM。

Homogeneous L1 and XL1 models rank at the 45th–75th and >90th percentiles for inundation depth, respectively, but heterogeneous ruptures extend horizontal inundation limits up to 600 m further inland and exceed Crescent City evacuation lines.
L1和XL1深度位于45-75和>90百分位，但非均匀震源使淹没范围向内陆多延伸达600米。
Assuming bare-earth DEMs and a uniform Manning coefficient of 0.025 neglects urban roughness, potentially overestimating inland flood limits by 20–60% relative to ASCE 7-22 guidelines.
采用裸地DEM和均匀曼宁系数（0.025），在城区相比ASCE 7-22可能高估淹没范围20–60%。

Directly compares geodetically constrained stochastic heterogeneous CSZ ruptures against deterministic DOGAMI 't-shirt' models, state evacuation zones, and ASCE 7-22 Tsunami Design Zones at the 1-in-2475-year exceedance level.
首次将大地测量约束的CSZ随机非均匀破裂与DOGAMI模型、疏散线及ASCE 7-22设计区进行系统对比。

kc: Simulated 200 stochastic heterogeneous Cascadia rupture scenarios across four geodetic locking models to evaluate local tsunami inundation.
Demonstrated that L1 and XL1 quasi-homogeneous 't-shirt' models correspond to the 45th–75th and >90th percentiles of mean inundation depth, respectively.
Showed that heterogeneous ruptures extend horizontal inundation limits up to 600 m further inland than homogeneous sources due to local coseismic subsidence and near-trench slip.
Identified that Crescent City's official tsunami evacuation lines and ASCE 7-22 tsunami design zones underestimate the 1-in-2475-year exceedance limit from heterogeneous sources.
基于四个大地测量闭锁模型模拟了200个随机非均匀卡斯卡迪亚破裂情景，以评估局部海啸淹没。
证明L1和XL1准均匀“T恤”模型的平均淹没深度分别对应非均匀集合的第45–75百分位和>90百分位。
揭示受局部同震沉降和近海沟滑移驱动，非均匀破裂使水平淹没边界比均匀震源向内陆多延伸达600米。
发现克雷森特城的官方海啸疏散线和ASCE 7-22设计区低估了非均匀震源在2475年一遇阈值下的淹没范围。
me: Stochastic kinematic rupture generation using FakeQuakes constrained by four geodetic interseismic coupling models (1 cm/yr, Gauss, Gamma, Li).
2D nonlinear shallow water hydrodynamic tsunami propagation and inundation modeling with adaptive mesh refinement using GeoClaw.
Spatial and statistical comparison using Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI), violin plots of mean inundation depth, and probabilistic exceedance hazard curves.
使用受四个大地测量震间耦合模型（1 cm/yr、Gauss、Gamma、Li）约束的FakeQuakes方法生成随机运动学破裂。
利用具有自适应网格细化功能的GeoClaw求解二维非线性浅水方程，进行海啸传播与淹没模拟。
采用杰卡德相似系数（JSI）、平均淹没深度小提琴图和概率超越危险性曲线进行空间与统计对比。
de: 200 synthetic rupture scenarios split into 100 L-like (9.0 <= Mw < 9.1) and 100 XL-like (9.1 <= Mw <= 9.2) events on the Slab 2.0 CSZ geometry.
SRTM15+ (15 arcsec) global bathymetry and CUDEM/NOAA coastal DEMs (1/3 arcsec) for Ocean Shores (WA), Newport (OR), and Crescent City (CA).
Comparisons against deterministic DOGAMI L1/XL1 't-shirt' models, state tsunami evacuation lines, and ASCE 7-22 Tsunami Design Zones.
基于Slab 2.0俯冲带几何模型生成的200个合成破裂情景，分为100个L类（9.0 <= Mw < 9.1）和100个XL类（9.1 <= Mw <= 9.2）事件。
SRTM15+（15角秒）全球水深数据以及华盛顿州Ocean Shores、俄勒冈州Newport和加州Crescent City的1/3角秒高精度海岸DEM。
与DOGAMI确定性L1/XL1“T恤”模型、各州官方海啸疏散线及ASCE 7-22海啸设计区进行对比。
li: Uses bare-earth DEMs and a spatially uniform Manning roughness coefficient (0.025), potentially overestimating urban inundation limits by 20–60% compared to ASCE 7-22.
Neglects secondary tsunamigenic sources such as submarine landslides, splay faulting, and inelastic wedge deformation.
Relies on simplified paleoseismic annual rates (1/3333 and 1/5000) rather than a full Gutenberg-Richter logic tree PTHA, and lacks offshore seafloor geodetic validation.
采用裸地DEM和空间均匀的曼宁粗糙度系数（0.025），相比ASCE 7-22在城市区域可能高估淹没范围20–60%。
忽略了海底滑坡、分支断层和浅部楔体塑性变形等次生致灾源。
依赖简化的古地震年发生率（1/3333和1/5000）而非完整的古登堡-里克特逻辑树PTHA，且缺乏海底大地测量数据验证。

tm.why: The paper generates 200 stochastic heterogeneous earthquake rupture slip models constrained by geodetic coupling to evaluate source complexity effects on tsunami generation.
The study performs probabilistic tsunami hazard assessments and compares 1-in-2475-year exceedance inundation limits against official state evacuation zones and ASCE 7-22 building codes.

ev.notes: Full 19-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 11 figures, 1 table, equations, and section text.

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric stretching style and crustal thinning of the Xisha Trough in the South China Sea using 2D multi-observable modeling (LitMod2D). By jointly fitting gravity, geoid, topography, and surface heat flow data constrained by seismic data, the authors construct a lithospheric thermo-chemical model. They find that the Xisha Trough is underlain by hyper-extended continental crust (4–6 km thick) with a shallow lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) at 50–70 km, contrasting with the deeper LAB (~90 km) beneath the Xisha block. The results support a depth-dependent stretching mechanism where deformation is concentrated in the upper crust and uppermost mantle, while the weaker middle-lower crust undergoes plastic flow.
本研究利用二维多观测值联合建模方法（LitMod2D），通过联合拟合重力异常、大地水准面高度、地形和地表热流，并结合地震反射与折射约束，构建了南海西沙海槽的岩石圈热-化学结构模型。结果表明，西沙海槽下方存在极度减薄的陆壳（厚约4-6 km），其岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）显著上涌至50-70 km，……

t: 2D multi-observable modeling (LitMod2D) integrating gravity, geoid, topography, and heat flow data with seismic constraints.
结合地震约束，利用重力、大地水准面、地形和热流数据进行二维多观测值热-化学联合建模（LitMod2D）。
Gravity anomalies, geoid height, topography, surface heat flow, and seismic reflection/refraction profiles across the Xisha Trough, South China Sea.
南海西沙海槽区域的重力异常、大地水准面高度、地形、地表热流及地震反射/折射剖面数据。
The Xisha Trough has a hyper-extended continental crust (4–6 km) and shallow LAB (50–70 km), contrasting with the Xisha block (LAB ~90 km).
西沙海槽下方为极度减薄陆壳（4-6 km），LAB浅至50-70 km，而西沙地块LAB深约90 km。
The study is limited by the 2D assumption of LitMod2D and the spatial resolution of available heat flow and seismic data.
受限于二维建模假设以及现有热流和地震数据的空间分辨率。
Provides the first integrated thermo-chemical model confirming hyper-extended crust in the Xisha Trough, supporting depth-dependent lithospheric stretching.
首次通过综合热-化学建模证实西沙海槽存在极度减薄陆壳，并支持深度相关岩石圈伸展机制。

kc: Constructed a robust 2D lithospheric thermo-chemical structure model across the Xisha Trough using joint multi-observable modeling (LitMod2D).
Determined that the Xisha Trough is underlain by hyper-extended continental crust (4–6 km thick) and a shallow LAB (50–70 km).
Provided quantitative evidence supporting the depth-dependent stretching mechanism during continental breakup in the South China Sea.
利用多观测值联合建模（LitMod2D）构建了跨西沙海槽的二维岩石圈热-化学结构模型。
确定了西沙海槽下方存在极度减薄的陆壳（厚4-6 km）以及浅部岩石圈-软流圈边界（50-70 km）。
为南海大陆破裂过程中的深度相关伸展机制提供了定量的地球物理证据。
me: 2D multi-observable thermo-chemical modeling (LitMod2D).
Joint inversion/fitting of free-air and Bouguer gravity anomalies, geoid height, topography, and surface heat flow.
Integration of seismic reflection and refraction data as structural constraints.
二维多观测值热-化学联合建模（LitMod2D）。
联合拟合空间重力异常、布格重力异常、大地水准面高度、地形和地表热流数据。
整合地震反射和折射数据作为结构约束。
de: Geophysical observations including gravity anomalies, geoid height, topography, and surface heat flow in the northwestern South China Sea.
Seismic reflection and refraction profiles across the Xisha Trough.
南海西北部边缘的重力异常、大地水准面高度、地形和地表热流等地球物理观测数据。
横跨西沙海槽的地震反射和折射剖面数据。
li: The 2D modeling approach cannot capture 3D lateral variations and oblique stretching effects.
Resolution is dependent on the quality and spatial coverage of the input seismic constraints and heat flow measurements.
二维建模方法无法捕获三维侧向变化和斜向伸展效应。
模型分辨率取决于输入的地震约束和热流测量数据的质量及空间覆盖范围。

tm.why: The paper models the lithospheric thermo-chemical structure, crustal thinning, and lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depth of the Xisha Trough.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the JGR Solid Earth abstract and metadata.

sum: This study investigates sedimentary basin amplification and rupture directivity effects in Wellington, New Zealand, using 3D physics-based ground motion simulations with the ADER-DG code SeisSol. The authors integrate a high-resolution Wellington Basin shear-wave velocity model (minimum Vs of 160 m/s) into the New Zealand Wide Model 2.2 on an adaptive tetrahedral mesh. First, point-source simulations up to 2 Hz for 18 local moderate earthquakes (Mw 3.7–5.3) are validated against GeoNet strong-motion records and empirical ground motion models, showing good agreement across 0.02–2.0 Hz. Next, spontaneous dynamic rupture scenarios (Mw ~7.1) on the Wellington Fault are modeled with onshore and offshore hypocenters. The novel integration of spontaneous dynamic rupture with fine-scale 3D basin geometry reveals pronounced source-path-site interactions: offshore-nucleating ruptures propagating northward toward the city generate up to 3 times higher basin amplification at 1–3 s periods compared to southward-propagating onshore ruptures.
本研究利用基于ADER-DG方法的SeisSol程序开展三维物理地面运动模拟，评估新西兰威灵顿盆地的放大效应与破裂方向性效应。研究将高分辨率威灵顿盆地剪切波速度模型（最小Vs为160 m/s）嵌入新西兰全国速度模型，并在自适应四面体网格上进行计算。首先利用18个中等规模地方地震（Mw 3.7–5.3……

t: The authors use SeisSol, an ADER-DG solver on adaptive unstructured tetrahedral meshes, to simulate 3D seismic wave propagation up to 2 Hz for both point sources and spontaneous dynamic fault ruptures.
利用SeisSol在自适应四面体网格上开展点源和自发动态断层破裂的三维地震波传播模拟（最高2 Hz）。
A 19-unit Wellington Basin velocity model (minimum Vs 160 m/s) merged with New Zealand Wide Model 2.2, validated using 18 GeoNet earthquakes (Mw 3.7–5.3) recorded between 2009 and 2025.
融合19个单元的威灵顿盆地速度模型与全国模型，并使用18个GeoNet地震（Mw 3.7–5.3）进行验证。

Simulated waveforms match observations well (cross-correlation > 0.5, time shifts < 2 s). In Mw ~7.1 dynamic ruptures, offshore-to-onshore propagation increases basin amplification factors by up to 3 times compared to onshore-to-offshore rupture.
模拟波形与观测吻合良好；Mw~7.1动态破裂中，近海向陆地破裂使盆地放大因子增加高达3倍。
The simulations only test two hypocenter locations and omit nonlinear sediment effects, which are expected to impact intermediate and high-frequency ground motions in Wellington.
仅测试了两个起裂位置，且未考虑影响威灵顿中高频地面运动的非线性沉积响应。

Incorporates physics-based spontaneous 3D dynamic rupture modeling into regional ground-motion simulations with fine-scale Wellington Basin geometry to capture realistic source-path-site interactions.
将自发三维动态破裂模拟与精细威灵顿盆地结构结合，以捕捉真实的震源-路径-场地耦合效应。

kc: Integrated a detailed 19-unit Wellington Basin velocity model (minimum Vs = 160 m/s) with the regional New Zealand Wide Model 2.2 using an adaptive tetrahedral mesh.
Validated 3D wave propagation simulations up to 2 Hz against GeoNet strong-motion records for 18 local earthquakes (Mw 3.7–5.3).
Demonstrated via Mw ~7.1 spontaneous dynamic rupture simulations that offshore-to-onshore rupture directivity increases Wellington basin amplification by up to 3 times at 1–3 s periods.
利用自适应四面体网格，将包含19个地质单元的精细威灵顿盆地速度模型（最小Vs = 160 m/s）与新西兰区域速度模型相结合。
利用18个地方地震（Mw 3.7–5.3）的GeoNet强震记录，验证了最高2 Hz的三维地震波传播模拟。
通过Mw ~7.1自发动态破裂模拟证明，在1–3秒周期内，由近海向陆地传播的破裂方向性可使威灵顿盆地放大效应增强多达3倍。
me: 3D seismic wave propagation and spontaneous dynamic rupture modeling using the ADER-DG method implemented in SeisSol.
Unstructured tetrahedral meshing via GMSH with spatially adaptive refinement down to 110 m edge length inside the sedimentary basin.
Linear slip-weakening friction law with Mohr-Coulomb yield criterion and regional Andersonian tectonic stress regime (SHmax = N80°E) for dynamic fault rupture.
Validation using time-domain cross-correlation, Fourier amplitude spectra (FAS) bias, and spectral acceleration (SA 1.0 s, 3.0 s) ratios relative to bedrock station POTS.
采用SeisSol中实现的ADER-DG方法进行三维地震波传播与自发动态破裂模拟。
使用GMSH生成非结构化四面体网格，在沉积盆地内部进行自适应加密，最小网格边长约110米。
结合线性滑移弱化摩擦准则、莫尔-库仑屈服准则以及区域安德森构造应力场（SHmax = N80°E）模拟断层动态破裂。
利用时域互相关、傅里叶幅值谱（FAS）偏差以及相对于基岩台站POTS的谱加速度（SA 1.0 s、3.0 s）放大比进行模型验证。
de: 3D geological and shear-wave velocity model of the Wellington Basin (Hill et al. 2022) merged with the New Zealand Wide Model 2.2 (Eberhart-Phillips et al. 2020).
Waveform and strong-motion records from the GeoNet catalog and New Zealand Ground Motion Database (NZGMDB) for 18 local earthquakes (Mw 3.7–5.3, 2009–2025).
Two 75-km spontaneous dynamic rupture scenarios (Mw 7.10 and 7.11) on the Wellington Fault nucleating onshore (northern segment) and offshore (southern segment).
融合了威灵顿盆地三维地质与剪切波速度模型（Hill et al. 2022）及新西兰全国速度模型2.2版（Eberhart-Phillips et al. 2020）。
来自GeoNet目录和新西兰地面运动数据库（NZGMDB）的18个地方地震（Mw 3.7–5.3，2009–2025年）波形与强震记录。
威灵顿断层上两个75公里长的自发动态破裂情景（Mw 7.10和7.11），分别在陆地（北段）和近海（南段）起裂。
li: Simulations assume purely linear elastic wave propagation and neglect nonlinear sediment response, which impacts high and intermediate frequencies.
Only two hypocenter nucleation locations were explored for the dynamic rupture scenarios despite geological uncertainties.
Assumed a constant Vp/Vs ratio (1.732) throughout the basin and a constant 1.5 s rise time for point-source models.
模拟假设纯线弹性波传播，忽略了影响中高频地面运动的沉积层非线性场地响应。
尽管存在地质不确定性，动态破裂模拟仅探讨了两个震源起裂位置。
在盆地内假设了恒定的Vp/Vs比值（1.732），并对点源模型假设了恒定的1.5秒上升时间。

tm.why: The paper directly evaluates basin amplification and ground motion intensities in Wellington using strong motion records and physics-based simulations.
The authors simulate spontaneous 3D dynamic rupture scenarios (Mw >= 7.0) on the Wellington Fault to investigate rupture directivity effects.
Simulations are conducted up to 2 Hz using the ADER-DG method in SeisSol on adaptive unstructured tetrahedral meshes.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page preprint PDF including all 5 figures, equations, and references.

sum: This study investigates how fault gouge composition controls precursory deformation and earthquake recurrence using direct shear experiments on binary mixtures of soda-lime glass beads and quartz powder (100 to 0 wt% glass beads) at ~313 kPa normal stress. Homogeneous glass beads (100 wt%) exhibit quasi-periodic stick-slip with pronounced pre-failure dilation, rapid late-stage acceleration, and time-predictable recurrence. Adding quartz powder introduces grain-scale compositional heterogeneity, causing earlier, gradual slip acceleration, shorter and weaker pre-failure dilation, and extended intermittent critical stress states. A sharp transition from stick-slip to stable sliding occurs between 85 and 80 wt% glass beads, across which peak slip velocity drops by ~3.8 orders of magnitude. Furthermore, increasing quartz content triples aseismic slip per cycle and causes systematic departure from time-predictable recurrence. The novelty lies in isolating grain-scale compositional mixing to show it independently drives intermittent criticality and recurrence complexity without external perturbations or geometric roughness.
本研究在约313 kPa正应力下对钠钙玻璃珠和石英粉二元混合物（玻璃珠占100–0 wt%）开展直剪实验，探究断层泥成分对震前准备过程和复发周期的控制。纯玻璃珠表现为准周期粘滑、显著震前扩容、晚期快速加速及时间可预测复发。加入石英粉引入颗粒尺度成分异质性，导致更早且平缓的滑移加速、更短弱的扩容及延长……

t: Direct shear experiments on binary mixtures of glass beads and quartz powder sheared between grooved PMMA blocks at 5 µm/s and ~313 kPa normal stress, measuring stress, slip, and dilation at 1000 Hz.
利用带槽PMMA块对玻璃珠与石英粉二元混合物在5 µm/s和约313 kPa下进行直剪实验，以1000 Hz采集力学与位…
Fourteen direct shear experiments (seven binary compositions from 100 to 0 wt% glass beads plus replicates) on 3 mm thick gouge layers under 8 kN initial normal force (~313 kPa).
3 mm厚断层泥层在8 kN初始正力下的14组直剪实验（涵盖100至0 wt%玻璃珠的7种配比及重复测试）。

Transition from stick-slip to stable sliding occurs between 85 and 80 wt% glass beads with a ~3.8 orders of magnitude velocity drop; aseismic slip increases from ~54 to ~165 µm/cycle, causing departure from time-predictability.
85–80 wt%玻璃珠间发生粘滑向稳滑转变，峰值速度差3.8个量级；每周期无震滑移从54增至165 µm，偏离时间预测…
Experiments were performed at low normal stress (~313 kPa) without pore fluid pressure, using idealized spherical glass beads and relatively short event catalogs (14–24 cycles).
实验在低正应力、无孔隙水压下进行，采用理想化玻璃珠模拟且单次实验粘滑目录较短（14–24个周期）。

Isolates grain-scale compositional heterogeneity in spatially uniform gouge layers, proving that mineral mixing alone drives intermittent critical stress states and breaks time-predictable recurrence without geometric roughness.
分离出空间均匀断层泥中的颗粒尺度成分异质性，证实仅靠矿物混合即可诱发间歇临界状态并打破时间可预测复发。

kc: Demonstrated a sharp transition from unstable stick-slip to stable sliding within a narrow gouge compositional range (80–85 wt% glass beads), spanning ~3.8 orders of magnitude in peak slip velocity.
Showed that grain-scale compositional heterogeneity induces extended intermittent critical stress states with episodic slip accelerations prior to dynamic failure.
Quantified that pre-failure dilation amplitude and duration systematically decrease with increasing compositional heterogeneity despite longer preparatory phases.
Established that compositional mixing increases aseismic slip per cycle threefold and causes systematic departures from time- and slip-predictable earthquake recurrence models.
证实了在狭窄的断层泥成分范围（80–85 wt%玻璃珠）内发生从不稳定粘滑到稳定滑动的急剧转变，峰值滑移速度跨越约3.8个数量级。
表明颗粒尺度的成分异质性会在动态破裂前诱发延长的间歇性临界应力状态及幕式滑移加速。
量化了尽管准备阶段延长，震前扩容幅度和持续时间仍随成分异质性增加而系统性减小。
确立了成分混合使每周期的无震滑移增加三倍，并导致系统性偏离时间和滑移可预测的地震复发模型。
me: Single-direct shear friction experiments using low-stiffness PMMA forcing blocks with machined triangular grooves at 5 µm/s constant loading rate and ~313 kPa normal stress.
Controlled grain-scale compositional mixing of velocity-weakening soda-lime glass beads and velocity-strengthening angular quartz powder across seven weight fractions.
Continuous 1000 Hz high-resolution mechanical monitoring of shear stress, fault-parallel slip, and fault-normal displacement (dilation/compaction) using load cells and DCDTs.
Statistical and slip-budget analysis comparing observed recurrence intervals and cumulative slip against time-predictable and slip-predictable frameworks.
使用带加工三角槽的低刚度PMMA加载块，在5 µm/s恒定加载速率和约313 kPa正应力下开展单直剪摩擦实验。
对速度弱化钠钙玻璃珠与速度强化棱角状石英粉在七种重量比例下进行受控的颗粒尺度成分混合。
利用载荷传感器和位移传感器（DCDT）对剪应力、断层平行滑移和垂直位移（扩容/压实）进行1000 Hz高分辨率连续监测。
开展统计与滑移预算分析，将观测复发间隔和累积滑移与时间可预测及滑移可预测模型进行对比。
de: 14 total direct shear laboratory experiments (7 primary compositions from 100 wt% to 0 wt% glass beads plus 7 complementary reproducibility tests).
High-precision time-series catalogs of stick-slip cycles (14 to 24 events per unstable experiment) capturing stress drop, waiting time, peak velocity, dilation, and aseismic slip.
共14组直剪实验室实验（涵盖100 wt%至0 wt%玻璃珠的7种主要成分比例及7组重复性验证实验）。
高精度粘滑周期时间序列目录（每次不稳定实验包含14至24个事件），记录应力降、等待时间、峰值速度、扩容和无震滑移。
li: Experiments were conducted at low normal stress (~313 kPa) and room-dry conditions without pore fluid pressure.
Smooth spherical soda-lime glass beads represent an idealized analog, likely producing a sharper slip-mode contrast than natural mineralogic variations.
Event catalogs per experiment (14 to 24 stick-slip cycles) are too short to distinguish between stochastic stress perturbations and deterministic chaos.
实验在低正应力（约313 kPa）和室温干燥无孔隙流体压力的条件下进行。
光滑球形钠钙玻璃珠属于理想化模拟材料，产生的滑移模式反差可能比天然矿物变化更为剧烈。
单次实验的事件目录较短（14至24个粘滑周期），不足以区分随机应力扰动与确定性混沌机制。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates frictional stability, stick-slip vs. stable sliding transitions, and aseismic slip budgets in binary fault gouge mixtures using direct shear laboratory experiments.
It examines earthquake nucleation phases, pre-failure dilation, slip velocity acceleration patterns, and time-predictable recurrence intervals of laboratory stick-slip events.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF read and analyzed, including abstract, methods, results, discussion, conclusions, Table 1, and Figures 1–7.

sum: This study investigates the 2023 Mw 7.8 and 7.6 Kahramanmaraş earthquake doublet in Türkiye to understand how multi-segment ruptures affected a broad region. Using a Bayesian framework, the authors model coseismic slip from surface deformation measurements, finding that slip is concentrated above 20 km depth with a shallow slip deficit of 10% to 80%. Slip decreases at geometric complexities and is higher on straight segments. Postseismic InSAR time series show that afterslip is concentrated at the northeastern ends of both ruptures, while aftershocks spread in fan-shaped zones at the southwestern tips due to geometric complexity and crustal damage. Finally, the study highlights how strain partitioning between subparallel strike-slip faults facilitated the unusually large spatial extent of the doublet, offering key insights into seismic hazards along broad plate boundaries.
本研究利用贝叶斯框架和地表形变数据，反演了2023年土耳其双震的同震滑动。结果显示滑动集中在20km以浅，且在断层几何复杂处降低。震后InSAR分析表明余滑集中在破裂东北端，而西南端的几何复杂性与地壳损伤阻碍了破裂。研究强调了平行走滑断层间的应变分配对超大破裂范围的控制作用，揭示了板块边界的地震危险……

t: Bayesian inversion of surface deformation measurements to model coseismic slip and uncertainties, combined with postseismic InSAR time-series analysis to map afterslip.
基于地表形变的贝叶斯反演建模同震滑动，结合震后InSAR时间序列分析余滑。
Surface deformation measurements and postseismic InSAR displacement time series covering the East Anatolian Fault Zone, along with aftershock location data.
东安纳托利亚断裂带的地表形变测量、震后InSAR时间序列及余震定位数据。

Coseismic slip concentrates above 20 km with 10%-80% shallow slip deficit. Slip decreases at geometric complexities, afterslip concentrates at northeastern ends, and aftershocks fan out at southwestern terminations.
滑动集中在20km以浅且存在浅部亏损；滑动在几何复杂处降低，余滑集中在东北端。
Potential resolution limits of geodetic data in constraining deep slip and simplified fault geometry assumptions.
大地测量数据在约束深部滑动时的潜在分辨率限制，以及简化的断层几何假设。
Demonstrates the role of strain partitioning between subparallel faults and geometric complexities in controlling the unusually large rupture size of the Kahramanmaraş doublet.
揭示了平行断层间的应变分配与几何复杂性在控制土耳其双震超大破裂中的作用。

kc: Quantified the coseismic slip distribution and shallow slip deficit (10%-80%) of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş doublet using a Bayesian framework.
Identified the controlling role of fault geometry, showing slip decreases at geometric complexities and aftershocks fan out at southwestern terminations.
Demonstrated how strain partitioning between subparallel strike-slip faults facilitated the unusually large spatial extent of the doublet.
利用贝叶斯框架定量反演了2023年土耳其双震的同震滑动分布及浅部滑动亏损（10%-80%）。
阐明了断层几何的控制作用，表明滑动在几何复杂处降低，且余震在西南端呈扇形散开。
揭示了平行走滑断层间的应变分配如何促进了此次双震异常广泛的空间破裂范围。
me: Bayesian inversion of surface deformation measurements to estimate coseismic slip and uncertainties.
Postseismic InSAR displacement time-series analysis to map afterslip.
Analysis of aftershock spatial distributions relative to fault geometry.
基于地表形变观测的贝叶斯反演，用于估算同震滑动及不确定性。
震后InSAR位移时间序列分析，用于制图震后余滑。
结合断层几何特征分析余震的空间分布。
de: Surface deformation measurements (including InSAR) covering the East Anatolian Fault Zone.
Postseismic InSAR displacement time series.
Aftershock catalog data for the 2023 Kahramanmaraş sequence.
覆盖东安纳托利亚断裂带的地表形变观测数据（包括InSAR）。
震后InSAR位移时间序列。
2023年土耳其地震序列的余震目录数据。
li: The study relies on simplified fault geometries which may not capture all fine-scale multi-segment complexities.
Resolution of shallow slip deficit and deep slip limits may be constrained by the spatial coverage of geodetic data.
研究依赖于简化的断层几何模型，可能无法完全捕获所有微观的多段破裂复杂性。
浅部滑动亏损和深部滑动边界的分辨率可能受限于大地测量数据的空间覆盖范围。

tm.why: The paper models coseismic slip and rupture segmentation of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake doublet.
It investigates the role of fault geometry, strain partitioning, and postseismic afterslip along the East Anatolian Fault Zone.
The authors use a Bayesian framework to model coseismic slip and obtain uncertainties.

sum: To resolve debates over lithospheric thinning and mantle temperatures beneath Anatolia, this study performs a regionalized 1-D Bayesian thermo-compositional joint inversion of Rayleigh-wave group and phase velocities (12–100 s), elevation, and surface heat flow down to 360 km depth. Using k-means clustering, Anatolia is divided into ten tectonic zones, with thermodynamic modeling (Perple_X) and MINEOS linking temperature and composition to geophysical observables. Results show a pervasively thin thermal lithosphere (40–85 km), thinnest (<50 km) beneath the Eastern Pontides and between the Central and Eastern Anatolian Plateaus, and thickest (>75 km) under the Central Pontides and northern Arabia. Crucially, mantle potential temperature increases sharply by ~140°C from west to east across 35°E. This novel continuous thermal constraint implies hot plume-derived asthenosphere is confined to eastern Anatolia—enhancing local lithospheric removal—rather than driving plate-wide westward motion via basal drag.
本研究采用区域化一维贝叶斯热-成分联合反演方法，融合瑞利波群速度与相速度频散曲线（12–100秒）、地形高程和地表热流数据，构建了安纳托利亚至360 km深度的温度与成分结构。结果表明研究区热岩石圈普遍较薄（40–85 km），东庞蒂德及中、东高原过渡带最薄（<50 km），而中庞蒂德和阿拉伯板块最……

t: Joint 1-D Bayesian thermo-compositional inversion using GASWAM MCMC sampling, Perple_X thermodynamic modeling, and MINEOS to invert surface-wave dispersion, elevation, and surface heat flow directly for geotherms and mantle composition down to 360 km.
利用GASWAM采样、Perple_X热力学正演和MINEOS开展面波、高程与热流的一维贝叶斯热-成分联合反演。

Rayleigh-wave group and phase velocities (12–100 s), SRTM15+ elevation, global surface heat flow (<120 mW/m²), and prior crustal constraints partitioned into 10 regional clusters across Anatolia using k-means clustering.
12–100秒瑞利波群速度与相速度、SRTM15+高程、地表热流及地壳先验，经k-means聚类为10个区。

Thermal lithospheric thickness across Anatolia is 40–85 km (thinnest <50 km in Eastern Pontides and C2E; thickest >75 km in Central Pontides and northern Arabia), with a ~140°C eastward increase in mantle potential temperature across 35°E.
安纳托利亚热岩石圈厚40–85 km，东庞蒂德与C2E最薄（<50 km），跨35°E地幔潜温向东骤升约140°C。

Dataset incompatibilities and 3-D slab complexities caused poor fits in western/coastal Anatolia, while neglecting sub-lithospheric radial anisotropy and tomographic damping bias absolute temperature estimates.
数据不兼容与三维俯冲板片导致西部拟合不佳，忽略软流圈径向各向异性和层析阻尼拉低了绝对温度。

First regionalized Bayesian thermo-compositional joint inversion of group/phase dispersion, elevation, and heat flow across Anatolia, resolving continuous lateral mantle temperature contrasts and thermal LAB depths.
首次在安纳托利亚联合反演群/相速度、高程和热流，直接约束连续的岩石圈热厚度与横向地幔温差。

kc: Jointly inverts Rayleigh-wave group and phase dispersion, elevation, and surface heat flow in a self-consistent Bayesian thermodynamic framework across 10 regionalized zones in Anatolia.

Maps thermal lithospheric thickness across Anatolia as pervasively thin (40–85 km), with extreme thinning (<50 km) beneath the Eastern Pontides and C2E region and an ~18 km step across the North Anatolian Fault.

Resolves a sharp ~140°C west-to-east increase in mantle potential temperature across ~35°E, demonstrating that hot plume material is confined to eastern Anatolia and does not drive westward plate motion via basal traction.
在自洽的贝叶斯热力学框架下，对安纳托利亚10个分区的瑞利波群速度与相速度频散、高程和地表热流进行了联合反演。
揭示安纳托利亚热岩石圈普遍较薄（40–85 km），东庞蒂德和C2E区极薄（<50 km），且跨北安纳托利亚断层存在约18 km的厚度阶跃。
发现在约35°E两侧存在约140°C的西低东高地幔潜温突变，证明热地幔柱物质局限于安纳托利亚东部，并非通过底部拖曳驱动板块向西运动。
me: k-means clustering with silhouette analysis and tectonic boundary refinement to partition the study area into 10 internally consistent zones.
1-D steady-state conductive lithospheric geotherm parameterization overlying an adiabatic mantle with an optional 100-km-thick cosine-shaped thermal anomaly.
Thermodynamic forward modeling using Perple_X and Abers & Hacker (2016) equation-of-state parameters, anelastic attenuation corrections, and MINEOS for surface-wave dispersion.
Global Adaptive Scaling Within Adaptive Metropolis (GASWAM) MCMC sampling followed by a strict '1-misfit' filtering criterion across all datasets.
结合轮廓系数分析与构造边界细化的k-means聚类算法，将研究区划分为10个内部一致的分区。
采用一维稳态传导岩石圈地温线叠加绝热地幔及可选100 km厚余弦形热异常的参数化方案。
利用Perple_X和状态方程参数进行热力学正演，结合非弹性衰减校正与MINEOS计算面波频散。
采用自适应Metropolis（GASWAM）马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样，并对所有数据集施加严格的“1-misfit”过滤准则。
de: Rayleigh-wave group velocities (12–100 s) from Kaviani et al. (2020) and phase velocities (12–100 s) from El-Sharkawy et al. (2024).
SRTM15+ global elevation data (Tozer et al., 2019) modeled under local isostatic equilibrium to 360 km depth.
Surface heat flow (SHF) compilation from Lucazeau (2019), excluding values >120 mW/m².
Crustal thickness, Vp/Vs, and shear-wave velocity priors from receiver function and surface-wave studies (Ogden & Bastow, 2022; Zhou et al., 2025).
Kaviani等（2020）的12–100秒瑞利波群速度模型和El-Sharkawy等（2024）的12–100秒相速度模型。
SRTM15+全球高程数据（Tozer等，2019），基于360 km补偿深度的局部均衡假设计算。
Lucazeau（2019）的地表热流（SHF）数据集（剔除>120 mW/m²的异常高值）。
来自接收函数和面波研究的地壳厚度、Vp/Vs和剪切波速度先验信息（Ogden & Bastow, 2022; Zhou et al., 2025）。
li: Incompatibilities between phase and group velocity datasets or complex 3-D slab structures prevented acceptable fits in western Anatolia and western/southern coastal zones.
Sub-lithospheric radial anisotropy is neglected in the main inversions due to sparse Love-wave coverage, which may bias absolute mantle temperature estimates.
Absolute mantle potential temperatures are systematically lower than petrological estimates due to oceanic calibration of the thermodynamic mapping and tomographic amplitude damping.
相速度与群速度数据集的不兼容或复杂的三维俯冲板片结构导致安纳托利亚西部及西、南沿海地区无法获得可接受的拟合。
由于勒夫波覆盖稀疏，主反演忽略了岩石圈下方的径向各向异性，这可能会影响地幔绝对温度的估计。
受热力学映射的大洋校准和层析成像振幅阻尼影响，反演得到的绝对地幔潜温系统性地低于岩石学估计值。

tm.why: The paper investigates the thermal lithospheric thickness, upper-mantle potential temperatures, and geodynamic drivers of lithospheric thinning and westward plate motion in Anatolia.
The authors apply a joint Bayesian thermo-compositional inversion using Adaptive Metropolis MCMC sampling to estimate posterior distributions of thermal and compositional parameters.
Rayleigh-wave group- and phase-velocity dispersion curves from regional surface-wave tomographic models are primary inputs inverted to constrain 1-D shear-wave and thermal profiles.

ev.notes: Full 27-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§7), and all 9 figures.

sum: Scientific ocean drilling archives are sparse and incomplete, typically relying on geologist-assigned lithological labels as ground truth. This study trains a self-supervised masked variational autoencoder with a heteroscedastic Gaussian decoder and learnable mask tokens on the LILY database, utilizing six routine measurements (bulk density, magnetic susceptibility, natural gamma radiation, and RGB reflectance) across 236,963 intervals from 296 boreholes. Evaluated via 30 borehole-level cross-validation folds, the learned 10-dimensional embeddings separate lithology better than PCA, TabNet, and SCARF. Crucially, adding semi-supervised lithology labels provides no improvement and degrades measurement reconstruction at high weights because categorical labels compress continuous petrophysical variations. Using CatBoost, the embeddings zero-shot predict held-out properties on unseen boreholes, achieving R² of 0.53 for porosity, 0.52 for magnetization, 0.39 for P-wave velocity, and 0.30 for thermal conductivity, whereas depth alone fails to transfer across boreholes (median R² = -0.02).
科学大洋钻探档案通常不完整，且依赖地质学家指定的岩性标签。本研究在LILY数据库上训练了具有异方差高斯解码器和可学习掩码标记的自监督掩码变分自编码器，使用来自296个钻孔的236,963个样本的六项常规测量（体积密度、磁化率、自然伽马辐射和RGB反射率）。通过30折钻孔级交叉验证，该嵌入对岩性的区分……

t: A masked variational autoencoder maps 6 routine core measurements (with 10% random masking using learnable tokens) to a 10D Gaussian latent space, paired with a heteroscedastic decoder learning per-variable log-variances.
使用带可学习掩码和异方差高斯解码器的变分自编码器，将6项常规岩芯测量映射至10维潜在空间。

236,963 observations binned at 20 cm intervals across 296 boreholes from 25 IODP expeditions in the LILY database, containing bulk density, magnetic susceptibility, NGR, RGB reflectance, and 139 lithology classes.
LILY数据库中25个航次296个钻孔的236,963个20厘米间隔观测值，含6项测量与139类岩性。

Self-supervised and semi-supervised VAEs yield indistinguishable lithology clustering (ARI 0.237 vs 0.247) and probing (AUC 0.958 vs 0.959); embeddings zero-shot predict held-out borehole porosity (R²=0.53) and P-wave velocity (R²=0.39), beating depth (R²=-0.02).
自监督与半监督模型表现无异；嵌入在未见钻孔上预测孔隙度(R²=0.53)和纵波速度(0.39)，远超深度(-0.02)。

Only 236,963 intervals out of 34 million measurements have all six inputs, biasing the dataset to soft sediment; mechanical properties (vane shear strength, penetration resistance) and crystalline basement fail.
仅23.7万区间具备全部6项属性，偏向软沉积物；无法预测力学属性及结晶基底。

Proves expert lithological labels are redundant for representation learning on routine core logs, and establishes a rigorous borehole-holdout and depth-residualized evaluation protocol for geological archives.
证明专家岩性标签对表征学习冗余，并建立钻孔分块与去除深度混杂的严格评估协议。

kc: Demonstrates that six routine shipboard core measurements suffice to recover expert lithological classifications via self-supervised representation learning.

Predicts unseen physical properties (porosity, whole-core magnetization, P-wave velocity, thermal conductivity) on held-out boreholes where depth alone fails (median R² of 0.20 vs -0.02).

表明使用专家岩性标签进行监督不会改善分类或聚类，且随标签权重增加会降低测量重构精度。
在未见钻孔上预测未参与训练的物理属性（孔隙度、全岩芯磁化强度、纵波速度、热导率），表现远优于单纯深度预测（中位R²为0.20对比-0.02）。
建立了严格的按钻孔分块交叉验证与新颖性评估协议，防止沿岩芯深度自相关造成的数据泄露。

Heteroscedastic Gaussian decoder predicting per-variable log-variance clamped to [-6, 6] to handle different instrument noise scales.
Semi-supervised variant adding an unweighted cross-entropy linear classification head across 139 lithology classes with annealing weights.
Borehole-level 30-fold blocked cross-validation evaluated via GMM clustering (ARI), linear SVM probing (AUC), and CatBoost regression (R²) for zero-shot property transfer.
掩码变分自编码器（VAE），将6个输入（随机掩码10%并替换为可学习参数）映射到10维高斯潜在空间。
异方差高斯解码器，预测限制在[-6, 6]的逐变量对数方差，以处理不同仪器噪声尺度。
半监督变体，增加针对139个岩性类别的无加权交叉熵线性分类头及退火权重。

Six routine whole-core training inputs: GRA bulk density, loop magnetic susceptibility, natural gamma radiation (NGR), and RGB line-scan reflectance.

Held-out target variables including cross-sensor measurements (point magnetic susceptibility, L* reflectance) and independent physical properties (porosity, thermal conductivity, discrete/whole-core P-wave velocity, magnetization, grain density, vane shear strength, penetration resistance).
整理的IODP LILY公开数据库子集，包含来自25个航次、296个钻孔的236,963个20厘米间隔观测样本及139个岩性类别。

sum: To understand lunar mare volcanism and radius changes, the authors developed a 3-D regional spherical shell mantle convection model coupled with magmatism. In this model, internal heating forms a basal partially molten layer, from which buoyant, partially molten plumes ascend due to magma buoyancy. Decompression melting within these plumes drives further ascent. Magma supply peaks between 4.0 and 3.5 Gyr ago, coinciding with maximum radial expansion, and then declines. However, magma supply persists for billions of years because earlier plumes leave thermally softened conduits that localize subsequent plume ascents. This 3-D mechanism, along with recycling of magmatic products, explains long-lasting localized volcanism and quantitatively accounts for the Moon's early expansion followed by contraction. The results suggest an initially hot, mostly solid lunar mantle with a dense basal layer.
为理解月球玛利亚火山活动和半径变化历史，本研究开发了一个结合岩浆作用的三维区域球面壳层地幔对流模型。模型中，内部加热在早期形成底部部分熔融层，岩浆浮力驱动部分熔融羽流上升，且减压熔融进一步加速其上升。岩浆供应在40至35亿年前达到顶峰，与月球最大径向膨胀相吻合。由于早期羽流留下了热软化的通道，使得后……

t: A 3-D regional spherical shell mantle convection model coupled with magma segregation, percolation, and decompression melting.
结合了岩浆运移、渗流和减压熔融的三维区域球面壳层地幔对流数值模型。
Numerical simulations of lunar mantle evolution under varying initial thermal states and dense basal layer configurations.
在不同初始热状态和致密底层配置下月球地幔演化的数值模拟。
Magma supply peaks at 4-3.5 Gyr ago, matching lunar expansion, and persists for billions of years via stable, thermally softened conduits.
岩浆供应在40-35亿年前达到顶峰（与月球膨胀一致），并通过稳定的热软化通道持续数十亿年。
The regional 3-D geometry and simplified mantle rheology may not fully capture global-scale convection and chemical heterogeneity.
区域三维几何结构和简化的地幔流变学可能无法完全捕捉全球尺度的对流和化学非均匀性。
Demonstrating that 3-D geometry enables stable, thermally softened conduits that sustain localized, long-lasting planetary volcanism.
证明了三维几何结构能够形成稳定的热软化通道，从而维持局部的、长期的行星火山活动。

kc: Developed a 3-D regional spherical shell mantle convection model that couples magma buoyancy and decompression melting.
Explained the mechanism of long-lasting, localized lunar mare volcanism through thermally softened conduits in 3-D geometry.
Quantitatively reconciled the timeline of lunar radial expansion and contraction with the peak of magma supply.
开发了一个结合岩浆浮力和减压熔融的三维区域球面壳层地幔对流模型。
通过三维几何结构中的热软化通道，解释了长期且局部的月球玛利亚火山活动机制。
定量调和了月球径向膨胀与收缩的时间线与岩浆供应峰值之间的关系。
me: 3-D regional spherical shell mantle convection modeling.
Formulation of magma segregation, percolation, and decompression melting.
Parameterized volume change calculations to model lunar radius evolution.
三维区域球面壳层地幔对流数值模拟。

用于模拟月球半径演化的参数化体积变化计算。

Comparison of model-derived magma supply history and radius changes with observed lunar mare volcanism and tectonic records.
从初始高温、大部分呈固态且具有致密底层的状态开始的月球地幔演化数值模拟。
将模型推导的岩浆供应历史和半径变化与观测到的月球玛利亚火山活动及构造记录进行对比。
li: The model is regional rather than global, which may affect global-scale convection patterns.
Simplifications in the rheology and chemical composition of the lunar mantle and the dense basal layer.
该模型是区域性的而非全球性的，这可能会影响全球尺度的对流模式。
简化了月球地幔及致密底层的流变学和化学成分。

The paper investigates planetary volcanism (lunar mare volcanism) and the thermal/magmatic evolution of the Moon.

sum: This paper is a reply to a comment by Aires et al. (2026) on a previous study by Braga et al. (2026), which used magnetotelluric (MT) data to image a Neoproterozoic paleosubduction zone in the NW Borborema Province, Brazil. The authors address criticisms regarding regional petrological, spectroscopic, and geobarometric interpretations (such as coesite and HP-UHP metamorphism). They argue that these petrological debates do not invalidate their MT results. Specifically, they defend the robustness of the C1 conductive anomaly—a west-dipping crustal structure recovered via 3D inversion—as a paleosubduction-related feature along the eastern margin of the Santa Quitéria Arc, emphasizing that its electrical response depends on graphite connectivity rather than sheer volume.
本研究是针对Aires等（2026）对Braga等（2026）利用大地电磁（MT）数据揭示巴西西北博博雷马省新元古代古俯冲带一文所提评论的回复。作者回应了关于区域岩石学、光谱学和地质压力学解释（如柯石英和高压-超高压变质作用）的质疑，指出这些争议不影响MT反演结果。他们强调，3D反演得到的向西倾斜地……

t: 3D inversion of magnetotelluric data to image crustal resistivity structures.
利用大地电磁数据的3D反演来成像地壳电阻率结构。
Magnetotelluric sounding data and regional petrological/geobarometric constraints from the NW Borborema Province.
来自西北博博雷马省的大地电磁测深数据及区域岩石学/地质压力学约束。
Confirmation of a robust, west-dipping crustal conductive anomaly (C1) representing a paleosubduction zone.
确认了代表古俯冲带的稳健向西倾斜地壳导电异常（C1）。
Relies on previously published data and interpretations without new field acquisitions.
依赖于先前发表的数据和解释，未进行新的野外采集。
Clarification of graphite connectivity as the primary driver for the C1 anomaly's high conductivity.
阐明了石墨连通性是C1异常高导电性的主要驱动因素。

kc: Defends the robustness of the 3D magnetotelluric inversion and the west-dipping C1 crustal conductive anomaly.
Clarifies the geological and petrological context of the NW Borborema Province, arguing that alternative exhumation mechanisms do not exclude paleosubduction.
Demonstrates that the electrical conductivity of the C1 anomaly is primarily controlled by graphite connectivity along grain boundaries.
捍卫了3D大地电磁反演及向西倾斜的C1地壳导电异常的稳健性。
澄清了西北博博雷马省的地质和岩石学背景，指出替代折返机制并不排除古俯冲作用。
论证了C1异常的电导率主要受晶界石墨连通性的控制。

Geological and petrological synthesis.

Petrological and geobarometric literature data.

sum: This study applies source-side teleseismic tomography (SSTT) to image the 3-D P-wave velocity structure beneath the Taiwan orogen down to ~400 km depth. By utilizing travel-time residuals from deep local earthquakes to distant stations, SSTT overcomes the spatial sampling limitations of sparse surface stations. The resulting model reveals the detailed interaction of the subducting Eurasian Plate (EP) and Philippine Sea Plate (PSP). In southern Taiwan, the EP subducts eastward to 400 km, while in central-northern Taiwan, it steepens and detaches at 200–300 km depths. This progressive northward widening of slab detachment beneath the PSP supports a slab breakoff model rather than a lithospheric tear model, providing crucial constraints on the geodynamics of the active Taiwan orogeny.
本研究采用源侧远震断层成像（SSTT）方法，重建了台湾活动造山带下方深至400公里的三维P波速度结构。该方法利用深部本地地震到远震台站的旅行时残差，克服了地表台站分布有限的局限性。结果揭示了欧亚板块（EP）与菲律宾海板块（PSP）相互作用的三维细节：在台湾南部，EP向东俯冲至400公里深；在台湾中北……

t: Source-side teleseismic tomography (SSTT) using travel-time residuals from deep local earthquakes to distant stations to improve mantle ray-path coverage.
利用深部本地地震到远端台站的旅行时残差进行源侧远震断层成像，改善地幔射线覆盖。
Travel-time residuals from local earthquakes beneath Taiwan recorded at distant teleseismic stations.
台湾下方本地地震在远端远震台站记录到的旅行时残差数据。
Imaged Eurasian Plate subducting eastward to 400 km in the south, and steepening/detaching at 200-300 km depth in central-northern Taiwan, supporting slab breakoff.
成像显示南部欧亚板块向东俯冲至400公里，中北部在200-300公里深度脱落，支持板块断裂。
Resolution relies heavily on the distribution of local earthquakes, and the study is limited to isotropic P-wave velocity.
分辨率高度依赖于本地地震的分布，且研究局限于各向同性P波速度。
First application of SSTT to Taiwan to resolve the deep 3-D plate interaction and distinguish between slab breakoff and lithospheric tear models.
首次将SSTT应用于台湾，以解决深部三维板块相互作用并区分板块断裂与岩石圈撕裂。

kc: Successfully applied source-side teleseismic tomography (SSTT) to image the upper mantle beneath Taiwan down to 400 km.
Resolved the detailed 3-D geometry and interaction of the subducting Eurasian Plate (EP) and Philippine Sea Plate (PSP).
Provided strong evidence supporting the slab breakoff model over the lithospheric tear model for the Eurasian Plate beneath northern Taiwan.
成功应用源侧远震断层成像（SSTT）对台湾下方深至400公里的上地幔进行了成像。
解析了俯冲欧亚板块（EP）与菲律宾海板块（PSP）相互作用的详细三维几何结构。
为台湾北部下方欧亚板块的板块断裂模型（而非岩石圈撕裂模型）提供了强有力的证据。

sum: Coseismic ionospheric disturbances (CIDs) measured by GNSS total electron content (TEC) are typically interpreted using an epicentral point-source assumption. This study presents a 3D acoustic ray-tracing forward model driven by a moment-weighted finite-fault source, tracing waves through a stratified, moving atmosphere into the far field and solving the 3D continuity equation for synthetic slant TEC. Applied to 249 GNSS satellite-receiver arcs from the 28 March 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake—which ruptured >400 km unilaterally southward along the Sagaing fault—the finite-fault model reduces the median arrival-time error from 383 s (point source) to 202 s and shifts peak amplitudes southward to match observations. Crucially, observed CID arrival times and amplitudes organize by distance from the fault trace rather than the epicenter, demonstrating that extended ruptures systematically bias traditional epicentral travel-time diagrams and apparent velocities.
本研究提出了一种三维声学射线追踪正演模型，利用矩加权有限断层子源模拟同震电离层扰动（CIDs），并计算沿卫星-接收机视线的合成斜总电子含量（sTEC）。将该模型应用于2025年3月28日缅甸Mw 7.7级地震（沿实皆断裂向南单侧破裂超400公里）的249条GNSS观测弧段。结果表明，有限断层模型将点……

t: 3D forward model tracing acoustic rays from 30 moment-weighted finite-fault sub-sources through a moving stratified atmosphere, projecting neutral motion onto the geomagnetic field to integrate synthetic slant TEC.
建立三维声学射线追踪正演模型，将30个矩加权断层子源的声波投影至地磁场并积分计算合成sTEC。

249 phase-continuous satellite-receiver slant TEC arcs from 38 multi-constellation GNSS stations recording the 28 March 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake, paired with the 530-subfault USGS finite-fault model.
2025年缅甸7.7级地震38个GNSS台站记录的249条连续sTEC弧段，结合USGS 530子断层模型。
The finite-fault model reduces median arrival-time error to 202 s versus 383 s for a point source, shifts peak amplitudes southward to match observations, and collapses azimuthal travel-time offsets.
有限断层将走时中位误差从点源的383秒降至202秒，峰值振幅南移与观测吻合，消除了方位角时差。
Uneven azimuthal station coverage, use of seismic moment as a proxy for vertical acoustic forcing, and omission of nonlinear propagation and Rayleigh-wave-induced far-field modes.
方位角台站覆盖不均、以地震矩代理垂直声源强迫，且未包含非线性传播与远场瑞利波模式。
Quantifies how a >400 km unilateral rupture biases epicentral CID travel-time diagrams and proves that fault-distance ordering and 3D finite-fault ray tracing resolve these kinematic discrepancies.
量化了超400公里单侧破裂对震中时距图的偏差，证明断层距排序与有限断层射线追踪可消除该偏差。

kc: Developed a 3D acoustic ray-tracing and ionospheric coupling model (cidmodel) incorporating moment-weighted finite-fault sub-sources, path-accumulated absorption at observed frequencies, and post-apogee far-field rays.
Demonstrated on 249 GNSS arcs from the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake that a finite-fault source reduces median timing error from 383 s to 202 s compared to a point source.

Showed that CID arrival times and amplitudes are ordered by distance to the fault trace rather than the epicenter, establishing pre-modeling diagnostics for extended-source effects in ionospheric inversions.
开发了结合矩加权有限断层子源、沿路径累积吸收及远场过远地点射线的三维声学射线追踪与电离层耦合正演模型（cidmodel）。
通过对2025年缅甸Mw 7.7级地震249条GNSS弧段的分析，证明有限断层源相比点源将中位走时误差从383秒降至202秒。

sum: This study investigates the coseismic deformation of the July 28, 2026, M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake on the Hinagu Fault zone using GNSS and SAR data. The authors construct a two-segment fault source model, validated by strong-motion waveform inversion. The results show that the 2026 rupture occurred south of the 2016 Kumamoto rupture termination. The main slip features shallow right-lateral slip near the hypocenter and deeper normal slip near a fault bend. Slip decreases southwestward, with weak shallow slip on the southwestern segment. The spatial variations in slip characteristics correlate with a fault bend and pre-existing seismic velocity and geological contrasts, highlighting the influence of structural heterogeneity on earthquake rupture propagation.

sum: This study utilizes teleseismic Ps receiver functions from networks 7G, YA, and KV to investigate the crustal structure beneath the Kivu Rift and Virunga Volcanic Province in the Western Rift, Africa. By combining H–κ stacking, 1-D waveform inversion, and forward modeling, the authors map lateral variations in crustal thickness, Vp/Vs ratio (κ), and Moho impedance. The results show that the thinnest crust (28–34 km) lies within the rift, while thicker crust (mid-30s to low-40s km) characterizes the flanks. Elevated κ values and complex waveforms around the Virunga Volcanic Province indicate mid- to lower-crustal modification by mafic intrusions or melt. The crustal stretching factor of ~1.23–1.32 confirms significant extension, while elevation contrasts suggest sub-crustal density variations. The study provides key insights into localized magmatic modification and tectonic extension during early-stage rifting.
本研究利用接收函数分析了东非裂谷西支基伍裂谷及维龙加火山区的地壳结构。通过H-κ叠加和波形反演，发现裂谷内侧地壳最薄（28-34 km），而维龙加火山区下方高波速比指示了中下地壳的岩浆侵入改造。地壳拉张系数达1.23-1.32，证实了显著的构造延伸，揭示了早期裂谷中岩浆与拉张的相互作用。

sum: This study investigates the early stages of the India-Asia collision by analyzing Paleocene crustal shortening across the Tibetan Plateau. The authors demonstrate that deformation propagated rapidly across Tibet, facilitated by pre-existing, inherited lithospheric structures. Rather than a simple sequential outward growth, the reactivation of these older structural weaknesses allowed for rapid, widespread deformation. This highlights the fundamental role of lithospheric inheritance in controlling the spatial and temporal evolution of continental collision zones.
本研究通过分析青藏高原古新世地壳缩短，探讨了印度-亚洲碰撞的早期阶段。作者表明，在预先存在的继承性岩石圈结构促进下，变形在青藏高原内部实现了快速传播。这些早期构造薄弱带的活化导致了快速且广泛的变形，而非简单的向外顺序生长。这突出了岩石圈继承性在控制大陆碰撞带时空演化中的关键作用。

sum: DeepWaveRL introduces a reinforcement learning framework for self-supervised Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) that requires neither ground-truth velocity maps nor gradients from the forward modeling operator. The authors formulate FWI as a single-step policy learning problem where a Vision Transformer policy network takes seismic data as states and predicts discretized 2D velocity maps as actions. A pre-compiled CUDA finite-difference solver simulates waveforms solely to compute a global scalar data-misfit reward. To overcome high gradient variance and spatial credit assignment bottlenecks, the framework integrates group-relative policy optimization with a map-level importance ratio, a discretized velocity action space, a sign-preserving logarithmic reward transformation, transfer-learned structural priors, and Test-Time Optimization (TTO). Evaluated on OpenFWI datasets (CurveVel-A, FlatFault-A, CurveFault-A), DeepWaveRL+TTO outperforms differentiable self-supervised baselines (UPFWI) and achieves accuracy competitive with supervised InversionNet, offering a flexible paradigm compatible with non-differentiable black-box wave simulators.
本文提出DeepWaveRL，一种无需真实速度标签和正演算子梯度的自监督全波形反演（FWI）强化学习框架。该方法将FWI建模为单步策略学习问题：策略网络以地震数据为状态，输出离散化的二维速度图作为动作，并通过有限差分正演计算全局标量数据残差作为奖励。为解决空间信用分配瓶颈与高方差问题，作者引入图级重……

sum: Earthquake coda-correlation reveals body-wave-like features sampling Earth's deep interior, arising from constructive interference of reverberating body waves with similar slowness rather than reconstructed Green's functions. However, the lack of distributed sensitivity kernels has prevented 3D tomographic inversion of these signals. This paper develops a two-step forward modeling framework using SpecFem2D that bypasses conventional cross-correlation of long late-coda waveforms by treating the time-reversed generating wavefield as a distributed source throughout Earth's interior. The directly simulated correlograms reproduce conventional stacked features (such as P*, ScS*, K*) with significantly higher signal-to-noise ratio. Using adjoint methods, the authors derive finite-frequency banana-doughnut traveltime sensitivity kernels for P-wave velocity, S-wave velocity, and density at station separations from 30° to 180°. The kernels demonstrate comprehensive sampling across the mantle, outer core, and inner core, establishing the theoretical foundation for 3D global coda-correlation tomography.
地震尾波互相关能够提取采样地球深部的体波特征，但缺乏分布式敏感度核限制了其三维层析成像应用。本文基于SpecFem2D开发了两步正演模拟框架，将时间反转的生成波场作为地球内部的分布式震源，直接模拟尾波互相关波场，绕过了传统的长时窗尾波互相关叠加，显著提高了信噪比。在此基础上，利用伴随方法推导了P波速……

t: Simulates the coda-correlation wavefield in two steps using a time-reversed generating wavefield from a primary station as a distributed interior source, then computes symmetric finite-frequency traveltime sensitivity kernels via the adjoint method.
将主台生成波场时间反转作为地球内部分布式震源分两步直接模拟尾波互相关波场，并利用伴随法计算对称有限频走时敏感度核。
Exclusively 2D P-SV synthetic waveforms simulated with SpecFem2D in a modified ak135f Earth model across 1441 surface stations, bandpass filtered between 22.5 and 50 s over a -1 h to +1 h lapse time.
基于修改的ak135f模型和1441个地表台站，使用SpecFem2D生成22.5–50秒二维P-SV合成尾波互相关波形…

Direct simulation reproduces conventional correlation features (ScS*, P*, I*) with higher SNR; 2-h and 8-h simulation durations yield a correlation coefficient of ~1.0, and antipodal kernels sample the entire mantle and core.
直接模拟以更高信噪比复现了ScS*、P*等特征，2小时与8小时模拟波形相关系数达1.0，对跖核全面采样地幔与地核。

Simulations are limited to 2D with an artificial low-Vs outer core (0.1 km/s), uniform effective source assumptions, and high computational/storage costs requiring 6 wavefield simulations per station pair.
局限于二维模拟、外核低横波速度近似及均匀震源假设，且单台站对需模拟并存储6个波场。

First direct forward modeling and adjoint finite-frequency sensitivity kernel formulation for earthquake coda-correlation body-wave features, bypassing late-coda waveform cross-correlation and enabling 3D deep-Earth coda-correlation tomography.
首次建立地震尾波互相关体波特征的直接正演与伴随有限频敏感度核计算框架，为三维深部地球层析成像奠定基础。

kc: Developed a direct two-step forward modeling framework for the earthquake coda-correlation wavefield that bypasses conventional simulation-then-correlation stacking.
Derived finite-frequency traveltime banana-doughnut sensitivity kernels for density, Vp, and Vs of coda-correlation features using adjoint methods.
Demonstrated that coda-correlation features extensively sample the deep mantle, outer core, and inner core, especially for antipodal stations, confirming they are not inter-station Green's functions.
开发了地震尾波互相关波场的两步直接正演模拟框架，无需传统的先模拟长地震图再互相关叠加流程。
利用伴随方法推导了尾波互相关特征对密度、纵波速度和横波速度的有限频走时敏感度核。
证明尾波互相关特征（尤其是对跖台站对）广泛采样深部地幔、外核和内核，证实其并非台站间重构的格林函数。
me: Two-step direct forward simulation of coda-correlation wavefields using a time-reversed generating wavefield as a uniformly weighted distributed source in Earth's interior.
Adjoint-state method to compute symmetrized Fréchet sensitivity kernels for traveltime perturbations with respect to density, P-wave velocity, and S-wave velocity.
2D P-SV viscoelastic spectral-element numerical modeling (SpecFem2D) in a modified ak135f model with a low-Vs approximation for the fluid outer core.
将时间反转的生成波场作为地球内部均匀加权的分布式震源，进行尾波互相关波场的两步直接正演模拟。
应用伴随状态法计算走时扰动对密度、P波速度和S波速度的对称化Fréchet敏感度核。

Validation comparison between direct 2-hour forward simulations and conventional cross-correlation of 3–9 hour late-coda waveforms (bandpass filtered at 22.5–50 s).
Computation of partial and symmetric sensitivity kernels for prominent correlation features (e.g., P*, ScS*, I1*) at inter-station distances of 30°, 130°, and 180°.
在ak135f模型中使用SpecFem2D和1441个地表均匀分布台站开展二维合成数值实验。
将2小时直接正演模拟结果与传统的3–9小时尾波互相关方法结果在22.5–50秒频带内进行对比验证。
计算了30°、130°和180°台间距下显著互相关特征（如P*、ScS*、I1*）的部分及对称完整敏感度核。
li: Numerical experiments are restricted to 2D P-SV wave propagation due to computational constraints, differing from 3D in geometric spreading.
The fluid outer core is approximated as a solid with artificially low S-wave velocity (0.1 km/s) to avoid numerical instabilities.
Assumes a spatially uniform effective source distribution throughout the Earth, which may introduce bias if earthquake catalogs are sparse or clustered.
High computational and disk storage demands, requiring 6 wavefield simulations and archiving per station pair for complete symmetric kernels.
受计算资源限制，数值实验仅在二维P-SV波场中进行，几何扩散等特性与三维存在差异。
液态外核采用人工低横波速度（0.1 km/s）的固体近似以避免数值不稳定。
假设有效震源在地球内部均匀分布，在地震分布稀疏或丛集时可能引入偏差。
计算与磁盘存储开销巨大，每个台站对需模拟并存储6个波场以获取完整的对称敏感度核。

tm.why: The paper derives finite-frequency traveltime banana-doughnut sensitivity kernels using adjoint methods for earthquake coda-correlation features.
The work focuses on seismic interferometry of the earthquake coda-correlation wavefield and compares its theoretical foundation to ambient noise correlation.

sum: Shallow coseismic slip deficit (SSDc)—the depletion of earthquake slip in the uppermost crust relative to peak slip at depth—has traditionally been attributed to off-fault inelastic deformation on immature faults based on <30 events. To rigorously test what controls SSDc, the authors built the largest database to date, comprising 1078 kinematic source models for 163 Mw ≥ 6 continental earthquakes worldwide since 1990 across all slip modes, alongside a database of ruptured fault maturity parameters (initiation age, net displacement, length, slip rate). Multivariate regression analyses reveal that SSDc is primarily an intrinsic geometric property of earthquakes, scaling linearly with the ratio of peak slip depth to theoretical circular crack radius (Zmax/R). Fault maturity only weakly reduces SSDc (by 15%–30% rather than the previously thought 30%–80%). An analytical crack model with zero stress drop in a shallow velocity-strengthening layer reproduces the observations well.
大陆地震浅部同震滑动亏损（SSDc）以往基于不足30个震例被归因于未成熟断层的浅部非弹性变形。本研究构建了迄今最大的震源模型数据库，包含1990年以来全球163次Mw≥6大陆地震的1078个运动学模型，以及发震断层成熟度参数（起始年龄、累积位移、长度、滑动速率）。多元回归分析表明，无论滑动类型如何，……

t: Extracted peak and shallowest slip from 1078 kinematic models to compute normalized coseismic SSD, then performed multivariate power-law regressions against peak slip depth normalized by theoretical crack radius (Zmax/R) and fault maturity parameters.
从1078个运动学模型提取峰值和最浅部滑动计算SSDc，并对Zmax/R及断层成熟度参数进行多元幂律回归。

Compiled 1078 kinematic source models for 163 global continental earthquakes (Mw 6.0–8.1) since 1990 across all slip modes, alongside literature-derived fault maturity parameters (initiation age, cumulative displacement, length, and slip rate).
汇编1990年以来全球163次Mw 6.0–8.1大陆地震的1078个震源模型及文献中的断层成熟度参数。

Average SSD(max) is ~30%. For efficient earthquakes (Zmax/R ≤ 1.35), SSD(max) scales linearly with Zmax/R (R² = 0.93). Fault maturity weakly reduces SSDc (by 15%–30% for Mw 7–7.5 events with Zmaxd 3–5 km).
平均SSD(max)约30%；有效地震的SSDc与Zmax/R呈线性相关（R²=0.93），断层成熟度仅弱幅降低SSDc…
Kinematic source models for a single earthquake exhibit large variability and potential inversion artifacts, while fault maturity parameters carry large, non-quantifiable epistemic uncertainties.
同一地震的运动学反演模型差异大且含假象，断层成熟度参数存在巨大且难以量化的认知不确定性。
First global analysis of 163 earthquakes (1078 models) overturning the paradigm that fault immaturity dominates shallow slip deficit, proving SSDc is primarily a geometric magnitude-depth effect.
首次基于163次地震的大样本推翻未成熟断层主导假说，证明SSDc主要是震级-深度控制的固有几何效应。

kc: Compiled the largest earthquake source model database to date with 1078 kinematic models for 163 Mw ≥ 6 continental earthquakes since 1990, plus a fault maturity database.
Demonstrated that shallow coseismic slip deficit (SSDc) scales linearly with the ratio of peak slip depth to theoretical rupture radius (Zmax/R), making it an intrinsic geometric property.
Showed that fault maturity only weakly governs SSDc (15%–30% difference for typical studied events, much lower than earlier 30%–80% estimates).
Developed empirical charts and an analytical zero-stress-drop shallow velocity-strengthening model to explain SSDc and aid rapid surface slip hazard assessment.
构建了迄今最大的地震震源模型数据库（含1990年以来163次Mw≥6大陆地震的1078个模型）及断层成熟度参数库。
证明浅部同震滑动亏损（SSDc）与峰值滑动深度和理论破裂半径之比（Zmax/R）呈线性相关，属于地震固有几何属性。
揭示断层成熟度对SSDc的控制作用很弱（在典型震例中仅造成15%–30%的差异，远低于此前认为的30%–80%）。
提供了经验预测图件及浅部速度强化层零应力降解析模型，解释了SSDc机制并可用于快速评估地表破裂灾害。
me: Extraction and normalization of along-dip and along-depth maximum and mean slip profiles from 357 tabular and 721 figure-based kinematic source models.
Normalization of peak slip depth (Zmax) by theoretical circular crack radius (R) assuming a constant 3 MPa stress drop.
Univariate and multivariate power-law regressions relating SSDc to Zmax/R, seismic moment (M0), peak slip depth (Zmaxd), and fault maturity metrics.
Analytical semi-circular crack modeling with a shallow velocity-strengthening fault section of thickness H experiencing zero coseismic stress drop.
从357个表格模型和721个图件运动学震源模型中提取并归一化沿倾向和沿深度的最大与平均滑动剖面。
假设恒定3 MPa应力降，利用理论圆裂纹半径（R）对峰值滑动深度（Zmax）进行归一化。
开展单变量和多元幂律回归，量化SSDc与Zmax/R、地震矩（M0）、峰值滑动深度（Zmaxd）及断层成熟度指标的关系。
建立包含厚度为H、同震应力降为零的浅部速度强化断层段的半圆形裂纹解析模型。
de: 1078 published kinematic earthquake source models covering 163 continental earthquakes (Mw 6.0–8.1) worldwide since 1990 (15% normal, 26% reverse, 46% strike-slip, 13% oblique).
Fault maturity database for the 163 ruptured faults containing initiation age, largest cumulative displacement, fault length, and maximum slip rate from literature.
Compilation of postseismic afterslip-to-coseismic moment ratios for a subset of analyzed earthquakes.
1990年以来全球163次Mw 6.0–8.1大陆地震（15%正断、26%逆断、46%走滑、13%斜滑）的1078个已发表运动学震源模型。
通过文献调研构建的163条发震断层成熟度数据库，包含起始年龄、最大累积位移、断层长度和最大滑动速率。
部分所分析地震的震后余滑与同震矩比值汇编数据集。

Large, non-quantifiable epistemic uncertainties in literature-derived fault maturity parameters (age, displacement, length, slip rate).
由于震源反演的不适定性，同一地震的不同运动学震源模型间存在较大差异及潜在滑动假象。
文献来源的断层成熟度参数（年龄、位移、长度、滑动速率）存在较大且难以量化的认知不确定性。

It integrates rebased OPERA DISP-S1 InSAR displacement stacks with PyLith finite-element crustal deformation models. The code reproduces all figures, sensitivity tables, and results of the accompanying paper, and includes a forecasting notebook (Notebook 13) that predicts the timing of the next Tule Pond slow slip event based on data up to October 2026.

sum: This study utilizes 14 years of postseismic seafloor geodetic observations, onshore geodesy, repeating earthquakes, and numerical modeling to delineate the relocking process of the Tohoku megathrust after the 2011 Mw 9.0 earthquake. The authors show how the recovery of locking is interrupted by afterslip and accompanied by viscoelastic relaxation in the upper mantle. Crucially, they find that the megathrust has already returned to a locking state similar to its pre-earthquake level, despite ongoing stress relaxation. This provides key insights into the physics of megathrust earthquake cycles.
本研究利用14年的震后海底大地测量观测、陆地大地测量、重复地震分析和数值模拟，刻画了2011年日本东北Mw 9.0大地震后俯冲带超大逆断层的重新锁定过程。研究表明，锁定的恢复受到断层余滑的干扰，并伴随着上地幔的粘弹性应力松弛。关键发现是，尽管应力松弛仍在持续，该超大逆断层目前已恢复到与震前相似的锁定……

结合14年海底与陆地大地测量数据、重复地震及粘弹性数值模拟的联合分析。

sum: This study investigates the 2022 unrest episode at Ruapehu volcano, New Zealand, characterized by intense seismic tremor, harmonic tremor, and 'drumbeats.' To overcome the limitations of conventional location methods on emergent tremor signals with a sparse network, the authors apply the network covariance matrix method. They successfully isolate and locate the tremor sources, finding that low-level tremor began three months prior to the main unrest, coinciding with a deep earthquake swarm. During the unrest, tremor and drumbeats were continuously located at shallow depths. This application demonstrates the utility of network covariance analysis for tracking volcanic unrest and improving monitoring.
本研究针对新西兰鲁阿佩胡火山2022年的活跃期进行了分析，该时期以强烈的地震微震、谐波微震和“鼓点”信号为特征。针对稀疏台网下渐变微震信号定位困难的问题，研究采用网络协方差矩阵方法对微震源进行隔离与定位。结果表明，低水平微震在活跃期前3个月就已开始，并与深部地震群重合；而在活跃期内，微震和“鼓点”信……

t: The network covariance matrix method is used to isolate and locate emergent volcanic tremor and drumbeat sources.

Seismic network data recording the 2022 unrest episode, tremor, and crater lake heating cycle at Ruapehu volcano.
记录了鲁阿佩胡火山2022年活跃期、微震和火山口湖加热循环的地震台网数据。

sum: This study investigates the initiation of the 2023 Mw 7.8 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye, earthquake. Using InSAR, pixel tracking, and strong-motion data, the authors model the slip distribution of the preparatory Mw 6.8 Narlı fault (NF) rupture. The NF rupture began at 10 km depth on a blind normal fault before transitioning to left-lateral slip and propagating northward. This subshear rupture increased the Coulomb failure stress on the East Anatolian fault (EAF) by approximately 2 MPa. The main EAF rupture initiated 17.2 seconds later near the intersection, demonstrating rapid, near-instantaneous triggering. The work highlights the complex, multi-fault initiation process of major earthquakes.
本文研究了2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什Mw 7.8地震的起动机制。作者结合InSAR、像素跟踪和近断层强震动数据，模拟了纳尔勒断层（NF）Mw 6.8前导破裂的滑动分布。结果表明，NF破裂始于10公里深处的隐伏正断层，随后转为左旋走滑并向北传播。该亚剪切破裂使东安纳托利亚断层（EAF）上的库仑应力……

结合InSAR和像素跟踪的断层滑动联合建模，并结合库仑应力变化计算和强震动时间分析。
Geodetic data (InSAR and pixel tracking) and seismic waveforms from two near-fault strong-motion stations.

sum: This study investigates lower-crustal magmatic modification along the northern South China Sea margin using joint refraction-reflection travel-time tomography with adaptive importance sampling on the OR1-999-6 profile. The resulting ensemble-constrained velocity structure resolves three discrete lower-crustal high-velocity layers (HVLs) rather than a uniform layer. By integrating crustal thickness and lower-crustal velocity covariation with melting models, the authors quantitatively assess mantle and lithospheric controls. The preferred models suggest a proximal-to-distal transition from melting beneath a thicker inherited lithospheric lid with strong lower-continental-crust contamination to depleted-mantle-dominated melting with negligible lid restriction at moderate temperatures. This links segmented HVLs to progressive source-lid reorganization during rifting-to-spreading evolution.
本研究对南海北部剖面进行联合走时断层成像，获得系综约束的地壳速度结构，发现三个离散的下地壳高波速层。结合地壳厚度-速度协变与熔融模型，定量评估了地幔和岩石圈控制。结果表明，从近端到远端，熔融从较厚岩石圈下的地壳污染型向中温、无盖层限制的亏损地幔主导型转变，揭示了裂陷至扩张中的渐进源-盖重组。

t: Joint refraction-reflection travel-time tomography with adaptive importance sampling is used to obtain an ensemble-constrained crustal velocity structure.
采用自适应重要性采样的联合折射-反射走时断层成像，获取系综约束的地壳速度结构。
Active-source seismic refraction and reflection data along the OR1-999-6 profile across the continent-ocean transition of the northern South China Sea.
横跨南海北部陆洋过渡带的OR1-999-6剖面主动源地震折射和反射数据。
The model resolves three discrete lower-crustal high-velocity layers, indicating a proximal-to-distal transition from lid-restricted, contaminated melting to depleted-mantle-dominated melting.
解析出三个离散的下地壳高速层，指示了从受盖层限制、受污染熔融向亏损地幔主导熔融的转变。
The analysis is limited to a 2D profile and relies on simplified assumptions of regional mantle compositions and lithospheric lid thickness.

sum: This study investigates 8 years of post-seismic deformation following the 2014 Mw 8.1 Iquique earthquake in northern Chile and Bolivia by combining Sentinel-1 InSAR (2014–2019) and 25 GNSS station time series (2010–2022). Using a 2D finite-element model in PyLith, the authors jointly simulate kinematic afterslip and viscoelastic relaxation across five structural domains, performing a systematic 10-parameter sensitivity exploration. They demonstrate that reproducing the spatial and temporal evolution of vertical uplift requires both an elastic forearc wedge ('cold nose') extending to a slab-mantle decoupling depth of 84 km and a low-viscosity weak zone beneath the Western Cordillera and Altiplano (below a 25 km elastic crust). Crucially, this weak zone must be governed by a transient Burgers rheology (Kelvin viscosity 2e18 Pa s, Maxwell viscosity 2e19 Pa s) rather than a simple Maxwell rheology to match early-stage uplift.
本研究结合Sentinel-1 InSAR（2014–2019年）和25个GNSS台站时间序列（2010–2022年），分析了2014年Mw 8.1伊基克地震后8年的震后形变。作者利用PyLith建立二维有限元模型，联合模拟了断层后滑和粘弹性松弛，并对10个几何与流变参数进行了系统敏感性探索。结果表……

t: Developed a 2D finite-element model in PyLith 2.2.2 to simulate coseismic/viscoelastic relaxation and kinematic afterslip separately, exploring 10 geometric and rheological parameters against GNSS and InSAR data.
在PyLith中建立二维有限元模型，分别模拟粘弹性松弛和运动学后滑，并对10个参数进行敏感性探索。
Processed 5+ years of Sentinel-1 InSAR (tracks A149 and D054, Oct 2014–Dec 2019) using NSBAS and 8 years of post-seismic GNSS time series from 25 stations in Chile and Bolivia.

The preferred model features a 25 km thick Altiplano elastic layer, an 84 km deep cold nose limit, and a Burgers weak zone with Kelvin viscosity 2e18 Pa s and Maxwell viscosity 2e19 Pa s.

Gravitational body forces are excluded to avoid numerical instability, and the 3D subduction process is simplified into a 2D cross-sectional model without poroelasticity.

在PyLith中开展了10个参数的二维有限元敏感性探索，区分了运动学震后滑移与粘弹性松弛的贡献。

sum: This study presents enhanced 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs tomographic models of the complex subduction system beneath Sulawesi Island, Indonesia. By inverting approximately 300,000 P- and S-wave arrival times recorded by 144 stations, the authors image the Banggai-Sula subduction system and investigate the relationship between the Celebes Sea subduction and regional volcanic processes. The resulting high-resolution models reveal seismic velocity anomalies associated with partial melting and continental subduction. They also suggest a potential connection between the Colo/Una-Una volcanic system beneath Gorontalo Bay and the Celebes Sea subduction. These findings provide new constraints on the magmatic source of Colo Volcano, support tectonic interpretations of microcontinental subduction, and offer an improved velocity model for regional earthquake monitoring.

sum: The 2022 Mw 6.1 Pasaman earthquake in Sumatra is analyzed using a joint inversion of InSAR and GNSS data via the FaultResampler framework. The study reveals that coseismic slip was concentrated at shallow depths (0–5 km) within Miocene volcanic rocks, with a peak slip of 0.72 m. Crucially, the rupture was arrested by lithological barriers, specifically Pleistocene–Holocene volcanic deposits, intrusive microgranite, and metasediments. The earthquake occurred on a previously unrecognized 45-km-long fault segment and transferred stress to adjacent locked segments of the Sumatran fault zone, increasing regional seismic hazard. This work highlights the role of material heterogeneity in controlling earthquake rupture limits.
本研究利用InSAR和GNSS数据，通过FaultResampler框架联合反演了2022年苏门答腊Mw 6.1巴萨曼地震的同震滑动分布。结果表明，同震滑动主要集中在0-5公里的浅部中新世火山岩中，最大滑动量为0.72米。破裂在更新世-全新世火山沉积物、侵入微花岗岩和变质沉积物的非均匀性边界处停止。……

sum: This study quantifies irrigation-driven land subsidence in the Barind Tract, northwest Bangladesh, using ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR networks from 2017 to 2025, tied to a continuous GNSS station. The vertical velocity maps reveal a median subsidence rate of -10.1 mm/yr, with over half the area subsiding faster than 10 mm/yr. The seasonal ground deformation lags groundwater storage minimums by three to four months, indicating delayed aquitard drainage. Using Random Forest and XGBoost models with spatial block cross-validation and SHAP analysis, the authors identify elevation, built-up density, and Boro irrigation intensity as the primary controls on subsidence. The study highlights the importance of spatial cross-validation and cross-track consistency in machine learning-based geodetic interpretations.
本研究利用2017-2025年升降轨Sentinel-1 InSAR数据并结合GNSS基准，量化了孟加拉国西北部巴林德地区的灌溉型地面沉降。结果显示中值沉降速率为-10.1 mm/yr，超过51%的区域沉降速率大于10 mm/yr。季节性形变滞后于地下水储量最小值3-4个月，符合弱透水层延迟排水特征……

sum: This study investigates the distribution and development characteristics of loess seismic landslides triggered by the historical 1622 M 7 earthquake in Northern Guyuan, Northwest China. By mapping and analyzing landslide locations, the authors evaluate how topographic, geological, and seismic factors influenced landslide occurrence. The findings provide critical insights into the mechanisms of loess landslides under strong seismic shaking and contribute to seismic hazard assessment and mitigation strategies in the loess-covered regions of Northwest China.
