sum: This study presents new Early Cretaceous paleomagnetic data from the Jiuxi Basin to investigate the tectonic deformation and sinistral strike-slip history of the Altyn Tagh Fault. By analyzing the paleomagnetic directions and comparing them with the coeval Eurasian reference pole, the authors constrain the regional vertical-axis rotation and lateral displacement along this major strike-slip system. The results provide crucial observational constraints on the Mesozoic-Cenozoic tectonic evolution of the northern Tibetan Plateau.
本研究利用甘肃九西盆地下白垩统地层的全新古地磁数据，探讨了阿尔金断裂的左旋走滑历史及区域构造变形。通过分析古地磁方向并与欧亚大陆同期参考极进行对比，约束了该区域的垂直轴旋转和沿断裂带的侧向位移。研究结果为理解青藏高原北部中新生代的构造演化提供了关键的观测约束。

sum: The paper presents RevealLO, a global-scale full-waveform inversion (FWI) model that updates the REVEAL baseline. By extending the inversion time window from 1 hour to 3.5 hours, RevealLO incorporates minor-arc ($R_1, G_1$) and major-arc ($R_2, G_2$) surface waves, alongside late-arriving multi-orbit body waves. This significantly improves azimuthal coverage, particularly in the southern hemisphere and ocean basins where receiver coverage is sparse. Using the spectral-element solver Salvus, 3-D viscoelastic wavefields are simulated on cubed-sphere meshes. The inversion progresses from 100–200 s to 60–200 s period bands using time-frequency phase misfits and a mini-batch stochastic trust-region L-BFGS algorithm. RevealLO successfully mitigates trade-offs between unmodeled azimuthal anisotropy and isotropic structure in the upper and mid mantle while preserving short-period body wave fits.

sum: Classical earthquake models restrict inelastic processes to a single fault plane, requiring prescribed heterogeneities or very small nucleation sizes to generate multiscale seismicity. This study introduces a 2D dynamic seismic cycle model (using SEM2DPACK) that couples rate-and-state fault friction with a continuum damage and healing rheology for surrounding fault zone rocks. When the fault zone is weak (internal friction ~0.2), the coevolution of localized fault slip and distributed off-fault plastic damage spontaneously generates both small and large earthquakes (Mw 2 to 7), including migrating foreshock-mainshock sequences. The simulated catalogs successfully reproduce three fundamental seismological observations without prescribed heterogeneities: a Gutenberg-Richter frequency-magnitude distribution, magnitude-invariant static stress drops (1–20 MPa), and a dual-regime scaling of fracture energy density with slip. These findings demonstrate that off-fault inelastic deformation fundamentally governs earthquake rupture arrest and energy partitioning, highlighting the utility of monitoring fault zone wave speeds.
经典地震模型将非弹性过程限制在断层面上，本研究采用二维谱元法（SEM2DPACK）构建动态地震周期模型，将速率-状态摩擦定律与周围断层带岩石的连续损伤及愈合流变学相结合。模拟数据表明，当断层带较弱（内摩擦系数约0.2）时，断层局部滑动与断层外分布式塑性损伤的协同演化会自发产生2至7级的多尺度地震及前……

t: 2D antiplane spectral-element seismic cycle simulations (SEM2DPACK) coupling rate-and-state fault friction with continuum damage rheology, Drucker-Prager plasticity, and interseismic healing in surrounding fault zone rocks.
采用SEM2DPACK进行二维谱元地震周期模拟，耦合速率-状态摩擦与连续损伤愈合流变学。

Synthetic catalogs of 693 simulated earthquakes across eight parameter combinations varying friction, cohesion, normal stress, preexisting low-velocity zone rigidity reduction, and characteristic weakening distance, compared against real earthquake source observations.
改变摩擦、内聚力、孔隙压力等参数生成的8个模型共693个合成地震目录及真实观测对比。

Weak fault zones (friction ~0.2) spontaneously generate Mw 2–7 earthquakes following Gutenberg-Richter statistics (b = 0.45), magnitude-invariant stress drops (1–20 MPa), and dual-regime fracture energy scaling with slip (exponents ~1.30 and ~0.62).
弱断层带自发产生Mw 2–7地震，符合G-R定律(b=0.45)、恒定应力降(1–20 MPa)及断裂能双重标度。
The 2D single-fault model omits explicit discrete secondary fault networks and 3D along-strike variations, artificially capping maximum magnitudes near Mw 7 and yielding a low b-value (0.45).
二维单断层模型忽略了次级断层网络和三维走向变化，限制最大震级在Mw 7附近。

First demonstration that spontaneous coevolution of on-fault slip and off-fault continuum damage/healing in weak fault zones reproduces multiscale seismicity and empirical source scaling laws without prescribed fault heterogeneities.
首次证明无需预设非均质性，弱断层带滑动与损伤演化即可重现多尺度地震及震源标度律。

kc: Demonstrates that spontaneous off-fault damage and healing in weak fault zones generate multiscale seismicity (Mw 2–7) without prescribed frictional or geometric heterogeneities.
Reproduces three fundamental observational constraints in a unified physical framework: Gutenberg-Richter statistics, magnitude-invariant stress drops, and dual-regime fracture energy scaling.
Shows that coseismic off-fault damage accumulation near the rupture front dissipates energy and promotes self-arrest of small earthquakes, driving foreshock migration.
Reveals that smaller earthquakes dissipate a higher proportion of fracture energy as off-fault plastic strain compared to larger earthquakes.
证明了弱断层带中断层外自发损伤和愈合无需预设摩擦或几何非均质性即可产生多尺度地震活动（Mw 2–7）。
在统一物理框架内重现了三个基本观测约束：古登堡-里克特统计、与震级无关的应力降以及双重机制的断裂能标度律。
表明破裂前缘附近的同震断层外损伤积累会耗散能量并促进小地震的自发停止，从而驱动前震迁移。
揭示了与大地震相比，小地震通过断层外塑性应变耗散的断裂能比例更高。
me: 2D antiplane fully dynamic seismic cycle modeling using the spectral element package SEM2DPACK.
Rate-and-state friction with the aging law regularized at zero slip velocity on the main vertical strike-slip fault.
Continuum damage and healing rheology coupled with Drucker-Prager plasticity in the surrounding fault zone.
Statistical and source parameter analysis including Q-Q plots, maximum likelihood b-value estimation, slip-weighted stress drop, and breakdown/plastic energy partitioning.
使用谱元软件包SEM2DPACK进行二维反平面完全动态地震周期建模。
在主垂直走滑断层上应用在零滑动速度下正则化的老化律速率-状态摩擦。
在周围断层带中结合Drucker-Prager塑性的连续损伤和愈合流变学。
统计和震源参数分析，包括Q-Q图、最大似然b值估计、滑动加权应力降以及破裂能/塑性能量分配。
de: Synthetic earthquake catalogs (e.g., 693 events across Models 1 to 8) generated by varying friction coefficient, cohesion, pore-pressure ratio, preexisting rigidity reduction, and characteristic weakening distance.
Control simulations with fixed fault frictional strength (f0 = 0.6) to isolate the effect of off-fault bulk internal friction.
Comparison of synthetic fracture energy scaling against published real-earthquake datasets (Friuli seismicity, Loma Prieta aftershocks, and large crustal earthquakes).
通过改变摩擦系数、内聚力、孔隙压力比、先存刚度折减和特征弱化距离生成的合成地震目录（如模型1至8中的693个事件）。
固定断层摩擦强度（f0 = 0.6）的控制模拟，以分离断层外体相内摩擦的影响。
将合成断裂能标度与已发表的真实地震数据集（Friuli地震活动、Loma Prieta余震和大型地壳地震）进行比较。
li: The model includes only a single planar main fault and uses continuum damage rather than explicitly modeling discrete secondary fault networks.
Simulations are restricted to 2D antiplane geometry to reduce computational cost, neglecting 3D along-strike variability and capping rupture dimensions at the seismogenic width (~Mw 7).
The simulated Gutenberg-Richter b-value (0.45) is smaller than the global average (~1.0), likely due to the 2D geometry and absence of prescribed small-scale heterogeneities.
该模型仅包含单一平面主断层，并使用连续损伤而非显式建模离散次级断层网络。
为降低计算成本，模拟局限于二维反平面几何，忽略了三维沿走向变化并将破裂尺寸限制在发震层宽度（约Mw 7）。
模拟的古登堡-里克特b值（0.45）小于全球平均值（约1.0），这可能是由于二维几何结构和缺乏预设的小尺度非均质性所致。

tm.why: The paper investigates earthquake rupture arrest, stress drop, and fracture energy scaling across small and large magnitudes.
The study simulates multi-cycle fault mechanics combining rate-and-state friction with continuum damage and healing rheology in weak fault zones.
The authors use 2D spectral element dynamic seismic cycle simulations (SEM2DPACK) capturing both quasistatic deformation and dynamic seismic wave radiation.
